jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

jobs.title: Représentant(e) en prospection commerciale
jobs.excerpt: Tu désires côtoyer des gens passionnés?  Évoluer en tant que professionnel dans un environnement moderne qui favorise la conciliation travail-vie personnelle?
jobs.description:
Tu désires côtoyer des gens passionnés? Évoluer en tant que professionnel dans un environnement moderne qui favorise la conciliation travail-vie personnelle? Faire partie de l'équipe Unicorne, c'est tout ça, et encore plus! Télétravail, mentorat, horaires flexibles, formations payées, hackathon, une équipe authentique et professionnelle… Voilà notre quotidien et notre mission.

Chez Unicorne, les défis ne manquent pas et on s'amuse en changeant le monde un compte AWS à la fois. Nous accompagnons nos clients et partenaires dans leur utilisation de l'infonuagique, afin d'innover plus efficacement et atteindre des résultats tangibles. Que ce soit en développant des solutions SaaS complètes ou en optimisant des infrastructures AWS, nous travaillons avec des technologies de pointe à tous les jours et générons diverses sources de revenus récurrents.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) représentant(e) en prospection commerciale (SDR) pour collaborer étroitement avec le Vice-Président Croissance. Tu seras la première ligne de contact avec nos prospects. Ton rôle : ouvrir des conversations qui comptent, créer des opportunités, et nourrir le pipeline de ventes. Tu seras coaché pour devenir une machine à qualifier, comprendre les besoins clients, et connecter avec les bons décideurs.

Ton quotidien

  • Générer et qualifier des opportunités en faisant de la prospection active (cold calling, emails, LinkedIn)
  • Effectuer un volume élevé d'appels quotidiens
  • Identifier et cibler les bons comptes à l'aide d'outils modernes
  • Utiliser des scripts de vente et les adapter selon les conversations
  • Surmonter les objections initiales et susciter l'intérêt pour les solutions Unicorne
  • Qualifier les prospects selon la méthodologie établie (besoins, budget, autorité, timeline)
  • Planifier des rencontres entre prospects qualifiés et l'équipe de ventes
  • Préparer des briefings complets pour l'équipe de ventes (contexte, besoins, opportunités)
  • Maintenir le CRM propre, à jour et actionnable
  • Gérer le suivi, relancer, et adapter ton approche selon la personnalité du prospect
  • Entretenir des relations fortes pour maximiser le potentiel de nos clients, de nos partenaires et d'AWS
  • Participer activement à la stratégie d'outbound (et proposer tes idées!)
  • Suivre et rapporter les métriques de performance quotidiennes/hebdomadaires

Profil recherché

  • Diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC) ou universitaire en vente, marketing, administration ou domaine connexe
  • 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la vente
  • Autonome, organisé(e) et orienté(e) résultats
  • Bilingue français/anglais, autant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit et excellentes compétences en communication verbale
  • Résilience et persévérance face aux refus
  • Capacité à établir rapidement un rapport et susciter l'intérêt
  • Expérience en cold calling ou prospection téléphonique (atout majeur)
  • Maîtrise des outils CRM (HubSpot ou équivalent)
  • Aisance avec les outils de communication (téléphone, email, LinkedIn)
  • Expérience dans le secteur technologique ou SaaS(atout)

Pourquoi tu vas aimer ce poste

Tu ne seras pas laissé(e) à toi-même. Tu recevras une formation continue sur les techniques de prospection, tu auras accès à un stack moderne d'outils , et tu évolueras dans une culture de feedback et d'amélioration continue. Le rôle est évolutif : si tu performes, on te prépare pour la suite de ta carrière en vente. C'est un tremplin vers d'autres rôles en ventes avec un développement de compétences transférables en vente B2B.

Notre offre

En plus des défis stimulants, des technologies modernes et une équipe fantastique, nous offrons :

  • Télétravail à 100%
  • Poste permanent 35 à 40 heures par semaine avec un vrai horaire flexible
  • 4 semaines de vacances
  • 1 semaine de congés personnels
  • 14 journées fériées par année, dont 7 pendant la période des fêtes
  • REER collectif (contribution employeur jusqu'à 2%)
  • Assurances collectives (payées à 50%) avec télémédecine
  • MacBook Pro et tout le matériel nécessaire fourni dont un cellulaire payé
  • Allocation annuelle pour améliorer ton espace de télétravail
  • Accès à un espace de coworking une fois par semaine
  • Club social très actif
  • Formations continues payées, incluant les certifications AWS

jobs.title: Lead Motion & Graphic Designer
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.

What you will do

  • Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
  • Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
  • Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
  • Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
  • Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
  • Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
  • Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
  • Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
  • English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

Nice to have

  • Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
  • AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
  • Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

jobs.excerpt: • Lead IT infrastructure projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and best practices.
jobs.description:
• Lead IT infrastructure projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership in cloud adoption, migration strategies, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Optimize cloud costs, performance, and security through continuous assessment and innovation.
  • Implement and enforce cloud governance, compliance, and security frameworks.
  • Automate cloud infrastructure deployment and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
  • Troubleshoot complex system and network issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with IT and application teams to improve infrastructure automation, deployment processes, and operational workflows.
  • Develop and enforce IT policies, procedures, and best practices for cloud operations.
  • Administer, configure, and support SharePoint Online, including site architecture, permissions, governance, security, lifecycle management, and integration with Microsoft 365 services.
  • Provide Tier 3 administration and advanced technical support for the Microsoft 365 environment, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive for Business, identity and access management, security, compliance, and complex incident resolution.
  • Participate in internal and external audits by providing IT technical support, required documentation, system evidence, and timely responses to audit inquiries.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical training to the IT team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in IT system engineering, cloud architecture, or a related role.
  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including Virtual Machines, Azure AD, Networking, Storage, and Security.
  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with SharePoint Online administration, site architecture, permissions, governance, security, and integration with Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
  • Strong experience in automation and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or similar languages.
  • Deep understanding of networking concepts, security protocols, VPNs, and firewall management.
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps practices and cloud automation.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise-level IT infrastructure, virtualization, and containerization.
  • Experience with cloud cost management and optimization strategies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a leadership capacity.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 framework.
  • Advanced Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-305, AZ-400, and SC-500) are highly desirable.
  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud strategies and solutions.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions (M&A), including IT due diligence, infrastructure integration, tenant migrations, and technology consolidation, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and enterprise IT frameworks.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote working in the UK

Salary: £30,204.75 rising to £32,692 after 1 year of service

Responsible to: Head of Programme Support

Contract type: Full Time (37 hours per week), Fixed Term until August 2027 with the possiblity to extend

Closing date: 6 November 2026, Midday

Interviews: We will be interviewing on a rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible

Who we are

Futures For All is the largest social mobility charity in the UK. We help to level the playing field between state and independent schools by giving all young people access to the same prestigious networks available to the top fee-paying schools.

We believe that by inspiring young people to explore their ambitions through our speaker programme, facilitating access to multi-day experiences of the world of work, and supporting young people to successfully seize opportunities available to them, then we can make a profound difference to the lives of young people, their future happiness and prosperity.

By 2028, our ambition is that every young person in the UK has access to high quality work experience. Yet today, less than half of young people leave secondary school having had any work experience whatsoever.

Role Summary

This role sits within our Programme Support team and is crucial to the delivery of the charity’s programmes and hosting of virtual and in-person activities for young people. This role involves supporting schools and students as well as stakeholders in the delivery of work experience and charity programmes.

Key Duties / Responsibilities

  • Responding to enquiries from schools and students regarding questions about the application portal registration process and general troubleshooting
  • Helping with technical delivery processes using both our in-house software and that of external partners
  • Stakeholder engagement and management – working closely with organisations to deliver their virtual activities
  • Hosting virtual and in person activities including work experience and talks and supporting clients and the schools with the attendance lists and safeguarding
  • Supporting the technical hosting of virtual activities
  • Creating and developing content and structure of virtual activities and work placement
  • End-to-end technical support for partners, schools, and students
  • Enabling stakeholders in the delivery of work experience and charity programmes
  • Data Management and CRM
  • Inputting new data, maintaining existing records and generating reports
  • Creating bespoke impact reports for each programme (this may vary depending on the client)
  • Responding to and managing stakeholder queries via email and telephone
  • Supporting the delivery of charity programmes
  • Attending client, schools and other charity meetings and reporting of evaluation materials and scheduling of those meetings
  • Providing briefings for teachers/delivery partners, staff and volunteers for each event
  • Ensuring schools have any physical merchandise alongside the online materials available in advance of the sessions
  • Monitor the student and employer volunteer registrations and ensure the relevant paperwork is in place
  • Arrange the schools Data Sharing Agreements
  • Ensure safeguarding processes are followed for the events and that the clients staff have a clear awareness of safeguarding procedures
  • Ensure the prizes and merchandise for the programme are purchased and delivered to the schools
  • Planning in person and virtual events, including creating agendas and working out logistics for the day (this may vary depending on the client)

Skills / Experience / Knowledge:

Essential:

  • Experience of hosting virtual and in-person events for young people
  • Experience in creating and writing content for events
  • Experience in a similar delivery-focused role within a small, fast-paced organisation
  • Experience using Microsoft packages, including Outlook
  • Experience of using CRM software to achieve the tasks outlined above
  • Good customer service skills that mean queries are answered professionally and clearly
  • Excellent organisation skills and ability to learn quickly to ensure smooth delivery processes
  • Flexibility and a willingness to get stuck in and help with any tasks the team require support for
  • Ability to clearly communicate with students to ensure they understand our processes and are able to access opportunities
  • Are sociable and confident and happy building and maintaining relationships with multiple stakeholders
  • Excel at organising their workload and enjoy driving work forward independently

Desirable:

  • Experience of developing and delivering content to young people
  • Experience of working in programme support in education charities
  • Experience of using Salesforce
  • Experience of supporting young people via charity programmes
  • Experience of using Google Classrooms
  • Experience in creating and writing content for events

Diversity at our core

Futures For All is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process and encouraging equality and diversity among our workforces. We acknowledge that some candidates may require additional support to overcome barriers experienced during the application process. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support your application or interview, please reach out to us via

The Application Process:

Please apply as soon as possible by clicking the 'apply for this job' button in the top right-hand corner of the job advert. Once clicked, you will be asked to complete your application by submitting your CV and a cover letter. The cover letter is an opportunity for you to share the skills and knowledge you have to be successful in this role. Appointees are subject to a DBS check. You must have the right to work in the UK to apply.

The deadline to submit your application is 6 November 2026, Midday. Please note that we reserve the right to close this advertisement early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications

We will be interviewing on a rolling basis. Please apply as soon as possible.

Futures For All is committed to safeguarding the young people we work with and expects all staff members to share this commitment. Appointees are subject to a DBS check. Having a criminal record will not automatically exclude applicants. You are also required to have the Right to Work in the UK for this role.

Benefits offered at Futures For All

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Morning of your birthday off
  • £500 a year professional development fund
  • Option to purchase additional annual leave yearly
  • 'Winter shutdown' gifted so no need to use annual leave between Christmas and new years eve.
  • Early bank holiday finish - we finish at 3:30pm on a Friday before all bank holidays
  • 22.2 hours of volunteering days to use each year
  • Home office set up support
  • Enhanced sick pay
  • Enhanced family friendly leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Futures For All Values

PASSION: We are committed to levelling the playing field for young people across the UK, creating social mobility and tackling disadvantages.

AGILITY: We challenge our ideas of what is possible in order to better meet the needs of those we support. We are human, make mistakes, learn, evolve and adapt.

INTEGRITY: We act with empathy and bring our authentic selves to work every day. We value and respect the talent, time and intentions of those we work with.

COLLABORATION: We are one team with one mission and only by working together can we deliver better outcomes for young people. We support each other unconditionally and feel motivation in shared success as well as individual progress.

DIVERSITY: We know it takes people with different ideas, strengths, identities, interests, and cultural backgrounds to make our organisation succeed. We encourage constructive debate and critical friendship.

jobs.title: Software Publisher Services – Program Associate / Senior Associate
jobs.excerpt: Position Overview:Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals.
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals. This role sits within the Software Publisher Services (SPS) line of business and is dedicated to a single, high-volume compliance program delivered on behalf of a global enterprise software publisher.

This is a platform-led program rather than a traditional audit role. Licensees complete their own compliance review through a dedicated audit platform, and the Program Associate drives that process end to end. You will own a large portfolio of engagements over the course of the year, with a large number active at any given time, and you will be accountable for getting each one started, unstuck, and closed. The work is high-cadence and relationship-driven: daily outreach, structured follow-up, clear escalation, and disciplined tracking. It is a strong fit for someone from a compliance, audit support, renewals or customer success background who is energized by volume, ownership, and consistent execution.

This is also a build role. The program is expanding, and the person who establishes the operating rhythm in the US will be positioned to add supporting staff and grow into a Manager role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of active compliance engagements and drive each one from initial outreach through closure against defined cycle-time and service level targets.
  • Conduct daily outreach and structured follow-up with licensee contacts by email and phone, maintaining persistent and professional contact cadences on unresponsive accounts and applying defined escalation triggers.
  • Onboard licensees onto the audit platform: explain the process and timeline, direct them to the platform, walk them through the required inputs, and resolve access or usability issues that stall completion.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for licensee questions, objections, and concerns; handle pushback diplomatically and escalate contractual, disputed, or legal matters to the Senior Manager.
  • Lead the verification call with the licensee to confirm and clarify the data submitted through the platform.
  • Identify licensees unwilling or unable to use the platform and coordinate the exception path to a standard, manually executed review with the engagement team.
  • Review submissions for completeness and obvious anomalies, apply the program’s standardized methodology and templates, and prepare findings for Senior Manager review.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account status, contact history, and next actions in Connor’s engagement platform as the single system of record for the program.
  • Produce recurring program reporting for the client and internal leadership, including pipeline by stage, aging, response and completion rates, and results to date.
  • Monitor throughput, flag bottlenecks and recurring licensee objections, and recommend improvements to outreach templates, platform guidance, and process documentation.
  • Support the onboarding and day-to-day direction of additional program staff as the program scales.
  • Other duties may be assigned without notice.
  • Senior Associate: Carry a larger portfolio, own the most sensitive or highest-value accounts, quality review the work of supporting staff, and act as backup program lead.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • BA/BS in Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 2+ years in software license compliance, contract or audit compliance support, customer success, account management, renewals, inside sales, or a comparable high-volume client-facing role.
  • Exposure to software licensing concepts and contract terms. Prior license compliance or software asset management experience is preferred but not required; the ability to learn a publisher’s licensing model quickly is essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of concurrent accounts or cases without loss of accuracy or follow-through.
  • Comfort working from a repeatable playbook: applying the same process consistently across hundreds of accounts while recognizing the exceptions that require escalation.
  • Fluency with CRM, ticketing, or case management platforms (for example Salesforce, HubSpot, Monday.com, or Zendesk) and a track record of disciplined data hygiene.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite with solid Excel skills including lookups and pivot tables. Advanced modeling is not required.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to maintain a consistent and professional tone across a high volume of outbound correspondence.
  • Confident verbal communication and the ability to lead a call with a licensee’s technical, procurement, or finance contacts.
  • Professional persistence: comfortable following up repeatedly with unresponsive contacts and navigating resistance without escalating tension.
  • Self-directed, organized, and reliable with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Based in and available to work United States business hours, with occasional flexibility for licensees in other regions.
  • Minimal travel expected, up to 10%.

Preferred Additional Experience

  • Prior experience on a publisher-side or Big 4 software license compliance team.
  • Experience supporting customers through a self-service or customer-completed data collection platform.
  • Familiarity with common software deployment and usage data sources.
  • Second language capability (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, or Polish) in view of planned EMEA expansion.

Competencies and Skills

  • Ownership mentality; treats the assigned portfolio as a book of business to be advanced every day
  • Consistency and follow-through
  • Resilience in the face of non-response, delay, and pushback
  • Strong organization and prioritization across many small, simultaneous commitments
  • Clear and concise communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate
  • Collaborative and professional demeanor with clients, licensees, and internal teams
  • Genuine interest in process improvement and in building something repeatable and scalable

Measures of Success

  • First 30 days: Program mechanics and licensing model learned, platform fluency established, outreach templates in use, and the full portfolio loaded and accurate in the engagement platform.
  • First 60 days: Daily outreach cadence running consistently, the first cohort of licensees onboarded to the platform and submitting data, and program reporting delivered on schedule.

Whilst initially this role is scoped to DTCommand, there is also the opportunity for the scope to broaden in the future. This role represents a genuine growth opportunity for someone who wants more than a single product to own long term.


Whilst this is a remote role, flexibility to attend our Telford office and meet with customers, partners and suppliers as required is important. We're looking for someone who is proactive in building relationships and maintaining a visible presence across the business, recognising when face-to-face engagement adds value.

Key Responsibilities

Ownership
  • Own the delivery of DTCommand, taking the agreed roadmap through to launch and into live service alongside development teams and design
  • Manage the backlog and plan releases, making sure work is clearly defined, scoped, and ready for development teams to deliver
  • Track DTCommand's KPIs post-launch and report of the KPIs, flagging where performance points to a change in direction
  • Bring customer insight and a delivery perspective into the product direction.

Customer understanding
  • Build a genuine, ongoing habit of speaking to customers, both direct and indirect, rather than treating it as an occasional check-in
  • Use what you learn to sense-check ideas early, through conversations, prototypes, or small experiments, before asking development teams to build something at full scale
  • Take the time to properly understand a problem before jumping to a solution, so the team isn't just building the first idea that comes up

Working with the team

Prioritisation and roadmap
  • Work with the product team on prioritisation across the needs of the business, bringing recommendations that balance customer value, commercial impact, and delivery capacity

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential:
  • 3+ years in Product Management, with a track record of taking products from requirements through to successful launch
  • Experience regularly speaking with customers and using that insight to shape decisions and priorities
  • Comfortable working closely with Engineering / Development teams and design from early on, not just briefing them once decisions are made

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.

We are seeking experienced, detail-oriented Virtual Medical Assistants to support a growing U.S.-based pulmonary specialty practice operating across three clinic locations.

  • Process medical records requests from insurance companies, referring providers, and patients accurately and within required timelines.

  • Collaborate with clinic supervisors, billing personnel, and fellow Virtual Medical Assistants to ensure smooth communication across multiple locations.

  • Provide backup inbound call coverage during peak hours while balancing assigned medical records and administrative responsibilities.

  • Maintain accurate EMR documentation and contribute to developing standard operating procedures (SOPs) for consistent and efficient workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices in similar clinical administrative functions.

  • Hands-on experience in patient communication, inbound call handling, medical records processing, or related medical administrative workflows.

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with a professional, empathetic, and patient-centered approach.

  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare workflows, medical terminology, patient confidentiality, and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize time-sensitive requests, and work independently in a high-volume remote healthcare environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AthenaHealth EMR for patient messaging, clinical documentation, or administrative workflows.

  • Previous experience supporting pulmonology practices or other U.S. specialty outpatient clinics.

  • Experience coordinating with billing departments, clinic supervisors, and remote healthcare teams.

Technical & Work-From-Home Requirements

  • Computer or laptop with at least an Intel Core i5 processor or equivalent/higher.

  • Reliable high-speed primary internet connection with a dedicated backup internet source.

  • Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or reliable backup power solution.

  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for handling confidential patient information and inbound calls.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, highly organized, and confident communicating with patients over the phone. You should be comfortable transitioning between live patient calls and back-office administrative responsibilities while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and a strong commitment to patient service.

Snif is setting the new standard in fine fragrance. The search for high-quality scented products should be simple, accessible, and fun. We bring our customers what they want to smell and develop new, unexpected ways for them to incorporate fine fragrance into their daily routines.
Every scent we develop is designed to be an immersive experience. From the name, packaging design, and creative campaigns to someone’s first spray, we want them to see and smell the quality behind every release. Our formulas are always made with top-shelf ingredients and are genderless, non-toxic, vegan, and cruelty-free.
Snif and its sub-brands are sold on our DTC site . Select products can also be found at Ulta Beauty and on Amazon. We’ve been featured across notable press outlets including Forbes, Fast Co., WWD, Vogue, Allure, Cosmopolitan, NY Mag, Harper’s Bazaar, and more. Additionally, we’re backed by some of the most revered investors in the consumer goods space.
We’re a lean team that’s expanding quickly, and we’re looking for someone who believes in our vision to shift the way people experience scents.

The Role:

As Retail Operations Manager, you will own how our retail orders move from receipt through fulfillment, delivery, and invoicing as we expand our distribution. Success means orders are processed accurately, shipment and invoice requirements are met, and exceptions are resolved early enough to protect retailer commitments.

You will be Snif’s primary owner for retail order execution, responsible for keeping each order moving, resolving operational exceptions within agreed guidelines and escalating inventory allocation, commercial, or spending decisions that require approval. You will work closely with Sales, Procurement and Inventory, Finance, and our manufacturing and fulfillment partners to make sure requirements are clear and commitments are met.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. When inventory is short, an EDI document is rejected, or a shipment is at risk, you will identify the issue early, bring the right partners together, and drive it to resolution.

As Snif expands its retail distribution, you will help shape the processes, reporting, and tools the business relies on, working directly with the VP of Operations to improve how we serve our retail partners.

This role will report directly to the VP of Operations.

While we are based in New York City, we operate as a remote team. This job may require travel ~10-20% of the time depending on business needs.

What You'll Do:

    Order Management and Inventory Coordination
  • Own daily order management across our retail channels, including Ulta, Ulta International, Amazon, and future distribution expansion
  • Validate incoming purchase orders against approved item data, pricing, quantities, inventory availability, and delivery requirements; resolve discrepancies before confirming orders
  • Partner with Procurement and Inventory to identify shortages, execute agreed fulfillment priorities, and communicate risks with recommended actions
    • Fulfillment and Retailer Requirements
  • Coordinate with fulfillment providers to meet retailer requirements for order confirmation, routing, labeling, shipping documentation, pickup, and delivery
  • Monitor EDI transactions and retailer portals, resolve missing or rejected documents, and verify that required order, shipment, and invoice information has been successfully received
    • Invoicing and Chargebacks
  • Prepare and submit accurate invoices, reconcile ordered, shipped, and invoiced quantities, and partner with Finance to resolve discrepancies and deductions
  • Investigate operational chargebacks, prepare dispute documentation, track deadlines, and address recurring causes
    • Retail Launch Readiness
  • Own retail order-execution readiness for new retailer and item launches, including operational data checks, test orders, documented workflows, and clear handoffs with Commercialization, Sales, Procurement and Inventory, and fulfillment partners
    • Reporting and Process Improvement
    • Maintain accurate order records and reporting by retailer and distribution center, with clear deadlines, shipment status, exceptions, and next actions
    • Improve procedures, service reporting, and backup coverage; simplify or automate repetitive work and verify that changes improve accuracy and reliability

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in wholesale order management, retail operations, or customer operations within a consumer products business
    • Experience personally managing national retailer orders from receipt through delivery and invoicing, including resolving exceptions across internal teams and fulfillment partners
    • Experience supporting multiple distribution centers and meeting retailer routing and compliance requirements
    • Hands-on experience monitoring EDI transactions, diagnosing operational errors, and working with providers to resolve them
    • Experience working directly with third-party warehouses and transportation partners on fulfillment and delivery issues
    • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including reconciling order, inventory, shipment, and invoice data
    • Sound judgment when priorities compete, with the ability to explain risks, recommend actions, and recognize when a decision requires approval
    • Clear communication, careful attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
    • Examples of improving an operating process, with a clear explanation of your contribution and the resulting change in accuracy, service, or manual effort

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in beauty, fragrance, personal care, or home products
  • Familiarity with OpenText, ShipIQ, Partners Online, or comparable retailer systems; experience improving workflows through ERP systems or automation
  • Proficiency in LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT)
  • Experience supporting new retailer launches or managing Amazon fulfillment alongside national wholesale accounts

What You'll Get

  • Be part of a fast-growing company with an awesome mission
  • Highly competitive salary and equity so you’re a part of the Snif family
  • An opportunity for growth and ability to widen your role and responsibilities
  • Medical, Dental and Vision healthcare insurance
  • 401K Retirement Plan with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible vacation and PTO policy
  • Industry-leading well-being and mental-health benefits
  • Virtual and remote work as well as work-from-home setup
  • Snif product on us!

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Imagine Everything.  Build the Future with Hexion.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.

At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact. We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future.

This is where bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next. Whether you're engineering advanced materials, transforming manufacturing technologies, or leading strategic innovation, your ideas and actions leave a lasting mark. We cultivate an inclusive culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability, ensuring every contribution propels us forward.

We don’t follow the status quo—we challenge it, disrupt it, and improve it. Every role at Hexion is part of something bigger.

We invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous development—equipping you with the tools, training, and opportunities to excel. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide.

Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Role Impact

The Process Controls and Automation Manager leads the process controls and automation center of excellence (COE) team in conjunction with other global engineers to hold high accountability for the performance, reliability, and standardization of the control systems that run Hexion's manufacturing network. This is a working manager role: the incumbent leads a team of process controls engineers while remaining personally engaged in design, programming, troubleshooting, and technology evaluation at the plant level.

The Manager sets the direction and standards for control system and OT network architecture, programming practice, and instrumentation across the region, and converts site issues, project demand, and emerging technology into a prioritized work plan the team can execute. The role owns the process controls project portfolio, partners with project and process engineering managers on multi-site implementations and serves as the senior technical authority when control system incidents, upgrades, or new installations require immediate direction.

The Manager reports to the Sr. Director, Manufacturing Process Engineering and works in a peer relationship with Reliability, Operations, Maintenance, EHS, IT, and AI. Success in the role combines deep technical credibility in SIS, PLC, DCS, and MES environments with the people leadership to build a capable, geographically distributed team and the business judgment to make the case for control system investment.

What You Will Do

Process Controls Leadership and Technical Direction (40% of Time)

  • Lead the Process Control and Automation COE group, setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring the team delivers responsive support to sites across the region.
  • Own the development and maintenance of process controls standards and protocols that standardize the equipment, instrumentation, programming methods, and documentation used in plant control systems.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for instrument and control activities, communicating clearly with technicians, site leadership, and senior management when issues arise.
  • Direct the design and specification of instrument and control equipment on capital and maintenance projects, and lead or assign engineers to project design teams.
  • Manage SIS, DCS, and PLC reliability, software upgrade programs, and system downtime within a matrixed supply chain and across assets at varying stages of their depreciated life.
  • Oversee reliability calculations for safety instrumentation system (SIS) and the documentation supplied to safety standard committees.
  • Support regional specialists and site teams in troubleshooting efforts and corrective actions, providing immediate direction during process incidents and new installation start-ups.
  • Partner with Reliability, Operations, EHS, and IT to keep control system practice aligned with plant reliability, process safety, and cybersecurity requirements.

Hands-On Engineering and Technology Development (30% of Time)

  • Personally develop and review instruction code for Rockwell PLC and Emerson DeltaV networks or equivalent control systems, carrying a working share of the group's technical load.
  • Own the design approach for HMI and control platforms, including escalation to the highest levels of vendor technical support, and document and define changes for manufacturing and technical audiences.
  • Investigate new instrumentation and programming technologies, develop testing protocols, and validate viability before incorporation into the existing process controls structure.
  • Apply mathematical and data analysis to design AI-driven models for process improvement, including machine analysis platforms such as AWS, TwinThread, or equivalent.
  • Evaluate and resolve networking issues at both the IT business layer and the industrial IOT layer, including process control network, data historian, and other PCN infrastructure.
  • Provide standardized design for OT layer with proper documentation and roadmap for implementation across the network sites.
  • Maintain working knowledge of batching systems and manufacturing execution systems, including non-standard configurations in use across the network.

Project Portfolio and Strategic Planning (20% of Time)

  • Build and manage programs that deliver control system project implementations across multiple remote sites, working with project and program managers on scope, schedule, and resourcing.
  • Develop and manage the annual process controls budget, forecasting operating and capital requirements and managing performance against plan.
  • Establish a risk-based prioritization process for control system obsolescence, upgrade, and automation investment, and build the business cases that support it.
  • Escalate significant unfunded control system risk to engineering and operations leadership and participate in capital prioritization reviews.
  • Track and report control system performance, project delivery, and program metrics to the Americas Engineering leadership team.

Leadership, People Development, and Culture (10% of Time)

  • Build, coach, and develop a team of process controls engineers working remotely and across multiple sites, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for results.
  • Lead with flexibility and calm confidence, resolving problems quickly and steadying the team and site partners during process upsets.
  • Promote a culture of inclusion, empowerment, and psychological safety that encourages proactive problem identification.
  • Support succession planning and the technical and leadership development of engineers within the controls and broader engineering organization.
  • Model Hexion's values of integrity, innovation, accountability, and safety in all leadership actions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor of Science in chemical or electrical engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of experience building, programming, and supporting industrial control systems, including significant time in a plant environment working alongside controls technicians and electrical & instrumentation technicians.
  • Demonstrated leadership of engineers or technical specialists, whether through direct supervision, project leadership, or a matrixed team.
  • Solid command of control system architecture and programming, with hands-on depth in Rockwell PLC, MES, data historian, and Emerson DeltaV platforms or equivalents.
  • Working knowledge of industrial process control network, network communication protocols, and data security in conjunction with the IT team.
  • Ability to manage controls programs and project portfolios across multiple remote sites in a matrix environment.
  • Strong technical writing, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to explain an issue and its proposed solution clearly to any audience.
  • Certified with SIS calculation and fluent in SIS calculation applications, preferably ExSILentia.
  • Advanced computer skills, including the ability to build and work in large Excel models and to collect and interpret data across sites running non-matching systems.
  • Willingness to travel, typically 50 percent, to manufacturing sites across the Americas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or professional registration as a licensed engineer.
  • Experience with batch and continuous chemical manufacturing processes and the working principles of unit operation.
  • Experience developing standards, documenting procedures, and maintaining controls documentation using appropriate symbols and drawing conventions.
  • Experience with machine analysis and process analytics software such as TwinThread, or with developing AI-driven models for process improvement.
  • Working knowledge of a computerized maintenance management system such as SAP PM.
  • Familiarity with electronic data management systems such as Hexion MOC, PI, and AIMs, or equivalents, and with the WAVE productivity project system.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Project and strong general Microsoft Office skills.
  • Experience building capital business cases and securing funding for automation or obsolescence projects.

Leadership Attributes

A working leader who stays close to the technology and earns credibility with the team by solving problems alongside them.

Self-directed and comfortable leading a distributed team in a matrix environment, providing immediate direction when sites are under pressure.

Flexible and quick to solve problems, imparting calming confidence without arrogance.

Skilled communicator who translates complex control system issues into terms that technicians, plant leadership, and senior management can act on.

Data driven and standards minded, balancing day-to-day site support against the longer work of building a consistent controls platform.

Other

We are an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, pregnancy, race, national origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, status as a qualified individual with a disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

To be considered for this position candidates are required to submit an application for employment through our career site and, be at least 18 years of age. jobs.excerpt: About ShippaboShippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder.
jobs.description:
About Shippabo

Shippabo is a tech-enabled ocean freight forwarder. Founded in 2016, we have raised $22 million from Wonder Ventures, TenOneTen Ventures, Double M Partners, and Slow Ventures. Our platform gives importers one place to book, track, and manage ocean shipments, with their internal teams and their overseas suppliers working from the same data. Behind the platform sits a real forwarding operation: a dedicated ocean contracts and pricing team that negotiates carrier rates, and a team in China that works directly with shippers at origin. We’re about 40 people across the US, Canada, Vietnam, Philippines, and China. Our engineering team builds the software that makes the operation faster and more transparent than a traditional forwarder can be.

About the role

This is an account management role built around retention, service quality, and problem solving. It’s not a quota-carrying sales job. There’s no cross-sell or upsell target, and no cold outbound. The one exception is re-engaging importers who have gone quiet or moved volume elsewhere, where the goal is to understand what went wrong and win the volume back. What we actually need is someone who can look at an account and a shipment and figure out what is really going on, then drive it to resolution without needing to hand it off.

What you’ll do

Own a portfolio of importer accounts. You are the primary relationship owner for a book of existing importers. You are accountable for retention, satisfaction, and the health of the relationship over time.

Diagnose before you escalate. When a client raises an issue, your first job is to determine what kind of issue it is. Is it a rate problem, a service failure, an expectation that was set wrong, or a process that broke internally? The answer determines who needs to be involved and what the fix is. We want you to make that call, not pass it off to someone else.

Review shipments and catch problems early. You should be able to look at a booking and know when something is off before the customer tells you. Rolled bookings, a vessel schedule change that will miss a delivery window, drayage constraints at the port of discharge, a document mismatch that will hold a container at customs. You’ll know when to dig into carrier schedules, customs entry, drayage, or documentation, and when it is normal activity not worth alarming a customer over.

Balance the client and the business. Understand what each importer is optimizing for, whether that’s landed cost, transit reliability, or predictability, and weigh that against what makes commercial sense for Shippabo. Advocate hard for the client, and be honest internally about what we got wrong.

Drive quote acceptance and forecast accuracy. Make sure forecasted volume actually books, quotes are accepted or the reason they were not is understood, and that feedback goes back to the supply/pricing team so our rates stay competitive on the lanes that matter.

Own outcomes across teams. Many customer requests require Product, Operations, Finance, or the origin team in China. You’re the owner of the outcome. You map the steps, set the timeline, follow up, and close the loop with the customer.

Monitor and report on your portfolio. Track operational and revenue metrics across your accounts. Surface trends, at-risk accounts, and volume shifts before they become surprises.

Serve as an advisor, not an order taker. Educate importers on supply chain practices and on what Shippabo's platform and network can do for them. Communicate market conditions, rate trends, surcharges, and capacity shifts in terms of what they mean for that specific customer’s business.

Handle inbound small and new importer leads. Own inbound marketing leads from smaller importers, qualify them, and get them onboarded and running.

Re-engage churned and dormant accounts. Work through importers who have reduced or stopped shipping with us, understand why, and rebuild the relationship where the fit is still there.

What we’re looking for

  • Direct experience in ocean freight forwarding, NVOCC, or as an importer managing ocean freight. You understand the mechanics of an ocean shipment end to end, from booking and origin cargo receipt through customs clearance and final delivery.
  • The ability to troubleshoot independently. You form a hypothesis about what went wrong, check it against the data, and act. You don’t need a manager to tell you where to look.
  • Strong commercial judgment. You know the difference between a concession that’s worth making and one that sets a bad precedent.
  • Structured thinking. You can take a messy situation with many moving parts, prioritize it, map out next steps, and communicate clearly what happens next and by when.
  • Clear written communication. Much of this job is explaining a complicated logistics situation to a customer in plain language, quickly.
  • Comfort in a small company. About 40 people, no large support layer, a lot of ownership.

Helpful but not required

  • Experience with a freight forwarding TMS or a modern digital forwarder platform.
  • Familiarity with customs documentation and entry requirements
  • Working knowledge of demurrage, detention, and how to keep clients out of accessorial charges.

Compensation

Base salary is $110,000 to $120,000.CAD. An annual performance bonus brings expected Year 1 total cash compensation to $130,000 to $150,000 CAD. Actual compensation is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location, and market demands. This range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Benefits for our Shipmates

At Shippabo, our benefits are a reflection of our core values and our commitment to making healthy living affordable and accessible to everyone on board. Our team members enjoy ample Vacation and Sick time, allowing you to take the breaks you need to recharge and ensuring your well-being remains a priority as you grow with us. We offer multiple health plan options and contribute meaningfully toward the cost of coverage for you and your dependents, in addition to a RRSP Plan with matching contributions.

About PSD Citywide

Ready to make a real impact on communities across North America?

About the Role

The VP, Marketing is a growth-focused, strategic executive with proven expertise leading Marketing and Business Development teams to drive expansion for our PE-backed GovTech SaaS organization.
Reporting to the CRO and serving as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the VP, Marketing will own the company’s marketing and business development strategy, team, and execution. This leader will connect corporate strategy to a measurable go-to-market (GTM) engine, strengthening our market position, generating qualified pipeline, and supporting revenue growth across our target municipal and government markets.

The ideal candidate brings experience scaling marketing in a B2B SaaS and GovTech environment, understands the expectations of a private equity-backed organization, and can balance strategic leadership with disciplined execution and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing & GTM Strategy

  • Develop and execute an integrated marketing and GTM strategy aligned with corporate growth objectives and revenue targets.
  • Translate company strategy into clear market positioning, messaging, campaigns, and demand-generation priorities.
  • Build and strengthen the company’s brand, market presence, thought leadership, and competitive positioning within the GovTech SaaS space.
  • Develop strategies to support customer acquisition, expansion, retention, and entry into new markets or segments.
  • Partner closely with the CRO, Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success leaders to create a coordinated customer journey and revenue engine.

Marketing & Business Development Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership and direction to the Marketing and Business Development teams, including organizational structure, talent development, priorities, and performance.
  • Establish clear goals, KPIs, accountability, and operating rhythms across both functions.
  • Build a high-performing, data-driven team capable of supporting a growth-stage SaaS organization.
  • Ensure marketing and business development resources are aligned to the highest-value growth opportunities.

Demand Generation & Revenue Growth

  • Own the strategy for pipeline generation, lead acquisition, campaign performance, events, content, digital marketing, and other demand-generation channels.
  • Establish effective lead-generation and qualification processes in partnership with Sales.
  • Use data, market intelligence, and customer insights to optimize marketing investment and improve conversion throughout the funnel.
  • Develop reporting and attribution models that demonstrate marketing and business development contribution to pipeline and revenue.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to corporate strategy, organizational planning, and growth initiatives.
  • Support the CRO and CEO with board reporting, business performance updates, GTM metrics, and growth initiatives.
  • Provide clear analysis of marketing performance, pipeline contribution, market trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Help establish and execute scalable processes and operating disciplines appropriate for a PE-backed growth environment.
  • Partner with Finance and executive leadership on budgets, forecasting, resource allocation, and ROI.

Market & Customer Insight

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the municipal/government technology market, customer needs, competitive landscape, and emerging trends.
  • Develop market intelligence that informs corporate, product, sales, and GTM decisions.
  • Strengthen relationships with industry organizations, strategic partners, and key market influencers.
  • Leverage customer insights and data to continuously improve positioning, messaging, and the customer experience.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, with significant experience leading a B2B SaaS or technology marketing function.
  • Demonstrated experience building and executing growth-focused GTM strategies tied to revenue and pipeline outcomes.
  • Experience leading multiple marketing disciplines and ideally Business Development/BDR functions.
  • Experience in a PE-backed, high-growth, or investor-driven environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and executive leadership to create an integrated revenue strategy.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS demand generation, marketing operations, CRM, digital marketing, content, brand, and performance analytics.
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level and/or board-level reporting.
  • Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams through periods of growth and change.
  • Experience in GovTech, public-sector technology, enterprise software, or selling into municipalities/government is an asset.
  • Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and executive presence.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12–18 months, the VP, Marketing will have:

  • Established a clear, measurable Marketing & GTM strategy aligned to corporate growth objectives.
  • Built a high-performing, accountable Marketing and Business Development organization.
  • Increased qualified pipeline and improved conversion through the marketing and sales funnel.
  • Strengthened the company’s positioning and brand within the GovTech market.
  • Established meaningful marketing and BD KPIs, reporting, and ROI measurement.
  • Created a scalable GTM operating model that supports continued growth and PE value-creation objectives.
  • Established Marketing as a strategic business partner to Sales, Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, and the broader executive team.

The Candidate Journey

Resume Review:Once you apply, an actual person will review your resume and we are committed to getting back to you with a response.

Phone Interview:PSD’s People and Culture team will connect with you to learn about your experience and discuss the role further. They’ll also give you an understanding of what the interview process involves, along with an estimated timeline.

Virtual Interview:Depending on the position, there will be one or two interviews with the Hiring Team that will include questions related to your skills, work experience, values and goals. We provide the opportunity to meet with a wide range of staff members so you can learn more about life at PSD Citywide.

Offer/Feedback:The Hiring Team will debrief and make a decision within a few days of your final interview. If successful, your Recruiter will present you with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter via email. If the timing was not right for this particular opportunity, we will connect with you and provide feedback.

PSD Citywide is committed to ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. We believe in integration, and we are committed to meeting the needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner. We will do so by removing and preventing barriers to accessibility.

We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Should you require any accommodation, please indicate this when you apply, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PSD Citywide may use Google Gemini to assist with recruitment note taking during the hiring process. While we incorporate select AI features to enhance process efficiency, we remain committed to human-led decision making. All AI-generated outputs are subject to human review to ensure accuracy and fairness.
