jobs.description:
About us

The Earthshot Prize is the world's most prestigious environmental prize. Founded by HRH Prince William in 2020, we are driving a decade of action for the planet, guided by the belief that Urgency + Optimism = Action.

Our mission is to find, celebrate, and scale the solutions that will repair our planet by 2030. At our heart are five Earthshots: Protect and Restore Nature, Clean Our Air, Revive Our Oceans, Build a Waste-free World, and Fix Our Climate.

Each year, we select 15 Finalists and five Winners, who each receive £1 million to take their work further. What makes the Prize unique is what happens next. We work with every Finalist on a plan to grow their impact, then bring in our Global Alliance of partners to help make it happen.

Our regional programmes build on what we do best: convening leaders, spotlighting solutions, building ecosystems of changemakers, and connecting local solutions to global platforms.

Australia and the Pacific are a growing focus for the Prize. We are looking for a Director of Oceania to build the partnerships and programmes that will make those moments count, and carry their impact well beyond them.

About the job

The Director of Oceania is part of Earthshot’s global leadership team. You will lead our impact and partnerships work across Australia and the Pacific nations, and be our senior voice in the region.We are looking for an outstanding, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader in partnerships and programmes. Your focus will be fourfold: building an ecosystem of partners and changemakers ahead of major Earthshot moments in the region, securing legacy funding for a long-term regional programme, leading on specific Finalists and Winners in the region to help scale their impact, and securing sponsorship for any regional events with support from our global partnerships team.

You will work closely with colleagues and external leaders to open up new and existing networks of philanthropists, foundations, investors, and corporations. You will also nurture our regional community of supporters, from Official Nominators, Expert Advisors, nominees, and Finalists to philanthropists, investors, and friends.You will be the voice of The Earthshot Prize in the region, and the voice of the region to the Prize. Given the distance and time difference from our London team, we need someone we can confidently put on stage and in front of the media, and who is comfortable making decisions on the ground. This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, with the autonomy to drive real change and make a meaningful difference to the planet.

Key responsibilities

Ecosystem building

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Product Data Systems
jobs.excerpt: BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies.
jobs.description:
BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 41 reports over the last 3 years (14 in 2025 alone!) and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

We are building the data and intelligence foundation required to turn large, diverse sources of threat data into reliable, explainable, and actionable protection for our customers. You will work with a dedicated global team on technically difficult problems involving cybersecurity, distributed systems, data engineering, machine learning, and SaaS product development.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to build the production services and pipelines that acquire, normalize, enrich, relate, score, and deliver threat intelligence through BforeAI’s customer-facing SaaS product.

📣 What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on product-engineering role. You will design systems and write production software for event-driven data processing and we need an engineer who understands when a managed service is appropriate, when custom code is necessary, and how to deliver either choice as a reliable product capability.

Build product data services

  • Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate production services for ingestion, normalization, enrichment, identity resolution, scoring, and intelligence delivery.
  • Build maintainable pipeline workers, event consumers, APIs, scheduled processes, and supporting libraries rather than relying exclusively on notebooks, visual workflows, or vendor configuration.
  • Own the complete software lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and improvement.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns that other members of the team can follow.

Engineer reliable event-driven pipelines

  • Develop asynchronous workflows with explicit data, event, and work contracts.
  • Design for duplicate delivery, ordering constraints, idempotency, retries, timeouts, partial failure, dead-letter handling, backpressure, and recovery.
  • Make pipeline state and failures observable, with reconciliation that identifies missing, delayed, duplicated, or inconsistent processing.
  • Support safe replay and reprocessing without silently changing the meaning of historical results.

Protect data integrity and tenant boundaries

  • Preserve source evidence, provenance, lineage, processing context, and applicable versions from the first write so customer-visible results remain explainable.
  • Define validation and quality controls at service boundaries and support safe evolution of schemas, contracts, and processing logic.
  • Preserve tenant isolation while safely combining shared intelligence with customer-private evidence, configuration, and conclusions.
  • Apply authorization, retention, deletion, audit, GDPR, and SOC 2 requirements throughout data-processing workflows.

Shape the architecture and team

  • Evaluate when to use a managed service, open-source component, existing capability, or purpose-built service based on product and operational requirements.
  • Contribute to architecture through working software, written proposals, prototypes, and constructive technical review.
  • Work with Product, Platform Engineering, Threat Research, Data Science, Security, and customer-facing teams. Platform Engineering includes Data Engineering and SRE responsibilities.
  • Translate product requirements into clear technical contracts, communicate tradeoffs, and mentor engineers in modern data and distributed-systems practices.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • You have significant hands-on experience building and operating data-intensive software for an externally used SaaS product.
  • You are a strong software engineer who specializes in data systems, not solely a user or administrator of data tools.
  • You have production development experience with Go, Scala, Rust, Java, or another comparable language used to build reliable backend services.
  • You are willing to work primarily in Go for pipeline and product data services. Existing Go experience is strongly preferred, but deep experience with Scala, Rust, or similar languages can provide a strong foundation.
  • You are proficient with Python and SQL where their data-processing, analytics, integration, or machine-learning ecosystems provide a practical advantage.
  • You understand relational, document, graph, key-value, analytical, and object-storage models and their tradeoffs.
  • You understand distributed-systems concerns such as asynchronous processing, delivery semantics, concurrency, backpressure, idempotency, consistency, recovery, and failure isolation.
  • You have designed or operated event-driven systems using technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis, or comparable messaging infrastructure.
  • You have experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production operations.
  • You can reason about provenance, replay, data quality, multi-tenant isolation, shared data, private customer context, and authorization boundaries.
  • You evaluate unfamiliar technologies based on engineering principles, communicate clearly, challenge weak assumptions constructively, and own delivery outcomes.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Cybersecurity, threat intelligence, fraud, abuse prevention, or other evidence-intensive domains
  • Data provenance, explainability, auditability, or regulated data systems
  • Graph-based data processing, Neo4j, Azure Data Explorer, or Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Machine-learning feature pipelines, model inputs and outputs, or feedback and learning systems
  • Migrating legacy batch or pipeline workloads into service-based, event-driven architectures
  • Operating customer-facing data systems under defined reliability and recovery expectations

💻 Our environment

Our Azure-based environment includes Go and Python services, Event Hubs and Kafka-compatible messaging, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Explorer, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis, Databricks for appropriate analytics and machine-learning workloads, Kubernetes, and Azure-managed compute services.

Experience with every component is not required. We care more about whether you understand the engineering principles underneath these technologies, can become productive in an unfamiliar environment, and can choose the appropriate combination of managed services and custom software.

Don't meet every single requirement? Don't count yourself out just yet.

jobs.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

TeamInStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

The Clinical Evaluator is the first voice and face of InStride Health for patients and families seeking care. Evaluators conduct phone screens and comprehensive clinical evaluations to determine clinical eligibility and appropriateness for InStride services. They provide education and orientation about InStride, serve as brand ambassadors, and ensure families feel engaged and motivated from their first interaction.

Clinical Evaluators are strong diagnosticians with excellent case conceptualization skills, adept at assessing patient presentation and navigating sensitive conversations. They determine when medical clearance is required prior to admission and, when families are not appropriate for InStride, redirect them to alternative resources with empathy and clarity.

Clinical Evaluators also generate thorough, timely documentation that ensures a smooth and intentional handoff to the care team, supported by AI note-writing tools. They provide feedback to the Tech Product team on workflows, systems, and patient experience, and to the Clinical Product team on biopsychosocial assessment and patient needs.

Key Responsibilities/Essential Functions

  • Conducts phone screens and clinical evaluations for patients and families seeking admission.
  • Accurately assesses diagnoses, case conceptualization, and clinical eligibility for InStride.
  • Provides education, orientation, and motivation to engage patients and families in care.
  • Determines when medical clearance is required prior to admission.
  • Redirects patients and families to alternative resources when InStride is not appropriate.
  • Produces robust, timely documentation to support seamless transitions into treatment, leveraging AI note-writing tools.
  • Serves as a brand ambassador, creating a welcoming and professional first experience for families.
  • Collaborates with internal stakeholders by providing feedback and insights:
    • To the Tech Product team on workflows, systems, and patient/family experience.
    • To the Clinical Product team on patient presentation and assessment processes.
  • Participates in designated trainings, team meetings, and clinical rounds to ensure alignment with care pathways and best practices.
  • Upholds InStride’s mission, values, and ethical standards in all interactions.

Qualifications

Required Education & Licensure

  • Ph.D. or PsyD in psychology from an accredited program; OR
  • Master’s degree in social work, counseling, or related field from an accredited program with independent licensure (LICSW, LMHC, LMFT, or equivalent, depending on state).
  • Active state-specific licensure in good standing; willingness to obtain additional licensure in other states, as requested.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Expertise in diagnosing and treating children, adolescents, and young adults with anxiety, OCD, and related disorders.
  • Strong skills in case conceptualization, assessment, and measurement-based care.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to motivate and engage patients and families.
  • Ability to navigate sensitive conversations and redirect families to alternative care resources when needed.
  • Strong clinical judgment and decision-making skills in time-sensitive situations.
  • Commitment to creating a positive, professional, and brand-aligned first impression for families.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills, including comfort using AI-assisted tools.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a fast-paced, mission-driven team.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab
  • Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features
  • Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo
  • Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab.
  • Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps.
  • Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js.
  • Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics.
  • Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results.
  • Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase.
  • Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes.

What you'll bring

  • Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows.
  • Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization.
  • A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release.
  • Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back.
  • Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates.
  • Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values.
  • Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling.

About the team

We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own. For more on how we work, see the Growth and Product sections of the GitLab handbook.

The Vice President, Environmental Health, Safety & Operational Risk provides strategic and operational leadership for environmental health, safety, quality, and risk management across Support Services, with a primary focus on the rapidly growing Data Centers business.

The role operates across Support Services environments that may include data centers, mission-critical and critical environments, facilities management and integrated facilities management, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor and cleanroom operations, life sciences, healthcare facilities, construction, commissioning, capital projects, industrial operations, infrastructure, utilities, and other 24/7 hard-services and engineering operations.

This is a remote role and may be based near any major airport in the U.S.

Key Responsibilities:

EHS Strategy, Governance & Risk Management

jobs.description:
Chart Desktop Management Registered Nurse

Department: Clinical Operations

Reports To: Nurse Manager

Location: Remote

Employment Status: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Hourly, Nonexempt

Position Summary

The Chart Desktop Management Registered Nurse is a full-time, remote clinical support position responsible for the daily ownership, monitoring, management, follow-up, and timely closure of assigned AthenaOne provider staff buckets and clinical desktop work across designated providers and care teams.

The position serves as a centralized clinical resource for provider-directed results, patient communications, portal messages, referrals, orders, clinical documents, follow-up needs, and other work routed to assigned provider staff buckets. The RN prioritizes work according to clinical urgency, ensures time-sensitive items are addressed appropriately, tracks unresolved items through completion, and escalates concerns in accordance with provider direction, organizational policies, established workflows, and registered nursing scope of practice.

This is a newly created position. The responsibilities, workflows, performance expectations, and processes associated with the role will continue to be developed and refined with input from the employee selected for the position. The employee will be expected to actively participate in establishing effective workflows, identifying barriers, and recommending improvements as the role evolves.

The Chart Desktop Management Registered Nurse works collaboratively with the Nurse Manager, providers, and on-site clinical teams, allowing on-site staff to remain focused on direct patient care and efficient clinic flow.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Maintains primary responsibility and accountability for assigned AthenaOne provider staff buckets and clinical desktop work during scheduled work hours.
  • Continuously monitors assigned work queues and prioritizes items according to clinical urgency, patient-safety considerations, established timelines, provider direction, and organizational workflows.
  • Reviews and manages clinical messages, provider-directed results, patient communications, portal messages, incoming clinical documents, referrals, orders, and other work routed to assigned provider staff buckets.
  • Completes appropriate follow-up or routes items to the provider, triage team, or another appropriate team member when additional review, direction, or action is required.
  • Follows established protocols for abnormal or critical results, promptly escalating findings to the appropriate licensed provider and confirming that timely follow-up occurs.
  • Communicates provider-directed test results, care instructions, follow-up testing, referrals, and other clinical information to patients in accordance with provider direction, approved protocols, organizational policy, and registered nursing scope of practice.
  • Documents patient outreach, nursing communications, provider instructions, unsuccessful contact attempts, and follow-up actions accurately and promptly in the electronic health record.
  • Tracks unresolved, pending, overdue, aging, or incomplete clinical items through completion and performs the follow-up or escalation necessary to reduce the risk of missed or delayed care.
  • Recognizes patient messages involving new or worsening symptoms or other concerns requiring nursing assessment and routes those messages to the established triage workflow.
  • Responds to urgent or potentially emergent concerns in accordance with organizational emergency protocols, including immediate nursing assessment and escalation to an appropriate provider, clinical leader, or emergency service when indicated.
  • Does not routinely perform clinical triage. Triage may be performed when necessary to address an emergent concern or when specifically directed under an approved organizational workflow.
  • Coordinates provider-directed follow-up related to referrals, specialist recommendations, laboratory testing, diagnostic imaging, hospital or emergency department records, and other continuity-of-care needs.
  • Reviews and follows up on referral- and order-related desktop items to support timely processing, patient communication, and completion.
  • Provides patient education related to provider-directed care plans, testing, and follow-up recommendations within registered nursing scope of practice.
  • Maintains awareness of provider schedules, absences, and covering-provider arrangements to ensure time-sensitive information is directed to an available provider.
  • Collaborates with the Nurse Manager, providers, triage staff, referral staff, and on-site clinical teams to resolve clinical desktop work requiring additional information, assessment, direction, or follow-up.
  • Communicates significant backlogs, aging items, recurring routing concerns, barriers to completion, or patient-safety concerns to the Nurse Manager promptly.
  • Provides updates regarding the status of assigned provider staff buckets, including unresolved work, aging items, and issues affecting timely completion.
  • Participates in developing and refining the responsibilities, processes, and performance measures for this newly created position.
  • Identifies recurring workflow or routing problems and recommends improvements related to AthenaOne desktop management, message routing, clinical follow-up, and closure of outstanding items.
  • Maintains reliable availability, productivity, and responsiveness throughout assigned remote work hours.
  • Protects patient confidentiality and complies with HIPAA, organizational privacy and security requirements, and remote-work expectations.
  • Uses only organization-approved equipment, systems, communication methods, and secure remote-access processes.
  • Follows all applicable agency, state, and federal policies, procedures, professional standards, and regulatory requirements.

Role Boundaries

  • This position is accountable for the active management and timely resolution of assigned provider staff buckets, not solely the observation or forwarding of desktop work.
  • Routine prescription refill processing is not an expected responsibility of this position. Refill requests must be routed and managed according to the organization’s established refill workflow.
  • Routine clinical triage is not a primary responsibility of this position. Messages requiring triage should be directed to the established triage workflow unless immediate nursing intervention is necessary due to an urgent or potentially emergent concern.
  • The RN may not independently diagnose, prescribe, modify treatment plans, communicate unapproved interpretations, or provide instructions outside provider direction, approved protocols, organizational policy, and registered nursing scope of practice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse license valid in the State of New Hampshire.
  • Graduate of an accredited registered nursing program.
  • Minimum of [two] years of clinical nursing experience preferred.
  • Experience using an electronic health record system.
  • Demonstrated ability to recognize urgent, emergent, abnormal, or time-sensitive concerns and escalate them appropriately.
  • Strong nursing documentation, organization, communication, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to independently prioritize and manage a high volume of electronic clinical work involving multiple providers and care teams.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in ambulatory care, primary care, community health, or a federally qualified health center.
  • Previous experience with AthenaOne.
  • Experience managing provider desktops, clinical inboxes, patient messages, results, referrals, or orders.
  • Experience supporting multiple providers or clinical care teams.
  • Familiarity with population health, care coordination, and continuity-of-care workflows.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of professional registered nursing standards and scope of practice.
  • Ability to apply sound nursing judgment while working within established protocols and provider direction.
  • Ability to distinguish routine clinical work from matters requiring provider review, formal triage, or immediate escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, timely documentation.
  • Ability to monitor multiple work queues and track assigned items through final resolution.
  • Ability to recognize workflow breakdowns, recurring routing problems, and risks associated with unresolved clinical work.
  • Strong written, verbal, telephone, and electronic communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and compassionately with patients, providers, and members of the care team.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining accessible, responsive, and accountable to the Nurse Manager.
  • Willingness to help develop, test, and improve workflows for a newly established position.
  • Proficiency with computers, electronic health records, secure messaging, Microsoft applications, and remote communication platforms.

Remote-Work Requirements

  • Maintains a private, secure, and HIPAA-compliant workspace.
  • Maintains reliable high-speed internet access sufficient to support the organization’s electronic health record and communication systems.
  • Remains actively available and responsive during assigned work hours.
  • Complies with organizational requirements for remote access, information security, productivity, attendance, and communication.
  • Reports technology, access, workflow, or connectivity concerns promptly.
  • Understands that remote-work arrangements may be modified based on organizational needs, performance, security requirements, or operational considerations.

Performance Expectations

Successful performance includes:

  • Consistent daily ownership and management of assigned provider staff buckets.
  • Timely response to and closure of assigned clinical desktop work.
  • Appropriate prioritization and escalation of urgent, abnormal, or time-sensitive matters.
  • Accurate and timely documentation.
  • Effective tracking of unresolved and aging items through completion.
  • Prompt communication of backlogs, barriers, routing concerns, and patient-safety risks.
  • Compliance with established boundaries regarding prescription refills and routine triage.
  • Reliable availability, productivity, and responsiveness during assigned remote work hours.
  • Active participation in developing and improving the position’s workflows and performance standards.

Physical and Technical Requirements

  • Ability to remain seated and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to communicate by telephone, video, secure messaging, and electronic health record systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret clinical documentation, electronic communications, and provider instructions.
  • Ability to perform repetitive keyboarding and computer-based tasks throughout the workday.

Acknowledgment

This job description summarizes the primary duties, responsibilities, and qualifications of the position. Because this is a newly created role, responsibilities and workflows may be adjusted as the position develops and organizational needs are evaluated. The employee selected for this position will be expected to participate in that development process.

Project Description

EDC is seeking a Gender and Social Inclusion Specialist for a proposed education consultancy in Somalia focused on the development of the National Teacher Professional Development Plan (TPDP). The assignment will support the Ministry of Education, Culture and Higher Education (MoECHE) to produce a comprehensive, quality-assured, and implementation-ready national teacher professional development plan aligned with the National Teacher Competency Framework (NTCF), the Somalia Education Act (2023), and the National Transformation Plan 2025–2029.

The assignment is designed to help establish a coherent national system for continuing professional development (CPD), strengthen quality assurance, support certification and monitoring systems, and improve teacher professional development across Federal Member States, school types, education levels, and Integrated Quranic Schools.

Position Description

The Gender and Social Inclusion Specialist will ensure that gender equality and social inclusion are fully integrated into the design of the TPDP. The specialist will lead analysis of barriers to participation in teacher professional development, especially for female teachers and other underserved groups, and will help shape inclusive approaches to CPD delivery, stakeholder engagement, implementation planning, and monitoring. This role is particularly important to ensure that the TPDP responds to the needs of teachers in rural, nomadic, and conflict-affected settings, including female teachers in Integrated Quranic Schools and other hard-to-reach contexts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead a gender and social inclusion analysis as part of the broader situational assessment for the TPDP.
  • Identify barriers to participation in CPD, with specific attention to female teachers in rural, nomadic, and conflict-affected areas, as well as female teachers in Integrated Quranic Schools.
  • Provide technical input to ensure that TPDP policies, systems, and implementation approaches are gender-responsive and inclusive.
  • Advise on inclusive design of CPD delivery models, including approaches suitable for low-resource, low-connectivity, and geographically dispersed settings.
  • Support the integration of gender and inclusion considerations into stakeholder consultations with MoECHE, Federal Member States, Teacher Training Colleges, teacher associations, Islamic scholar networks, and development partners.
  • Contribute to the development of inclusive frameworks, tools, and recommendations across key work packages, including implementation planning, governance arrangements, quality assurance, M&E, and digital learning systems.
  • Help ensure that indicators, baseline tools, and reporting approaches capture relevant sex-disaggregated and inclusion-sensitive data.
  • Work closely with the Team Leader and other technical specialists to ensure that gender and inclusion considerations are embedded throughout all deliverables.
  • Contribute written sections, recommendations, and review comments to ensure final outputs are practical, evidence-based, and responsive to the Somali context.

Education:

Master’s degree in Gender Studies, Education, Social Science, or a related field.

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in gender-responsive program design.
  • Proven expertise in analyzing barriers to female teacher participation and broader social inclusion constraints.
  • Experience designing or advising on inclusive CPD, education, or teacher development approaches in rural, nomadic, fragile, or low-resource settings.
  • Strong understanding of equity and inclusion issues affecting access, participation, and retention in education systems.
  • Experience working on donor-funded education programs, preferably in fragile or conflict-affected contexts.

Language:

Professionally proficient and fluent in written and spoken English.

Established in 1958, EDC designs, delivers and evaluates innovative programs to address some of the world’s most urgent challenges in education, health, and economic opportunity. ADHD Online, the leading brand for Mentavi Health, stands at the forefront of revolutionizing telemedicine in mental health care. Our steadfast commitment revolves around prioritizing patients, who are at the core of our mission, and stewarding mental health care by harnessing the capabilities of telemedicine for comprehensive assessment and treatment services.

We are actively seeking a dedicated Physician in New York to join our esteemed Medical Treatment network, enhancing our capacity to provide high-quality care to our patients. Applicants that are not licensed to practice and have a valid DEA license in this state above will not be considered for this specific role opening.

To address the holistic needs of our patients, we provide diagnosis and treatment options that go beyond ADHD, which includes other mental health conditions, such as anxiety, mood disorders. Through our services, we provide crucial mental health resources to individuals nationwide.

We are actively seeking a dedicated Physician to join our esteemed Medical Treatment network, enhancing our capacity to provide high-quality care to our patients. In this pivotal role, you will not only deliver compassionate care, but also serve as a genuine partner in our patients' holistic health journey, while actively providing them with valuable education and support. Join our team and become a vital part of our ongoing mission to deliver top-tier mental health care, enhance accessibility, and significantly improve the lives of our patients each day!

Why Choose Us?

Competitive Wages and Malpractice Insurance

  • $70 per initial consult video visit (30-minute visit)
  • $40 per follow-up consult video visit (15-minute visit)
  • Compensation for no-shows and cancellations per policy
  • Malpractice Insurance is provided with tail coverage

Flexible Schedule

  • Work the schedule that best accommodates your life

Fully Supported Telemedicine Environment

  • We offer superb support staff so you can focus on what you do best, patient treatment
  • Our Medical Assistants act as a liaison between the Provider and patient
  • Our staff handles patient scheduling, payments, etc.

Licensed Psychologists conduct patient assessment

  • Every patient comes to their treatment appointment with a completed assessment and diagnosis

Growth Opportunities

  • We will cover the cost of approved additional state licenses
  • Culture of continuous learning with access to monthly educational resources, interactive webinars with industry experts, ongoing educational support, and collaborative peer-to-peer learning opportunities

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Utilize video conferencing to conduct virtual appointments with patients.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive treatment plans for mental health conditions including ADHD, anxiety, depression, binge eating disorder, and other related disorders tailored to individual patient needs.
  • Prescribe and manage medications, while educating patients on usage, potential side effects, and interactions.
  • Deliver comprehensive patient education, including information on health conditions, treatment options, and preventive measures.
  • Monitor patients' progress during and after treatment and conduct follow-up appointments to assess treatment effectiveness and make adjustments as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and up-to-date medical records for each patient; documenting all assessments, diagnoses, treatments, and follow-up plans.
  • Efficient and prompt handling of task completion, prescription refills, and addressing patient inquiries.
  • Engage in collaborative efforts with fellow providers to ensure optimal patient care.
  • Report quality of care issues promptly through established mechanisms.
  • Attend relevant meetings and educational training sessions as required to stay informed about industry developments and best practices.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of telemedicine regulatory changes and ensure adherence to federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
  • Stay abreast of the latest advancements in mental health care and consistently updating and enhancing your knowledge base.
  • Fully comply with all internal privacy policies and procedures to safeguard patient confidentiality and privacy.
  • Complete any additional tasks and functions as requested by the company, contributing to the overall success of our mission.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Specialized expertise in the comprehensive treatment and management of ADHD, anxiety, depression, binge eating disorder, and other related conditions in both adult and pediatric populations.
  • Demonstrated experience of a minimum of 2 years in mental healthcare or 5 years in a primary care setting, showcasing a proven track record of success.
  • In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with current mental disorder diagnostic tools, including but not limited to the DSM-5, GAD-7, PHQ-9.
  • A genuine passion for delivering accessible mental health care to diverse communities.
  • Proficiency in utilizing technology and electronic health record systems
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to foster positive and collaborative relationships with both patients and colleagues.
  • High level of flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic and evolving work environment
  • High emotional awareness and sensitivity to patients' needs, reflecting a patient-centered approach to care.
  • Thorough understanding of state telemedicine laws and regulations to ensure compliance in the delivery of services.
  • Previous telehealth experience, highly preferred

Education/Board Certification/Licensure

  • Graduation from a US medical school or foreign medical school with ECFMG certification
  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Osteopathy (DO) Required
  • Completion of Residency Program in either Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Psychiatry
  • Board Certification
  • Current, unrestricted state license
  • DEA license(s) and state controlled substance license(s), as applicable

Location & Equipment Requirements:

  • Remote from any location in the United States
  • Must have a sterile work environment, free from external noise
  • Must have reliable internet connection
  • Must possess a desktop computer, laptop, and/or tablet to conduct video visits

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment (e.g., computer).
  • Manual dexterity sufficient for typing and data entry.

Equal Opportunity:

Mentavi Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified to bring your unique perspective to our team. To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this role now or in the future.

Role Type: 1099 Contractor

jobs.excerpt: Hi and welcome! We are so glad you landed on our job posting.
jobs.description:
Hi and welcome!

We are so glad you landed on our job posting. Take a look below to learn more about the position and what makes us Big Leap. If the details align with your skills and experience, we’d love for you to apply. Looking forward to connecting with you, and thanks so much for taking the time to get to know us better!

Why work with Big Leap?

Big Leap is an award-winning Digital Marketing Company founded on trust and focused on relationships. Our motto is, "Earn Trust Every Day", which we achieve by doing what we say, checking our ego at the door, inspiring confidence, and investing in relationships. Our team and client satisfaction guide us as we strive to create the best agency to offer digital marketing services and a wonderful place for people to work.

As a team player at Big Leap, you will enjoy a range of benefits including:

  • Remote or Hybrid Work Capability
  • Flexible PTO
  • Flexible Work Hours
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • A full range of Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K match, and Life Insurance benefits
  • Growth opportunities that will heighten your skill sets and enhance your career.
  • A high-ranking company culture, collaborative team dynamics, and much more!

Big Leapers have the option to work remotely, in the Lehi office, or in a hybrid setup. Candidates located in Utah are preferred, but candidates in Texas, Georgia, New Hampshire, Indiana, and Wisconsin are welcome to apply!

What does success look like in this position?

The Director of Paid Advertising, reporting to the President, leads Big Leap’s paid media strategy and execution. This role oversees innovation, team development, client relationships, and internal process improvements. Success means building a high-performing team, delivering strong client results, and advancing our paid media offerings.

Essential Functions

  • Align paid media strategy with the goals of Big Leap and its clients in close partnership with internal teams.
  • Lead innovation in paid media, guiding strategy, reviewing campaigns, and mentoring team members.
  • Grow and retain top-performing client accounts by addressing key challenges, sharing insights, and highlighting our unique value.
  • Partner with the Client Success team to drive results and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Collaborate across departments—sales, product, creative, and fulfillment—to explore new channels and client success strategies.
  • Oversee and refine departmental processes to boost efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability
  • Leverage data analysis to inform strategy and optimize performance across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other ecommerce-focused advertising channels, using analytics tools like GA4, Looker Studio, and Excel

So, what does the day-to-day look like for the Director of Paid Advertising?

This role is immersive and dynamic, which means that every day will be different. However, at its core, you'll be responsible for:

  • Report on product KPIs & goals, with particular attention to paid social and ecommerce performance metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and conversion rates.
  • Coordinate delivery of a superior product to client services and Big Leap clients.
  • Work with client services and product teams to develop and help train on client strategy, roadmap execution, and large initiative planning.
  • Drive innovation and best practices in Meta Ads and ecommerce advertising, including creative testing, campaign optimization, and emerging platforms like TikTok.
  • Interact with internal peers and/or Managers to exchange pertinent data and information related to projects.
  • Client relationship duties and responsibilities as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

This job might be a fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media account management or strategy, with strong expertise in paid social advertising (Meta, TikTok), particularly for ecommerce brands, as well as search advertising (Google Ads, Bing Ads), LinkedIn, display, and programmatic.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Meta Ads campaign strategy, creative testing, audience targeting, and performance optimization, with an understanding of ecommerce metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and conversion rates.
  • Proficient experience in managing a team.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in an Agency environment or similar fast-paced setting is critical.
  • Ability to successfully manage and move forward multiple projects at the same time.
  • Experience in client-facing and client-relationship scenarios and duties.
  • Must be able to read, write, and speak English. Some projects may require advanced skills in each area.
  • Prompt and regular attendance is required.
Salary: $115k-$120k DOE with Bonus Potential

jobs.excerpt: About CAFOThe Christian Alliance for Orphans (CAFO) unites more than 300 respected organizations and a global network of churches to inspire and equip Christians to effectively answer God’s call to care for vulnerable children and families.
jobs.description:
About CAFO

The Christian Alliance for Orphans (CAFO) unites more than 300 respected organizations and a global network of churches to inspire and equip Christians to effectively answer God’s call to care for vulnerable children and families. Since 2004, CAFO members have sought to “leave their logos and egos at the door” to join in shared initiatives to grow and guide effective responses for the world’s most vulnerable children, from foster care and adoption to family strengthening and care for vulnerable children worldwide.

Position Summary

The Director of the CAFO Aging-Out Excellence Lab will lead the newly established Lab to serve as the nation’s leading hub for knowledge, innovation and well-informed action to promote the whole-person success of youth transitioning from foster care into adulthood. This individual will provide executive-level leadership to oversee the creation of the Lab, focus its core strategies, build its team and operations, conduct joint endeavors with CAFO colleagues and other institutions and leaders, and, ultimately, lead the Lab forward in all that is essential to cultivating good in the lives of aging-out youth across America. The Director will work closely with CAFO’s President, COO, and other members of the CAFO leadership team (especially the More Than Enough initiative) to develop and execute the Lab’s strategic vision.

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Travel: Travel will likely average 1-2 trips per quarter. Travel will include the CAFO Summit, the annual staff retreat, and other events/activities hosted by CAFO and its partners.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an experienced, mission-driven leader with a deep commitment to the whole-person wellbeing of vulnerable youth. He/she possesses a strong blend of strategic vision and operational expertise, with a proven track record in program development and team leadership. He/she takes great pleasure in cultivating strength in organizations and leaders, and can skillfully turn information and insights into resources and processes that enable this growth. Grounded in deep Christian faith and practice, he/she desires to live out a sense of calling to foster innovation and excellence to improve outcomes for youth aging out of foster care.

Essential Responsibilities

The Director will serve as the executive leader for the creation and ongoing leadership of the Aging-Out Excellence Lab. Key elements of Lab’s work will include endeavors that:

  • Identify best-in-class practices and program models nationwide.
  • Distill knowledge into useful insights and actionable resources.
  • Deliver resources, training, and coaching to help leaders start, grow, and improve effective aging-out programs.
  • Advance research in the field, especially understanding of factors that make the biggest difference in outcomes for aging-out youth. (This will include the collection, review and promotion of existing research as well as new research engaged by the Lab, both in-house via the CAFO Research Center and via partnerships with other researchers and universities.)
  • Provide competitive grants (paired with expert guidance and peer cohorts) to advance excellence -- likely including seed funding for new programs, compelling innovations, strategic expansions, research grants, and awards.

To advance and deepen this vision, the Director will:

  • Lead the refining and development of these broad ideas into focused strategies and measurable objectives, in close collaboration with the CAFO leadership team.
  • Design and steadily build the operational capacity necessary to achieve the Lab’s objectives, including hiring staff and contractors, establishing essential systems, and utilizing CAFO’s operational teams (i.e. marketing, film, web, accounting, etc.)
  • Advance jointly-owned endeavors in tandem with CAFO teammates and programs, including the More Than Enough initiative, Research Center, Pure Religion Project, and Family Institute.
  • Engage strategic partnerships with key allies across the field, including CAFO member organizations, universities, researchers, corporations, and other partners.
  • If expansion beyond the current budget is deemed strategic, work in tandem with CAFO’s president and development director to raise additional funds.
  • Establish systems for meaningful feedback and measurement—including both process metrics and, ultimately, true outcomes achieved by the organizations strengthened by the Lab and the young adults they serve.

Competency, Skills, and Character

  • Committed follower of Jesus Christ who wholeheartedly shares in the mission, vision, deepest commitments, and guiding principles of the CAFO community.
  • Sincere desire to grow more like Jesus together as part of a “community of Christian spiritual formation.”
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in program development, research, and grant management.
  • A team player willing to work collaboratively across multiple teams.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a distributed organization.
  • Possession of the personal traits, habits, and local community essential to flourishing in a remote work environment.
  • Demonstrates deep care and attentiveness to others, evidenced by strong, respectful relationships with colleagues and peers
  • Excellent communication skills, with an ability to distill complex insights into accessible ideas and practices.
  • Strong inclination to press beyond “processes” or “activities” alone to pursue, whenever possible, measurable results in organizations and leaders we work to strengthen, and in the lives of the children and families they serve.
  • Passion to see “the people of God overflowing with the love of God,” including effective service and care for youth aging out of care.

Education and Experience

  • At least 10+ years of highly relevant experience.
  • Proven results in organizational leadership, fiscal management and program development.
  • Strong track record in managing people and programs.
  • Deep knowledge of the challenges faced by aging-out youth and a compelling vision for how to address them.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience preferred.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionOverview We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team.
jobs.description:
Description

Overview

We are looking for a Client Success Manager (Performance Marketing) to join our growing global team. In this role, you will own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end: setting account strategy, guiding success plans tied to business KPIs, driving growth opportunities, and proactively managing retention and risk. Your portfolio will include paid media-driven accounts as well as SEO-focused accounts. The ideal candidate combines marketing strategy thinking with strong client communication, ties every decision to client ROI, and can lead cross-functional specialists (Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics) toward clear priorities and outcomes.

This is a remote role open to candidates willing to work US business hours.

Responsibilities

  • Own account strategy and success planning: define goals, KPIs, priorities, and quarterly roadmaps with each client.
  • Lead client relationship and communication: run recurring meetings, manage stakeholders, align expectations from day one, and document next steps.
  • Drive account performance management: interpret results against business metrics (ROAS, CPA, CAC vs. LTV, organic growth), identify issues and opportunities, and coordinate actions with channel owners.
  • Identify and scope account growth opportunities: expansions, tests, and new initiatives tied to performance signals and client objectives.
  • Manage account health, retention, renewal, and risk: flag risks early, create mitigation plans, and ensure consistent value delivery across a multi-client portfolio.

Why Join Finch

  • Work globally, stay flexible: Join a fully distributed team across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC.
  • Meaningful impact from day one: Your work directly influences client outcomes and how Finch grows.
  • A culture built on curiosity, transparency, and ownership: We share context and empower people to make decisions.
  • High-caliber teammates: Collaborate with specialists in Paid Search, Paid Social, SEO, DSP, Creative, Analytics, and more.
  • Learning as a default: We encourage experimentation, cross-training, and growth as the company scales.
  • Real work-life balance: We value high performance, not overwork.

Requirements

We’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Account Manager or Client Success Manager in a performance marketing or digital marketing agency (required).
  • Acted as the primary point of contact (POC) for multiple client accounts simultaneously (required).
  • Strong understanding of performance marketing fundamentals: paid advertising, attribution, KPIs, and optimization logic (required).
  • Experience working with paid advertising-driven accounts across Paid Search, Paid Social, and Programmatic/DSP (required).
  • Proven track record of improving client retention or growing accounts, with concrete examples (required).
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, and comfortable leading strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders (required).
  • Availability to work with consistent overlap with US business hours. (required)
  • Background managing SEO-driven accounts or hands-on SEO experience (advantage).
  • Experience working with US or international clients (advantage).

Position: Senior Officer, Learning and Impact

Starting Salary: $84,885.25 CAD/year

ABOUT THE FIRST RESPONSE FUND

The First Response Fund (FRF) is a new global pooled fund, currently in its pilot phase, that seeks to resource humanitarian responses led by feminist civil society organizations - by leveraging women’s and feminist funds’ (W/FF) funding capacity, reach, and relationships with women’s rights and women led organizations (WROs/WLOs) across regions.

Twelve feminist and women’s funds (along with Prospera, the international network of women’s funds) worked together to design the First Response Fund centering the strategies of local WLOs/WROs in ODA-eligible countries, providing resources and accompaniment via a global network of over 50 Women’s and Feminist Funds. FRF represents an innovative advance on localization because it moves core, flexible resources to local WROs/WLOs for the life-saving, humanitarian services prioritized by their communities.

FRF is a new initiative that builds on the existing expertise of WROs/WLOs doing critical humanitarian response and of W/FFs resourcing these groups. We are creating an accessible channel for donors to resource the humanitarian activities of WROs.

FRF is hosted by the Equality Fund, a feminist fund based in Canada, resourcing feminist movements through global grantmaking, gender-lens investing, policy advocacy, and feminist philanthropy. Launched in 2019, the Equality Fund has activated $100 million to date which flows to more than 1,800 organizations working across 100 countries.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Reporting to the Director, First Response Fund, the Senior Officer, Learning & Impact drives the implementation and adaptation of the First Response Fund (FRF) monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) strategy, in alignment with the Equality Fund’s Learning and Impact strategy. The Senior Officer plays a critical role in data collection and analysis from FRF’s partners, impact measurement, and knowledge management and ensuring these processes are timely, accurate, and compliant with Equality Fund and donor standards, collaborating closely with Manager, Learning and Impact and the wider Strategy, Innovation and Impact team.

The Senior Officer independently and accountably tracks progress against key indicators, demonstrates partner and FRF impact through analysis and interpretation of qualitative and quantitative data, and facilitates dissemination of results and learnings. The Senior Officer is also responsible for leading evaluative activities, managing effective reporting, stewarding relationships, and contributing to strategy development for the First Response Fund. The work of the Senior Officer, Learning and Impact contributes to strengthening the evidence base of the impact and effectiveness of localization, while also demonstrating the various ways in which feminist MEL can be operationalized to collect and analyze this type of evidence.

While embedded within the FRF Secretariat, the Senior Officer maintains a dotted line of supervision with Equality Fund's Learning & Impact (L&I) team to ensure cross-organizational alignment, methodological rigor, and shared learning. The Senior Officer coordinates directly with the L&I team to ensure FRF’s MEL processes integrate seamlessly into the organization’s broader social change frameworks and institutional reporting standards.

SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and implementation of MEL framework, strategy, and tools

  • In collaboration with the Director of First Response Fund and the Manager of Learning and Impact, leads the implementation of FRF’s MEL framework that accompanies the overall grantmaking strategy and theory of change;
  • Leads the design and implementation of tools and processes to ensure tracking and reporting of key indicators to bilateral and philanthropic donors, such as FCDO (UK) and Global Affairs Canada..
  • Collaborates internally and externally to improve FRF’s MEL framework, data collection and analysis tools and processes in alignment with best practice in the humanitarian sector and donor reporting requirements.
  • Leads on managing FRF’s external partnerships focused on learning and impact measurement (e.g. third party monitoring, evaluations, partnerships with think tanks and researchers).

Data collection, management, analysis and sensemaking

  • In collaboration with Learning & Impact and Global Programs colleagues, continuously improves tools, design, and implementation of pilot projects for non-traditional/innovative reporting methods, such as audio and video reporting, use of instructional videos, and revised content and format of tools and reports;
  • Contributes to the collection, validation, and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data from FRF’s grantee partners and translates field-level evidence into actionable learning;
  • Works cross-functionally to identify, write, compile and communicate compelling impact stories and narratives for reports and knowledge products;
  • In collaboration with the Grantmaking Operations team, supports the quarterly update of grantmaking basic statistics to meet Equality Fund’s internal and external reporting requirements;
  • In collaboration with FRF Director and Officer, supports Milestone, Progress, and Final Report reviews, as well as implementation of data collection tools and processes to track and demonstrate the impact of women’s and feminist funds’ accompaniment model, and ongoing redesign for the use of Salesforce for MEL;
  • Implements the Learning and Impact data analysis strategy to report on aggregate and thematic/regional impact on gender equality outcomes;

Dissemination of results, reporting, and partner capacity strengthening

  • In coordination with the Learning and Impact team, compiles and presents key grantmaking data and crisis-informed insights for use across the Equality Fund.
  • Ensures compliance with institutional and bilateral donor reporting requirements; leads writing of internal briefs and external narrative reports to funders (for example, interim reports, inception reports and FRF Annual Report), associated Performance Measurement Frameworks, as well as other knowledge products and communications materials as required;
  • Disseminates impact data through presentations and preparing reports, briefs and talking points for internal and external audiences (ie. Impact Library, data shareback sessions with partners, proposals, joint advocacy efforts, etc);
  • In close collaboration with FRF Director and EF Program Managers, supports partner MEL capacity strengthening through creation of MEL webinars using key insights provided by the programs team and supporting with specific MEL capacity strengthening needs of partners as required;
  • Supports responses to internal and external data requests; provides current First Response Fund data to key stakeholders and databases upon request.

Other horizontal organizational activities

  • Contributes to and supports organization wide Learning & Impact efforts; Serves as the primary bridge between the First Response Fund and the L&I team, actively participating in L&I team meetings.
  • Contributes to and supports FRF updates to the Internal Impact Library and design and implementation of participatory grantmaking models across grantmaking streams;
  • Acts in accordance with our policies around nurturing a safe and respectful work environment; never engaging in harassment, coercion, sexual exploitation or abuse of any form, or anything else contrary to our code of conduct.

QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

Experience

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent training in social science, international development, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of direct experience in Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and Impact for the Senior Officer role.
  • Experience working with women’s rights organisations, grassroots organizations and international partners in humanitarian settings and reporting to humanitarian donors is a requirement.
  • Strong skills in qualitative and quantitative research, data analysis and visualization, and evaluation methods.
  • Excellent computer skills including proficiency in MS Excel and working knowledge of data analysis and research-related software tools.
  • Demonstrated high ethical standards and ability to work with sensitive information in a confidential manner.

Adaptive Competencies

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Compliance Officer rigoureux(se) et expérimenté(e), capable de sécuriser nos activités tout en soutenant notre développement commercial.

Vos missions

  • Assurer la veille réglementaire continue (AMF, ESMA, CySEC, FCA ou toute autre autorité compétente selon les marchés visés) et anticiper les évolutions législatives impactant l'activité de courtage.
  • Mettre en place, actualiser et faire respecter les procédures internes de conformité (KYC, LCB-FT/AML, gestion des conflits d'intérêts, protection des données).
  • Piloter les processus KYC/KYB et de vérification d'identité des clients, en lien avec les équipes support et onboarding.
  • Rédiger, mettre à jour et diffuser les politiques et procédures internes (compliance manual, code de conduite, politiques AML/CTF).
  • Réaliser des contrôles réguliers (contrôles de premier et second niveau) et des audits internes pour identifier les risques de non-conformité.
  • Assurer le suivi des transactions suspectes et la déclaration aux autorités compétentes (type déclarations de soupçon).
  • Être l'interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des régulateurs lors des inspections, audits ou demandes d'information.
  • Former et sensibiliser les équipes internes (commerciales, support, marketing) aux obligations réglementaires et aux bonnes pratiques de conformité.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes juridiques, risques et direction générale pour évaluer l'impact réglementaire des nouveaux produits, marchés ou partenariats.
  • Assurer une veille concurrentielle sur les pratiques de conformité du secteur afin de maintenir un haut niveau d'exigence face à un environnement réglementaire mouvant.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience confirmée (2 à 5 ans minimum) en compliance, idéalement au sein d'un broker, d'une société d'investissement, d'une banque ou d'un établissement de paiement.
  • Bonne connaissance des réglementations applicables au trading et aux marchés financiers (MiFID II, LCB-FT, RGPD, réglementations locales selon les juridictions).
  • Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de procédures KYC/AML et dans la gestion de la relation avec les régulateurs.
  • Rigueur, sens de l'éthique et capacité à faire preuve de fermeté face aux enjeux réglementaires, tout en restant un partenaire business pragmatique.
  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse (rapports, procédures, réponses aux régulateurs).
  • Anglais courant indispensable (environnement international, échanges avec régulateurs étrangers).
  • Une certification professionnelle (ex. ICA, ACAMS ou équivalent) est un plus apprécié.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant avec de multiples départements (juridique, risques, produit, marketing).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle clé et stratégique au sein d'une structure en croissance, avec une réelle influence sur les décisions de l'entreprise.
  • Un environnement de travail international, au contact direct des enjeux réglementaires les plus actuels du secteur.
  • L'opportunité de structurer et faire évoluer la fonction compliance au sein d'un broker en pleine expansion sur un marché de niche.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a 3D Graphics Engineer to own and advance the real-time rendering engine at the heart of our web-based digital twin platform.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a 3D Graphics Engineer to own and advance the real-time rendering engine at the heart of our web-based digital twin platform. You will work in our Three.js and React Three Fiber rendering library, building photoreal, high-performance 3D experiences (architectural walkthroughs, immersive sales experiences, and Gaussian-splat captures of real spaces) that run in the browser across kiosks, tablets, desktops, and large-format displays.
This is a deep, specialist engineering role focused on real-time graphics, performance, and the 3D asset pipeline. You will partner with our full stack and web developers, who own the surrounding web app, CMS, and APIs, and with our content and 3D-capture teams. The rendering engine and its visual quality are yours to own and push forward.

At Imerza, we are pioneers in architectural visualization software, specializing in digital twins and real-estate marketing. We turn architectural concepts into breathtaking, immersive experiences that run everywhere from a sales-center video wall to a tablet in a buyer's hands.

Key Responsibilities

Rendering and Graphics (primary focus)
  • Build and maintain our real-time Three.js and React Three Fiber rendering engine.
  • Implement and optimize rendering features: lighting (lightmaps, HDR and image-based lighting, ambient occlusion), anti-aliasing, materials, and post-processing.
  • Integrate Gaussian splat captures alongside traditional mesh-based 3D content.
  • Write and debug GLSL shaders and custom materials.
  • Develop camera systems, navigation, waypoints, and scene interaction.
Asset and Performance Pipeline
  • Own the 3D asset pipeline: glTF and GLB optimization, Draco and mesh compression, KTX2 and Basis texture conversion, and lightmap baking.
  • Profile and optimize for frame rate, memory, and load time across constrained devices (tablets, kiosks) and large displays.
  • Use spatial structures (BVH) for fast raycasting, picking, and pathfinding.
  • Build diagnostics and debug tooling that keep visual quality and performance measurable.
Collaboration
  • Partner with full stack and web developers to expose clean, well-documented renderer APIs to the web app.
  • Work with 3D-capture, content, and design teams to bring real spaces and designs into the engine.
  • Contribute to the Nx monorepo with strong testing, code review, and documentation.
  • Help define the technical direction of immersive and photoreal experiences.
Our Stack

Core (what you will work in daily)
  • A custom Three.js rendering engine (@imerza/threejs-renderer) built on React Three Fiber and drei, mounted inside a Next.js app.
  • Gaussian splatting via Spark (@sparkjsdev/spark) for photoreal capture of real-world spaces, rendered alongside traditional mesh-based content.
  • glTF and GLB asset pipelines with Draco compression, KTX2 and Basis textures, baked lightmaps, and HDR image-based lighting.
  • WebGL and GLSL shaders, post-processing (temporal anti-aliasing, ambient occlusion), and spatial acceleration with three-mesh-bvh.
  • WebXR immersive viewing via @react-three/xr, including a 360 viewer.
  • TypeScript throughout, in an Nx monorepo with pnpm workspaces.
Adjacent areas (owned by other engineers; good to understand)
  • The React and Next.js plus Payload CMS web app that hosts and configures the renderer.
  • Real-time digital-twin data streamed into scenes over MQTT.
  • AWS (CDK) and Docker-based on-prem deployments.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 3 to 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent on real-time 3D or graphics.
  • Deep proficiency with Three.js (React Three Fiber experience is a strong plus).
  • Solid WebGL and GLSL shader experience.
  • Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills.
  • Experience with 3D asset formats and pipelines (glTF and GLB, textures, compression).
  • A strong grasp of 3D math (vectors, matrices, quaternions, transforms, and cameras).
  • Experience profiling and optimizing rendering performance and memory usage.
  • A strong eye for visual quality, lighting, and detail.
Nice to Have
  • Gaussian splatting or radiance fields (Spark, Luma, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or NeRF-adjacent work).
  • Experience with KTX2 and Basis, Draco, or meshopt compression.
  • PBR materials, baked lighting and lightmap workflows, and HDR or image-based lighting.
  • WebXR, VR, or AR (@react-three/xr or similar).
  • Familiarity with DCC tools (Blender, 3ds Max, Maya) and capture or photogrammetry pipelines (RealityCapture, Postshot, and similar).
  • Experience with Unreal Engine or another real-time engine.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, or a monorepo (Nx, Turborepo).
  • Architecture, AEC, BIM, or spatial-data background.
  • Experience with PlayCanvas

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge digital twin and immersive visualization technology.
  • A collaborative, product-driven engineering culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • A flexible work environment with real opportunities for growth.
