Reimagine the infrastructure of cancer care within a community that values integrity, inspires growth, and is uniquely positioned to create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. We’re looking for an advanced practice provider to help us accomplish our mission to improve and extend lives by learning from the experience of every person with cancer. Are you ready to be the next changemaker in cancer care?

What You'll Do

As an Advanced Practice Provider (APP) on the Clinical Oncology Team, you will use your deep expertise in oncology and genomics to inform the design, development, and optimization of Flatiron Health’s point of care products, tools, and service.

The Clinical Oncology Genomics APP will play a critical role in supporting the integration of genomic data, insights, and testing decision support at the point of care. This individual will serve as a subject matter expert at the intersection of clinical practice and precision medicine. The role is designed for an advanced practice provider (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) with deep experience in clinical oncology, genomic testing, test result interpretation, and subsequent patient care and clinical decisions. In addition you will:

Clinical-Genomics Product Expert

  • Serve as the subject matter expert at the intersection of clinical oncology and genomics for Flatiron’s product development teams.
  • Interpret complex genomic test results and translate clinical workflows into actionable product requirements.
  • Advise on the integration of molecular diagnostics and precision medicine into Flatiron’s software solutions, ensuring products reflect real-world clinical needs and best practices.
  • Review and validate product features related to genomic data capture, interpretation, and clinical decision support.

Product & Workflow Enhancement

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to inform and test enhancements to clinical workflows in OncoEMR and other Flatiron products.
  • Represent the voice of providers in product discovery, scoping, development, rollout, and maintenance phases.
  • Surface real-world challenges from practices and translate them into actionable product requirements and process improvements.

Education & Enablement

  • Develop and deliver educational resources (e.g., guides, presentations, webinars) to help practices utilize point of care genomic testing recommendations, orders, and results in support of personalized patient care.
  • Serve as a resource for Flatiron colleagues, providing clear explanations of genomic concepts and their impact on product design and user experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between clinical workflows, product features, and business objectives.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary discussions focused on the clinical implications of genomics in oncology care.
  • Stay current on advances in molecular diagnostics, targeted therapies, and precision medicine guidelines to inform ongoing product innovation.

Who You Are

You're a kind, passionate and collaborative problem-solver who values the opportunity to think beyond the way things are.

  • You are an experienced Advanced Practice Provider (NP or PA) with at least 5 years of oncology experience in a community or academic setting.
  • You have demonstrated expertise in interpreting genomic test results (e.g., NGS panels) across vendors (Caris, FMI, Guardant) and understand how these results inform treatment decisions and have taken action on them in a clinical setting for patients.
  • You possess a deep understanding of the clinical-genomics landscape, including familiarity with NCCN Guidelines, molecular diagnostics, and precision medicine workflows.
  • You are an excellent communicator who can distill complex genomic concepts for diverse audiences—product managers, engineers, designers, and other non-clinical stakeholders.
  • You are passionate about education and have experience developing or delivering training on clinical-genomics topics.
  • You are collaborative, resourceful, and thrive in a fast-paced environment focused on improving cancer care through technology.

Extra credit

  • Experience with OncoEMR or similar oncology EHRs; experience with Flatiron Assist is a plus.
  • Prior involvement in clinical research or quality improvement initiatives related to precision medicine.
  • City of Hope Genomics Risk Assessment Certified

Where you’ll work

If NYC Based:

In this hybrid role, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and 3 office days set by you and your team. For more information on our approach to hybrid work, please visit the how we work website.

If you are Remote:

In this remote position, you have the freedom to choose your preferred work location while aligning your working hours with your team's. For further details on our hybrid work approach and remote work type, please visit the how we work website.

Life at Flatiron

At Flatiron Health, we offer a full range of benefits to support you and your loved ones so you can focus your working hours on improving cancer care and accelerating cancer research, and your non-working hours on everything else life has to offer:

  • Path to parenthood programs supporting fertility, adoption and surrogacy

About Backstory

Backstory (formerly People.ai) is the leading AI answers platform for sales teams. With more than a decade of training AI models on billions of sales interactions, Backstory enables modern sales teams to ask questions and get the right answer in the moment directly within their existing AI workflows. Sales leaders from companies like OpenAI, IBM, Red Hat, Verizon, Palo Alto Networks, Iron Mountain, TransUnion, Randstad and others rely on Backstory to get trusted answers wrapped in real business context helping them orchestrate deals more effectively and drive revenue.

By connecting every signal to the right accounts and opportunities, Backstory shows teams exactly what is happening and what to do next. Customers across industries including enterprise, cybersecurity, data and analytics, and defense use Backstory to drive trillions in pipeline and revenue.

Recognized by Gartner and Forrester, the Inc. 5000, Y Combinator Top Companies, and the Forbes AI 50, Backstory is based in San Francisco and backed by ICONIQ Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Akkadian Ventures and Mubadala Capital.

The Role

We are hiring a Sr. Director of GTM Operations to build the operating system behind Backstory’s growth. You will own the metrics, systems, cadences, and commercial operations that let a small, AI-leveraged team run what once took a much larger ops function. The role reports to the SVP of Customer Value.

This role brings GTM operations together in one place. Comp design, territory and quota planning, pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration consolidate here instead of sitting in separate functions. Sales, CS, and Partnerships should run on one integrated operating system.

You will present quarterly results and forward guidance to the Executive Leadership Team, and be the authority on how confident leadership should be in the numbers. You will also run our GTM on Backstory itself, turning our own operating model into a proof point for customers.

Responsibilities

    Measurement and data foundation

  • Instrument the full customer journey, from pre-funnel and partner activity through credit consumption and expansion. At our scale, this is a weeks-not-months deliverable.

  • Define the GTM data model, funnel stages, and metric definitions so numbers reconcile across Sales, CS, Partnerships, and Finance.

  • Connect product usage and billing data to the revenue stack so every customer is represented completely and consistently.

  • Govern CRM fields and data quality through automation and clear standards, not manual cleanup.

    • Forecasting and executive reporting

  • Design and run a forecasting rhythm built for a consumption-based, land-and-expand model: channel and marketing activity into pipeline, new-logo velocity, consumption trajectories, and expansion revenue.

  • Present completed-quarter results and forward guidance to the ELT at each quarter-end.

  • Give ELT members the analysis, forecasts, and materials they need to run their functions and report upward.

  • Run forecast reviews, pipeline inspections, and business reviews as forums for decisions, not status updates.

  • Use the data to pressure-test plans and flag risk early, even when the conclusion is unwelcome.

    • Intelligence layer and AI

  • Build AI-driven reporting and analysis across solution presentation, adoption, credit consumption, and customer outcomes, with Backstory as the primary source of truth.

  • Deliver automated briefings, pipeline intelligence, and self-serve analytics to the whole GTM organization, not just leadership.

  • Make build, buy, or connect decisions for the GTM data and tooling that power instrumentation and the intelligence layer.

    • Retention and expansion signals

  • Re-anchor our early warning system around solution adoption: credit consumption, feature activation, workflow integration depth, CS engagement, and conversation signals.

  • Turn those signals into a review cadence and save and expand plays triggered by what customers are actually doing.

  • Feed adoption-based churn and expansion signals into the forecast, so save and expand plays show up in projected revenue.

    • Commercial operations

  • Comp plan design for Sales, CS, and Partnerships, in partnership with Finance and People.

  • Territory, quota, and capacity planning, including clear rules of engagement and handoffs across direct, CS, and partner teams.

  • CPQ and pricing approvals, from quote to close.

  • Lead routing across marketing, sales, CS, and partners, with defined service levels.

  • Day-to-day CRM administration and the health of revenue-critical systems.

    • Be Our Best Customer

  • Run Backstory's GTM on Backstory, learning from our strongest adopters and trying uses customers that have not yet tried.

  • Document the results so they can be referenced in customer and prospect conversations.

  • Engage with customers and the market as a practitioner of the platform.

Qualifications

  • Builder instinct. You have built functions, systems, or processes from scratch rather than inheriting mature ones. You reach for leverage before headcount and lead a small team while staying close to the work.

  • Applied AI. Deep understanding of the AI tooling landscape and the ability to make informed tooling decisions and understand where Backstory fits. You have deployed LLMs and AI tools in operational workflows, not just evaluated them. You know where AI outperforms traditional automation and where it adds risk. You have experience building the right AI infrastructure and supporting the change management required.

  • GTM operating model fluency. You have run GTM operations through a real business model change, ideally consumption-based, land-and-expand, or channel-augmented. You can set the right metrics framework and put it in place without a long assessment phase.

  • Data architecture literacy. You understand how GTM data is structured and flows across CRM, warehouse, and AI layers well enough to design instrumentation and make build, buy, or connect decisions. You don't need to be an engineer, but you don't depend on one to understand the data model.

  • Forecasting authority. You know ARR forecasting deeply: where each input comes from, how it is calculated, and where it may be wrong. You can reconcile sources and tell executives how confident to be and why.

  • Commercial operations depth. You have hands-on experience with comp design, territory and quota planning, CPQ and pricing approvals, lead routing, and CRM administration.

  • SaaS metrics fluency. You can connect ARR, GRR, NDR, CAC, pipeline coverage, capacity, and productivity to how the business actually performs.

  • Modern data tooling: working knowledge of SQL, dbt, or BI tools.

  • Executive presence. You can present a difficult conclusion to the ELT without hiding behind the analysis, and push back constructively when the data calls for it.

  • Experience. Typically 10+ years in revenue operations, GTM operations, or GTM strategy at a growth-stage B2B SaaS company, including leading a team.

    • Nice to have

  • Chief of Staff or CEO-adjacent experience: translating strategic intent into operating plans, preparing board materials, and managing cross-functional work without formal authority.

  • Channel and partnership operations: tracking, attribution, and handoffs between partner-sourced and direct pipeline.

  • Usage- or consumption-based pricing: structuring and governing credit-based deals.

The successful candidate will be a confident and empathetic communicator, capable of engaging with customers sensitively on responsible gambling matters and conveying regulatory requirements clearly. They will handle customer interactions professionally, assess customer risk indicators, and take appropriate action in line with internal procedures and regulatory obligations.

A key part of this role is the delivery of high-quality, empathetic customer interactions, ensuring that customers who may be experiencing gambling-related harm are identified early, engaged with appropriately, and supported in line with regulatory expectations and QuinnBet's safer gambling framework.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement safer gambling policies and procedures in line with regulatory expectations and internal procedures
  • Maintain compliance with UKGC, Irish, and Gibraltar frameworks in all customer-facing activity
  • Conduct proactive and reactive customer interactions to identify and act on behavioural, affordability, and financial risk indicators
  • Review customer accounts and activity to identify patterns of concern, applying appropriate interventions including deposit limits, cooling-off periods, self-exclusion referrals, and GAMSTOP signposting
  • Complete affordability assessments and responsible gambling interactions in line with UKGC financial risk thresholds, escalating to the Safer Gambling Manager or Team Lead where enhanced review is required
  • Handle customer contacts relating to safer gambling, responsible gaming concerns, and self-exclusion requests in a professional, non-judgmental, and empathetic manner
  • Support the handling and resolution of safer gambling-related customer queries and complaints, escalating to the Safer Gambling Manager or team lead where appropriate
  • Maintain accurate and complete case records in the case management system, ensuring all customer interactions are documented with a recorded outcome, rational and next action
  • Receive quality assurance feedback from the Quality team and act on it promptly, working with the Safer Gambling Manager and Team lead to develop and improve performance
  • Support onboarding and continuous training by sharing knowledge and contributing to a consistent team approach
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and licensing requirements by maintaining audit-ready case files and documentation

Education and Experience Required.

  • A minimum of one year's experience in a related role, preferably in the gaming, financial services, or customer-facing compliance sector
  • Demonstrable understanding of UKGC safer gambling regulations, guidance, and expectations, or a willingness to develop this knowledge rapidly
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise and deliver in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a high degree of personal accountability, integrity, and trust
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to assess customer risk indicators and apply sound, consistent judgment
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and discretion when handling sensitive customer information
  • Recognised relevant qualification is desirable; the company will support further certification if required
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in fluent English

What We Offer

Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager independently leads complex projects and engagements across multiple workstreams, stakeholder groups, vendors, and delivery dependencies. This role integrates scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, governance, and change into a coherent delivery approach, using sound judgment to navigate ambiguity, manage tradeoffs, and maintain momentum when plans or assumptions change.

The role anticipates delivery risks, facilitates difficult tradeoff and recovery discussions, and gives senior stakeholders clear, decision-ready recommendations. It also mentors project managers and strengthens governance and delivery discipline while remaining focused on assigned projects rather than assuming ownership of a broader program or account portfolio.

Location: Remote – United States

Key ResponsibilitiesComplex Project Delivery
  • Independently own delivery of complex projects and engagements with minimal oversight, aligning delivery activities to intended client outcomes.
  • Build and maintain integrated plans across workstreams, milestones, teams, vendors, and dependencies; coordinate cross-functional contributors through ambiguity and changing priorities.
  • Apply sound judgment to scope, schedule, budget, quality, resource, commercial, and delivery-recovery tradeoffs as conditions change.
  • Protect quality, acceptance criteria, operational readiness, team health, and delivery commitments throughout the project lifecycle.
Risk, Governance & Stakeholder Leadership
  • Anticipate risks and constraints, develop contingency and recovery plans, and escalate material issues with clear analysis and recommendations.
  • Lead complex governance forums and stakeholder discussions; communicate delivery health, options, impacts, decisions, and required actions clearly.
  • Manage project financials, forecasts, change requests, resource needs, commitments, and delivery variances with the appropriate business and delivery partners.
Adobe Platform & Cross-Team Coordination

Team Development & Continuous Improvement

  • Strengthen project standards, reusable practices, reporting, and lessons learned within the assigned delivery area

  • Strong command of integrated project planning, scope and change control, scheduling, budgeting, resource coordination, quality, governance, and delivery reporting.

  • Experience anticipating delivery risks, creating mitigation or recovery plans, and escalating material decisions with actionable recommendations.

jobs.description:
Accelerate your development and exposure to high‑performance data platforms and cloud infrastructure. Join Sedona Digital, a fast‑growing scale‑up with the ambition to be recognised as one of the leading technology companies in Romania.

Our global client base needs builders, engineers who enjoy designing and implementing scalable data platforms, have deep expertise in cloud data technologies, and take pride in delivering reliable, well‑governed solutions.

At Sedona, we:

  • Create an open, collaborative culture
  • Invest in learning and long‑term careers

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PySpark, SQL and Databricks to support a strategic data engineering engagement within the insurance sector.

The role focuses on transitioning existing data and reporting capabilities towards controlled, reusable and sustainable solutions. You will work within a small product team, collaborating with engineers, data professionals and business subject-matter experts to deliver robust data pipelines, reconciliation capabilities and well-governed data solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on working code, automated testing, data quality, reconciliation, technical documentation and effective handover.

Responsibilities:

  • Assess and re-engineer ingestion pipelines from operational and source-system data, reducing dependencies on tactical or manually maintained data feeds where appropriate.
  • Design and implement robust data mappings, lineage, dependencies and controlled migration or cutover approaches.
  • Develop and maintain detailed data reconciliation processes to validate engineering changes and explain movements in values, record counts, inclusion rules and hierarchy assignments.
  • Refactor and enhance PySpark-based data processing and hierarchy/roll-up capabilities, introducing appropriate testing, versioning, metadata, observability and deployment controls.
  • Work closely with business and technical SMEs to expand and improve data coverage based on business priorities and consumer requirements.
  • Assess GCP data pipeline options and contribute to implementation where the platform and operating model are appropriately established.
  • Assess opportunities to source mappings and reference data directly from operational systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, reducing reliance on manual data submissions.
  • Support changes to reporting hierarchies and filtering logic, including impact assessment, testing and reconciliation.
  • Build and maintain automated data-quality checks, monitoring and operational controls.
  • Support the transition and adoption of centralised reporting and data capabilities by incorporating prioritised data feeds and requirements.
  • Produce concise technical documentation, decision records, reconciliation evidence, variance explanations and handover materials.
  • Deliver through a prioritised backlog and short iterative sprints, working collaboratively with other engineers and stakeholders.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering or closely related data roles, with significant hands-on experience building and supporting production data solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, SQL and Databricks, including the development and support of production-grade data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP data technologies and data pipelines.
  • Experience with data pipeline testing, optimisation and operational support.
  • Strong experience with dimensional, master/reference or hierarchical data modelling.
  • Experience implementing complex entity matching, data mappings and roll-up logic with appropriate traceability.
  • Practical experience implementing automated data-quality checks and reconciliation processes.
  • Experience with observability, audit history, version control and CI/CD within data engineering solutions.
  • Experience assessing source-system data and documenting data contracts, mappings, lineage and dependencies.
  • Experience managing controlled data pipeline or platform transitions.
  • Ability to investigate data issues and clearly explain variances in values, record counts, mappings and hierarchy outcomes.
  • Ability to work directly with platform teams, analysts and business SMEs, translating ambiguous reporting and mapping needs into tested engineering solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to produce concise technical documentation, decision records, variance explanations and handover materials.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working within a collaborative, iterative delivery environment.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience working within Insurance, London Market, Reinsurance, broker, distribution or policy-level data environments.
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or comparable operational source systems.
  • Experience with Power BI, including semantic models and reporting dependencies.
  • Experience with Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCDs) and historical hierarchy management.
  • Experience supporting complex master/reference data, entity matching and hierarchy solutions.
  • Experience investigating historical data and reporting discrepancies.
  • Experience supporting controlled data migrations, source-system transitions or platform changes.
  • Experience working within distributed Agile teams and collaborating with UK-based business and technical stakeholders.

Key Tools & Technologies

  • GCP
  • Databricks
  • PySpark
  • SQL
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Power BI
  • Git / Version Control
  • CI/CD
  • Data Quality & Reconciliation
  • Data Lineage & Metadata Management

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management

  • Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
  • Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
  • Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.
  • Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.
  • Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
  • Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
  • Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.

2. Construction & Commissioning Integration

  • Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
  • Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
  • Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
  • Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.

3. Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Power Management Systems (PMS)
  • SCADA
  • DCS and industrial control platforms
  • PLCs and industrial controllers
  • RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
  • EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
  • Environmental and mechanical controls
  • Industrial networking infrastructure
  • Engineering workstations and management platforms
  • Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
  • Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.

· 4. Data Center Operations Integration

  • Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
  • Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
  • Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
  • Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.

5. OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination

  • Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
  • Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
  • Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
  • Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
  • Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
  • Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.

6. Technical Logistics & Readiness

Own the technical-readiness process covering:

  • Site access
  • Assessment workstations
  • Network connectivity
  • Engineering system access
  • Required documentation
  • Network and controls architecture
  • Asset inventories
  • Configuration documentation
  • OEM technical resources
  • System integrator resources
  • Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
  • Testing windows
  • Evidence collection
  • Technical repositories
  • Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal readiness gate before site mobilization.

7. Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination

  • Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
  • Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
  • Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
  • Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
  • Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
  • Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.

8. Program Governance & Reporting

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.

MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We're an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact.

We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to act as the operational backbone of our engineering team. The initial focus of this role is to take operational ownership of our legacy environment, while helping shape the architecture and strategy for our future-facing projects.

You'll ensure the stability, security, and high availability of our core production VMs running Java/Tomcat applications and MySQL 5.7 instances. You'll manage incidents, diagnose root causes, tune performance, and keep these critical legacy systems stable.

At the same time, you'll partner with us on our long-term growth. We're actively developing multiple new products and services on modern tech stacks and need someone who can balance maintaining legacy reliability with helping us design and scale our next-generation cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Incident Response & Operational Stability: Own the incident management lifecycle for production. Triage alerts, troubleshoot OS-level bottlenecks, debug performance issues, and drive rapid root-cause analysis.

  • Performance Monitoring & Debugging: Actively monitor system performance, application logs, and resource health using modern observability platforms (such as Observe by Snowflake) to quickly diagnose and resolve operational issues.

  • Legacy Infrastructure Management: Proactively maintain, patch, and secure our existing virtual machines on GCP.

  • Legacy Database Operations & Health: Monitor MySQL 5.7 instances, manage backups, and troubleshoot connection pool exhaustion or locking issues.

  • Cloud Architecture & Modernization: Collaborate to design, provision, and scale forward-looking cloud infrastructure for our new products and services, incorporating modern cloud-native tools and managed services (such as Cloud SQL and BigQuery).

  • Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Gradually replace manual operational tasks with clean automation scripts and infrastructure tools to reduce toil and improve repeatability.

  • Security & Compliance: Ensure systems comply with enterprise security baselines through rigorous OS hardening, access controls, and vulnerability patching.

Qualificiations:

  • Experience: 5+ years in a System Administration, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Operations role within an enterprise environment.

  • Legacy Stack Mastery:

    • Deep expertise in Linux administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting (including storage and file system management, specifically ZFS).

    • Proven experience running, tuning, and debugging Java/Tomcat applications in production.

    • Strong working knowledge of MySQL 5.7, including query tuning, replication, backup/restore strategies, and migration troubleshooting.

    • Proficiency in shell scripting and writing lightweight automation (Bash)

  • Cloud & Modernization Experience:

    • Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and managed services, including operational databases (Cloud SQL) and data warehousing platforms (BigQuery).

    • Production experience architecting and running containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes to support new product stacks.

    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform) and modern CI/CD deployment workflows.

  • Mindset & Soft Skills:

    • Calm under pressure: A methodical, safety-first approach to live-site incident response.

    • Pragmatic problem solver: You understand the realities of legacy software and prefer practical, stable solutions over chasing unproven tech fads.

    • Strong communication skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders during high-stakes migrations or outages.

Ideal Experience / But Not Required:

  • Familiarity with Java development, enabling you to read application code, assist developers with debugging, or understand internal stack traces more deeply.

  • Experience with transitioning legacy tech stacks to modern GCP / cloud-native setups.

The annual gross base salary range is $90,000 - $150,000USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

Pourquoi Ingeno?

Travailler chez Ingeno, c'est évoluer dans une entreprise qui valorise l'innovation et l'humain, et qui mise sur l'expertise et la rigueur de ses équipes pour dé-risquer les mandats de ses clients. Nos interlocuteurs sont souvent des dirigeants qui nous confient des enjeux d'affaires stratégiques. Le Responsable Produit (Product Owner) est leur point de contact privilégié : c'est lui qui transforme des problèmes complexes en produits livrables, en faisant le pont entre le client et nos équipes de développement.

Une personne dynamique et passionnée, dotée d'une grande capacité à collaborer, à écouter et à traduire les besoins en solutions concrètes mais aussi à challenger les hypothèses d'un client avec assurance et crédibilité. Tu as au moins cinq ans d'expérience comme Responsable Produit (Product Owner) dans un environnement Agile (Scrum, Kanban ou Lean), idéalement acquise en studio, en agence ou en conseil, où tu as livré des produits from scratch pour des clients externes. Une certification PSPO, PMI-ACP ou équivalente est un atout.

Tes responsabilités

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients pour recueillir, cadrer et définir leurs besoins;
  • Cadrer la valeur d'affaires d'un mandat et challenger les hypothèses du client pour orienter les bonnes décisions;
  • Agir comme interlocuteur crédible auprès de dirigeants (C-level);
  • Définir le produit minimum viable (MVP) et piloter sa livraison sous contraintes de temps et de budget;
  • Définir et communiquer la feuille de route (roadmap) du produit;
  • S'assurer que l'équipe de développement partage une vision commune du produit;
  • Rédiger les user stories et les valider avec les parties prenantes;
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog de produit en mode Agile;
  • Faciliter les cérémonies Agile (revue de sprint, démo, rétrospective, etc.);
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de design produit pour valider les hypothèses et ajuster la vision du produit.

Ce que nous apprécions chez toi

  • Tu utilises les outils d'IA pour optimiser ton travail au quotidien, et tu comprends leur potentiel pour les produits que nous concevons;
  • Tu es bilingue : tu peux non seulement échanger, mais aussi rédiger et présenter des livrables professionnels en français comme en anglais;
  • Tu as une grande capacité à vulgariser et à communiquer des concepts complexes;
  • Tu possèdes de l'expérience en création de produits numériques;
  • Tu démontres du leadership, une attitude positive et une bonne dose d'empathie envers les utilisateurs;
  • Tu fais preuve d'une grande rigueur et d'un sens du détail;
  • Tu incarnes une passion pour l'innovation et les nouvelles technologies.

Travailler chez Ingeno, c'est aussi...

  • Une politique de télétravail 100% Remote First, avec la possibilité de venir travailler dans nos bureaux à Québec;
  • Un horaire flexible pour que tu puisses profiter de tes passions;
  • 26 jours de vacances et deux jours de maladie dès ton premier jour;
  • Assurances collectives;
  • Un budget pour certains aspects de l'aménagement de ton espace de travail;
  • Un budget annuel pour des activités sociales et sportives;
  • Accès à un gym au bureau de Québec, télémédecine, PAE et une politique santé et bien-être;
  • La possibilité de demander du temps d'étude pour compléter une certification en lien avec tes responsabilités;
  • Des collègues incroyablement compétent(e)s avec qui partager ta passion et grandir;
  • Et bien plus encore!

Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cyera is seeking a Privacy Specialist to help us win and expand our privacy line of business. This is a technical, customer-facing go-to-market role that supports our sales organization. You will be the privacy expert in the room alongside our Account Executives and Sales Engineers, turning a prospect's privacy requirements into compelling, credible demonstrations, proofs of value, and RFP responses that help our sellers move deals forward. You will work in front of prospects and customers across the full suite of privacy capabilities, including data subject requests, data mapping, privacy assessments, risk management, and consent and preference management.

To be clear about what this is: a technical, external-facing role that supports our sales team, not an in-house privacy or compliance role. Your privacy expertise matters because it helps our sellers win. You will be equally comfortable presenting to executive privacy leaders and to hands-on technologists and operators, building tailored demos, and writing RFP responses that stand out. You will be a key player in how Cyera sells privacy, and your insight from the field will shape the product. We're an AI-forward team, and the strongest candidates will show us how they use AI to work smarter and how they'd help customers navigate the intersection of AI, privacy, and data security.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Field Engagement

  • Serve as the privacy subject matter expert for sales and solutions teams, joining discovery calls, demos, and executive briefings with prospects and customers.
  • Build and deliver tailored demos that connect Cyera's privacy capabilities to each customer's regulatory drivers, operating model, and existing use cases.
  • Lead proof of value engagements from scoping through customer readout, including success criteria, tenant and environment setup with the account team, and aligning product capabilities to customer use cases.
  • Own privacy responses to RFPs, RFIs, and related questionnaires, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely answers and coordinating input from internal teams.
  • Coach go-to-market (GTM) teams on privacy discovery and qualification, and help them pursue privacy opportunities across prospects and existing accounts.

Pre-Sales Support

  • Run the privacy demo request process, including intake, prep documentation, agendas, and engaging the right SMEs for each call.
  • Provide privacy-specific input to sellers and Revenue Operations so privacy opportunities are accurately scoped and recorded in our CRM.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact on active pursuits, POVs, and RFPs.
  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success and Implementation teams so customers move smoothly from sale to deployment.

Product and Technical Expertise

  • Act as a power user of the privacy products, with working knowledge of its modules, integrations, and configuration, so you can demo and troubleshoot with confidence.
  • Capture structured customer feedback, feature gaps, and win and loss insights, and relay them to the Product team to influence the roadmap.

GTM Enablement

  • Develop demo scripts, talk tracks, and recorded walkthroughs across the full suite of privacy capabilities.
  • Enable and certify technical teams to present privacy modules with confidence.
  • Work with Product Marketing to turn field learnings into positioning, collateral, and customer stories.

Privacy and Data Landscape

  • Translate regulatory and market developments (GDPR, US state laws, AI regulation) into clear positioning, sales plays, and customer guidance.
  • Help shape Cyera's point of view on how privacy, data security, and AI intersect.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years in a privacy-focused pre-sales, solutions engineering, privacy consulting, or technical privacy implementation role.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and deliver tailored product demos to technical and executive audiences, in person and virtually.
  • Strong working knowledge of privacy laws and frameworks (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state laws), emerging frameworks around AI governance, and core privacy operations concepts such as DSRs, data mapping, RoPA, privacy impact assessments, and consent.
  • Exceptional written communication, with the ability to produce clear, accurate, and persuasive responses, proposals, and customer-ready documents.
  • Excellent presentation skills and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for privacy, legal, security, and data leaders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment, working in or alongside Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.

Nice to have

  • Everyday AI fluency: you already use AI tools to sharpen research, call prep, drafting, and follow-up, and you enjoy sharing what works with teammates.
  • Curiosity about the AI opportunity: you can explain how AI adoption raises the stakes for privacy and data governance (assessments, data mapping, processing records) and turn that into a compelling conversation with customers.
  • Experience with privacy tooling where you have selected, implemented or operated these tools in-house or through consulting engagements.
  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP, CIPM, or CIPT.
  • Familiarity with data security concepts such as data discovery and data classification.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

You’ll work with a designer embedded from our creative team and with outside agency partners, and you’ll help shape the right mix of in-house and agency support over time. Expect to build a fair amount yourself and to use AI to produce what sales needs.

The sales motions you'll support

Each of these has its own buyers, sales cycle and proof points. Part of the job is knowing which materials and programs can be shared across motions and which need to be built separately.

Positioning and sales support as the motion grows

Role commitments

  • Tie marketing to commercial revenue: Work with commercial sales leadership to turn their priorities into a marketing plan and budget, and show what marketing contributes to pipeline in each sales motion.
  • Win in luxury hospitality: Help our hospitality team win more hotel, resort and spa business by building the credibility and proof we need in a segment where we’re still establishing ourselves.
  • Help sales win more deals: Make sure reps and dealers have current, accurate materials for every customer conversation, and turn new requests around quickly.
  • Make iFIT a reason to buy: Position connected equipment and iFIT content as a differentiator against competitors, and support iFIT subscription sales into gyms, universities, corporations and hospitality.
  • Own Freemotion: Be the Freemotion brand owner, responsible for its positioning, standards and reputation with commercial buyers.
  • Earn NordicTrack credibility in commercial: NordicTrack is best known as a home fitness brand. Build its standing with commercial buyers, leading with Pilates, through proof such as premium installations, case studies and partnerships, within the standards set by the NordicTrack brand team.
  • Build the right support model: Get the most from our in-house and agency resources, and shape the mix over time so sales gets faster, better support.

Essential duties and responsibilities

Strategy and positioning

  • Define and prioritize segments across fitness facilities (big-box, franchise, university, military, corporate, multifamily), hospitality and wellness (luxury hotels, resorts, spas, residential), and Pilates studio founders.
  • Build segment positioning, messaging and proof points for Freemotion and NordicTrack Commercial, applying NordicTrack brand standards set by the NordicTrack brand team, and partner with the Senior Creative Director on Freemotion's visual identity and commercial creative standards.
  • Track competitors (e.g., Technogym, Life Fitness, Matrix, Precor; Balanced Body and Merrithew in Pilates) and buyer trends, and turn them into guidance sales can use.
  • Own commercial launch planning: timelines, assets, training and success metrics.

Sales enablement and partnership

  • Partner with sales leaders across every motion, including domestic, rest-of-world, our VP of Hospitality, and iFIT B2B, on priorities and target accounts.
  • Build a hospitality marketing program in partnership with our VP of Hospitality: flagship properties, case studies, design-trade presence and experiential events.
  • Own the sales toolkit: segment decks, brochures, spec sheets, proposal templates, ROI and total-cost-of-ownership tools, battlecards and rep onboarding materials.
  • Build a proof engine: case studies, testimonials, reference customers and co-marketing around new installations.
  • Run a customer advisory board and referral program with hotel, gym and studio customers.
  • Support distributors and dealers, including localized materials for European markets.
  • Run a simple intake and prioritization process so sales requests are delivered quickly and predictably.

Demand and pipeline

  • Partner with the paid media and web teams on website lead capture, conversion and lead generation across every sales motion.
  • Build on the studio founder discovery completed before you join: launch a pilot quickly, then scale the channels that produce qualified leads.
  • Give territory managers simple playbooks for following up on studio leads, and coach them on using them.
  • Brief any paid media to studio prospects within the paid media team's standards, and track leads, cost per lead and conversion.
  • Run account-based campaigns and LinkedIn programs for priority gyms and hotel groups.
  • Work with sales operations to make sure inbound leads are captured, routed and followed up, with clear reporting on lead sources, conversion and pipeline sourced and influenced.
  • Own trade show and commercial event strategy and content, partnering with the events manager on execution.
  • Manage our agency partners, including for social media and trade PR in fitness and hospitality media.

Team and operations

  • Lead and develop the team, and make the case for new roles as the business grows.
  • Set up AI tools and workflows for producing sales materials, copy, localized versions and account-specific content, with checks for quality, accuracy and brand.
  • Use AI within iFIT's policies on AI use, data privacy and intellectual property, and train the team to do the same.
  • Build key materials hands-on, and set the embedded designer’s commercial priorities in partnership with the Senior Creative Director.
  • Assess which work is best done in-house and which by agencies, recommend changes, and manage vendors for PR, freelance and production work.
  • Own the commercial marketing budget and report results to marketing and commercial leadership.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Sales has a single front door to marketing, with a known turnaround for requests.
  • Decision rights with the NordicTrack brand team and commercial sales are agreed.
  • A hospitality plan is agreed with sales, including a target property list.
  • The most-used hospitality and studio sales materials are refreshed, and a studio pilot is launched based on the discovery completed before you joined.
  • A clear working rhythm with our agency partners is in place, and leads and pipeline influenced have a baseline.

In your first 90 days

  • Hospitality: outreach to target properties is live, at least one flagship property is committed with sales, and the first hospitality case study is in production.
  • Pilates studios: the pilot is producing qualified leads for territory managers, and the best-performing channel is being scaled.
  • The core sales toolkit for every segment is current and in a shared library reps use.
  • Commercial leadership has approved a 2027 commercial marketing plan: priority segments and accounts, trade show calendar, budget and measures.
  • You’ve recommended the right mix of in-house and agency support for the year ahead.

By the end of your first year

  • Commercial marketing's contribution to pipeline is measured by segment and growing.
  • The studio funnel produces a steady flow of qualified leads at a target cost, scaled up through the channels the pilot proved out.
  • Hospitality pipeline and wins are growing, with flagship properties to point to.
  • Commercial buyers see NordicTrack as a credible choice, backed by flagship installations and case studies.
  • Sales materials are delivered faster and to a higher standard than today, supported by an AI-enabled production system.

Education and experience

Basic qualifications (measurable, disqualifier)

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field.
  • 8+ years in marketing, including 4+ years in B2B or commercial marketing for physical products (fitness equipment, hospitality supply or similar).
  • Track record partnering with a quota-carrying sales organization, with measurable pipeline or revenue impact.
  • 3+ years marketing to hospitality buyers, such as hotel and resort owners and operators, hotel brands, spas or hospitality design firms, with a track record of helping win business in the segment.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience planning trade shows and experiential events.
  • Hands-on ability to build sales materials, write copy, and brief and direct designers and agencies.
  • Experience managing people, agencies and a budget.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20%, including internationally.

Preferred qualifications (non-measurable, not a disqualifier)

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

jobs.description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for an Associate Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:
  • Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license.

You will love this job if...

  • You have 1-2 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.
  • You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.
  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels.
  • You are proficient with CRM tools.
  • You are comfortable with a high volume of proactive outbound calls as a core, everyday part of the role.
  • Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus.

Let's be honest!
This is a proactive, commercially focused customer success role. You will be responsible for renewal and expansion revenue, minimizing churn, confirming coverage accuracy, handling objections, and following up on payment. Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role.
As a function, this team is a net revenue retention play. The goal is to move net revenue retention from 102% to 105% in Year 1, calculated as expansion plus renewal minus churn. Individual measures roll up to the team's overall net revenue retention target, not a standalone quota.

If you need a bit more information...

This position runs on a structured outbound calling cadence, proactively checking in with every customer approximately 90 days ahead of their renewal date to confirm coverage, catch any new sites or locations, and resolve compliance questions well before renewal.

You will monitor customer usage declarations against public sources, provide compliance assurance, handle renewal objections, identify and close upsell opportunities, and take direct ownership of ensuring customer invoices are paid in full and on time. You will also coordinate with Legal and Finance on deal amendments and documentation, maintain accurate CRM records, and escalate the most complex renewal objections, compliance questions, or at-risk accounts to a senior colleague.

Benefits

  • Remote located in the United States
  • Comprehensive health insurance package (medical, dental, sick pay)

  • 15 days paid vacation

What Helps Explorers Succeed Here

Your Required Skills and Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Certification: At least one current ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification.
  • ServiceNow Development: Hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring, and deploying ServiceNow applications and platform solutions.
  • Integrations: Experience developing and supporting ServiceNow integrations with external systems.

  • CI/CD: Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes within a ServiceNow environment.
  • Technical Development: Strong scripting and development capabilities, including JavaScript and related ServiceNow development technologies.
  • Communication: Strong client-facing communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Why Explorers Stay

  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on growth and continuous learning.
  • Opportunities to expand into broader engineering and DevSecOps ownership areas.
  • Meaningful work supporting mission-driven programs with real-world impact.

How We Work

  • This is a client-facing role that includes virtual collaboration and occasional customer interaction.
  • Team members are expected to actively engage through Slack, Teams, email, Monday.com, and other collaboration tools during standard business hours.
  • Availability for meetings and collaboration between 9AM–5PM EST is expected.
  • Cameras on during virtual meetings is part of our collaborative culture.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. everything people. You understand what creates value in a professional services business: the depth of
client relationships, the continuity of the teams that serve them, the expertise that compounds over a

tracks rather than one ladder, and the compensation and performance systems that reward client impact
and the outcomes clients pay for. You lead and guide our internal People team, including our recruiting, HR,
and compliance leads: you set the strategy, standards, and priorities, and they run execution in their areas.
You earn credibility with delivery teams by connecting with them at their level: you understand their work,

working through our recruiting lead.

internally what we sell externally.
Transformation Leader
You own the people side of Propeller's transformation into an AI-enabled firm. You redesign roles as AI takes
on the mechanical work, build the AI fluency programs that move every team member from awareness to
daily practice, and reshape performance expectations so the new behaviors are the ones that get recognized
and rewarded. You know that resistance is rarely about the tool; it is about identity, trust, and what people
believe the change means for them. You bring a clear, tested point of view on how to lead through that, and
you hold leaders accountable for doing it with you. You also partner with our Transformation practice to
bring change management to client system and process implementations, where the people side decides
whether the technology delivers. If your change playbook is a launch email and a training deck, this isn't
your role.
• Lead the people side of Propeller's AI transformation: role redesign, AI fluency training, change
management, and adoption measurement.
• Redefine what great looks like in each role as the work shifts from producing outputs to exercising
judgment.

to client engagements.
Practice Builder
You own the People Services practice end to end: offering, pipeline, delivery, and P&L. You accelerate our
existing payroll services and build around them the HR services small and growth-stage companies need:
handbooks and policies, multi-state compliance, onboarding and offboarding, compensation benchmarking,

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

jobs.description:
Security Engineer

Overview: Supply Chain Security and Compliance

The Security Engineer is a critical role responsible for implementing and enforcing robust security practices across our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will safeguard e-commerce transactions, secure internal tool integrations, and establish the trust framework for our AI agent operations, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards like PCI-DSS and GDPR.

Internship Details

  • Duration: 3 months (extendable based on performance and project scope)

  • Start Date: Immediate

  • Location: Remote

  • Stipend: Unpaid initially; may convert to a paid internship, full-time role, or even direct client absorption (FTE) based on your performance

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will secure all layers of the application, from the Next.js frontend to the NestJS modular monolith and the cloud infrastructure.

  • Security Architecture & Threat Modeling: Perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and threat modeling for all new features and systems, focusing on the critical MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS business process flow.

  • Compliance Enforcement: Lead the implementation and auditing of security controls necessary for PCI-DSS compliance (for Payment module) and GDPR compliance (for user/tenant data handling).

  • Access Control & Authentication: Implement and manage secure API authentication methods, including OAuth 2.0 and SAML, utilizing Authentik/Ory Kratos and leveraging PostgreSQL's Row-Level Security (RLS) for tenant isolation.

  • Secrets & Encryption: Manage secrets and key rotation using Vault, define and enforce encryption protocols for data both in transit and at rest, and manage certificates via Traefik.

  • Abuse Prevention: Implement and monitor controls for API rate limiting, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, and traffic monitoring to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks.

  • Incident Response: Develop and practice incident investigation and response protocols. Conduct security awareness training for development and operations teams.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess hands-on security experience with our core stack and compliance tools:

  • Platform Security: Node.js/NestJS security best practices, Next.js/React security, PostgreSQL RLS.

  • Compliance Focus: Experience with PCI-DSS and GDPR controls and auditing.

  • Authentication & Access: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, Authentik/Ory Kratos.

  • Secrets & Infrastructure: HashiCorp Vault, Docker, Terraform.

  • Monitoring & Assessment: Tools for Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST).

AI Agent Security

You will be responsible for securing the emerging AI ecosystem.

  • Agent Trust Framework: Establish security boundaries for the AI agent interfaces, ensuring agents (built with LangChain/AutoGen) operate within strict permissions when accessing supply chain data (WMS, OMS).

  • Prompt Injection Prevention: Implement validation and sanitization techniques to mitigate prompt injection and data exfiltration risks in user-facing LLM interactions.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Security Scorecard: Reduction in identified vulnerabilities from assessments and code reviews (SAST/DAST).

  • Compliance Audits: Successful passing of regular PCI-DSS and GDPR audits.

  • Incident Handling: Speed and effectiveness of security incident investigation and remediation.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, working closely with the development and DevOps teams to embed security into the CI/CD pipeline.

jobs.title: Launch Growth Marketer, Dash
jobs.excerpt: We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere.
jobs.description:
We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere.

Who we are

Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian.

Our Mission

To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.

Our culture

Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships.

If you're entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!

The Opportunity

Dash is a managed AI teammate for small teams, built by Process Street. It picks up the recurring work that falls between people — the follow-ups, the handoffs, the things everyone assumes someone else did — and does it in Slack or Microsoft Teams, checking with a human before anything goes out.

Dash is new, and most of the people who'd love it haven't heard of it yet. Your job is to change that, and to turn the attention you create into pipeline.

This is demand creation, not demand capture, and the distinction shapes everything. There's no proven channel to scale, no playbook to inherit, and no installed base to build referral or expansion programs on. Every source of growth has to be invented and proven before anyone can optimize it.

The role has four connected parts: create attention, produce the content that sustains it, convert it into pipeline, and keep finding the next advantage. They're one job. The campaigns only work because there's a content engine behind them, the content only compounds because there's a conversion engine in front of it, and none of it holds for long without constant experimentation.

Dash runs like a startup inside a funded one. Process Street has investors behind it. Dash has a small team, its own budget, and has to earn its next dollar — which is exactly why this role exists. Budget won't be the lever that makes a campaign succeed. Creativity, timing, partnerships, and earned attention will be. We want someone whose instinct is to manufacture reach rather than purchase it, and who treats a small budget as a design constraint rather than an obstacle. The same discipline applies to the direct marketing engine: spend should be deliberate, measured, and defensible against the pipeline it produces.

You'll have real leverage behind you. Much of our content, research, and distribution runs on an automated production layer, so one person here can put far more into market than they could at a company doing this by hand. You won't be limited by how much you can produce. You'll be limited by what you decide is worth making — and whether it's good enough to ship, backed by a system that moves as fast as you think.

What You'll Do

  • Run stunts that earn attention. Conceive and execute the kind of campaign people stop for and share. This is a distinct craft, and we're hiring for it deliberately.
  • Build launch moments. Time the creative, the paid push, and partner distribution to land together. One well-built moment is worth more than months of steady output.
  • Build creative partnerships. Source, negotiate, and close deals with creators, communities, and complementary brands, including working out what makes each one worth their while.
  • Invent channels, online and off. Prove new routes to an audience that doesn't know us yet, using events and activations as part of an integrated campaign, and be as quick to abandon what doesn't work as to pursue what does.
  • Own the content calendar and the output. We publish at high volume across search, video, social, and community. You own what gets made, when it ships, and whether it's good enough.
  • Direct the automated production layer. Brief the agents, review what comes back, correct what's wrong, and extend the system into new formats and channels. Make modern content — short-form video, images, ads, and written work — at a pace that only works if you use AI as a genuine force multiplier.
  • Own discovery in both directions. Traditional search optimization and AI-assisted discovery, where a growing share of buyers now form their shortlist. Work the conversation through community and reply marketing where our audience already is, kept human rather than automated into noise.
  • Hold the brand line. Dash has a distinct voice and personality. Everything that ships sounds like it, including the work the agents produced. You make the final call.
  • Convert attention into pipeline. Stand up and operate the direct marketing engine, run the ad accounts across the major platforms, and keep a clear, measurable path from spend to qualified opportunity. Direct agencies and partners with content and context, challenge their thinking, and verify their numbers rather than accepting their reporting.
  • Keep finding the next advantage. Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with a visible record of what each one produced, assess new AI tools and formats weekly and adopt the few that matter, mine customer and market data for insight, and track what competitors are doing that's worth beating.

About You

  • You've created demand for something people weren't looking for, and you can show what you did.
  • You generate ideas that travel, and you can tell those apart from ideas that only sound good internally.
  • You're commercially minded. Awareness that doesn't become pipeline doesn't interest you.
  • You get more out of a small budget than most people get out of a large one.
  • You work quickly and would rather run several experiments than plan one perfectly.
  • You have a sharp eye for detail and can tell immediately when AI-assisted output is off or missing the point.
  • You learn new tools fast, go deep on them without being asked, and enjoy that part most.
  • You're comfortable across analytics, publishing, and advertising platforms, and you understand how search, AI-assisted discovery, and outbound fit together. Depth in every one isn't expected — the appetite to learn whatever an experiment needs is.
  • You want responsibility for an outcome that's genuinely undecided.

Useful, but not required:

  • Partnerships, influencer, or creator marketing, particularly deals you sourced and closed yourself
  • Events or activations you've planned and run
  • Building with AI tools, including agents, automations, and content workflows
  • Short-form video production and editing
  • Editing and copywriting
  • Marketing a product distributed through a platform ecosystem such as Slack or Microsoft Teams
  • Community and conversational marketing on X, LinkedIn, or Reddit
  • A working growth stack: web and product analytics, search console, advertising platforms, CRM, and retention tooling
  • A/B testing and conversion rate optimization
  • Enough technical literacy to wire tools together, such as HTML and CSS, SQL, or no-code automation platforms
  • Taking a product to market from zero rather than scaling one that already works

Our Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO policy — most take 3–4 weeks, plus their major holidays, AND a company-wide week off in December.
  • Company offsite and sponsored small-group meetups.
  • Social time — coffee chats, games, story-telling, optional house tours.
  • Equity for all full-time roles.
  • Generous health insurance for US employees and their families, including dental and vision plans.
  • A chance to shape how companies around the world run through the future of no-code automation.

Apply, even if you're not sure

Research shows that some people hesitate to apply unless they match every line of a job description. If this role excites you and you'd bring most of what we've described, we'd rather see your application than miss you. Tell us what you've built and what you'd do here.

Equal Opportunity

Process Street is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We're committed to building a team that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

A note on recruitment scams

All communication from our recruiting team comes from an @process.st email address. We will never ask you for payment, banking details, or equipment purchases at any stage of the hiring process. If you receive an offer or request that looks like it's from Process Street but doesn't come from an @process.st address, please don't respond, and let us know.
