Our engineers work remotely across the United States and its territories, including Puerto Rico, so building ways of working that span time zones is central to this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop engineering leadership. Own the engineering leadership team, including directors and managers. Set clear expectations, coach with candor, and build a leadership bench that scales with the company.
  • Build and retain a high-caliber workforce. Own the engineering workforce plan, hiring strategy, and interview process, and apply our career ladder consistently, to triple the team without lowering the bar. Make timely, fair decisions on performance and staffing.
  • Shape the engineering culture. Define working norms, career paths, recognition, and feedback loops around how our engineers actually want to work, and protect that culture as we grow.
  • Communicate with clarity at every level. Set direction and context for the whole engineering organization, and represent engineering to the executive team, the board as needed, and customers. Translate technical trade-offs into business and mission terms.
  • Own delivery and accountability. Partner with product leadership to turn priorities into predictable delivery, balancing roadmap commitments, technical debt, architecture, and capacity across a growing portfolio. Establish the metrics and operating rhythm that show how engineering is performing.
  • Set technical direction and consolidate platforms. Working with the CTO, rationalize the toolchain, development environments, and shared infrastructure across our Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React codebases and our AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare environments to reduce duplication and speed delivery.
  • Scale skills and knowledge. Put documentation standards, shared engineering practices, onboarding, and training in place so knowledge lives in the organization rather than with individuals.
  • Hold the bar on security and quality. Ensure engineering practices meet the security, compliance, and reliability standards our government and allied customers require, including deployments onto small form factor computers in constrained and disconnected environments.
  • Lead a remote team across U.S. time zones and territories. Set core collaboration hours, meeting cadences, and on-call rotations that work across the continental U.S., Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and other territories, with written, asynchronous communication as the default.
  • Partner across the business. Work closely with the CTO, Product, Security, People, Business Operations, and IT on budget, headcount, vendor decisions, and company-level planning.
  • Travel up to 25% to our McLean, VA headquarters, team gatherings, and customer sites.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations through other managers, with at least 3 years at the director level or above.
  • Prior experience as an engineering leader at a small or early-stage company (for example, under 200 employees), including operating with limited process and building structure as the company scales.
  • Demonstrated success as a people leader: developing managers, building diverse and high-performing teams, handling difficult performance and staffing decisions, and retaining top talent through rapid growth.
  • Proven success scaling an engineering organization through rapid growth, including building hiring pipelines and interview processes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with a record of setting direction, giving candid feedback, and explaining engineering trade-offs to executives, boards, and customers.
  • Proven experience leading a fully remote engineering organization across multiple time zones, including schedules, core hours, meeting cadences, and on-call coverage.
  • Hands-on technical background in modern software delivery (cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevSecOps), including production experience with at least one of Rust, Go, or TypeScript and with AWS, GCP, or Cloudflare, deep enough to make sound architecture decisions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience across our stack: Rust, Go, TypeScript, and React, deployed on AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare (including Workers).
  • Experience shipping software to small form factor computers and other edge hardware, including resource-constrained or disconnected deployments.
  • Experience leading engineering for products delivered to the DoD, Intelligence Community, or allied governments, including accredited, air-gapped, or edge environments.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Experience building or scaling data platforms, data integration, or AI/ML products in production.
  • Experience leading a toolchain consolidation, platform engineering, or developer-experience initiative across multiple teams.
  • Experience managing an engineering budget and contributing to company-level strategy.
  • Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the United States and U.S. territories

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

jobs.excerpt: Welcome to Clearway Health - At Clearway Health, we’ve been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for four years in a row—and we’re just getting started.
jobs.description:
Welcome to Clearway Health - At Clearway Health, we’ve been recognized as a Great Place to Work® for four years in a row—and we’re just getting started. We’re redefining specialty pharmacy by improving access to care, delivering personalized support, and helping patients navigate complex medication needs. Our award-winning culture is built on empowering our people to grow, contribute, and make a difference every day. If you’re driven to create meaningful change and thrive in a collaborative, purpose-driven environment, you’ll fit right in. If you’re looking for a role where you can truly make an impact, keep reading below!

Position Summary:

​​Under the direction of the Senior Manager, Accounting, the Senior Accountant is responsible for the

preparation of monthly financial statements, general ledger reconciliations, complex journal entries,

intercompany transactions, bank reconciliations, accounts receivable reporting, and daily cash

management for Clearway Health. The role plays a key part in the month-end and year-end close

processes, proactively identifying improvements and efficiencies.

Responsibilities also include capital expenditure and WIP/JIP accounting, appropriate classification of

expenditures as capital or expense, and oversight of the company’s tax obligations, including sales

tax, income tax, business licenses, and annual reporting requirements. The Senior Accountant assists

with the annual audit, trains and mentors new accountants, and acts as the Subject Matter Expert

within the Accounting department. This is an execution-focused, non-managerial role.

Essential Responsibilities/Duties:

General Ledger & Month-End Close

  • Take ownership of day-to-day general ledger responsibilities and all aspects of the monthend and year-end close, including journal entries, cash receipts recording, and account reconciliations.
  • Prepare and review accounting entries posted to the general ledger to ensure proper accounting of expenses and revenue; extract and analyze data to prepare monthly financial statements, comparative reports, and account reconciliations.
  • Perform monthly general ledger account analysis and reconciliation for assigned accounts (cash, other accounts receivable, fixed assets, prepaid expenses, accounts payable, accrued expenses, etc.) and maintain and reconcile intercompany transactions.
  • Support the Senior Manager, Accounting by coordinating adherence to the month-end close calendar—monitoring deadlines, resolving issues with the relevant parties, and escalating problems in a timely manner.
  • Perform daily cash management activities and reconcile bank statements for the department.
  • Develop and implement accounting principles, practices, and procedures to ensure accurate and timely financial statements.

Audit, Tax & Capital Accounting

  • Assist with preparation of the annual audit package, including footnotes and all related analyses, and support timely completion of the audit.
  • Prepare and file Clearway Health’s tax returns (IRS Forms 990, 990-T, 1120-F, 4720 and applicable state returns), quarterly state sales and use tax returns, and annual exemption requests; prepare federal, state, and regulatory reports as needed.
  • Ensure accounting procedures comply with relevant tax legislation, regulations, and internal controls.
  • Assist with the capital approval and consolidated accounting processes, including appropriate classification of expenditures as capital or expense.
  • Manage capital spending accounting for WIP/JIP (works in progress / jobs in progress); determine and manage the closing of final fixed asset accounts with appropriate useful lives.

Reporting, Analysis & Collaboration

  • Support FP&A and the Senior Leadership team with financial reporting, performance, and variance analysis.
  • Develop and oversee the accounts receivable package for the Senior Leadership team.
  • Summarize balance sheets and reports for senior leadership and offer suggestions on resource utilization and the assumptions underlying budget forecasts.
  • Strategically analyze trends, costs, revenues, financial commitments, and obligations incurred to predict future operational needs and expenses.
  • Mentor and lead the training of new employees in general accounting policies and procedures; complete complex special projects and financial analysis as needed.
  • Promote open communication, team building, and collaboration among team members and between departments, utilizing Clearway’s High-5 values—Collaboration, Curiosity, Optimism, Respect, and Excellence—as the basis for decision-making.

Education

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree required with a major or concentration in Finance, Business Management or Accounting preferred. Masters or CPA are strongly preferred. 3 Years equivalent additional work experience considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.

Certificates, Licenses or Registrations:

  • Master’s degree or CPA preferred, but not required (in lieu of applicable work experience)

Experience:

  • ​​Minimum of five (5) years of financial/accounting experience; up to two (2) years may be waived for candidates with a master’s degree or CPA.
  • Managed services and/or healthcare or pharmacy-related experience preferred.
  • Experience with a large enterprise accounting and general ledger system such as Infor.
  • Experience supporting annual audits and preparing federal and state tax filings preferred.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Solid working knowledge of US GAAP and strong analytical skills.
  • Experience with large enterprise accounting and general ledger systems such as Infor.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.
  • Knowledge of auditing standards, regulatory requirements, and the healthcare industry preferred.
  • Exceptionally organized, with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet time-sensitive
  • Accounting judgment – Ability to apply US GAAP to complex journal entries, reconciliations, and capital-versus-expense classification decisions
  • Ownership and accountability – Ability to independently own day-to-day general ledger work and all aspects of month-end and year-end close within a lean team.
  • Communication – Strong oral and written communication skills to interact with all levels of personnel within and outside the organization.
  • Confidentiality and integrity – Proven ability to work with and maintain confidential financial information.
  • Adaptability and resilience – Positive attitude, flexibility, and professional demeanor in a highly demanding, fast-paced environment.
  • Team orientation and growth mindset – Dedicated team player willing to help in other areas of the department and to learn and grow within the organization

Special Working Conditions (On-call, travel, shift, coverage):

  • This position may require up to 10% annual travel

The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required. External and internal applicants, as well as position incumbents who become disabled as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, must be able to perform the essential job functions (as listed) either unaided or with the assistance of a reasonable accommodation to be determined by management on a case-by-case basis.

Build better healthcare together


Maple's purpose is to meet the world's healthcare needs. We're Canada's leading on-demand healthcare platform, connecting patients with Canadian-licensed doctors, nurse practitioners and specialists. Today, we're proud that over 8 million patients and 7,000 businesses and government partners have access to same-day, proactive and ongoing care. We enable people to take control of their health and push the boundaries of what's possible every day.

Bold minds. Big impact. A career at Maple is about making an impact. We empower bold thinking, surround you with an inspiring team and are driven by a motivating purpose. Here, you'll do work that changes lives—including your own.

The role

    As we continue to grow our Channel Partnerships business — one of Maple's largest commercial distribution channels, working with insurance providers, benefits brokers, and other organizations that bring virtual care to their members — we're looking for a Bilingual Client Success Associate (French/English) to own the day-to-day success of a portfolio of channel partners.

    In this role, you'll be the primary contact for your partners — moving programs from signed to live, running bilingual partner meetings, coordinating renewals, and keeping the behind-the-scenes mechanics running smoothly. You'll partner across Operations, Support, and Product to solve issues before they escalate, and you'll help build the playbooks that make our Channel Partnerships team stronger as it scales — with your Team Lead close by whenever you need a sounding board.

Your responsibilities

    As a Bilingual Client Success Associate, you will:

  • Act as the primary day-to-day contact for a portfolio of channel partners, keeping communication timely, professional, and responsive

  • Support program launches end to end, coordinating the technical and administrative steps so partners' members can access care without friction

  • Lead business reviews and everyday communications in both French and English for our national and Quebec-based partners

  • Coordinate renewals across your portfolio — tracking timelines, preparing renewal materials, and working with your Team Lead on pricing, contracts, and eligibility details

  • Manage the behind-the-scenes mechanics of our partnerships, from eligibility and billing cycles to keeping

  • Salesforce accurate and up to date

  • Partner across Operations, Support, and Product to resolve partner issues before they escalate

  • Use data to track partner performance — flagging risks early and making sure reporting is accurate and delivered on time

  • Spot gaps in existing workflows and help improve the playbooks that keep the Channel Partnerships team running as it grows

What success looks like

    In your first 90 days, you'll build a strong understanding of Maple's channel programs, tools, and workflows. You'll take ownership of your assigned portfolio, support active program launches, and start managing partner communication on your own — leaning on your Team Lead for the trickier calls, and building credibility by staying organized, responsive, and detail-oriented.

    Over the next 12 to 18 months, you'll confidently manage your portfolio end to end. You'll coordinate renewals across your accounts — building clear renewal narratives, tracking timelines, and navigating the variables that shape contract outcomes — contribute to partner expansions, and proactively surface insights that improve program delivery. You'll recognize patterns across your accounts, help strengthen recurring workflows, and play an active role in supporting the growth and stability of Maple's channel partners.

What you bring

  • Full bilingual fluency in French and English, with the confidence to lead meetings, manage written communication, and build relationships in both languages

  • Strong ownership — you follow through, stay organized, and manage multiple priorities without letting things slip

  • Clear, professional communication that builds trust with partners and internal stakeholders

  • Comfort balancing relationships and operations — from partner conversations to the detailed workflows behind billing, eligibility, and reporting

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving — you know when to take action and when to loop in your Team Lead

Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $5-$6.50/hour
performance-based increase after 6 months

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

  • Device Requirement: Mac OS required

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

Affirm runs its workloads on more than 85 Amazon EKS clusters, and the number is growing. The Workload Safety team creates one set of standards for how workloads are configured and run, so Affirm can grow globally and still meet its availability and latency SLOs. The team identifies the industry best practices Affirm needs, drives their adoption across every engineering team on EKS, and enforces them through policy and automation so new workloads comply by default.

As a senior engineer on the team, you will help set its roadmap, decide which standards matter most, and build a repeatable way to take each standard from research to enforcement across the fleet.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve workload safety standards for Affirm's EKS fleet, such as CPU and memory settings, workload isolation and placement, tolerance for disruption, graceful termination to name a few

  • Own each standard end to end: research and prototyping, white-glove onboarding for early adopters, self-service guidance for everyone else, and automation and policy guardrails that keep every workload compliant from day one

  • Lead cross-team initiatives from design through fleet-wide rollout, mentor other engineers, and set a high bar for design, code review, and operational readiness

  • Isolate workloads by criticality and resource profile so one misbehaving workload cannot degrade critical paths such as checkout

  • Fix stuck workloads and node lifecycle problems, such as pods that ignore termination signals, pod disruption budgets that block node cycling, and Karpenter timeouts that prevent bin packing and the removal of excess capacity

  • Determine the safe operating limits of each cluster (pod count, node count, API server request volume), keep clusters within them, and develop control plane scaling patterns for bursty workloads such as scheduled batch jobs and large deployments

  • Analyze workload resource profiles across the fleet (CPU, memory, disk, network) to guide EC2 instance type strategy, and automate that analysis as workloads change

  • Measure each standard's impact on availability, latency, risk, and cost, and use the results to prioritize the roadmap

  • Participate in on-call for Kubernetes runtime issues across the fleet, and turn recurring failure patterns into roadmap items

  • Work closely with the teams that run services, batch jobs, and ML workloads on EKS, and with the deployment, capacity, and SRE teams

  • Keep up with new best practices from the Kubernetes community and adapt them to Affirm's needs

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production at scale, ideally Amazon EKS across many clusters

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes resource management and scheduling: requests and limits, OOM and CPU throttling behavior, affinity and anti-affinity, taints and tolerations, and topology spread constraints

  • Solid grasp of the pod lifecycle and disruption management, including graceful termination, pod disruption budgets, and node draining

  • Experience enforcing configuration standards through admission control and policy-as-code (for example, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno)

  • Proficiency in Go or Python, including building production infrastructure software such as Kubernetes controllers, operators, or admission webhooks

  • Strong production debugging skills and a demonstrated ability to turn recurring incidents into systemic fixes

  • Track record of leading technical initiatives across multiple teams, driving adoption of shared standards, and mentoring other engineers

  • Experience quantifying the impact of infrastructure changes on availability, latency, and cost

  • Strong written communication, including standards and guidance that teams can adopt on their own

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOrbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Own the agentic systems at the center of Orbis AI — the orchestration, planning, retrieval, and tool-use machinery behind the Agent Catalog and the OSINT Agent Harness. You will build agents that hold up under real mission workloads and set the evaluation bar the rest of the organization writes against. This is senior engineering on AI systems: the hard problems are correctness, explainability, cost, and behavior at scale.

Travel: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and ship agents across the portfolio — knowledge agents over customer data, tool agents that wrap external operations, and goal-driven agents that plan and execute multi-step analysis.
  • Own the orchestration layer: planning, tool selection, state and memory, retries, partial failure, and termination behavior.
  • Design and own retrieval end to end — chunking, embedding, indexing, ranking, and the query-time behavior that decides answer quality.
  • Build the provenance and citation paths that let a user see how a conclusion was reached, and treat unexplainable output as a defect rather than a limitation.
  • Own the evaluation infrastructure for agent quality — accuracy, groundedness, explainability, latency, and cost — and set the standard other engineers write cases against.
  • Integrate model providers and third-party tools behind stable internal interfaces, and instrument agents so quality regressions and cost anomalies surface before a customer finds them.
  • Partner with research engineers to productionize validated results, and mentor engineers moving into AI work from a conventional software background.
  • Travel up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building LLM-backed or agentic systems in production
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript, with substantial production code in at least one
  • Deep practical experience with retrieval-augmented generation — embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, ranking, and the failure modes of each
  • Demonstrated experience building and debugging multi-step, tool-using agents, whether on a framework or from primitives
  • Proven rigor about evaluation, including harnesses that measured whether an AI change actually improved anything
  • Willingness to travel up to 15%

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution, or information extraction
  • Experience running open-weight models in constrained or disconnected environments where a hosted API is not an option
  • Experience with production observability and cost control for model-backed workloads
  • Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or research workflows and the accuracy and provenance expectations that come with them
  • Experience mentoring engineers into AI work from a conventional software background
  • Open-source contributions, publications, or academic collaboration in applied AI

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
  • Travel: Up to 15% for customer engagement, integration support, and team collaboration.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

  • Single owner: Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer from kickoff through training completion and early live use.

    • Portfolio management: Manage a portfolio of concurrent customers at different stages, prioritizing effectively to keep every account moving toward go-live.
    • Clean completion: Confirm that implementation and training milestones are fully met — not just delivered — before transitioning the account to Customer Success or Support.
    Implementation & Integration
    • Configure the MarketMan system for each customer: inventory, suppliers, recipes, locations, users, and permissions.

Senior Account Executive

📍 Remote (Canada) │ Hybrid Available – Kitchener, ON

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Manager, New Sales

💰 Salary range: $90,000–$100,000 CAD base

🏢 About Encircle

Encircle is leading the $1.6 trillion property insurance industry out of the dark ages of pen-and-paper processes, into the digital age of transparency and empowerment. Our easy-to-use software platform enables thousands of restoration contractors and insurance professionals around the world to process claims faster. We're a remote-first company with a collaboration hub in downtown Kitchener — and we're growing.

📌 About the Role

Restoration contractors choose Encircle because the first conversation feels different: people who know their industry, understand their business and show them exactly how Encircle makes them money. As Senior Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle - prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal and close - for a book of restoration, independent adjusting and multi-location accounts.

This is an end to end sales position. You’ll be held accountable to hunting your own deals, not just working the marketing funnel. You'll build pipeline of your own alongside meetings sourced by our BDR team, and you'll be coached to the same formula every AE runs on: discovery and demo, demo-to-proposal, proposal-to-close, sales cycle length and ACV, using the SPICED methodology and the documented playbook. As a senior member of the team, you're expected to perform at or above benchmark, take on the more complex, multi-stakeholder deals — franchise locations, multi-site operators, independent adjusting relationships — and help sharpen the playbook for the reps coming up behind you.

You'll work closely with Onboarding & Activation and Account Management so every new customer starts with a plan, and with our BDR team so sourced pipeline converts cleanly into revenue.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

Own the full sales cycle

  • Prospect and build pipeline in your territory: self-sourced outbound plus inbound and BDR-sourced meetings, managed as one connected funnel
  • Run discovery, demo, proposal and negotiation using SPICED and the documented playbook, converting at or above benchmark at every stage
  • Build and defend a monthly forecast — pipeline coverage, stage conversion and deal velocity you can stand behind
  • Own deal strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder accounts: franchise and network structures, multi-location operators and independent restoration relationships

Be the trusted advisor restoration contractors remember

  • Diagnose the real business pain behind every conversation — tool consolidation, adjuster pushback, time lost in the field, missed revenue on jobs — and connect it to how Encircle solves it
  • Run demos and presentations tailored to the room, from field crews to owners and executive leadership
  • Build account-based plans for named target accounts, including multi-location and franchise prospects
  • Use real ROI data and customer proof points to build a business case that holds up to scrutiny

Close clean and hand off cleaner

  • Close deals with signed contracts and accurate CRM data that sets up a smooth transition
  • Partner with Onboarding & Activation on a mutual onboarding plan at the point of close, so every new customer starts strong
  • Partner with Account Management on account context and handoff for multi-location and franchise-influenced accounts
  • Maintain Salesforce hygiene so your pipeline and deal data are accurate and usable by the wider business

Raise the bar for the team

  • Contribute to the AE playbook: what's working in discovery, demos, objection handling and negotiation, and feed it back to your manager
  • Mentor newer AEs through call reviews, deal strategy and territory planning as a senior peer on the team
  • Lead by example on activity and pipeline discipline, hitting or exceeding published benchmarks
  • Bring AI into your own workflow — account research, call prep, follow-up and forecasting — and share what works with the team

Collaborate across the business

  • Partner with BDRs on outbound targeting, meeting quality and handoff feedback
  • Partner with Marketing on lead quality, campaign feedback and product-led buying signals
  • Feed win-loss insights, objection patterns and competitive intelligence back to Marketing and Product
  • Partner with the Enterprise team on franchise-location opportunities that sit under a national or network relationship

Key Metrics You'll Own

•New ARR and quota attainment

•Pipeline coverage

•Stage conversion rates vs. benchmark

•ACV and product attach rate

•Sales cycle length

•Forecast accuracy

Immediate Priorities

In your first few months, you'll ramp to the formula and start proving it:

1.Complete onboarding and ramp to full quota productivity on the defined timeline

2.Build pipeline to target coverage against quota within your first 90 days

3.Run discovery, demo and proposal stages at or above published benchmarks

4.Close your first deals with a clean, documented handoff to Onboarding & Activation

✅ What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS (or similar) direct sales experience, with a stable, proven track record of quota attainment
  • Experience running discovery, demo, proposal and negotiation for multi-stakeholder deals — not just working a queue of inbound leads
  • Skilled at building account-based plans and self-sourcing pipeline, not just closing what's handed to you
  • Comfortable navigating franchise, multi-location or network buying structures, including access to decision-makers up to the C-suite
  • A track record of building and defending an accurate forecast
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and familiarity with sales tools like Gong and DocuSign
  • Fluency with AI tools in your own workflow — research, call prep, follow-up and forecasting
  • A consultative, industry-fluent selling style: you close deals customers are glad they signed
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience selling to blue-collar or field-based industries, or in vertical SaaS, is a plus but not required

🤝 Why Encircle?

We VALUE our people:

  • ⚖️ Balance: Flexible hours, self-managed vacation and trust to manage your time.
  • 🏠 Remote-first: Work where you're most productive — with access to our collaboration hub in Kitchener.
  • 🚀 Growth-oriented: We support your learning and career development.
  • 💪 Well-being: We care about the full human — inside and outside of work.

Encircle is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and will work with applicants to accommodate accessibility needs throughout the hiring process.

A Note on Authenticity: We value genuine interest and authentic interaction. jobs.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

About the Role

PrizePicks’ Creative Collective is looking to add a Lead 3D Designer to our roster. The Creative Collective is a small, high-conviction team built around one standard: commit fully or not at all. We move fast, debate hard, and once a call is made, we stand behind it together.

You'll lead our 3D discipline from start to finish, working alongside our Art Directors & Product teams to design a 3D language that adds to the fan experience in our product and throughout our marketing.

You are an elite 3D craftsperson first. You build characters, environments, and objects that add to the PrizePicks experience/brand, and you know when to hand-build and when to let AI tools do the heavy lifting so you can move faster without losing the idea. You're also the person who now decides how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and shipped across the organization.

If you've spent your career being the best 3D mind in every room you've been in and you're ready to lead the discipline instead of just contributing to it, this is it.

How We Work

Lead with conviction — Be Iverson

Bring work you believe in and have a strong POV. Authenticity matters more than the idea itself. If the idea could live with another brand's logo on it, it doesn't belong here. We'd rather refine a bold idea than try to save a safe one.

↳ Not: "This is just an option" or over-explaining to compensate for weak belief

Sharpen each other — Be Pharrell

Value direct feedback and be comfortable in conflict. Debate makes the work better. Once a call is made, we move together. Mediocre work is a collective failure, not an individual one.

↳ Not: Silent agreement followed by side conversations or ego-driven critique

Execute under pressure — Be Jordan

The standard does not change when the moment does. We move with precision and continually refine our judgment. Practice or clutch time, you show up with the same intensity.

↳ Not: "We didn't have time" or overcomplicating simple calls

Show up fully — Be Virgil

Show up wherever you are needed, whenever you are needed, without hesitation. Not for credit — for the outcome. It's not about doing everything. It's about doing what's required to make it right.

↳ Not: "That's not my job" or trying to protect your role over protecting the work

What You'll Do

Build worlds that feel unmistakably PrizePicks

  • Design and build 3D characters, environments, and objects for brand campaigns, product moments, and cultural activations
  • Translate 2D concepts and mood boards into fully realized 3D executions
  • Own the render quality bar — lighting, materials, composition — from first pass to final delivery

Push what 3D + AI can do together

  • Integrate AI image generation workflows (Weavy) into the 3D pipeline to speed up ideation and exploration
  • Experiment with real-time rendering and emerging tools that shorten the distance between idea and finished asset
  • Bring new techniques back to the team — you're the one testing what's next, not waiting for someone else to

Lead the 3D discipline through craft, not authority

  • Own how 3D work gets briefed, reviewed, and delivered across the team
  • Partner with the Art Directors so 3D work lands inside the bigger creative idea, not bolted onto it
  • Create an environment where 3D work at PrizePicks is something the team is genuinely proud of

Own the pipeline

  • Maintain clean, reusable asset libraries, rigs, and templates so the team can move fast without rebuilding from scratch
  • Balance multiple projects across brand, social, and campaign timelines without dropping quality
  • Know when to hand-build and when to lean on procedural or AI-assisted workflows to hit a deadline without cutting corners

Who You Are

  • A maker first who's ready to lead — you'd rather build it than brief it out, and the team gets better because they watch you work
  • Fast — what would take an agency weeks, you can do in days
  • Deep in the tools — Blender/C4D (or equivalent) is second nature, not something you're still learning
  • A player-coach — you lead through craft and feedback, not authority for its own sake
  • Low ego about ownership
  • Curious by default — new tools, new workflows, new techniques get you excited, not defensive
  • Chronically online enough to know what culture actually looks/feels like right now
  • Die hard sports fan

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of 3D design experience, with a portfolio that shows range across character, environment, and object design
  • Strong command of Blender (or equivalent: Cinema 4D, Maya) plus a rendering engine like Octane or Redshift
  • Comfort integrating AI tools into a creative pipeline — this isn't optional, it's how we work now
  • A sports, streetwear, or hip-hop culture fluency that shows up in your work, not just your playlist

Bonus Points

  • Experience with real-time engines (Unreal, Unity) or procedural tools (Houdini)
  • Experience managing, mentoring, or directly leading other 3D or design talent
  • Motion or animation background alongside 3D

What Success Looks Like

  • In 90 days, you’ll have a real working rhythm — the 3D work is faster and the output is sharper than it ever has been at PrizePicks.
  • In six months, there's 3D work with your fingerprints on it that's genuinely moved the brand forward — campaigns, product moments, cultural activations that wouldn't have looked the same without you.
  • In a year, the 3D discipline at PrizePicks is looked upon as the industry standard, and you're a big reason why.

Location

  • While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $90,000 to $110,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations
jobs.excerpt: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011.
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this Role

GiveDirectly's People Operations team owns global payroll, employee lifecycle, HR data, and total rewards delivery for a workforce spread across more than 20 countries. As the team has grown, so has the case for additional capacity at the leadership level to help own the operating engine that keeps payroll, service delivery, and people data running well every day. This role is that operating engine.

The Senior Manager, People Operations will manage a team of Associates and Coordinators (3 in total for now). You'll own end-to-end payroll delivery, the ticketing system and employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, transfers), HRIS data quality, and execution of the annual compensation cycle and mobility transactions. You'll be the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, and ticketing matters, and you'll build depth across your team so critical knowledge doesn't sit with one person.

This is a hands-on, builder's role. You'll set the operating model for your areas (cadence, controls, service standards) and be accountable for the outcomes, not just for delivering against someone else's plan.

Job Type: Full-time

Reports to: Senior Manager, People Operations

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours, and meaningful overlap with US Eastern hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirements: Must be able to travel ~3-4 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats and oversight.

What you'll do

  1. Team leadership and delivery:
    • Lead, coach, and develop a team, setting clear priorities, standards of work, and ownership across payroll, service delivery, people data, and lifecycle operations
    • Build depth and cover across the team so critical knowledge is not concentrated in one person, and establish clear escalation paths for absences and peak periods
    • Define the operating model for your areas, including cadence, controls, service standards, and how work is prioritized against the function roadmap
    • Serve as the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, lifecycle, and ticketing matters
  2. Global payroll:
    • Own end-to-end payroll delivery for all global staff across entities and employer of record arrangements, ensuring accurate and timely processing of salaries, benefits, and deductions
    • Own the payroll calendar, approvals, controls, and reconciliation, partnering with Finance on month-end, accruals, and people cost reporting
    • Manage payroll providers operationally, including service quality, issue resolution, invoicing, and migrations
    • Maintain current knowledge of payroll and statutory requirements across all operating locations, and drive the changes needed to stay compliant
    • Run annual bonus administration end to end, ensuring calculations are accurate and payments are made within designated timelines
  3. People operations service delivery and employee lifecycle:
    • Own the ticketing system and its operating rhythm, including triage, assignment, SLA performance, and reporting
    • Own onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and role changes as designed processes rather than a series of transactions, and be accountable for the experience they produce
    • Analyze trends and root causes of recurring issues and deliver structural fixes rather than repeat workarounds
    • Drive the implementation of tools that improve functionality and user experience
    • Act as the escalation point for complex or high-priority tickets, providing direction and ensuring timely resolution
  4. People data and systems:
    • Own HRIS operations and data quality, including the method for preventing inaccurate data entering the system at source
    • Own the people systems roadmap covering workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting infrastructure, partnering with IT and Finance on delivery
    • Run the audit and reporting cycle, and maintain reporting standards in practice
    • Produce the people reporting that leadership decisions rely on
  5. Total rewards and mobility operations:
    • Execute annual compensation cycles, salary adjustments, and increase rollouts accurately and on time
    • Own benefits administration across all locations, including renewals, enrollments, and issue resolution
    • Produce the analysis behind compensation decisions, including benchmarking, compa ratio and cost modelling, and equity audits
    • Execute mobility transactions end to end, including payroll and entity transfers, contract issuance, location-based pay changes, work permit and employer of record administration, and the supporting trackers and records
  6. Other tasks:
    • Participate in cross-functional initiatives and organizational projects, representing People Operations requirements
    • Perform all other duties that may be assigned to you from time to time by the Senior Manager, People Operations and stakeholders

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in People Operations, HR operations, or global payroll, including at least 2 years managing a team
  • Direct experience running multi-country payroll and people operations, ideally including Sub-Saharan Africa and employer of record arrangements
  • Demonstrated ownership of an HRIS, including an implementation, migration, or significant data quality turnaround
  • A systems and process mindset, with the ability to point to workflows you have automated, simplified, or eliminated
  • Working knowledge of employment and statutory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, with sound judgment on compliance risk and a clear sense of when to decide and when to escalate
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort with compensation and cost modelling and advanced spreadsheet ability
  • Ability to liaise remotely with a wide range of people at all levels and across different cultures, and to act with credibility, tact, and diplomacy
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical people operations content to non-specialist audiences
  • Comfort operating with incomplete guidance and shifting priorities, and strong time management across competing deadlines
  • Professionally proficient in English
  • Experience in a global non-profit, international development organization, or mission-driven company with an Africa presence preferred
  • Familiarity with employer of record and contractor models across multiple countries (Oyster, Remote, or similar) preferred
  • Aptitude to learn new software tools such as Slack, BambooHR, Jira, and Asana, and comfort with AI-assisted tools to streamline people operations workflows
  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $114,660
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$11,466, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $13,415 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $126,126+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £77,600
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~£7,760, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £9,079 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £85,360+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $83,820

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As a Senior GTM Systems Engineer, you will partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to help Apollo's revenue teams move faster and smarter through aligned processes, scalable systems, and actionable data. You will own Salesforce architecture and process design across the GTM funnel, and act as the systems SME for the business functions you support.

This role sits within the GTM Business Systems team and is focused on turning business problems into elegant, durable system solutions. You will work across GTM, R&D, and IT to govern a multi-instance Salesforce environment, support the next-generation quote-to-cash build ahead of Apollo's pre-IPO scale, and contribute to a growing portfolio of AI-driven GTM builds.

This is a strong fit for an analyst who wants to own architecture decisions rather than execute against a spec, and who enjoys operating as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical delivery.

What You'll Do

Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

  • Build a working command of Apollo's GTM business processes and tech stack, and review and update the full systems architecture map and process flow diagrams so the team has a reliable single source of truth.
  • Serve as the primary GTM Systems partner for one of the domains the team is organized around (TOFU: Marketing and Partnerships, MOFU: Sales, Success and Onboarding, or BOFU: Internal Tools and BI). Own keep-the-lights-on work and incremental improvements within sprints, become the systems SME for your domain, and lead bi-weekly alignment and backlog grooming sessions to establish a roadmap.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and Sales Operations to streamline the renewal process, including opportunity stages, pages, and page layouts.
  • Make and defend the architecture calls that do not get faster with AI: whether something should be a platform event or a custom object, and whether a routine field-mapping change will trigger a resync across millions of records.
  • Partner with GTM Systems engineers on AI-driven builds such as automated call coaching and deal scoring, demo instance automation, and AI-assisted CRM data capture. Help define the solution, not just configure it. Contribute across the full development lifecycle, from solution design through rollout and feedback.
  • Support the design, build, testing, rollout, and maintenance of next-generation quote-to-cash infrastructure in service of pre-IPO activities. This includes refining the opportunity model to reduce friction and increase accuracy for GTM teams processing new business, upsell, and renewal opportunities.
  • Own Salesforce initiatives and end-user support end to end. Build and maintain SFDC automation (flows, Apex, LWC), manage users, profiles, roles, and permission sets, administer page layouts, custom fields and objects, and record types, and handle data imports, exports, and upserts.
  • Implement and administer Salesforce-integrated tools as needed (for example Chili Piper, Ironclad, Gong), promote Salesforce best practices and end-user adoption, and keep functional and technical systems documentation thorough and current.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of business analysis or consulting experience, plus 4+ years of hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform in an administration or development capacity.
  • A college degree in a technical field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Deep understanding of go-to-market business processes and how systems support them across Marketing, BDR, Sales, and CS/Onboarding.
  • Hands-on Salesforce depth: creating and maintaining custom fields and custom objects, managing roles, profiles, permission sets, and sharing settings, and building automation with Flow (preferred) and Process Builder. Well versed with Data Loader.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and collaborate with multiple concurrent stakeholders, and to translate a vague business problem into a scoped, well-designed solution.
  • A track record of making and defending architecture decisions under ambiguity, not just executing against a spec.
  • Experience supporting end-to-end feature and system implementations: discovery and requirements gathering, vendor selection, solution design, build and configuration, QA/UAT, deployment, and training and communication.
  • Experience working within Agile methodology, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment while owning multiple projects with high attention to detail.
  • Strong logic, analytics, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication and time management. Microsoft Excel power user.
  • Nice to have: Salesforce Administrator certification, an active Trailhead account, experience across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, experience in Salesforce environments with 100+ users, and experience at high-growth companies (Series C through IPO, SaaS or PLG preferred).

AI Fluency & Tooling

Apollo operates at the intersection of AI and go-to-market, and our systems team is expected to lead from the front. This role requires genuine fluency in leveraging AI tooling. That means:

  • Using AI-assisted development tools as part of your build workflow. Whether it is Salesforce configuration, writing and debugging Apex or Flow logic, or working down technical debt, you should be reaching for tools like Claude, Cursor, or Codex wherever they accelerate delivery, while owning the judgment behind each change.
  • Structuring systems and data for AI interpretation. Understanding how to make GTM data clean, well-labeled, and accessible so AI tools can reason over it reliably. This includes object and schema design, field definitions, and semantic documentation.
  • Helping build AI-native GTM capability. Partnering on the design and rollout of AI agents and AI-assisted workflows inside the GTM stack, and thinking about where automation should replace manual process entirely.
  • Staying current as the tooling evolves. The AI tooling landscape is moving fast. We want systems people who are curious, self-directed learners: people who experiment, share what works, and help raise the floor for the whole team.

jobs.title: Cloud Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise.
jobs.description:
Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility. As a Microsoft Partner with seven specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value.

Your Impact

You are joining us to lead one of two peer functions within Atmosera's Client Operations organization: either the Technician team responsible for initial client support and ticket management, or the Administrator/Engineer team responsible for advanced administration, engineering, and escalated technical work. In either assignment, you will own the performance, development, service quality, and continuous improvement of your assigned team while partnering closely with the peer Client Operations manager to create a connected operating model and seamless client experience.

Your day-to-day will include coaching and developing employees; hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, capacity management, and 24x7 coverage; overseeing ticket health, workload, escalations, and incident, problem, and change practices; and using service data, automation, and AI to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability. You will maintain clear operating procedures, technical documentation, and client-specific runbooks; ensure employees are trained and appropriately authorized for their work; and partner with Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to support client environments and service transitions.

You will also work with peer Client Operations leaders to coordinate operational priorities, major incident response, cross-team improvements, and temporary leadership coverage during vacations, leaves, on-call rotations, and other business continuity situations. Success in this role means building a capable, accountable, and client-focused team; developing future leaders; strengthening operational discipline; and delivering measurable improvements in service performance and client experience.

What Success Looks Like

    We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a win for this role over your first year.

    After 90 Days

  • The Foundation: Develop a strong understanding of Atmosera's Client Operations organization, service delivery model, client portfolio, operational tooling, escalation paths, compliance requirements, and ITIL-based processes. Assess your team's capabilities, service performance, coverage model, operational health, and improvement opportunities.
  • The Integration: Establish trusted working relationships with your team, peer Client Operations leaders, Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Compliance, and other key stakeholders. Create clear expectations, accountability, communication rhythms, and partnership practices within your assigned function.
  • The Contribution: Identify and begin executing a measurable operational improvement focused on an area such as queue health, backlog reduction, escalation quality, incident management, change management, automation, knowledge management, service coverage, or client experience.

    • After 1 Year

  • Your Impact: Lead a high-performing operational team that consistently achieves its service objectives, contributes to strong client satisfaction, and supports operational excellence across Atmosera's managed services organization. Deliver measurable improvements in service performance, resolution quality, team capability, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Your Growth: Be recognized as a trusted leader who successfully balances the needs of clients, employees, and the business. Build the technical, operational, and leadership capability of your team while developing future leaders and supporting meaningful career progression.
  • Your Influence: Build strong partnerships across Client Operations and related departments, helping create repeatable operating practices, scalable processes, effective runbooks, automation opportunities, and service improvements that elevate the client experience and strengthen organizational effectiveness.

The Skills Matrix

    Required Skills: The Non-Negotiables

  • Years of Experience: Five or more years of experience in cloud operations, infrastructure operations, managed services, technical support, engineering, or service delivery, including at least three years directly managing technical teams.
  • Role-Specific Mastery: Experience leading a technical support, service delivery, engineering, operations, or managed services team in a fast-paced environment. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations, with the technical depth and troubleshooting expertise to guide either a Technician team or an Administrator/Engineer team and earn credibility with technical employees and stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to hire, onboard, coach, evaluate, and develop employees; establish clear expectations and development plans; and support career progression and certification attainment.
  • Operational Excellence: Experience owning service delivery for an assigned team in a 24x7 environment, including workforce and capacity planning, schedules, shift and on-call coverage, ticket health, workload management, and service quality. Ability to ensure work is prioritized, routed, documented, escalated, and resolved in line with service commitments; lead or support major incidents; enforce incident, problem, and change practices; maintain escalation paths, operating procedures, technical documentation, and client-specific runbooks; and ensure employees are trained and appropriately eligible, authorized, and assigned for regulated work. Sound judgment to balance urgency, quality, operational risk, coverage, and client communication under pressure, including the ability to pass a federal background check for Public Trust Fitness.
  • Communication: Clear, calm, and effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to report KPIs, service performance, emerging risks, incident summaries, improvement priorities, and recommended actions to individual contributors, technical contacts, client executives, and internal leadership. Commitment to professional, timely communication during incidents, escalations, operational reviews, and service transitions.
  • Collaboration: Experience partnering across operational teams and support functions to coordinate staffing, priorities, escalations, major incidents, service transitions, and continuous improvement. Ability to work closely with peer Client Operations leaders without blurring ownership of the assigned team; collaborate with Client Success, Professional Services, Security Operations, Security, and Compliance; support audits, evidence collection, and remediation; and provide temporary leadership coverage during vacations, leaves, on-call rotations, major incidents, and other business continuity situations.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to use service and workforce data to identify trends, root causes, resource needs, and operational risks, then implement durable solutions that reduce repeat incidents and improve the client experience. Experience owning and reporting relevant KPIs, such as SLA attainment, response and resolution time, escalation rate, backlog, ticket aging, change success rate, service quality, automation adoption, and client satisfaction. Demonstrated ability to improve processes, tooling, training, monitoring, documentation, automation, or AI-assisted workflows while coordinating cross-team changes to avoid unintended downstream impacts.

Nice to Have: The Bonus Points

  • Experience working for a managed services provider, ideally a Microsoft Azure Expert MSP.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or other relevant Azure certifications.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or an advanced ITIL certification.
  • Experience with Azure Lighthouse, Azure Monitor, Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Automation, PowerShell, monitoring and alert tuning, AIOps, or Copilot-enabled workflows.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP, HIPAA, HITRUST, IRS-1075, or comparable regulated environments, including audit support and secure operating practices.
  • Experience leading teams distributed across multiple time zones or countries.
  • Knowledge of IT security practices and secure cloud operations.
  • Experience with a ticketing or IT service management platform such as Zendesk or ServiceNow.

How We Show Up

    These Core Three represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best.

  • Humble: Low Ego, High Impact. We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth.
  • Hungry: Internal Drive. We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things.
  • Mindful: Intentional Awareness. We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness.

Our Interview Process

    We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typical interview process includes:

  • Talent Screen: 30 minutes. A conversation about your background, leadership experience, career goals, and the mission of the role.
  • Impact & Attributes Assessment: 45 minutes. A discussion focused on how you lead, solve problems, develop people, handle operational pressure, and demonstrate Atmosera's Core Three.
  • Collaborator Loop: 60-90 minutes. Conversations with key partners focused on your technical and operational capabilities, service management experience, leadership approach, and ability to work across teams. This stage may include a presentation, scenario, or work sample.
  • Final Alignment: 30 minutes. A closing conversation with leadership to align on expectations, organizational needs, and the impact of the role.
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial security. Here's what you can look forward to:

Financial Security & Growth:

Competitive Salary: We offer competitive salaries commensurate with experience and skills.
Generous 401(k) Plan: Secure your financial future with our generous 401(k) plan, featuring a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4% of your salary! This is a fantastic opportunity to build your retirement savings with our support.
Performance-Based Compensation: Your hard work and dedication will be recognized and rewarded through our performance-based compensation program, which includes bonus potential in addition to your base salary.

Health & Well-being:

100% Employer-Paid Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance for employees: Say goodbye to expensive premiums! We cover 100% of the cost of your health, vision, and dental insurance premiums, saving you potentially thousands of dollars each year. Focus on your health, not your healthcare costs.
Company-Paid Life, AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance: We provide company-paid life, accidental death & dismemberment, and short- and long-term disability insurance to protect you and your family.

Time Off & Work-Life Balance:

Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with three weeks of paid time off, allowing you to relax, recharge, and pursue your personal interests. This flexible PTO can be used for vacation, personal time, or sick leave.
11 Paid Holidays: We observe 11 paid holidays throughout the year, giving you additional time to spend with family and friends.
Community Service Leave: We believe in giving back to the community and offer paid time off for you to volunteer with organizations that are meaningful to you.

Additional Perks & Recognition:

Employee Recognition and Reward Program: We celebrate and reward outstanding performance and contributions through our employee recognition program. We value your dedication and are committed to showing our appreciation.

  • Carry a personal number. For the first stretch you're the closer on our largest opportunities, not the coach watching one.

6 months. 3x coverage against your number, several POCs in flight, your first hires closed and ramping, and a forecast the executive team stop second-guessing.

12 months. The forecast holds within a reasonable band. Reps are closing deals you weren't in. The playbook exists on paper and the team uses it repeatedly to win.
