jobs.excerpt: Senior DevOps / SRE EngineerThis is a remote position within the UK.
jobs.description:
Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer

This is a remote position within the UK. We currently don’t provide visa sponsorship.

You must be currently residing in the UK to apply.

We are a B2B Fintech focusing on disrupting the small business lending market. SMEs make up 99% of all UK businesses yet are traditionally underserved by big banks and financial institutions. Built from nearly a decade of experience powering a digital credit broking marketplace, our SaaS solutions serve banks, lenders, and the wider SME finance ecosystem. Leveraging live, validated transactional data from the UK’s advanced data environment, FXE Technologies’ products drive accurate decisioning and proactive engagement. Our products are used by over 80 leading high street and challenger banks and specialist lenders

Role Description

Behind those products is a platform that has to earn the trust of the institutions that depend on it. FXE is a lean, fast-moving organisation with strong ambitions, and the DevOps team sits at the centre of it. We build and operate multi-tenant platforms used by customers including Tier 1 banks, so everything we build must meet the security, reliability and scale expectations of regulated financial institutions.

It's an exciting time to join. We're delivering several projects that will shape where FXE goes next, and the DevOps team is critical to making them happen.

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take real ownership of DevOps at FXE. You'll bring deep, hands-on infrastructure and networking expertise, a strong command of Terraform, AWS, identity and access management, delivery pipelines and observability, and recent, extensive experience running infrastructure through automation.

Your decisions on infrastructure, delivery pipelines, operations, FinOps, maintainability and reliability, together with the product and application architecture decisions you help shape, will directly determine how fast the business ships, how confidently it scales and how well it holds up under pressure.

This isn't a role where you quietly maintain someone else's designs. You'll create and help define them. You'll lead infrastructure and delivery initiatives end to end, hold your own in design and planning discussions with the most experienced engineers in the company, and bring modern DevOps, SRE and security thinking to how we build, deploy and run systems.

You'll also be a bridge between DevOps and Engineering. You'll understand infrastructure deeply, but you'll also be able to read, reason about and ideally contribute to application code, so that platform and application decisions are made together rather than handed over a wall.

Beyond product infrastructure and delivery pipelines, the DevOps team is responsible for FXE's security systems, supports our corporate IT infrastructure (including Microsoft 365 and our zero-trust network access), and assists with compliance activity such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus. This role shares in all of that, not just product-facing infrastructure.

If you want a role where your judgement genuinely counts, where your thinking will be challenged rather than rubber-stamped, and where the scope runs from network design to production reliability to shaping how Engineering and DevOps work together, this is it.

What you'll do

Infrastructure & platform

  • Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, with a strong emphasis on IAM and identity services, compute and container services such as EC2 and EKS, networking (VPC design, routing, service mesh, load balancing, DNS, connectivity, segmentation and security boundaries), database services, serverless (e.g. Lambda, Step Functions) and analytics services.
  • Own infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and the delivery pipelines that move code changes across environments.
  • Design for resilience, maintainability, availability (multi-AZ, failover, self-healing, backup and recovery), security and operability (observability, alerting, capacity), and overall functional and non-functional suitability, efficiency, and effectiveness.
  • Securely and reliably integrate and configure 3rd party services used to complement the AWS environment.
  • Use languages such as Python to automate DevOps tasks and support production capabilities owned by DevOps
  • Identify, document, and remediate as necessary infrastructure and platform-level technical risks following established processes.

Delivery pipelines and developer experience

  • Design, build and maintain software delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that are fast, reliable and secure by default.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code configuration, security and guardrail solutions (e.g. Helm charts, Open Policy Agent policies, and EKS admission controllers) to enforce secure, consistent deployment patterns across environments.
  • Improve build, test, release and deployment workflows in collaboration with Engineering.
  • Contribute to environment strategy (dev/test/staging/production) and release management strategies.
  • Support the Engineers during rollouts and deployments.

Bridging DevOps and Engineering

  • Work directly with Engineering teams to understand application-level constraints, so infrastructure and pipeline decisions reflect real delivery needs.
  • Ideally, read, debug and reason about backend and/or frontend code where needed, enough to have credible technical conversations with engineers, contribute to root-cause analysis, and make informed platform decisions that account for application behaviour.
  • Represent DevOps in architecture, design and planning discussions, including with senior engineers and product, and be able to constructively challenge and defend a technical position, as well as understand when trade-offs are necessary.

Leadership and initiative

  • Take ownership of significant infrastructure and delivery initiatives from proposal through to delivery and operations.
  • Research emerging tools, practices and approaches to identify improvements to our platform, delivery pipelines and operational processes, and propose practical, well-reasoned solutions to the problems you find.
  • Participate as a peer in design and planning conversations across DevOps and Engineering, contributing independent judgement rather than executing instructions.
  • Support the Head of Architecture and Security and the other DevOps Engineers in technical direction-setting and be capable of covering senior technical decisions and initiatives in their absence.
  • Document significant technical decisions (e.g. via ADRs/RFCs), review and contribute to RFCs written by Engineers, and to the team's standards, patterns and reference architectures.

Monitoring, observability and reliability

  • Design observability across infrastructure and services: metrics, logs, tracing and alerting that give early warning rather than after-the-fact explanations.
  • Bring SRE practice into how the team works: define and track metrics where meaningful, drive incident response and blameless post-incident review, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes rather than repeat firefighting.
  • Continuously improve signal quality, reduce alert noise, close observability gaps, and make it fast to answer "what's actually happening in production right now".

Security, IT infrastructure and compliance support

  • Evaluate, monitor, and improve as necessary the security resilience of FXE’s systems. Keep IT and network controls aligned with security and architecture requirements, and to keep audit evidence current and defensible.
  • Help support and operate FXE's corporate IT infrastructure, including Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, mail, collaboration tooling) in collaboration with a 3rd party, and our ZTNA network.
  • Assist with technical evidence, control implementation and remediation work for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
  • Balance this work proportionately alongside product infrastructure and delivery responsibilities, this is a supporting part of the role, not the majority of it.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Extensive, hands-on experience in infrastructure; you can design, troubleshoot and reason about network architecture at depth, not just consume managed services.
  • Real experience developing, deploying and supporting complex infrastructures made up of many moving parts, not just designing them on a whiteboard. The kind of knowledge and judgement that only comes from having built these systems, watched them break, and fixed them under pressure.
  • Strong, production-grade experience with Infrastructure as Code, including design, state management and multi-environment workflows, as well as scripting languages such as Python.
  • Deep working knowledge of AWS across compute, networking, storage, IAM, and managed services in a multi-account setup.
  • In-depth understanding of access controls, encryption, and networking concepts and protocols.
  • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD delivery pipelines in a production environment.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent).
  • Experience implementing security and guardrail controls in Infrastructure as Code and Kubernetes environments to enforce policy at deploy time rather than relying solely on after-the-fact review.
  • Solid experience with monitoring and observability tooling (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) and using it to drive real reliability improvements, not just dashboards.
  • SRE experience or equivalent; comfortable owning production reliability, leading or contributing to incident response, and working from SLIs/SLOs where appropriate.
  • Recent, hands-on experience developing and supporting modern, multi-tenant systems, using AI-assisted tooling and workflows in day-to-day engineering, current DevOps practices, and close, ongoing collaboration with developers/engineers.
  • Track record of taking technical ownership of initiatives from design through to delivery, with minimal oversight.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a credible technical peer in design and architecture discussions with senior/lead-level engineers.
  • Working knowledge of software development sufficient to read and reason about application code (backend and/or frontend) and engage meaningfully with engineers on design trade-offs.
  • Solid understanding of resilience, security and operability considerations in infrastructure design (e.g. failover, backup/recovery, least-privilege access, secrets management, observability).
  • Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable documenting decisions and rationale for technical and non-technical audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience working in a small or mid-sized organisation where DevOps and Engineering are separate but tightly coupled teams.
  • Experience with configuration/decision-recording practices such as ADRs and RFCs.
  • Hands-on development experience in Kotlin/Java and/or React, beyond simply reading code.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 (identity, device management, security configuration) and/or ZTNA network solutions.
  • Direct experience supporting SOC 2 and/or Cyber Essentials Plus certification or renewal, including evidence gathering and control remediation.

How you’ll work

  • You'll report to the Head of Architecture and Security, and work day-to-day alongside the DevOps team, sharing ownership of the infrastructure and delivery platform rather than working in a silo. This includes being part of on call rotas.
  • You'll engage directly and regularly with Engineering; this role is as much about acting as bridge between platform and application teams as it is about infrastructure delivery.
  • You'll be trusted to make and defend significant technical decisions independently, with appropriate visibility and documentation rather than sign-off at every step.

What success looks like

  • First 30 days
    You've built a working understanding of FXE's infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and the applications they support, enough to start contributing to technically sound, well-reasoned decisions that reflect real application constraints, not just infrastructure best practice in isolation. You've met the Engineering and Product teams you'll be working with and understand how DevOps and Engineering currently collaborate.
  • First 60 days
    You're an active contributor to the DevOps team and joint decisions between Engineering and DevOps rather than someone waiting to be looped in; collaboration on initiatives has visibly increased as a result. You've taken ownership of at least one meaningful piece of infrastructure or pipeline work, and the DevOps team's delivery capacity is measurably higher with you in it.
  • First 90+ days
    You're leading significant initiatives end to end, from design through to operations, with clear ownership and minimal oversight. You're recognised as a credible technical peer by the team's most experienced engineers. You regularly collaborate in the definition of designs and architecture patterns through mechanisms such as RFC reviews. You are actively contributing to the definition and delivery of DevOps strategic roadmap items, as well as the improvement to the efficiency and effectiveness of processes and tools.

Benefits

  • Salary banding 70K-85K GBP.
  • This position offers fully-remote work, you must be based within the UK.
  • Flexible working.
  • Autoenrollment in the pension scheme with contributions from FXE.
  • 25 days annual leave PLUS UK Bank Holidays.
  • Talent Referral Scheme.
  • Regular socials and team get togethers.

FXE is an equal opportunities employer and all positions are open to all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

The IPS platform includes single-space smart meters and vehicle detection sensors, multi-space pay stations and upgrade kits, the Elevate platform, digital payments (mobile app and text-to-pay), enforcement, permit management, DMV data services, and smart cash collection.

In 2026, IPS became part of Nayax (Nasdaq: NYAX), a global payments and commerce platform operating in more than 120 countries. IPS’s leadership team continues to run the business from San Diego. Together, the two companies offer cities, universities, and private operators one platform for parking, payments, and EV charging at the curb.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function. This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.

Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure. We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure. We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO. You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

This is a builder role for someone who combines strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You will initially be hands-on while hiring and developing a small, high-performing team. You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.
  • Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage. This should include sustained product storytelling between launches, including through independent reviews, technical publications, comparisons, creators, and third party validation. It could also include research-led PR.
  • Build strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, cybersecurity, and AI journalists, driving proactive media opportunities and increasing Tailscale's share of voice.
  • Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.
  • Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.
  • Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.
  • Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence. Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.
  • Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.
  • Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation. You should be able to improve processes over time as we scale.
  • Own Tailscale's awards and recognition strategy, identifying and securing high-value industry and company accolades.
  • Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement. This team will start small (likely 2 heads), but has the potential to grow in the future as we scale.
  • Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.
  • Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.
  • Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.
  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.
  • Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.
  • Strong strategic judgment and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize, build scalable processes, and measure impact. Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement.
  • A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.
  • Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.
  • Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.

  • Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$190,000—$237,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

At Terakeet, we’re comfortable with the uncomfortable. We live in the future of marketing and are revolutionizing how the world’s most valuable brands connect and build trust with their audiences. We are experts who deliver exceptional outcomes. Together, we win.

Terakeet controls online reputation and visibility for leading brands and executives. We proactively build, protect, and repair brand narratives and perception to drive trust across organic and AI-powered search using patented technology and decades of expertise.

Where We Hire

jobs.excerpt: English description below À propos d'IngenoIngeno est une firme de services professionnels basée au Québec, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles sur mesure et de solutions en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les secteurs manufacturier et de la défense.
jobs.description:
English description below

À propos d'Ingeno

Ingeno est une firme de services professionnels basée au Québec, spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles sur mesure et de solutions en intelligence artificielle, avec un focus sur les secteurs manufacturier et de la défense. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la conception, la construction et la mise à l'échelle de systèmes critiques, en combinant une expertise technique pointue à une approche pragmatique axée sur la livraison et la valeur ajoutée.

Aperçu du poste

L'architecte principal(e) partage son temps entre le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et la standardisation des pratiques, des processus et de l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. À ce titre, ce rôle exerce une influence directe sur les décisions technologiques et l'orientation technique d'Ingeno.

Responsabilités

L'architecte principal(e) combine le leadership technique sur les mandats clients les plus complexes avec la responsabilité de standardiser les pratiques, les processus et l'orientation technique à l'échelle de l'entreprise, couvrant les domaines suivants :

1. Livraison client

  • Agir à titre d'architecte principal(e) sur les mandats clients les plus complexes et à plus haut risque d'Ingeno
  • Servir de point d'escalade technique pour les équipes de livraison confrontées à des enjeux d'architecture
  • Diriger l'architecture de solution durant les phases de découverte stratégique et de conception de solution pour les comptes stratégiques
  • Effectuer la révision des risques techniques et l'approbation des énoncés de travail (SOW) dépassant un seuil de complexité défini

2. Cycle de développement logiciel

  • Détenir et faire évoluer en continu le cadre de développement en cinq phases d'Ingeno (découverte stratégique, conception de solution, planification de livraison, développement itératif, déploiement et transition)
  • Diriger la révision d'architecture pour les projets dépassant un seuil de taille ou de complexité défini
  • Détenir le cadre de mesure de performance et d'indicateurs par phase; s'assurer que les leçons tirées des rétrospectives et post-mortems se traduisent en améliorations concrètes des processus

3. Estimation

  • Standardiser la méthodologie d'estimation à travers les équipes de livraison
  • Réviser et approuver les estimations dépassant un seuil défini avant leur communication aux clients

4. Utilisation de l'IA

  • Définir les stratégies d'utilisation de l'IA à l'interne et pour les projets clients
  • Optimiser les processus de développement produit et logiciel en faisant levier sur l’IA
  • Définir les garde-fous et les bonnes pratiques pour une utilisation sécuritaire et responsable de l'IA, incluant la gestion des données client sensibles
  • Établir les standards d'intégration et d'interopérabilité pour les composants d'IA (LLM, RAG, bases de données vectorielles, modèles de ML), tant à l'interne que dans les solutions clients
  • Superviser les décisions de type « bâtir ou acheter » pour les outils et l'infrastructure d'IA
  • Maintenir des standards d'utilisation de l'IA cohérents à travers l'organisation

5. Stratégie technologique

  • Établir, en collaboration avec la haute direction, les stratégies technologiques de l'entreprise et participer à leur implantation

6. Développement des compétences

  • Contribuer à l'évolution de l'échelle de compétences techniques (la propriété demeure celle des chefs d'équipe et de la direction)

7. Soutien aux ventes

  • Fournir, au besoin, un appui à la solution technique et à la révision des risques des SOW pour les opportunités complexes

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente
  • 12 années ou plus d'expérience en génie logiciel, incluant une portion significative en architecture
  • Feuille de route éprouvée dans la conception de systèmes complexes de niveau production, en contexte de services-conseils
  • Expérience concrète d'intégration de composants d'IA/ML (LLM, RAG, bases de données vectorielles) dans des systèmes en production
  • Expérience de standardisation des pratiques de génie logiciel à travers plusieurs équipes (cycle de développement, estimation, qualité du code)
  • Bilinguisme (français/anglais), à l'oral et à l'écrit — Ingeno opère dans les deux langues
  • Expérience dans des secteurs réglementés ou à haute conformité (p. ex. défense, santé) constitue un atout
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication, à l'aise autant avec les équipes de livraison qu'avec la haute direction

Attributs clés

  • Pragmatique — sait équilibrer la rigueur de standardisation avec l'autonomie et la rapidité des équipes de livraison
  • Leader technique crédible qui demeure impliqué sur le terrain, au-delà d'un rôle purement stratégique
  • À l'aise de porter un double mandat et de protéger le temps alloué à chacune des deux facettes du rôle
  • Bon instinct de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption de nouveaux standards sans lourdeur excessive

Travailler chez Ingeno, c’est aussi...

  • Une politique de télétravail 100% Remote avec la possibilité de venir travailler dans nos bureaux à Québec;
  • Un horaire flexible pour que tu puisses skier, promener ton chien ou rendre visite à ta grand-mère. C’est toi qui décides;
  • 26 jours de vacances et deux jours de maladie dès ton premier jour;
  • Assurances collectives;
  • Une licence Claude Max 5x pour booster ta productivité;
  • Un budget pour certains aspects de l'aménagement de ton espace de travail;
  • Un budget annuel pour des activités sociales et sportives;
  • Accès à un gym au bureau de Québec, télémédecine, PAE et une politique santé et bien-être;
  • La possibilité de demander du temps d'étude pour compléter une certification AWS;
  • Des collègues incroyablement compétent(e)s avec qui tu pourras partager ta passion et grandir;
  • Et bien plus encore!

========================================================================

About Ingeno

Ingeno is a Québec-based professional services firm delivering custom software and AI solutions, with a focus on the manufacturing and defence sectors. We partner with our clients to design, build, and scale mission-critical systems, combining deep technical expertise with a pragmatic approach focused on delivery and added value.

Position Overview

The Principal Architect splits their time between hands-on technical leadership on Ingeno's most complex client engagements and standardizing practices, processes, and technical direction across the firm. In this capacity, the role has a direct impact on Ingeno's technological decisions and direction.

Responsibilities

The Principal Architect combines hands-on technical leadership on Ingeno's most complex client engagements with responsibility for standardizing practices, processes, and technical direction across the firm, covering the following areas:

1. Client Delivery

  • Serve as principal/lead architect on Ingeno's most complex and highest-risk client engagements
  • Act as the technical escalation point for delivery teams facing architecture-level challenges
  • Lead solution architecture during the Strategic Discovery and Solution Design phases on flagship accounts
  • Provide technical risk review and sign-off on statements of work (SOWs) above a defined complexity threshold

2. Software Development Lifecycle

  • Own and continuously evolve Ingeno's five-phase Development Process Framework (Strategic Discovery, Solution Design, Delivery Planning, Iterative Development, Deployment & Transition)
  • Run architecture review for projects above a defined size/complexity threshold
  • Own the phase-level KPI and performance measurement framework; ensure lessons from project retrospectives and post-mortems translate into concrete process improvements

3. Estimation

  • Standardize estimation methodology across delivery teams
  • Review and approve estimates above a defined threshold before they are communicated to clients

4. AI Usage

  • Define AI usage strategies for internal operations and client projects
    • Define guardrails and best practices for safe, responsible AI use, including handling of sensitive client data
    • Establish integration and interoperability standards for AI components (LLMs, RAG, vector databases, ML models), across both internal and client-facing solutions
    • Oversee build-vs-buy decisions for AI tooling and infrastructure
    • Maintain consistent AI usage standards across the organization

5. Technology Strategy

  • Establish the company's technology strategies in collaboration with senior leadership and participate in their implementation

6. Competency Development

  • Contribute to the evolution of the technical competency ladder (ownership remains with team leads and leadership)

7. Sales Support

  • Provide technical solutioning and SOW risk review for complex opportunities, as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in architecture roles
  • Proven track record architecting complex, production-grade systems in a client services / consulting environment
  • Direct experience integrating AI/ML components (LLMs, RAG, vector databases) into production systems
  • Experience standardizing engineering practices across multiple teams (SDLC, estimation, code quality)
  • Bilingual (French/English), spoken and written — Ingeno operates in both languages
  • Experience in regulated or high-compliance sectors (e.g., defence, healthcare) is an asset
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable working with both hands-on delivery teams and executive leadership

Key Attributes

  • Pragmatic — balances standardization rigor with delivery-team autonomy and speed
  • Credible technical leader who remains hands-on, not purely strategic
  • Comfortable holding a dual mandate and protecting time for both sides of the role
  • Strong change-management instincts to drive adoption of new standards without heavy-handedness

Working at Ingeno also means...

  • A 100% remote work policy, with the option to work from our Québec City office;
  • Flexible hours so you can go skiing, walk your dog, or visit your grandmother. You decide;
  • 26 vacation days and two sick days starting on your first day;
  • Group insurance benefits;
  • A Claude Max 5x license to boost your productivity;
  • A budget toward setting up your workspace;
  • An annual budget for social and sports activities;
  • Access to a gym at the Québec City office, telemedicine, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness policy;
  • The option to request study time to complete an AWS certification;
  • Incredibly talented colleagues to share your passion and grow with;
  • And much more!

At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone. Our employees and 1.3 million volunteers are raising the bar every single day. We are a culture comprised of diverse backgrounds and experience, to better serve our communities.

The people who work at the American Cancer Society focus their diverse talents on our lifesaving mission. It is a calling. And the people who answer it are fulfilled.

BrightEdge is the innovation, impact investment and venture capital arm of the American Cancer Society. We invest in for-profit, early-stage companies developing cutting-edge, cancer-focused therapeutics, diagnostics, devices, and technologies to fuel and accelerate ACS’s mission of ending cancer as we know it, for everyone.

The Principal will lead sourcing and due diligence for early-stage private company investment opportunities and manage all stages of the investment process, from initial contact through execution. The Principal will interface with internal and external ecosystem partners to identify and evaluate potential investments, conduct in-depth due diligence on both the scientific and business merits of select deals, and develop investment recommendations. The Principal will also provide guidance and mentorship to Associates and Senior Associates supporting deal execution, and will contribute to evolving BrightEdge’s investment strategy based on insights from curated deal flow and the broader investment landscape. The role requires a high level of self-motivation, sound independent judgment, and a meaningful level of responsibility from the outset.

***This position is a remote role, open anywhere throughout the United States. Experience in digital health tech field is preferred.***

  • Lead the end-to-end investment process for prospective portfolio companies across therapeutics, diagnostics, and healthcare technologies, from sourcing through close, including due diligence, financial modeling, and development of investment recommendations. (25%)
  • Lead drafting and delivery of investment memos summarizing the investment thesis, risk profile, and recommendation; present directly to the BrightEdge team and Investment Committee, and participate directly in Investment Committee discussions. (15%)
  • Manage and oversee ongoing portfolio company relationships, including board observer responsibilities where applicable, quarterly and annual reporting, and monitoring of company performance, strategy, and market developments. (15%)

The role will be responsible for the protection of internal corporate systems and cloud infrastructure. This is not a DevOps role, nor is there DevOps responsibility, however our compliance and security are owned by this position.

The ideal candidate is a strategic executive capable of balancing innovation, scalability, risk management, compliance, and execution at a high level of operational excellence in a high-growth SaaS environment. A successful VP of IT/CISO will combine the strategic mindset of a technology executive with the rigour of a security leader.

This role is not suited for someone who prefers delegation or high-level oversight alone. The VP of IT/CISO must be eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into day-to-day IT activities, and personally influence the employee and stakeholder experience.

We are a proud award winning employer and intend to continue to improve the company as a place to work so that we can be worthy of the incredible talent we have.

We are a remote-first company and welcome candidates across Canada. The expectations are that in-person meetings or in-person work will be less than 10% of the time.

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

If you bring strong IT leadership, a passion for security, and a willingness to work directly at both strategic and tactical levels, we want to hear from you.

The salary for this role is $180,000.00 to 250,000.00 CAD plus variable. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's IT and cybersecurity strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on technology investments, cybersecurity risk, compliance obligations, and operational scalability.
  • Establish IT and security roadmaps that enable growth, scalability and employee effectiveness.
  • Lead annual technology planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation processes.
  • Present regular updates to leadership regarding cybersecurity posture, risk landscape, compliance status, and strategic initiatives.
  • Build and lead a high-performing technology and security organization focused on accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support and participate as required on the Security & Privacy Committee.

Cybersecurity & Information Security Leadership

  • Serve as the company's Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) with enterprise-wide responsibility for information security governance.
  • Implement and maintain an enterprise cybersecurity program based on recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  • Maintain appropriate security architecture, policies, procedures, and standards across all systems and environments.
  • Lead security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat intelligence, security operations, and incident response capabilities.
  • Ensure implementation of robust identity and access management, privileged access controls, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and zero-trust principles.
  • Oversee third-party security reviews and vendor risk management programs.
  • Direct forensic investigations, incident response activities, and breach notification processes when required.
  • Conduct regular cybersecurity risk assessments and maintain enterprise risk registers.

Data Privacy & Compliance

  • Maintain responsibility for protecting sensitive data and ensuring continued compliance with applicable standards including:
    • HIPAA
    • Provincial, state and federal privacy regulations
    • SOC 2 Type II requirements
    • Client contractual security obligations
  • Partner with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Client Success teams to ensure proper handling of PHI and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
  • Oversee security controls protecting client data throughout its lifecycle including collection, transmission, storage, processing, backup, archival, and destruction.
  • Ensure implementation of appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for all regulated information.
  • Lead client security reviews, audits, and due diligence assessments.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for external audits, compliance certifications, and client risk assessments.
  • Serves as Privacy Officer

IT Infrastructure & Operations

  • Lead all internal IT operations including corporate systems, service desk, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and collaboration platforms.
  • Oversee disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and resilience testing programs.
  • Monitor and maintain appropriate service-level agreements (SLAs), operational metrics, and performance standards.
  • Drive modernization, automation strategies, and operational excellence programs, including support functions to improve security posture, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Support organizational wide adoption of AI to increase velocity of stakeholder impact.
  • Ensure secure remote workforce capabilities and endpoint management practices.

SaaS Platform Security

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Champion secure-by-design and privacy-by-design principles.
  • Oversee application security programs and cloud-native security controls across AWS and applicable multi-cloud environments with Engineering.
  • Ensure corporate applications maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
  • Support the completion of RFP/RFQs from prospective and current clients and other stakeholders as required.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Maintain applicable enterprise technology governance structures and security oversight programs.
  • Develop risk management methodologies and reporting mechanisms.
  • Maintain cybersecurity insurance readiness and support annual policy renewals.
  • Create meaningful executive dashboards and KPIs related to:
    • Security risk
    • Compliance posture
    • System availability
    • IT performance
    • Audit findings
    • Incident response metrics
  • Lead business continuity and crisis management planning efforts.

Team Development & Vendor Management

  • Recruit, develop, and retain top-tier IT and cybersecurity talent.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, security awareness, and client-centric service.
  • Manage strategic technology vendors, managed service providers, cloud providers, and security partners.
  • Negotiate and manage technology contracts and licensing agreements.
  • Develop succession plans for critical technology and security leadership positions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience.
  • 7+ years leading enterprise cybersecurity programs.
  • Experience serving as a CISO, VP of IT, CIO, or equivalent
  • Experience within SaaS, cloud software, healthcare technology, ERP software, or highly regulated industries with specific data-handling considerations.
  • Strong understanding of applicable security, privacy and compliance standards, certifications and frameworks including:
    • HIPAA
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
    • ISO 27001
  • Experience managing IT budgets and technology organizations.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, CCSP, HCISPP
  • Experience leading organizations through significant growth and scaling initiatives.
  • Experience supporting rapidly growing SaaS businesses.
  • Strong understanding of data privacy and protection laws.
  • Experience and curiosity surrounding the advancements of AI in SaaS operations.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Multiview is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. jobs.description:
The Engineering Manager, Web Data Acquisition leads an Europe-based engineering team responsible for building, operating, and improving scalable web-scraping capabilities. Reporting to a Senior Manager or Director, this role combines people leadership, technical delivery, operational ownership, and cross-functional execution. The manager is accountable for the performance and development of individual contributors in Europe and works with global Engineering, Product, Data Operations, and delivery stakeholders to translate priorities into reliable outcomes.

Lead and Develop the Europe Team

  • Manage, coach, and develop Europe-based engineers and associates, with clear goals, regular feedback, career development, and performance accountability.
  • Build an inclusive, high-trust team culture that values ownership, learning, engineering quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Plan team capacity, skills development, hiring, onboarding, succession coverage, and workload allocation for the Europe team.
  • Create clarity on priorities, decision rights, delivery expectations, and escalation paths.

Own Scraping Engineering Delivery

  • Lead the design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of web scrapers and supporting services.
  • Ensure reliable acquisition of retailer and marketplace data while managing changing websites, anti-bot defenses, data-quality requirements, and operational constraints.
  • Drive predictable execution across new-source onboarding, change requests, production support, technical debt, and platform improvements.
  • Use delivery and operational metrics to identify risks, remove bottlenecks, and improve throughput, quality, and resilience.

Drive Engineering and Operational Excellence

  • Establish practical engineering standards for code quality, reviews, testing, observability, documentation, security, and production readiness.
  • Improve automation, monitoring, alerting, failure diagnosis, recovery, and root-cause follow-through for scraping workflows.
  • Balance short-term delivery commitments with maintainability, scalability, cost, and platform alignment.
  • Promote responsible collection practices and adherence to applicable NIQ policies, contractual requirements, and legal guidance.

Partner Across the Organization

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, Customer Success, and delivery teams to clarify requirements and sequence work.
  • Communicate delivery health, dependencies, technical risks, trade-offs, and recovery plans to senior stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with peer managers and technical leaders across locations while retaining direct people-management scope for Europe-based associates only.
  • Contribute to planning, architecture discussions, operational reviews, and continuous-improvement initiatives for web data acquisition.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience managing software engineers or data-engineering professionals, including goal setting, coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong software-engineering background with experience delivering production systems in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with web scraping, browser automation, crawling, data pipelines, distributed systems, or high-volume data collection.
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, HTML/DOM, APIs, proxies, browser behavior, monitoring, incident response, and production support.
  • Ability to lead delivery across ambiguous requirements, operational pressure, and competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and trade-offs to non-specialists.
  • Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with retailer, marketplace, digital-commerce, or digital-shelf data.
  • Experience operating cloud-based services and automated data-processing workflows.
  • Familiarity with anti-bot techniques, headless browsers, scraper observability, data-quality controls, and resilient extraction patterns.
  • Experience improving team operating rhythms, delivery metrics, incident practices, and engineering productivity.
  • Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams.

Success in This Role

  • The team has clear priorities, strong engagement, effective coaching, and reliable execution.
  • Scraping services become more predictable, observable, maintainable, and resilient.
  • New and changed data sources are delivered with appropriate quality controls and operational readiness.
  • Stakeholders have timely visibility into delivery status, capacity, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Technical debt and recurring operational issues are systematically reduced.

Our Benefits

jobs.description:
Federal Pre-Sales Solutions Architect
Remote w/ travel (25-30%)
Reports to: Director of Sales

About Us

Istari Digital is a high-growth technology company enabling the next generation of AI-native engineering across aerospace, defense, and industrial enterprises. Our infrastructure platform orchestrates data across tools, organizations, and classification levels—removing barriers that limit digital engineering—and empowers customers to modernize mission-critical workflows and unlock meaningful ROI from digital transformation at scale.

To support rapid growth in federal markets, we are expanding our technical go-to-market team. This role is critical to enabling how customers understand, adopt, and operationalize Istari infrastructure to address mission critical challenges.

Position Overview

The Solutions Architect is the technical authority for how Istari enables modern digital engineering workflows across federal and commercial missions. This role partners closely with engineering leaders, program teams, and account executives to understand how engineering data is created, shared, governed, and operationalized across tools, organizations, and security boundaries—and to architect Istari as the connective infrastructure that makes those workflows possible.

You will lead engineering-centric discovery, design workflow-driven solution architectures, and deliver compelling technical narratives that resonate with engineers, program managers, and digital engineering leadership. While you will advise on secure deployment patterns, your primary focus is enabling new ways of working: faster collaboration, reusable data, cross-program visibility, and measurable mission impact.

Account Executives own account strategy, opportunity qualification, and overall deal execution.

Solutions Architects own technical credibility, engineering workflow alignment, and solution viability—ensuring Istari is positioned as foundational digital engineering infrastructure, not just another tool or deployment.

Together, these roles form Istari’s growth engine by aligning mission needs, engineering realities, and platform capabilities into winning capture strategies.

Core Responsibilities

    Engineering Workflow Discovery & Mission Understanding

  • Lead discovery sessions with engineering teams to understand design, analysis, simulation, integration, and sustainment workflows.

  • Analyze how data flows across CAD, CAE, PLM, MBSE, simulation, and custom engineering tools.

  • Identify friction points such as broken handoffs, siloed data, limited reuse, and cross-program collaboration challenges.

  • Understand mission context, program structure, and organizational boundaries that shape how engineering work gets done.

  • Translate engineering pain points into Istari-enabled workflow architectures and value narratives.

    • Engineering-Centric Solution Architecture

  • Architect Istari solutions that orchestrate engineering tools, data models, and workflows across programs and organizations.

  • Design patterns for engineering data versioning, traceability, access control, and reuse.

  • Define how Istari integrates into existing toolchains rather than replacing them.

  • Ensure solution designs support engineering velocity, collaboration, and program outcomes—not just technical correctness.

  • Incorporate secure deployment considerations (cloud, on-prem, hybrid) as constraints within engineering-first designs.

    • Demo Delivery, Technical Storytelling & Value Translation

  • Own end-to-end demo preparation and delivery for prospects

  • Tailor demos to mission-specific scenarios, data flows, engineering tools, and classification requirements.

  • Build repeatable demo environments and customize them for unique use cases across DoD, IC, and federal civilian agencies.

  • Collaborate with AEs to craft compelling technical narratives that articulate the “why,” not just the “how,” of Istari.

  • Capture demo feedback to refine content, improve demo flows, and influence roadmap priorities.

    • Pre-Sales Engagement & Technical Validation

  • Lead whiteboarding sessions focused on engineering workflows, data movement, and collaboration patterns.

  • Develop lightweight proofs of value that validate engineering integrations and workflow improvements.

  • Partner with Account Executives to quantify engineering impact (cycle time, reuse, coordination, risk reduction).

  • Articulate a clear technical path from initial workflow validation to production-scale adoption.

    • Security, Compliance & Infrastructure Expertise

  • Design engineering workflows that respect classification boundaries without breaking collaboration or continuity.

  • Advise on deployment patterns that enable cross-domain engineering while aligning with federal security requirements.

  • Partner with cybersecurity and infrastructure stakeholders to balance risk management with engineering productivity.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate real-world engineering needs into roadmap inputs.

  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Customer Success to ensure solutions scale beyond initial use cases.

  • Support federal capture efforts by shaping teaming strategies, solution architectures, and technical win themes.

  • Contribute reusable workflow patterns, demo assets, and technical documentation to scale the federal GTM motion.

Required Qualifications

    Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

    • Experience

  • 5–10+ years in solutions architecture, systems engineering, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting for complex engineering or infrastructure software.

  • Experience supporting federal missions (DoD, IC, national labs, or defense primes).

  • Hands-on experience working with engineering tools, workflows, or digital engineering environments.

  • Experience leading technical demos and customer-facing engineering discussions.

    • Skills & Capabilities

  • Deep ability to understand and articulate engineering workflows and data lifecycles.

  • Strong technical storytelling skills—able to translate complex engineering concepts into mission-relevant narratives.

  • Comfort whiteboarding workflows, toolchains, and data movement with engineering stakeholders.

  • Ability to design secure, distributed systems that support engineering collaboration.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with sales, product, and engineering teams.

    • Preferred Experience

  • Background in aerospace, defense, or mission-critical engineering environments.

  • Familiarity with CAD/CAE, PLM, MBSE, simulation pipelines, or engineering data platforms.

  • Experience supporting sales efforts or technical win strategy.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the future of digital engineering across the DoD and national security ecosystem.

  • Lead the technical motion at the intersection of AI, engineering infrastructure, and multi-domain collaboration.

  • Work directly engineering leadership and mission stakeholders on high-impact deployments.

  • Influence the product roadmap through real mission needs and demo feedback.

  • Join a high-trust, mission-driven team building transformative technology.

About Istari Digital

Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Our platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels — whether they're designing prototypes, performing virtual testing, or training AI and autonomy for complex systems.

Focus is rewarded. Finish is remembered.

Facts are friendly. Even when they are not fun.

Fellowship is fundamental. Make others successful.

Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams. In partnership with Deel’s recruitment platform, we are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant based in LATAM for a remote Contractor of Record (COR) or Employer of Record (EOR) engagement. Candidates must be available to work during EST or CST business hours.

Position Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.
  • Coordinate with technical consultants and developers as needed to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.
  • Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.
  • Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

  • Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.
  • Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.
  • Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.
  • Coordinate with software vendors and client stakeholders as needed to resolve issues and implement agreed enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.
  • Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Provide functional guidance and knowledge sharing with other consultants as appropriate.
  • Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

  • Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.
  • Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.
  • Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Bilingual in English and French.
  • Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools.
  • Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

About Us

Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications, providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation and training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,000–$4,200 USD per month, depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring.

Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

You will use data to drive product decisions, uncover opportunities to improve the user experience, and deepen our understanding of Hatch customers. You will own content measurement, keep product performance reporting and day-to-day analytics running for adult products, and support our subscription and growth analytics, working with Product, Engineering, Content, and Design. Our analytics team uses AI tools as part of its everyday workflow, and you'll be expected to do the same.

jobs.title: Singapore Shipping Manager
jobs.excerpt: Pacific Environment works to protect communities and wildlife of the Pacific Rim.
jobs.description:
Pacific Environment works to protect communities and wildlife of the Pacific Rim. We support community leaders to fight climate change, protect the oceans, build just societies, and move away from fossil fuels toward a green economy.
Pacific Environment campaigns to eliminate fossil fuel use from the shipping industry within their climate division by building strong regulatory frameworks to achieve zero-emission shipping on a timeline commensurate with the climate emergency; pressuring corporate customers to demand zero-emission ships; and influencing ports on the Pacific West Coast and beyond to end fossil fuel build-out and ready themselves for zero-emission shipping instead. We focus on environmental justice, labor equity, and science-based timelines for climate action.

Position 

The Singapore Shipping Manager will provide the technical, policy, and stakeholder engagement support necessary to accelerate maritime decarbonization in Singapore. The position will focus on harbor craft electrification, port decarbonization, sustainable marine fuels, and supporting Singapore's maritime leadership globally.
The Singapore Shipping Manager will conduct policy analysis, manage research projects, support pilot programs, develop technical recommendations, and coordinate stakeholder engagement activities with industry, government, research institutions, and civil society partners.  They will be part of our climate campaign team working to end fossil fuel pollution from ships, accelerate production of 100% zero-emission maritime technologies and fuels.  This position will report to Pacific Environment’s Singapore Country Director.

Location and travel 

This position has a flexible, remote work location within Singapore. The position will involve domestic and international travel.  The position’s working hours are generally standard (with flexibility), although the role can expect to work some earlier morning hours (7am-10am SGT) for overlap with PE colleagues in the United States.   

Key responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of Pacific Environment’s ports and shipping decarbonization campaigns in Singapore, working closely with the Singapore Country Director and regional and global teams.
  • Conduct research and analysis on shipping decarbonization policies and projects in Singapore, including those related to harbor craft vessel electrification, charging infrastructure, port decarbonization, sustainable fuels certification frameworks, and zero-emission maritime fuels.
  • Evaluate policy, regulatory, technical, and economic barriers and support the development of recommendations to accelerate deployment.
  • Monitor relevant policies, regulations, industry developments, and maritime decarbonization initiatives in Singapore and at the International Maritime Organization, and provide timely updates to support campaign planning and advocacy. Assess international best practices and translate lessons learned into relevant policy and advocacy opportunities in Singapore.
  • Support existing partnerships in Singapore and identify new opportunities to deepen campaign touchpoints in the country, which may include pilot projects, research partnerships, and convenings.
  • Draft policy briefs, technical reports, presentations, stakeholder-facing materials, consultation submissions, and advocacy materials.
  • Coordinate workshops, conferences, study tours, and stakeholder convenings to advance maritime decarbonization goals.
  • Build and maintain relationships with government agencies, industry, research institutions, NGOs, and other key stakeholders.
  • Support coordination with regional partners and Pacific Environment teams globally and across Asia to share research, campaign developments, policy lessons, and opportunities for collaboration.
  • Track progress against program objectives and contribute to grant reporting, impact assessment, and organizational planning.
  • Other tasks as assigned by the Singapore Country Director.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of work experience in relevant field (NGO administration, government, government relations, advocacy, campaigns, research, corporate sustainability, climate, etc.). Direct experience in shipping or renewable energy is a plus. 
  • Demonstrated experience and expertise in climate/energy issues and policies, including in shipping, ports, and/or other heavy industry sectors.  
  • A record of achievement in managing and winning local, regional, or international campaigns.  
  • Experience and expertise in advocacy, listening, consensus-building, coalition-building, and leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to work collegially and collaboratively with other staff, organizations, and diverse communities. 
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral. Experience as a public spokesperson and advocate; ability to analyze and articulate complex issues and communicate them to various audiences.
  • Experience managing external consultants and/or direct experience with event coordination.
  • Ability to work independently and exceptional management skills, of both projects and team.   
  • Skill and comfort in building relationships with diverse audiences, including with policymakers, coalition partners, community leaders, and members of the media.  
  • Singapore cultural fluency, awareness and familiarity with Singaporean business practices, and an understanding of how climate issues are perceived in Singapore are crucial. 
  • English proficiency (ability to conduct everyday organizational business in English). Fluency in Malay, Mandarin, Tamil, or another Southeast Asian language is a plus.
  • Advanced degrees are a plus.
  • Passion for solving the climate crisis. 
Physical requirements 
The Singapore Shipping Manager work involves remaining in a stationary position and looking at a computer for long stretches of time, communicating with co-workers electronically, and occasional travel (including overnight travel), in-person meetings, or events. The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation. 
Pacific Environment is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from communities harmed by environmental degradation and from backgrounds underrepresented in the environmental movement to apply. We welcome diversity to do our best work and believe that creating teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to the change we seek.
Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Pacific Environment. Please inform our team by emailing  if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application or interview process.
To ensure fair consideration of all candidates, we ask that applicants do not contact Human Resources, Hiring Manager, or Program Staff directly. No phone calls, please.
