jobs.description:
Director of Business Development, Defense & Aerospace

ZeroDrift Technologies, and sister co, SBQuantum · US-based (remote) · Full-time · Travel 25–50%

About SBQuantum

SBQuantum (ZeroDrift Technologies) builds diamond-based vectorial quantum magnetometers that, combined with AI-driven interpretation, deliver precision magnetic intelligence where GPS, radar, and sonar fail — enabling magnetic navigation (MagNav), anomaly detection, and mapping for defense, aerospace, autonomous systems, and space. We're a 25-person team of physicists, engineers, and data scientists, recently funded and scaling. We've moved past the lab: sensors are sold and deployed with government customers, and paid pilots are underway with defense and aerospace partners, while our sensing hardware is already orbiting the Earth in LEO.

The Mission

You will be our first full-time business development hire, owning our most strategic market: Tier 1 defense primes, inertial navigation system (INS) manufacturers, drone/autonomous platform OEMs, and US and Canadian government programs. Your job: get our quantum magnetometer designed into next-generation navigation and sensing systems — shaping requirements before RFPs are written, landing funded evaluations and joint development agreements, and building the capture pipeline that carries us from pilots to production programs. You report to the CEO, inherit a live pipeline (not a cold start), and grow into VP of Business Development as we scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle capture with primes, INS developers, and drone OEMs — build relationships with program managers and chief engineers; structure and negotiate JDAs, funded evaluations, and test-and-trial programs with paths to production commitments.
  • Pursue relevant US and Canadian government opportunities and represent us at key PNT and defense events (ION, JNC, AUVSI).
  • Be the voice of the market: translate program requirements into our roadmap, working directly with our engineering and product development teams.
  • Build the commercial infrastructure we'll scale with — capture plans, CRM discipline, pricing and proposal frameworks — and help define the next commercial hires you'll eventually lead.

First-Year Success

  • 30 days: Fluent in our technology and its applications; full pipeline review completed; introduced to all active accounts and pilots; capture plans drafted for top 5 opportunities.
  • 90 days: Owning all prime/OEM/government relationships independently; 10+ qualified new opportunities added; at least one new funded evaluation in negotiation.
  • 6 months: 1–2 signed JDAs or funded evaluation agreements; established presence at key industry events; capture pipeline of 15+ qualified opportunities with credible close paths.
  • 12 months: 3–5 signed JDAs/funded evaluations with primes, INS makers, or OEMs (stretch: 7+); at least one engagement progressing toward a production design-in decision; commercial processes documented and repeatable; recommendation delivered on next commercial hire.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in a business development, capture, program management, and/or technology/engineering role within aerospace & defense, of which at least 5 years are in a BD or capture role selling complex hardware, sensors, or navigation/PNT systems into defense primes, government customers, or aerospace OEMs. Up to 5 of the 10 years of experience may come from military service in roles tied to the acquisition and deployment of new technologies.
  • Demonstrated ownership of long-cycle capture efforts ($500K+) involving test and qualification phases, from opportunity identification through award.
  • Experience driving proposal development in partnership with proposal/pricing teams — translating capture strategy and win themes into compliant, compelling responses.
  • Experience with DoD/DoW acquisition frameworks (FAR/DFARS, RFI/RFP/BAA/CSO/ OTA vehicles) and managing the capture-to-contract lifecycle for complex hardware programs.
  • A real network within US defense primes, INS manufacturers, or autonomous platform makers, with demonstrated relationships across at least two of these three ecosystems
  • Proven ability to structure and negotiate NDAs, teaming/ joint-development agreements, and strategic partnerships that position the company for prime and subcontract pursuits.
  • Technical depth to engage chief engineers credibly — engineering/physics degree preferred or equivalent hands-on domain experience, plus the ability to learn fast, never bluff, and translate complex trade-offs for customers and internal teams alike.
  • Familiarity with the full hardware product lifecycle — concept through qualification and production — and what it takes to win and sustain programs of record.
  • Proficiency with CRM software and disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity tracking.
  • Working familiarity with ITAR and export control (EAR) requirements as they apply to handling technical data, quoting, and teaming.
  • Bachelor's degree (BS/BA) in engineering, physics, business, management, or a related field, or equivalent experience in lieu of the degree only (does not offset the 10+ year experience noted above).
  • US citizenship (clearance eligibility required; active or prior clearance a strong asset).
  • Comfort operating solo in ambiguity — you'll build the playbook, not follow one.
  • Nice to haves:
  • Magnetometry, inertial navigation or alternative-PNT experience.
  • Startup experience selling into primes.
  • Canadian defense procurement exposure.
  • Established presence at industry events (AUSA, JNC, Sea-Air-Space, AUVSI, ...).
  • Advanced degree (engineering, physics, or MBA).
  • Military experience working with new technologies

Compensation & Benefits

Base $160,000–$170,000 USD plus variable and meaningful early-employee equity. Full-time employment with our US entity, Zero Drift Technology, with health benefits, flexible vacation, and a professional development budget.

Why Join

GPS-denied navigation is one of the most urgent unsolved problems in defense, and magnetic navigation is one of the most credible answers. We have working sensors, government customers, and paid pilots and we are developing integrated solutions. What we don't have yet is the person who turns that into programs of record. That's the job — with the title, equity, and growth path to match.

SBQuantum is mission-driven and welcomes people independently of gender, race, beliefs, citizenship status where legally permissible, orientation — and we value unconventional paths. Let's meet.

The Role

As a Customer Experience Associate I, Borrower Support, you will help borrowers navigate their financing experience with clarity, empathy, and accuracy. This role requires sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to protect consumer trust in high-stakes lending conversations.

Share best practices, explore better ways of working, and stay flexible as business needs evolve, including support for merchants.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, financial services, operations, or another customer-facing role.

  • Comfortable spending the majority of your workday supporting customers over the phone in a high-volume environment.

  • Experience working with consumer lending products or other environments where accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail are critical.

Bonus points

  • Experience supporting borrowers or consumers in lending, banking, payments, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.

Conclusion

The hourly rate for the position is $25.00, plus equity, non-exempt PTO policy, sick pay, 6 paid holidays, and 401k.

jobs.description:
About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

  • SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
  • Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
  • IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
  • Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
  • Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
  • Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

The Head of Solutions, Power Markets (West Region) leads Energy Exemplar's presales Solutions team across the Western United States and Canada. The role owns the technical win for every opportunity in ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO. Accountability runs from first discovery through technical close and a signed handoff to Services. Scope covers new-logo pursuits and expansion within existing accounts across utilities, ISOs/RTOs, regulators, developers, traders, and consultancies.

This is the region's senior pre-sales leader and its engine of retention and growth. The role turns deployed software into measurable customer outcomes: calibrated models, trusted results, and repeatable decision workflows across resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, and market operations. Working with the Regional VP of Sales under a shared handoff protocol, the Head of Solutions ensures every West Region account has a success plan, an executive sponsor, and a clear path to expansion.

Key Responsibilities

The role is accountable for five things: team leadership, technical presales execution, pipeline partnership with Sales, market expertise across six Western markets, and a clean handoff to Services.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the West Region presales Solutions team of energy economists, power systems engineers, and modeling specialists; set goals and build succession depth.
  • Own technical presales across the sales cycle - discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and proposals - for PLEXOS, Aurora, and Adapt2 opportunities.
  • Partner with the Regional VP of Sales on territory plans, account strategies, and pipeline reviews; align Solutions capacity to the highest-value pursuits.
  • Lead discovery with prospects to map business problems - resource adequacy, capacity expansion, transmission planning, trading - to differentiated Energy Exemplar solutions.
  • Design and deliver compelling, market-specific demonstrations and workshops that prove value quickly and advance opportunities toward technical close.
  • Scope, govern, and execute proofs of concept and pilots with clear success criteria, timelines, and exit decisions tied to commercial outcomes.
  • Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires; own solution architecture, pricing inputs, and statements of work for Services handoff.
  • Operate the signed Presales-to-Services handoff protocol so every closed deal transfers with agreed scope, assumptions, model artifacts, and success criteria.
  • Bring deep market expertise across ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO to position PLEXOS and Aurora against competitors credibly.
  • Translate regulatory and market change (FERC Order 1920, WRAP, EDAM, SPP Markets+, ERCOT reliability standards) into use cases, campaigns, and pipeline.
  • Drive expansion within existing accounts by identifying new use cases, additional modules, and AI-enabled upsell opportunities with Sales and Services.
  • Build reusable demo environments, reference models, playbooks, and datasets for Western markets that shorten sales cycles and scale team capacity.
  • Represent Energy Exemplar at ISO stakeholder forums, conferences, and webinars; channel competitive intelligence and prospect feedback to Product and Marketing.
  • Track presales metrics - win rate, technical-close velocity, POC conversion, utilization - and report regional pipeline health monthly to leadership.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate combines Western power-market depth, technical presales leadership, and hands-on modeling credibility.

  • 10-15+ years of experience in power markets, energy consulting, or utility planning, including 5+ years leading technical presales or advisory teams.
  • Proven record owning technical wins - discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, proposals - for enterprise software or analytics sales.
  • Working knowledge of at least three of ERCOT, CAISO, SPP, WECC, AESO, and IESO market designs and planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience with production cost, capacity expansion, or resource adequacy modeling; PLEXOS or Aurora proficiency strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to run multiple concurrent pursuits, allocating specialists and managing scope, timelines, and quality of deliverables.
  • Executive presence and credibility with utility, ISO, and regulatory leaders; comfortable presenting model results and recommendations to C-suite.
  • Strong people leadership: hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical talent in a distributed team.
  • Data fluency with Python, SQL, or similar tools, and familiarity with applying AI/ML to energy modeling workflows.
  • Commercial acumen: able to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy with Sales, and scope services for proposals.

Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in power systems engineering, energy economics, energy policy, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or an equivalent professional engineering credential.
  • Formal training in a solution-selling or value-selling methodology (for example, MEDDICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message).
  • Active membership in IEEE PES, IAEE, USAEE, ISO stakeholder committees or similar professional bodies..
  • Prior presales or solutions engineering experience at an energy modeling, analytics, or enterprise software vendor serving utilities and grid operators.
  • Published or presented work on electricity market design, resource adequacy, or transmission planning.
  • PLEXOS or Aurora certification, or completion of Energy Exemplar's advanced training programs.

We are looking for a Senior Media Buyer (Search) with deep expertise in paid search to own and scale acquisition (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) for a new content site from day one.

This is not a pure execution role. You will act as a key partner to engineering and product teams, ensuring the technical foundation — conversion tracking, pixel implementation, data layer architecture, and signal quality — is built correctly so that automated bidding and machine learning can perform at their best.

If you thrive at the intersection of media buying, analytics, and technical collaboration, this role is for you.

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads targeting high-intent users in affiliate verticals
  • Own full-funnel keyword strategy — from discovery to transactional queries aligned with affiliate economics
  • Develop and test ad copy, landing page messaging, and audience overlays (RLSA, Customer Match, in-market segments)
  • Build and maintain a structured experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate testing)
  • Manage significant budgets with accountability to revenue, CPC, and tCPA/tROAS targets

Conversion Tracking & Signal Quality

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement a robust conversion tracking infrastructure
  • Ensure accurate attribution of clicks, affiliate conversions, and revenue events
  • Define data layer schema and event taxonomy for clean, granular signal passing
  • QA and troubleshoot pixel implementation, tag firing, and attribution discrepancies
  • Implement Enhanced Conversions and Conversion Adjustments
  • Collaborate with Google and Microsoft technical teams to maximize signal quality and capabilities

Automated Bidding & Algorithm Management

  • Design bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS, Max Conversions) aligned with affiliate economics
  • Structure campaigns and segmentation to support algorithm learning and performance
  • Manage learning phases and optimize conversion volume thresholds
  • Monitor and interpret Smart Bidding performance — knowing when to trust vs. guide the algorithm
  • Define conversion actions and values that reflect true business outcomes

Analytics, Reporting & Collaboration

  • Build dashboards in GA4 and BI tools linking spend to revenue, LTV, and engagement
  • Deliver clear, insight-driven performance reporting to leadership
  • Identify growth opportunities and recommend strategic actions
  • Stay up to date with platform updates, betas, and industry trends

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid search experience (Google Ads & Microsoft Ads)
  • Proven experience with Smart Bidding (tCPA, tROAS, Max Conversions)
  • Strong technical expertise in conversion tracking (GTM, GA4, data layers, pixel QA, Enhanced Conversions)
  • Experience passing conversion values and signals back to ad platforms to optimize performance
  • Background in affiliate, comparison, or performance content environments (e.g. finance, insurance, SaaS, e-commerce, home services)
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Solid analytical skills (Excel/Sheets, GA4, BI tools)
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, zero-to-one environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ads API, scripts, or Python automation
  • Familiarity with affiliate platforms (Impact, CJ, Awin, Partnerize)
  • Experience with server-side tracking or Conversion APIs
  • Previous involvement in launching a content/media property
  • Knowledge of tools like SEMrush, SpyFu, or similar

Who You Are

  • Systems thinker — you understand the full loop from click to signal quality
  • Proactively technical — you define tracking requirements, not just execute them
  • High ownership mindset — strategic and hands-on when needed
  • Experiment-driven — you test, learn, and scale quickly
  • Balanced — you know when speed matters and when precision is critical

What's on Offer

  • Foundational role in building a new content property within a well-funded organization
  • Access to a large global advertiser network and deep affiliate expertise

This is an opportunity for an experienced strategic account leader to build and strengthen Sobi’s capabilities within the evolving IDN landscape while leading a team with national reach and meaningful impact for patients living with rare diseases.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Corporate Account Director team by setting clear objectives, expectations, and accountability.

DISCLOSURES

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. ABOUT FREEDOM HEALTH SYSTEMS, INC

Freedom Health Systems, Inc. is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices.

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

Medical Biller & Coder 2 (Team A)

Colombia (Remote)

SERVICE OVERVIEW

Remote LATAM role. Compensation listed in USD with local currency equivalent. This particular role is a Colombia-based independent contractor engagement.

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES PHONE: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES EMAIL:

SERVICE TITLE: Medical Biller & Coder 2 (Team A)

ALTERNATE SERVICE TITLES: Medical Billing Specialist (Contractor), Medical Coding Specialist (Contractor)

CONTRACTING ENTITY: Freedom Health Systems, Inc. (In support of outpatient mental health center clients under contract)

DIVISION: Accounting & Finance

DEPARTMENT: Accounts Receivables

UNIT: Medical Billing & Coding (Revenue Cycle Management Services)

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Not applicable (Independent Contractor)

SERVICE HOURS: Monday – Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours (8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST or as otherwise contractually agreed)

REPORTING & COORDINATION

The contractor will coordinate daily service delivery with the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 1 (Team Lead – Team A). Escalations, risks, or unresolved issues will be routed through the Team Lead to the Accounts Receivables Department Manager as required.

CONTRACT CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN – Independent Contractor

COMPENSATION RANGE: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ COP 19,000–24,700/hr)

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team A, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 1 (Team Lead – Team A) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

CORE SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues
  • Support denial resolution activities by correcting coding or documentation issues as directed
  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready billing records and supporting documentation
  • Adhere to workflows, quality standards, and productivity expectations established by the Team Lead
  • Communicate documentation gaps, authorization issues, or system barriers promptly to the Team Lead

UNSCHEDULED / SUPPORT DUTIES

  • Assist with billing backlogs or high-volume periods
  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.
  • System access logs, activity monitoring, and usage metrics may be reviewed to ensure compliance with HIPAA, client contracts, and Company policies.
  • Failure to comply with technology, security, or monitoring requirements may result in immediate termination of the contract.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Colombia-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

  • Minimum 2–4 years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience
  • Outpatient mental health or behavioral health billing experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, and basic HCPCS coding
  • Familiarity with U.S. insurance, Medicaid, and managed care billing processes
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined workflows and quality standards
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Experience working in secure virtual workstation environments preferred
  • Professional coding certifications (CPC or equivalent) preferred
Salary: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ COP 19,000–24,700/hr)

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

KIPP Public Schools is a national network of tuition-free public charter schools that prepares students with the skills and confidence to create the future they want for themselves, their communities, and us all. We are a network of 279 schools, nearly 16,500 educators, and nearly 210,000 students and alumni.

Our mission: Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career, and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and build a more just world.

Our vision: Every child grows up free to create the future they want for themselves and their communities.

The KIPP Foundation is a nonprofit organization that supports KIPP public charter schools across the country. The KIPP Foundation helps to develop outstanding educators to lead KIPP schools; provides tools and resources for excellent teaching and learning; promotes innovation; and facilitates the exchange of insights and ideas across KIPP and other public schools and organizations.

To learn more about the KIPP Foundation, please visit .

ABOUT OUR VALUES

Excellent Results for Students: We value results over effort and know that our work is not finished until all students thrive. We maintain high expectations for self, team, and students. We drive outcomes by operating with agility, removing barriers, differentiating support, and prioritizing student-centered solutions—especially for those at the margins.

Collective Impact: We are one team. We win together. We embody a one-team mindset by working collaboratively across teams, aligning goals, and leveraging the strengths of all teammates. We build trust-based relationships and ensure inclusive decision-making by engaging those closest to the work. We provide clarity through simple, repeatable systems and goals that enable transformational outcomes.

Courageous Action: Our belief in what we can achieve is unwavering, fueling our optimism and commitment to overcome any challenge. We demonstrate an unwavering belief in students' potential and a commitment to addressing systemic inequities. We approach challenges with resilience, a solutions-focused mindset, and adaptability. We foster a psychologically safe environment centered on trust and accountability where feedback is encouraged. We leverage data to reflect on progress, own setbacks, celebrate successes, and continuously improve to maximize impact.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The SVP, Growth is a role with direct accountability for the success of work that impacts the entire KIPP network. This role sets the vision, goals, and strategy for KIPP’s growth function - stewarding the criteria and readiness frameworks that determine where growth should happen, shaping the long-term portfolio plan, and holding the network accountable for growing with rigor. Every new school, every expanded region, and every scale decision must be grounded in evidence, anchored in student outcomes, and designed to hold up over the long term.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role operates as a senior partner to the Chief Schools Officer and CEO—setting vision and strategy for the growth function and making network-level decisions on growth policy and priorities. The SVP is accountable for both defining the vision and ensuring its execution through their team. The SVP, Growth holds network-wide strategic accountability, partners with Chief-level leaders to make consequential organization-wide decisions, and manages one Senior Director of Growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Growth Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own KIPP’s enterprise-wide growth and scale strategy—including multi-year targets, portfolio priorities, and the conditions required for sustainable expansion.
  • Set the vision and standards for how KIPP grows as a network, ensuring every scale decision is evidence-based, equity-centered, and aligned with the One KIPP strategy.
  • Establish the methodology and criteria by which regions are tagged as viability risks and oversee an assessment of those regions to determine what’s required for long term sustainability and success.
  • Serve as the primary senior voice on growth to the Chief Schools Officer, Chief of Regional Impact, CEO, and Board—providing strategic counsel, synthesizing landscape intelligence, and driving organizational alignment around growth priorities.
  • Shape and steward cross-functional planning across the Office of the Chief Schools Officer and Chief of Regional Impact, ensuring that growth considerations are integrated into organizational and financial planning cycles.

Regional Growth Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead the Foundation’s partnership with regions pursuing opportunistic growth—driving strategy, ensuring accountability, and working through peer leaders for thought partnership and analytical support to translate ambition into executable plans.
  • Establish and lead the progress-monitoring systems that keep growth plans on track; exercise sound judgment about when course correction is needed and escalate risks to the Chief of Regional Impact and C-suite.
  • Identify cross-regional growth patterns, scale effective practices across the portfolio, and address systemic gaps—ensuring that what works in one region becomes a learning opportunity for the full network.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for regions on growth-related matters, exercising judgment about when issues require the attention of the Chief of Regional Impact, Chief Schools Officer, or CEO.

People Management & Development

  • Lead, develop and manage the performance of the Senior Director of Growth to drive regional growth partnerships, readiness assessment, and landscape analysis.
  • Build a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent the Growth function in executive decision-making forums, cross-functional planning, and Board-level growth updates—serving as a credible, compelling senior presence.

SKILLS & MINDSETS

  • Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s core values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action).
  • Self Management: Demonstrated record of setting and achieving ambitious goals for their departments in complex or ambiguous environment; uses data, research, and analysis to set a high bar of excellence for goal setting; effectively distributes and redistributes work among direct reports, teammates, and teams to optimizes goal attainments; effectively sets and fosters a culture that enables and celebrates teammates’ achievements and goals attainment.
  • Work Management: Sets a clear vision that ensures alignment of the team's work to organizational goals. Effectively prioritize and deliver work products that ensure sustainability and scalability of work. Develops and implements agile project plans that ensure cross functional collaboration and resource sharing to ensure achieving organizational goals; create and ensure systems are in place for knowledge management.
  • Process Management: Able to build and align goals and project plans with organization priorities; Develops and codifies processes that promote coordination, efficiency and efficacy across KF and the Network; Prioritizes processes that ensure sustainability and scalability; ensures team is finding efficiencies through process implementation and improvement, resource sharing, or other methods.
  • Data-Driven Actions and Decisions: Effectively uses data to shape teamwide decisions and the learning agenda or evaluation of a function or significant initiative. Able to generate, implement, and evaluate solutions with a focus on scalability and sustainability.
  • Communication and Change Management: Effectively articulates case for change to multiple functions, teams, and/or offices through clear and compelling presentations, tailoring communications and engagement approach for different audiences. Effectively translates vision into actionable plans among across team stakeholders; Champions KF and networkwide change with all stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Identifies and leverages opportunities with both internal and external stakeholders to increase impact. Leads successful collaboration across functions and evolves plans to get strong results. Has the interpersonal, diplomatic, relationships building and communication skills to connect and compel teammates across different functions to collaborate effectively toward shared goals.
  • People Management & Development: Effectively ensures strong professional development and coaching for teammates directly and through layers. Proficient in the mechanics of succession management and performance management for teammates. Skilled at fostering a positive team culture in which teammates feel ownership and accountability for their own and the broader team’s work and results.

Requirements

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in strategy, growth, and network development, or related enterprise leadership roles, ideally in K-12 education or a comparable mission-driven environment.
  • Proven track record of managing and developing people managers across nested teams of 4 or more direct reports with measurable impact on their performance and the organizational outcomes they drive.
  • Demonstrated ability to set vision, goals, and strategy for a function or multiple functions with executive-level autonomy, and to translate that vision into accountable execution through a team.
  • Direct accountability for network-wide strategic priorities with demonstrated outcomes that impacted all regions or the full network.
  • Proven track record of designing and maintaining readiness or assessment frameworks grounded in data, and translating quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear recommendations that drive network-wide organizational accountability.
  • Strong analytical and strategic skills, including landscape analysis, financial modeling, and the ability to synthesize complex information into crisp strategic narratives for executive and Board audiences.
  • Demonstrated executive presence and ability to make network-level decisions with autonomy while serving as a credible senior thought partner to C-suite leaders and regional boards.
  • Demonstrated record of partnering with regional or field-based leaders to translate national strategy into executable plans tailored to local context, while maintaining network-wide coherence.
  • Experience in K-12 education, charter school growth, or a comparable mission-driven environment strongly preferred.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Travel requirements: High Travel: 21-30% (40-60 days per year)
  • Job Type: Full time, Exempt

LOCATION

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Benefits

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $249,600 - $295,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including:

  • 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).
  • 100% paid parental leave
  • 100% coverage of the premium for employees and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.
  • Wellness benefits such as fitness reimbursements, discounted tickets to theme parks/attractions, backup care support for children and adults/elders, and our employee assistance program
  • Finance Security benefits include such as a 401K retirement plan with 4% match, employer-sponsored legal plans, life/disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts

TO APPLY

Please submit a resume online at

KIPP Foundation embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of the students and communities with whom we work and the world that’s around them. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

Pippen Health, the virtual medicine practice affiliated with Found, is looking for registered dietitians (RDs) to join their team of care providers dedicated to delivering high-quality, patient-centric care. Found’s platform integrates leading weight management clinical practice with innovative technology to provide holistic support for patients during their health journeys. Led by Dr. Rekha Kumar, a leader in obesity medicine, Found's program brings a more personalized, supportive, and hands-on approach to obesity care than other telemedicine companies.

You will get to be an early part of Found’s newest offering, expanding RD services and personalized nutritional coaching and support to members with insurance primarily through synchronous consultations. Consultations include health assessments, lab screenings, management of diagnoses related to obesity, documentation, & follow-up care for patients. Alongside our clinical prescribing and member support team, you will provide ongoing support to patients as they navigate their weight care journey, including managing medication side effects, changing nutrition treatment plans based on changes in patient’s health, weight loss progress, &/or insurance coverage. Best efforts are made to maintain continuity of care between patient & clinician to develop long-term relationships.

Providers at Found are passionate about increasing access, improving health outcomes, and delivering an excellent experience to patients at the cutting edge of weight management and obesity care. The ideal candidate would be a technologically-savvy, life-long learner who has independent practice experience in obesity medicine and telemedicine (synchronous and asynchronous).

Research shows that addressing weight health reduces the long-term risk of diabetes, heart disease, and some forms of cancer.   • Conduct synchronous nutrition counseling sessions with patients (60min initial and 30min followup) to support their individual medication assisted weight loss journeys.

  • Apply evidence-based behavior change techniques (motivational interviewing, SMART goal-setting, CBT-informed coaching) to build self-efficacy and long-term lifestyle change.
  • Adapt care plans in response to changes in medication or dosing, insurance coverage, weight-loss plateaus, or evolving patient goals, in partnership with the prescribing clinician.
  • Followup with patients via asynchronous messaging to address questions

  • Serve patients with high standards of personal and professional integrity and ethics, with the ability to practice a high level of confidentiality.
  • Complete session documentation (including ADIME notes, patient communication, and care team follow-up messages) in a timely manner for processing and reporting.

  • At least 2 years of independent practice experience, preferably in obesity medicine, cardiometabolic disease, or medication-assisted weight loss
  • Previous telemedicine experience
  • Strong and empathetic oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to adapt and remain agile, while helping to improve our ability to deliver care
  • Obesity medicine experience and/or certification preferred
  • Please note that you must be authorized to work and physically based in the U.S. for this position
  • Proficiency with EMR documentation (ADIME notes) and secure provider-to-patient messaging; comfort learning new clinical software quickly
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a private, HIPAA-compliant workspace with a professional-quality webcam and headset
  • Active professional liability (malpractice) insurance, or willingness to obtain coverage prior to start

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Senior Specialist, Regulatory Operations provides hands-on technical preparation and publishing of regulatory submissions, including eCTD packages, and supports submissions to assigned health authorities. The role manages the operational execution of assigned routine submissions and supports larger or complex filings under another Regulatory Operations Submission Manager (RSM). This position also prepares submission-ready documents, follows up on content readiness and milestones, maintains accurate Veeva RIM records, and supports submission-related projects and system activities.

Role and Responsibilities:

Submission preparation and execution

  • Serve as the assigned RSM for routine IND, CTA, application lifecycle, meeting, and Health Authority response submissions. Support complex or high-priority filings under the direction of the assigned RSM.
  • Maintain assigned submission plans, content trackers, deliverable dates, and readiness status with the Regulatory Lead and project team. Follow up with Document Owners on expected handoffs, document status, and open actions; provide updates and escalate risks to the Regulatory Lead and, when applicable, the lead RSM.

  • When qualified and independent of package preparation, perform submission-level QC for packages prepared by others. For assigned submissions, confirm technical readiness, transmit or deliver only after Regulatory Lead authorization, track acknowledgments or delivery status, resolve technical rejections, and archive final records.

RIM and cross-functional support

  • Create and maintain accurate application, regulatory objective, submission, document, metadata, milestone, and Health Authority correspondence records in Veeva RIM. Support workflows, data quality, user issue triage, and assigned system changes in coordination with the RIM business owner, IT, and Quality.
  • Provide technical support for promotional submissions, including Form FDA 2253, when assigned. Coordinate with the Regulatory Lead, promotional content owners, and PromoMats users to obtain approved versions and required package materials.
  • Support submission-related projects through action tracking, meeting follow-up, and status reporting. Participate in assigned RIM migration, user acceptance testing, training, work instruction updates, and process improvements; perform other related duties as assigned.

About Meridia

Meridia is an agtech company built around the first mile: the plots, farmers and aggregation points at the origin of every agriculture supply chain. Our first mile intelligence combines what field teams see on the ground and what satellites see from above, in the context of local law, foreign regulation and international frameworks. It rests on over a decade of field experience, our data lake covering 20%+ of the world’s agricultural land, a network of origin experts across the global South and a stellar team of 70+ agriculture, data and tech experts.

Meridia Verify®, our verification solution, checks supply chain field data against regulatory and voluntary sustainability frameworks in minutes and guides teams from risk detection to resolution. One platform covers EUDR, Deforestation- and Conversion-Free (DCF) commitments and Scope 3 land-use emissions at plot level, and benchmarks a supply chain against sector baselines.

Meridia Illuminate®, our sourcing intelligence solution, leverages the same first-mile data foundation to support secure sourcing decisions and resilient supply chains for the operators who shape global food and agriculture trade.

See for more information on our work.

Introduction

This document outlines the scope and objectives for hiring a consultant to support Meridia's first-mile intelligence work: the data science that connects commodity supply chains to the production areas they source from. This includes production area assessment, supply shed modelling and traceability, drawing on a variety of data sources and combining geospatial, statistical and ML approaches.

Understanding where commodities come from, without needing every farm boundary, helps buyers make credible, evidence-based sourcing risk assessments, while keeping smallholders included in supply chains. It supports deforestation- and conversion-free (DCF), EUDR and Scope 3-related risk assessment.

Objectives

  • Develop accurate, high-quality models and datasets for production area assessment and sourcing area (supply shed) analysis across multiple commodities and origin countries.
  • Leverage Meridia's in-situ farm plot datasets to train and validate models.
  • Adapt existing machine learning models to local agricultural contexts to improve prediction accuracy.
  • Create scalable and reproducible methodologies that work across different geographies and commodities.

Deliverables

  1. Methodology and codebase
  2. Organised folder with all source files
  3. Full documentation including operating workflow, methodology, sources (including retrieval and licensing details)

Requirements

Must have

  • Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in Remote Sensing, Geospatial Science, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 10+ years of practical experience in applying statistical and earth observation techniques to agricultural applications.
  • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in geospatial analysis and machine learning (Python, R, Google Earth Engine).
  • Knowledge of agricultural systems and supply chains in tropical and subtropical regions.
  • Experience with modelling approaches relevant to supply chain analysis, such as optimisation, spatial allocation, entity matching or network analysis across heterogeneous datasets.
  • Strong geospatial data engineering skills: spatial databases (e.g. PostGIS), GDAL/geopandas or equivalent, and handling of large raster and vector datasets.
  • Experience building reproducible, version-controlled analytical pipelines (Git; containerisation such as Docker is a plus).
  • Proven ability to document methodologies rigorously, including data provenance, assumptions, limitations and licensing.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting, with strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with agri-commodity sectors (e.g. palm oil, soy, rubber, cocoa, coffee) and their data landscape, including production statistics, mill or processor lists, and sourcing structures with producers and intermediaries.
  • Familiarity with (agricultural) supply chain transparency and traceability approaches, logistics, procurement and certification.
  • Working knowledge of relevant frameworks (EUDR, DCF/NDPE, certification schemes) and how production area and sourcing area information supports risk assessment under them.
  • Experience validating models against ground-truth or in-situ field data, and quantifying and communicating uncertainty.
  • Experience working with production statistics and yield data in data-scarce environments.
  • Track record of peer-reviewed publications or public technical documentation in a related domain.
  • Prior experience in Southeast Asia and/or Latin America.

Benefits

This is an independent consultancy assignment rather than an employment role. Here is what you can expect from working with us:

  • Initial 3-month engagement, with possible extension depending on progress and mutual fit
  • 2-3 days per week
  • Fully remote
  • Software subscriptions provided by Meridia where applicable
  • Monthly invoicing against agreed milestones and deliverables
  • Work on a data lake covering 20%+ of the world’s agricultural land, alongside a team of 70+ agriculture, data and tech experts
  • Direct impact on EUDR, DCF and Scope 3 compliance work

How to apply

Your application should include:

  • CV highlighting relevant experience in geospatial data science and machine learning for agricultural applications.

jobs.description:
About Manifest

Manifest is on a mission to secure the global software and AI supply chain. Our platform automates the discovery and analysis of risks across internally built and third-party software and AI systems, giving security, product, and engineering teams complete visibility into the components and dependencies that make up their technology stack. From product security and AI risk to supplier risk and compliance, we help teams trust the software and AI they build and buy.

Founded by alumni from the Department of Defense, CISA, and Palantir, Manifest is backed by leading investors including Ensemble VC, First Round Capital, Homebrew, BoxGroup, XYZ Venture Capital, AE Ventures, Leap435, and Overmatch VC. The company partners with the US Air Force, DHS, Global 2000 companies, and critical infrastructure organizations across defense, automotive, and financial services to bring transparency, resilience, and trust to modern digital systems.

About the Role

We're looking for a resourceful, highly organized Business Operations Associate who can turn ideas into action. You'll own projects across people operations, recruiting, vendors, systems, and company operations that keep the business moving forward. You’ll serve as connective tissue across the organization, partnering with teams to drive high-impact initiatives.

The right person is a generalist with a high bar for execution: someone who learns quickly, brings structure to ambiguous problems, follows through on the details, and is comfortable taking on things they haven’t done before.

This is a unique opportunity to gain broad, cross-functional exposure at a category-defining startup, where your work directly shapes the company’s ability to scale. You’ll see firsthand how a startup operates, from People and Finance to go-to-market, product, company planning, and leadership decisions. The role is built to grow with you: as you build context and earn trust, you’ll take on bigger, higher-impact work, including broader business and finance operations. It’s a strong fit for someone who wants to learn how to run a company from the inside and grow into a startup leader. You'll report to the Head of Operations, who sets the goals and the end result. You turn those into a plan, coordinate the right people, and see it through, flagging issues early and bringing decisions forward with a well-evidenced recommendation attached. Over time, you'll become the go-to expert on how the company runs and build relationships across every team, so you can move quickly and cross-functionally.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Business operations and planning

  • Gather and analyze operational data to surface insights that support leadership decisions
  • Drive special projects, managing timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables across Finance, Legal, IT, and other partners
  • Own onboarding and offboarding, and be the first stop for employee questions on benefits, policies, and tools
  • Run compliance processes, including employee data collection, required trainings, insurance, and audit documentation, and track recurring deadlines like state filings and renewals so nothing slips
  • Own vendors and tools: hold partners accountable, manage invoices, renewals, and contracts, and implement integrations that replace manual work
  • Lead offsites and events coordination end to end, and handle hands-on logistics like shipping equipment, swag, and gifts
  • Keep documentation, trackers, and checklists clear, current, and scalable
  • Provide executive support to the leadership team, including scheduling, travel, and meeting logistics
  • Support the company’s operating rhythm, including planning cycles, budget tracking, headcount, and reporting, and help prepare materials for leadership reviews, board meetings, and fundraising

Process and systems

  • Build internal processes where none exist, then automate them with AI and the right tools
  • Build dashboards and integrate and consolidate tools so the team works from clean, connected sources of truth
  • Build alignment across teams and turn decisions into working processes and make sure the team follows them
  • Bring clear, well-supported recommendations forward and present them persuasively to leadership
  • Spot growing pains before they become problems, and fix them proactively behind the scenes
  • Take ownership of new priorities and close gaps across the business as they emerge

Finance operations

  • Own accounts payable, receivable, and reconciliations so the books stay accurate and timely
  • Maintain trusted sources of truth for operational and financial data

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in a complex, fast-moving environment with little day-to-day direction. Operations, implementation, chief of staff, consulting, or corporate roles all count, and we'd love to hear from people moving from corporate into tech.
  • Strong execution skills. You're organized, dependable, and detail-oriented, and you can take a goal, build the plan, and see it through without step-by-step management.
  • A proactive approach. You spot what needs to happen and take initiative.
  • Sound judgment about priorities, tradeoffs, and when to ask for help, including with confidential employee and company information.
  • High-quality deliverables and clear written and verbal communication with leaders, vendors, and candidates.
  • An AI-native, critical approach, with proven experience using AI and automation to build dashboards, consolidate tools, and design systems that improve how a company operates. You pressure-test AI output and apply your own judgment, so you can defend every recommendation yourself.
  • Comfort with systems and data, plus the curiosity to learn new tools and unfamiliar topics quickly.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and shifting priorities.
  • A collaborative, low-ego attitude and a willingness to do hands-on work.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with tools like Rippling, QuickBooks, HubSpot, and AI platforms such as Claude
  • Exposure to accounts payable and receivable or other finance operations
  • Experience with offsite or event planning
  • A project management or process improvement certification, such as PMP or Lean Six Sigma

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $ 80,000 - $110,000, plus equity. Final compensation is commensurate with experience.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO (taken seriously)
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance — 100% covered for you and your dependents
  • 401(k) and retirement options

jobs.excerpt: Company Introduction:Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered.
jobs.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Own Consistent Execution Across the Network

You manage two different kinds of leaders. Four Regional Network Managers each own the complete supply picture in their geography, drivers and agents alike, and are accountable for their region’s overall health. Two Agent Leads each own agent-specific execution, onboarding, performance conversations, and (jointly with you and Procurement) deactivation, across two regions apiece. Your job is to make sure standards, tooling, and escalation protocols work the same way across all six of them, and that friction between the RNM and Agent Lead structure never becomes the network’s problem. This role sits at an intersection that’s new to the org: RNMs are accountable for outcomes they don’t personally execute on the agent side, and Agent Leads execute without owning the region they’re executing in. When that split works, neither side notices the seam. When it doesn’t, that’s yours to fix. The most predictable version of this: an Agent Lead covers two regions, and
both RNMs need their attention at once. That’s not a rare edge case, it’s a structural feature of the dotted-line model, and the default answer is you decide the priority when the two RNMs
can’t work it out themselves. You are also one of three required parties, alongside the relevant Agent Lead and Procurement, on every agent deactivation decision. This isn’t a rubber stamp: a deactivation has real consequences for regional coverage, and someone with visibility across all four regions needs to be in that decision, not just the person closest to it.

What You’ll Do

Manage the Regional Network Manager and Agent Lead Teams

  • Directly manage the four Regional Network Managers, owning cross-regional consistency in performance standards, tooling, and escalation protocols
  • Directly manage the two Agent Leads, making sure the two-region split is working, workload is balanced, and agent execution is consistent across all four regions
  • Coach and develop both groups differently — RNMs need broad, general-manager judgment across a full region; Agent Leads need deep, specific judgment on agent performance and the harder conversations that come with it
  • Resolve misalignment between an RNM and the Agent Lead covering their region before it becomes the network’s problem
  • Own prioritization when the two RNMs sharing an Agent Lead both need their attention at the same time — this is a structural, recurring tension with the dotted-line model, not an occasional exception, and the default is that you decide when the RNMs can’t resolve it between

Own Agent Deactivation Decisions

  • Serve as one of three required parties, with the Agent Lead and Procurement, on every agent deactivation decision, bringing the cross-regional and operational perspective an individual Agent Lead may not have
  • Ensure deactivation decisions are documented consistently and held to the same standard across all four regions, not decided differently region by region
  • Escalate to the VP only when a deactivation carries strategic or account-level risk beyond the region it affects

Serve as the Operational Escalation Point

  • Serve as the escalation point for Regional Network Managers on cross-regional issues or decisions that exceed their authority
  • Serve as the escalation point for Agent Leads on issues that cut across more than one region or require senior management-level judgment
  • Stay aligned with the Senior Manager of Network Enablement so recruiting pipelines and training programs reflect regional demand across all four regions.

Partner on Strategic and Cross-Functional Work

  • Partner with the VP on capacity planning, org design, and strategic initiatives for Network Operations
  • Partner with the Director, US Network Solutions during the build phase of new strategic accounts or capabilities, representing what RNMs and Agent Leads actually need to execute cleanly once something is handed off — a bad handoff is a failure regardless of how good the deal was
  • Coordinate with the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations so the data and scorecard methodology RNMs and Agent Leads depend on is consistent and trustworthy across the network

Requirements

  • 2-5+ years of experience in network operations, field operations, or multi-site operations leadership, with people-management experience across more than one function or team type
  • Experience managing managers, not just individual contributors — comfortable coaching leaders who each own a full geography as well as leaders who own a specialized, narrower function
  • Comfortable being one of three decision-makers on a consequential call rather than the sole decision-maker — shares authority well without diluting accountability
  • Comfortable making a fast, sometimes unpopular prioritization call between two peers who each think their need is more urgent — this happens routinely with a shared Agent Lead, and defaulting to indecision or letting it resolve itself is not an option
  • Strong operational judgment — you can tell the difference between a regional issue that should stay with the RNM and a cross-regional issue that genuinely needs senior management-level intervention
  • Experience partnering with a strategic or business-development-style function receiving handoffs of new capabilities or accounts, and translating them into operational reality on the ground
  • Clear, direct communicator, comfortable resolving disagreements between peers who report to you and who may see a shared problem differently
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Success Metrics

2026

Performance standards, tooling, and escalation protocols are consistent across all four regions. RNMs and Agent Leads report a clear, well-functioning working relationship with each other, not friction that routes to you by default. Agent deactivation decisions are documented consistently and held to the same bar across all four regions. Handoffs from Network Solutions land cleanly, RNMs and Agent Leads report feeling equipped, not blindsided, by new capabilities or accounts.

2027

The RNM and Agent Lead structure is running with enough maturity that it no longer requires your active mediation to function well. Cross-regional consistency in standards and quality is measurably improved. You are spending more time on capacity planning and strategic partnership with the VP and Network Solutions than on resolving day-to-day friction between your direct reports.

Your First 90 Days

Build individual working relationships with all four Regional Network Managers and both Agent Leads. Get fluent in how the RNM and Agent Lead structure is actually working today, where the seams are clean and where they’re not. Sit in on at least one agent deactivation decision to understand how that three-way call is functioning in practice. Build a working relationship with the Director, US Network Solutions and the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations.

Your First 180 Days

Performance standards and escalation protocols are consistent and well understood across all six direct reports. You have a track record on agent deactivation decisions that RNMs, Agent Leads, and Procurement trust. At least one Network Solutions handoff has gone through cleanly with your involvement from early in the build. The VP sees you as the person keeping regional execution consistent, not just the person four RNMs happen to report to.

Job Info

  • Department: Network
  • Reports to: VP, US Network
  • Location: Remote (U.S.), with periodic travel to support regions and cross-functional handoffs
  • Direct reports: 4 Regional Network Managers, 2 Agent Leads (6 total)

Compensation

  • Salary range: $115K - $125K
  • High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Open PTO
  • 401K with company match

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

jobs.description:
Red Nucleus is hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to join our global team!This is a remote role based out of Canada.

Inside Account Manager – Technology Sales, Western U.S. Clients (Remote)

Full-Time | Base + Commission / Performance Incentives

About GigaKOM

For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations across California and the Western U.S. Through partnerships with leading technology manufacturers and distributors, we provide secure, scalable networking, wireless, security, cloud, and infrastructure solutions.

As GigaKOM continues to grow across California, Arizona, Nevada, and other Western U.S. markets, we are seeking a motivated Inside Account Manager to support client relationships, drive sales activity, and help expand our customer base.

This is a fully remote position ideal for a relationship-driven sales professional with experience in technology sales, account management, quoting, vendor coordination, and customer follow-up.

Location

Remote

This is a remote position supporting clients across the Western U.S. Candidates must be able to maintain regular overlap with U.S. Pacific Time to support client communication, vendor coordination, sales meetings, and internal team collaboration.

Position Overview

The Inside Account Manager plays a key role in supporting revenue growth, maintaining strong client relationships, managing account activity, and assisting with sales execution across assigned accounts.

This role works closely with Account Executives, Sales Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and vendor partners to support customer needs, prepare quotes and proposals, follow up on opportunities, and maintain accurate account records.

This is a full-time remote position for a motivated sales professional who can manage account activity, support client needs, and contribute to revenue growth across Western U.S. markets.

The ideal candidate has technology sales or account management experience, strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

What You’ll Do

Account Management & Client Support

  • Serve as an inside sales contact for assigned Western U.S. clients
  • Maintain regular communication with IT leaders, procurement teams, business contacts, and customer stakeholders
  • Support existing customer relationships through timely follow-up and professional communication
  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts
  • Partner with outside Account Executives on account strategy, territory planning, and customer engagement
  • Help maintain high levels of client satisfaction and retention

Sales Execution & Revenue Support

  • Prepare quotes, proposals, and customer correspondence aligned with client needs
  • Follow up on active opportunities, pending quotes, and customer requests
  • Support pipeline development and opportunity progression
  • Maintain accurate sales activity, pipeline tracking, and forecasting information
  • Contribute to assigned revenue, gross profit, and margin objectives
  • Assist with renewal opportunities, add-on sales, and customer expansion initiatives

Vendor & Pricing Coordination

  • Work with distributors, manufacturers, and technology partners on pricing requests
  • Gather product information, availability, lead times, and deal registration details
  • Coordinate special pricing, discounts, and vendor programs where applicable
  • Support RFP responses, bids, and compliance documentation

CRM, Order & Sales Administration

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, account notes, opportunities, contacts, and follow-up tasks
  • Coordinate with Purchasing and Operations on order status, product availability, and customer updates
  • Support order handoff and communication between Sales, Purchasing, Engineering, and Project Management
  • Track customer requests, open items, and next steps to ensure timely completion
  • Help improve sales process consistency and documentation

Client Communication & Follow-Up

  • Respond to client questions regarding quotes, product information, renewals, and order status
  • Coordinate internal resources to address customer needs
  • Support customer-facing communications with professionalism and urgency
  • Escalate issues or opportunities to Account Executives and leadership when needed
  • Build trusted relationships through consistent and reliable follow-through

Professional Development

  • Continue developing knowledge of enterprise IT products and solutions
  • Learn about networking, wireless, cybersecurity, cloud, and infrastructure technologies
  • Stay current on vendor programs, public sector purchasing, and technology trends
  • Participate in sales training, vendor training, and internal enablement activities

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5+ years of sales, inside sales, customer service, or account management experience
  • Experience in technology sales, IT products, infrastructure, networking, cloud, security, or related fields preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, opportunities, and follow-up activities
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel, CRM tools, and business communication platforms
  • Ability to maintain regular overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

Preferred

  • Experience supporting SLED, K–12, higher education, government, or public sector accounts
  • Familiarity with technology vendors such as:
    • Cisco
    • Cisco Meraki
    • HPE Aruba
    • Extreme Networks
    • Palo Alto Networks
    • Fortinet
    • Microsoft
  • Knowledge of public sector procurement processes, RFPs, RFQs, bids, and cooperative purchasing
  • Experience working with distributors, vendor pricing programs, and deal registration
  • Experience with CRM or PSA platforms such as Autotask, NetSuite, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar systems

Core Competencies

  • Inside sales and account management
  • Client relationship development
  • Quote and proposal coordination
  • Vendor and distributor communication
  • CRM and pipeline management
  • Sales follow-up and opportunity tracking
  • Technology product awareness
  • Public sector and SLED sales support
  • Customer service and professionalism
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Remote work discipline and accountability

Compensation & Structure

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Compensation includes base compensation plus commission and/or performance-based incentives.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience, sales background, technology familiarity, and applicable industry experience.
  • Performance-based incentives may be available based on sales results, account growth, lead follow-up, and measurable outcomes.
  • Work schedule will be aligned with business needs, client communication, and U.S. Pacific Time team collaboration.

Why Join GigaKOM?

  • Established reputation serving public sector and enterprise markets across California and the Western U.S.
  • Opportunity to support and grow technology accounts across K–12, higher education, government, and commercial markets
  • Exposure to enterprise networking, wireless, security, cloud, and infrastructure solutions
  • Strong partnerships with leading technology manufacturers and distributors
  • Collaborative environment with Sales, Engineering, Purchasing, Project Management, and Operations teams
  • Fully remote structure with long-term growth opportunities

If you are a motivated inside sales professional with strong communication skills, technology interest, and a commitment to customer follow-through, we encourage you to apply and join GigaKOM’s growing sales team.

Our analyses and reports are transparent, supportable, and clearly outline the assumptions and projections incorporated into our financial models. We consistently apply sound valuation methodologies and unbiased perspective in our work product that enables management teams and fiduciaries to make confident, informed decisions.
