About Medium

Medium is one of the world's most influential writing platforms, connecting millions of readers with ideas that matter. We're a small, dedicated team that cares deeply and takes real ownership of the problems we tackle, moving fast while building something that lasts. Our actions and decision-making are guided by four principles: Humans First, Deepen Understanding, Orient for Impact, and Ladder Together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and evolve the Android experience that millions of readers and writers rely on every day. You'll own Android features end to end. That means digging into what users actually need, building it, shipping it, and paying attention to how it actually performs once it's out in the world. You'll work closely with our design team the whole way through.

This is a product engineering role at heart. We don't have a dedicated product team, so you won't be handed a fully-specified ticket and told to go build it. Rather, you'll be the one figuring out what's worth building in the first place, partnering with design and other engineers, and making good calls when the ask is vague or doesn't quite solve the real problem. Android is where you'll spend most of your time, but we want someone who can also hold their own on at least one other platform, whether that's web, iOS, or backend. That range matters: it means you can see how a feature fits into the bigger picture, make good calls about where logic should live, and work credibly with whoever owns that other platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own Android features end to end. Understand the problem, build it, ship it, and see how it actually does
  • Shape what gets built, not just how it gets built. Push back on scope, propose simpler solutions, and raise platform constraints early rather than after the fact
  • Write idiomatic, well-tested Kotlin and Compose UI that fits naturally into the team's existing architecture
  • Work directly with iOS, web, or backend engineers depending on what a feature needs, and help decide where functionality should live
  • Partner with our leadership team, design team, and engineers in the US and France to turn a rough idea into something that actually ships well on Android
  • Bring superb judgment to ambiguous requests. You can ask good questions, spot edge cases early, and propose reasonable first steps when the full scope isn't clear yet
  • Own shaping product and feature spaces, maintaining and driving a sense of forward momentum even when the final destination of your work may not be clear
  • Help raise the bar for the mobile team on code quality, testing, and product thinking
  • Attend Medium's twice-yearly, in-person offsites (hosted in locations around the U.S.)

What You Have

  • You've spent several years building production Android apps and you're genuinely fluent in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow, and modern Android architecture
  • You're an expert with all things Android engineering, but you can also hold your own on at least one other platform (web, iOS, or backend) and can work credibly there when a feature calls for it
  • You think like a product engineer. You don't just build what's asked, but can own and appreciate the impact at a product impact altitude of your work.You understand the problem underneath the request, push back when something doesn't add up, and care about whether it actually worked once it shipped
  • You've worked closely with designers and engineers on other platforms before. You're good at explaining a technical tradeoff in a way that actually lands for someone who isn't an engineer
  • You have good instincts about systems, you're adaptable, and you're genuinely eager to learn. You can advocate for an approach while staying open to a better one. We care a lot about collaboration and psychological safety here. We want someone who adds to it
  • You have the ability to push forward in ambiguity and make great trade off decisions to keep a project moving

Nice to Haves

  • Experience using AI to improve a team's leverage, reach, output and impact
  • You've owned product direction yourself rather than just executing someone else's plan
  • You personally use Medium and are genuinely excited to contribute to its mission, which is empowering humans to write meaningfully for other humans

Benefits

In addition to the new skills you'll pick up, here's what else you'll enjoy by working at Medium:

  • Working with a fully distributed team: We’re fully remote and have teammates across the U.S. & France
  • Healthcare benefits covered at 100% for employees and 80% for dependents
  • Generous parental leave policy
  • Mental health support through Spring Health (or find a provider through Rula or Kaiser Mental Health Network)
  • Financial wellness support through Northstar
  • Stipends for co-working, professional development, wifi, and a one-time home office bonus
  • Unlimited PTO and standard company holidays
  • A discounted Medium membership

Why Medium

We're a small team doing meaningful work. Beyond guiding your team's execution, you'll have real influence over engineering strategy, culture, and direction. You'll work alongside people who are genuinely good at what they do and who care about building something worth building.

At Medium, inclusion, diversity, and equity are core to how we work and what we build. We believe a more inclusive team creates a better product—one that’s intuitive, thoughtful, and serves a wide range of users. We strive to foster a supportive, fun, and challenging environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive.

We welcome applicants from all walks of life and strongly encourage those from historically underrepresented groups to apply. Our hiring process is built to ensure fairness and equal opportunity for everyone. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your perspective and passion matter more than checking every box.

Learn more about our mission, operating principles, and culture:

  • Yes to a diverse community
  • Be part of a better internet
  • Medium Rules
  • Operating Principles

Read about our story here.

Read our guidance on AI use for candidates. We believe human ideas have the power to change how people think, for the better. That belief shapes how we hire. We use AI tools ourselves, but we’ve thought carefully about where it adds value and where it gets in the way of something important.

About the Role

OKX is one of the world's leading digital asset exchanges, with a regulated and actively expanding presence across Latin America. We are looking for a senior compliance professional to join our LatAm team as Compliance Officer for El Salvador and permanent support for LatAm jurisdictions.

Strategic Responsibilities

  • Design, implementation and continuous improvement of the AML/CFT compliance program for El Salvador in alignment with the global standards.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to address regulatory challenges, working with Legal, Finance, Risk, and Product teams as needed.
  • Contribute to knowledge-sharing across compliance functions and support training efforts for the regional team.

Daily Responsibilities

  • Throughout LATAM jurisdictions:
    • Review and resolve escalated Transaction Monitoring cases referred by the operational team: apply senior risk-based judgment to complex or ambiguous alerts, make final suspicious activity determinations, and ensure all case documentation meets the evidentiary standard required for regulatory defensibility.
    • Review and resolve escalated EDD cases for high-risk customers in accordance with local regulation requirements.
    • Make final match/no-match decisions on escalated sanctions screening cases referred by the operational team.
    • Review and determine escalated PEP cases, applying intensified due diligence measures where required and setting the standard for what warrants escalation in the first place.
    • Own the preparation and submission of Reportes de Operaciones Sospechosas (ROS/SARs) to the UIF.
    • Own the preparation and timely submission of all mandatory periodic regulatory reports before local authorities.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 4–6 years of verifiable experience in global AML compliance standards applicable to VASPs/PSPs; in-depth knowledge of AML/CFT operations (CDD, EDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, PEPs).

  • Stakeholder management skills: ability to interact with senior leadership, and cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced knowledge of AML/CFT compliance operations, including CDD, EDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, and PEP screening.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage high-risk cases and make sound, risk-based compliance judgments.
  • Proficiency with blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of regional and global VASP regulatory frameworks, with focus El Salvador. Experience in additional LATAM jurisdictions is a plus.
  • Fluency in Spanish is required; English proficiency is strongly preferred.

Perks & Benefits

jobs.description:
Why Brightside:

For our clients - our mission is clear. To improve the financial health of working families. Brightside is an employee benefit with a brand-new approach to personal finance. We offer unique solutions to help with anything related to finances, emotions and behaviors that can impact our clients. For our employees - we believe in inspiring careers, a great life/work balance and meaningful work that truly makes a difference in the lives of working families. Your work will have direct impact on the lives of our clients. You will have the opportunity to see a growing start-up from the inside out and see how passionate our employees are about the work we do and the outcomes we are creating for others.

We are looking for a Principal AI Architect to own the design and build of Brightside’s AI agent platform. This is a senior, hands on role. You will work directly alongside Jacky Chiu and the engineering team to architect and ship production systems, not design from a distance. The core system you will build is a realtime agent layer that listens to live conversations between Financial Assistants and clients, understands what is happening turn by turn, surfaces intelligent coaching to the FA in under 2 seconds, and writes structured data back to the CRM. As the​ platform matures, this same agent layer will conduct client conversations autonomously.

We value personal connection. To fast-track your application, please email directly. In your email, please include one sentence about why this specific role caught your eye!

What this role isn't!
A governance role. An advisory role. A research role. Or a people-management role. It is an execution oriented architecture role. You will design it and help build it.

What You Will Own

Real-Time Agent Architecture

  • Design and own the multi-agent orchestration layer - session supervisor, domain clusters, escalation arbiter, and conversation manager
  • Define agent routing logic, context sharing, tool use, and latency budgets across 18+ agents
  • Architect the real-time pipeline: Amazon Connect → Contact Lens → Kinesis → Lambda → Bedrock → WebSocket push to FA panel
  • Own the dual-mode agent architecture: human-assisted mode (agent coaches the FA) and autonomous mode (agent conducts the client conversation directly)

LLM Systems & Prompt Engineering Governance

  • Define model selection and routing across low-latency and reasoning-intensive agent tiers
  • Govern the prompt architecture: structured agent prompt standards, runtime domain knowledge injection, and conditional output formatting across delivery surfaces
  • Build and own the eval harness - schema validation, behavioral regression testing, latency profiling
  • Design the domain knowledge base structure across the full financial use case library - 8 domains, 49 use case types

Data Architecture & CRM Integration

  • Own the data model underlying the AI platform: client financial profiles, cases, goals, options, outcomes, and financial impact measurement
  • Architect the CRM sync layer - real-time field writes after FA confirmation, human correction logging as training signal
  • Define canonical data models across clients, employers, financial products, and outcomes
  • Ensure data integrity across Aurora PostgreSQL (new CRM) and Aurora MySQL (existing platform)

AI Infrastructure & Platform

  • Own the AWS Bedrock-native inference infrastructure - async invocations, Knowledge Bases, RAG pipelines
  • Design the session state layer: ElastiCache Redis for hot state, DynamoDB for durable session records
  • Define AI governance standards: model evaluation, monitoring, explainability, and compliance in a regulated fintech environment
  • Evaluate and guide decisions on model providers, orchestration frameworks, and platform tooling

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years in software engineering or systems architecture, with significant hands-on experience in the last 3 years
  • Production experience building real-time AI systems - specifically systems that operate on a per-turn, sub-second latency budget
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, and Kinesis - not just familiarity, but have hit their limits and worked around them
  • Multi-agent system design experience - orchestration patterns, agent handoff, context sharing, structured output validation
  • Strong data architecture foundation - relational modeling, event-driven systems, CRM data patterns
  • Experience in a regulated environment (fintech, financial services, or healthcare) with an understanding of privacy and compliance requirements
  • Comfortable operating in a small, fast-moving team where you design and build - not just review and approve

Strong Advantage

  • Experience building voice or conversation intelligence systems (contact center AI, real-time transcription pipelines, live agent coaching tools)
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect and Contact Lens
  • Background in conversational AI product companies (Cresta, Observe.AI, Cogito, Replicant, or similar)
  • Experience with LLM prompt engineering at a systems level - eval harnesses, versioned prompt governance, regression testing
  • Prior experience as a lead architect at a Series B-D company where you were one of a small number of senior technical voices

How You’ll Work

  • Hands-on and opinionated - you form views, explain them clearly, and update them when wrong
  • Oriented toward production outcomes, not theoretical elegance
  • Comfortable saying no to poor architectural decisions and explaining why
  • Willing to be in the weeds - debugging a Bedrock invocation, profiling a latency spike, reviewing a schema change

Overview: Shaping the Supply Chain E-commerce Ecosystem

The Solution Architect is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining the complete, end-to-end technical architecture for our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will translate complex business requirements across Manufacturing (MES), Warehouse (WMS), and Order Management (OMS) into secure, scalable, and compliant technical blueprints. Your designs will ensure seamless integration between all core systems and our next-generation AI agent infrastructure.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will design the technical vision for our critical business flow: MES → WMS → OMS → Payments → Invoices.

  • Architecture & Design: Define the architecture (modular monolith/microservices) and API contracts for core modules (OMS, WMS, MES) built on Node.js 22/NestJS using TypeScript.

  • Multi-Tenancy & Security: Define the strategy for tenant isolation using PostgreSQL 15 with Row-Level Security (RLS) and architect the JWT-based licensing and feature metering system.

  • Infrastructure (IaC): Blueprint the deployment standards using Terraform and Docker with orchestration handled by Traefik on Oracle Cloud Free VMs.

  • Compliance & Observability: Ensure adherence to compliance (HS codes, export controls) and design the monitoring and tracing strategy using Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead architectural reviews and mentor engineering teams on domain modeling, performance, and best practices.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must demonstrate expertise in system design and hands-on integration across this stack:

  • Backend/Core: Node.js 22, NestJS (Modular Monolith), TypeScript

  • Frontend Patterns: Next.js 14, React 18

  • Data/Storage: PostgreSQL 15 (RLS), Redis, Meilisearch, MinIO

  • DevOps/Infra: Terraform, Docker, Traefik, pgBackRest

  • Security/Auth: Authentik/Ory Kratos, Vault

AI Agent Focus

You will architect the platform for integrating advanced AI capabilities into our operational systems.

  • Agent Infrastructure: Design the systems for hosting and orchestrating multi-agent systems that securely access data from MES, WMS, and OMS.

  • Framework Integration: Define best practices for production AI agents utilizing frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Architectural Soundness: Delivery of scalable, secure, and well-documented technical blueprints.

  • System Resilience: Achieving defined SLOs for the core business process flow.

  • Compliance: Full and verifiable implementation of security and compliance controls (RLS, Vault).

Mentorship Structure: Reports directly to the Head of Technology/CTO, leading the architectural review board and mentoring senior engineering leads.

About Us:

Structure Therapeutics develops life‐changing medicines for patients using advanced structure‐based and computational drug discovery technology. The company’s platform combines the latest advancements in visualization of molecular interactions, computational chemistry, and data integration to design orally available, superior small molecule medicines that overcome current limitations of biologic and peptide drugs. We are advancing a clinical‐stage pipeline of differentiated treatments focused on chronic diseases with high unmet need, including cardiovascular, metabolic, and pulmonary conditions.

Structure Therapeutics is led by an experienced group of international drug innovators and financed by top-tier global life sciences investors. The company completed an initial public offering (IPO) in February 2023. With offices in California and Shanghai, Structure Therapeutics has the benefit of being at the center of life science innovation in both the US and China and capitalizing on the strengths of each geographic location.

Position Summary:

The Director, Global GCP QA is responsible for governance, compliance oversight, and supporting strategic execution across clinical studies and vendor programs, in compliance with applicable national and international standards, regulations, and guidelines. The position will provide support and promote collaboration internally to ensure all systems; processes, and their outcomes remain compliant. The role will provide expert GCP guidance across global regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, PMDA, etc.) and ensure compliance with ICH GCP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant global regulations. The role will collaborate cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement and ensure patient safety and data integrity. This position will report to the Executive Director, Global GCP, QA.

Job Responsibilities

Study Quality Oversight:

  • Act as the primary GCP QA subject matter expert and point of contact for all GCP related matters and issues for the assigned early and late phase clinical and China clinical programs.
  • Ensure ongoing clinical phase and China clinical programs are in compliance with applicable health authority regulations and guidelines.
  • Provide quality oversight and review of key clinical and regulatory submission (e.g. IND/NDA) documents.
  • Own and implement the risk-based GCP audit and compliance strategy across the clinical portfolio.
  • Establish GCP quality governance forums and provide periodic compliance reports to senior leadership.
  • Lead the assessment and escalation of significant quality events, serious breaches, systemic trends, and critical and major CAPAs.
  • Monitor adverse trends for the assigned studies. Create and manage issue trends and make recommendations to management.
  • Provide strategic oversight of CROs and other critical clinical vendors.
  • Manage or mentor GCP QA employees, consultants, and contracted auditors.
  • Represent GCP QA in governance committees and major program decisions.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to assess and manage risks associated with vendors, supporting study compliance, data integrity, and participant safety.
  • Perform reviews of clinical trial documentation for data integrity and compliance with Good Clinical Practice guidance and regulations.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and improvement of quality SOPs, manuals, templates, process maps, and approval flows to establish a robust GCP QMS.
  • Drive the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across Global QA processes to enhance operational efficiency and maintain high compliance standards.
  • Partner with clinical functions to provide quality guidance and drive the implementation of fit-for-purpose procedures that ensure data and documentation are generated and managed in compliance with GCP.
  • Promote a culture of quality through effective communication, training, and proactive engagement with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Lead periodic reporting of key quality metrics to leadership to support continuous improvement in GCP compliance across Structure.

Compliance & Audit Management:

  • Develop strategies and execute/lead audits for the assigned studies, including internal processes, investigator sites, vendors/CROs, TMFs, and CSRs (both routine and for-cause).
  • Approve audit findings and reports, ensure effective root cause analysis and action plans and approve audit CAPAs.
  • Lead and oversee GCP-related vendor qualification and oversight, ensuring adherence to global quality standards, contracts and quality agreements.
  • Evaluate and mitigate compliance risks in GCP domain with a focus on risk-based thinking and operational efficiency.

Inspection Readiness:

  • Lead sponsor inspection readiness and regulatory inspection activities, including inspection strategy, front-room/back-room execution, and response development.
  • Support global regulatory authority inspections and lead/support site and vendor inspection readiness.
  • Maintain a contemporary knowledge of current agency and industry trends, standards, and methodologies related to GCPs.

Qualifications:

  • BS/MS or equivalent in a scientific discipline required; advanced degree is preferred.
  • Auditor certifications and/or SQA RQAP credentials are preferred.
  • 10+ years of pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience, including at least 7+ years in GCP QA lead auditor role.
  • Prior experience in Big Pharma is preferred.
  • Proven leadership in supporting regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, PMDA).
  • Expertise in ICH E6, E8, E2A-F, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and other global standards.
  • Prior success in designing and executing QMS systems, including vendor management and system implementation.

Key Competencies:

  • Exceptional leadership, project management, and communication skills.
  • Bias for action with the ability to drive outcomes across matrixed teams and third parties.

jobs.excerpt: Reddit is a community of communities.  It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet.
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is continuing to grow our teams with the best talent. This role is completely remote friendly within the United States. If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations (San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York City & Chicago) our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like.

Safety is central to Reddit’s mission and long-term health. Safety & Mods Data Science operates as a closed-loop system: Safety Insights helps the organization understand, measure, and prioritize risk, while Safety Enforcement Data Science builds and optimizes the models, rules, and systems that detect and mitigate abuse effectively, efficiently, and fairly.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Safety Enforcement Data Science. You will own one or more defined enforcement problem areas and translate ambiguous abuse risks and written policy into measurable signals, labels, detection approaches, actioning logic, and evaluation plans. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Policy, Safety Operations, Threat Intelligence, and Safety Insights partners to turn analysis into scaled mitigation.

This is a hands-on role. You will investigate adversarial behavior, prototype and evaluate models and rules, tune decision thresholds, define launch guardrails, diagnose enforcement gaps, and monitor systems after deployment. You will also help the team use modern AI methods—including language models—where they improve detection, investigations, labeling, or operational workflows, with rigorous evaluation and appropriate human oversight.

This role may involve exposure to sensitive content and participation in an incident-response on-call rotation, including occasional work outside normal hours.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the enforcement lifecycle. Lead a defined abuse or enforcement problem from problem framing and signal discovery through labels and taxonomies, model or rule development, thresholding, rollout, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Discover and characterize abuse. Analyze large-scale behavioral, content, account, and network data to identify adversarial patterns, emerging threats, and gaps in existing mitigations.
  • Build and evaluate decision systems. Develop models, classifiers, scoring systems, rules, and analytical prototypes using the statistical, machine-learning, or GenAI methods best suited to the problem.
  • Define decision-quality standards. Create evaluation frameworks that address precision, recall, calibration, coverage, robustness, fairness, user friction, reviewer capacity, and other operational costs—not model performance in isolation.
  • Ship with engineering partners. Partner with Engineering and Safety ML to productionize promising approaches; define data and logging needs, launch guardrails, monitoring and alerting, escalation paths, and rollback criteria.
  • Translate policy into systems. Work with Policy and Safety Operations to convert written policy and product requirements into modelable targets, labels, decision rules, reviewer workflows, and measurable enforcement outcomes.
  • Measure real-world impact. Design staged rollouts, experiments, and observational analyses that test whether interventions reduce harm while managing false positives and downstream effects on users, communities, and operations.
  • Respond and learn. Support investigations and urgent escalations, identify mitigation options, conduct post-incident analyses, and turn one-time findings into durable detection or monitoring improvements.
  • Scale the team’s effectiveness. Build reusable datasets, evaluation harnesses, monitoring tools, and documentation; communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical partners; and mentor junior peers when opportunities arise.
  • Stay ahead of the threat landscape. Track emerging abuse tactics and advances in detection, adversarial ML, language models, synthetic data, and human-in-the-loop safety systems, and apply them pragmatically.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience: Ph.D. with 4+ years OR Master’s degree with 8+ years* of relevant industry experience in Data Science, Applied Science, Economics, or a related quantitative role (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research).
  • Applied experience in safety, enforcement engineering, fraud, or similar fast-paced, adversarial domains where data may be incomplete or evolving.
  • Expertise in SQL and Python to write production-grade, reusable analytical code and contribute directly to data pipelines.
  • Strong background in statistical analysis, experiment design, causal modeling, and ML techniques (e.g., classification, ranking, anomaly/pattern detection).
  • Practical knowledge of evaluating real-world decision systems, including sampling, label quality, class imbalance, precision/recall, calibration, thresholding, drift, and monitoring.
  • Proven ability to deconstruct ambiguous problems into scopable components, bias toward action, and drive impactful decisions alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, and Policy teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in Trust & Safety, integrity, fraud, spam and abuse, account security, cybersecurity, risk, content moderation, or another adversarial domain.
  • Experience with one or more enforcement-relevant methods such as graph or network analysis, NLP, embeddings, sequence or behavioral modeling, weak supervision, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop evaluation.
  • Experience applying language models to detection, investigations, labeling, reviewer assistance, or workflow automation—and measuring quality, cost, latency, and safety tradeoffs.
  • Experience partnering with engineers to launch and monitor models or rules in production, including incident response and post-launch tuning.
  • Experience designing prioritization or triage systems for human review operations, including analysis of reviewer quality and capacity.
  • Experience assessing fairness, bias, privacy, and policy-aware tradeoffs in automated decision systems.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

We expect you to take a problem, define ways to solve it, identify the best ways to shape the output, and involve stakeholders throughout the solution's development. Your output might be a Figma design mockup, a prototype, shipped production code, a PRD, or a decision document.

  • Own problems end to end. Define the problem with your PM and engineers, decide what should exist at all, explore options, validate them, and ship improvements that move key metrics. Stay with the work after handoff.

  • Start in writing. Use AI to clarify hypotheses, surface risks and edge cases, write short PRDs or decision documents. Sometimes the document is the final outcome: not every problem needs a UI solution.
  • Use research to go faster. Talk to sales managers, customer success managers, and internal users, run quick tests, and adjust direction based on what you learn. Use research to speed up decisions, not block them.
  • Prototype with AI. Build and iterate on flows in Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. AI writes the code, and you own structure, behavior, and UX quality.

  • Ship with engineers. You'll occasionally ship small UI fixes to production; engineers own production code, and your share can grow over time.

What we expect from you

  • 3+ years as a product designer on complex B2B products with dense, data-heavy interfaces: tables, filters, reporting, multi-role flows.
  • A portfolio that shows product thinking, interaction design, and craft
  • At least several products you've built or prototyped in code with AI tools.
  • You proactively build domain and technical knowledge and get up to speed quickly on new problems.
  • Comfort in Claude Code, or similar: you can work in an existing codebase and get a prototype running without waiting for an engineer.

Nice to have

  • A public GitHub or shipped side projects.
  • Experience in data visualization

How we hire

Apply with a link to your portfolio. The process has three steps:

  1. Technical interview. Walk us through your portfolio and how you work: your research, how you prototype, and the decisions behind one project you built.
  2. Test task. We'd like to understand how you operate within an new domain and are ready to defend your own work
  3. Product manager interview. Product thinking and collaboration: how you define problems and success, prioritize, and work with a PM day to day.

jobs.description:
About this role

TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full-service capabilities, resourcing, and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

The Project Management Associate (PMA) is aligned to and managed under the assigned therapeutic business unit. The PMA will function operationally as a member of the study team and provide administrative support to the Project Manager (PM)

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, setup, execution, and close-out of clinical studies, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements are met.

  • Maintain study documentation, CTMS records, contact lists, trackers, logs, and study files.

  • Provide administrative and operational support to Project Managers, Clinical Research Managers, and CRAs.

  • Coordinate study communications, meetings, agendas, minutes, presentations, and newsletters.

  • Assist with vendor management, investigator payments, invoice tracking, and financial reconciliation.

  • Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and document translation processes.

  • Coordinate study logistics, supplies, and investigator meeting activities.

  • Act as a central point of contact for study teams and sponsors, fostering effective collaboration and communication.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a CTA or in another entry-level role within a major CRO, such as ICON, PPD, IQVIA or Syneos Health.

  • Motivated individuals looking to develop their careers, take on new challenges and grow professionally.

  • A genuine interest in progressing toward a Project Manager career path in the long term.

  • Strong Excel skills, including experience managing multiple trackers and spreadsheets, as well as using formulas, pivot tables and macros.

  • Interest in leveraging AI tools to improve efficiency, streamline processes and generate innovative ideas.

  • Strong English communication skills.

  • Comfortable working in a client-facing environment.

What We Offer

We provide opportunities for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You will join a team that values collaboration, quality, and making a difference in the lives of patients.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability guide our decisions and shape our culture. By aligning on these values, we foster collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to excellence. Together, we make a difference.

A bit more about us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service global CRO, we build solution-driven teams working toward a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries, offering flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Ophthalmology.

Technosylva is a global leader in wildfire and extreme weather risk mitigation software. The Company’s market-leading solutions, enhanced by AI and machine learning capabilities, provide real-time and predictive insights to support electric utility, insurance and government agency customers.

We are hiring a backend-focused Senior Software Engineer to build and optimize the high-performance services and compute models at the core of our platform. This role combines strong systems and backend engineering with advanced numerical and parallel-computing expertise. You will design robust services and APIs while also writing the highly optimized, concurrent code that makes large-scale simulation fast and accurate. It is an ideal fit for an engineer who is equally comfortable reasoning about service architecture and squeezing performance out of compute- and memory-intensive workloads.

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC or equivalent).

  • Develop primary backend systems in C# and Java.

  • Apply synchronization, concurrency, and multi-processing techniques to maximize throughput and correctness.
  • Profile, benchmark, and optimize performance-critical code paths.

Required

  • Solid understanding of concurrency, synchronization primitives, threading, and multi-processing.
  • Strong mathematical proficiency — numerical methods, linear algebra, or applied math relevant to compute models.
  • Experience with API design, database design, and IPC mechanisms.
  • Proven ability to profile and optimize compute- and memory-intensive workloads.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Diseña y es dueño de la estrategia de suscripción digital, define criterios de elegibilidad, segmentación de riesgo, puntos de corte de score y reglas de exclusión (knockout) a partir de datos de buró, datos alternativos y el historial de otros productos de Vana Tech.

Customer Success Manager

Please note: This role is based in Australia

Join Smart WFM as a Business Development Manager (we call them Customer Success Manager's) and play a pivotal role in driving the growth of our business through disciplined business development, consultative selling and commercial leadership.

At Smart WFM, we help organisations unlock the power of workforce management and HR technology. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for building and converting a healthy pipeline of opportunities by combining proactive prospecting, strong commercial discipline and exceptional relationship management. Your focus is to create new opportunities, understand client business challenges, position Smart WFM's expertise and convert interest into profitable, long-term client partnerships.

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, and a Customer Success Team member you will work closely with the Marketing, Consultants, Practice Leaders and Delivery teams to ensure prospects experience Smart WFM as knowledgeable, responsive and commercially practical.

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation and close. You will ensure accurate CRM management, reliable forecasting, disciplined pipeline management and consistent sales execution while contributing to the continued growth of Smart WFM.

Remuneration & Commission Framework

Smart WFM offers a highly competitive remuneration package comprising a strong base salary together with an attractive, uncapped performance-based commission framework.

Our commission model is designed to reward both exceptional sales performance and the behaviours that contribute to long-term client success, including business development, pipeline growth, collaboration and sustainable revenue generation.

Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed their On-Target Earnings through an uncapped commission structure. Full details of the remuneration framework will be discussed with shortlisted candidates during the recruitment process.

While this is a remote-first role, occasional travel to client sites or team events may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Prospecting

Identify and pursue new business opportunities across target industries and markets through outbound activity, networking, referrals, strategic partnerships and marketing-generated leads. Build and maintain a disciplined sales cadence that consistently generates qualified opportunities.

Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management

Own the end-to-end sales process from initial engagement through discovery, proposal, commercial negotiation and contract execution. Maintain accurate HubSpot CRM records, opportunity stages, forecasts, close dates, next actions and pipeline health.

Consultative Sales & Solution Positioning

Lead discovery discussions to understand client business objectives, workforce management challenges and desired outcomes. Position Smart WFM's consulting services and technology expertise in a practical, outcome-focused manner that aligns with each client's strategic priorities.

Commercial Management & Proposal Development

Develop commercially sound proposals, pricing models and Statements of Work in collaboration with internal subject matter experts. Balance customer value with Smart WFM's profitability while managing commercial risks throughout the sales process.

Client Relationship Management

Develop trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, decision makers and strategic partners. Represent Smart WFM professionally while creating confidence in our capability, expertise and delivery approach.

Collaboration & Market Intelligence

Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Consultants and Delivery teams to ensure a seamless client experience. Share market insights, competitor intelligence and customer feedback to continuously strengthen Smart WFM's go-to-market strategy.

Sales Performance & Continuous Improvement

Take ownership of agreed sales targets, pipeline performance and business development activity. Continuously improve sales capability, commercial knowledge and market understanding while contributing to improvements in Smart WFM's sales processes, tools and methodologies.

Success Measures

  • Achievement of agreed revenue, margin and pipeline targets.
  • Consistent growth in qualified sales opportunities.
  • Reliable sales forecasting and CRM accuracy.
  • Strong conversion rates across discovery, proposal and close.
  • High-quality client engagement and consultative selling.
  • Timely delivery of professional proposals and commercial documentation.
  • Growth of strategic client relationships and referral opportunities.
  • Consistent prospecting activity and pipeline progression.
  • Positive contribution to Smart WFM's values, culture and collaborative way of working.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Demonstrated success in business development, enterprise sales or consultative solution selling.
  • Proven ability to build and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting through to close.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience negotiating contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot or equivalent.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience selling consulting services, enterprise software or workforce management solutions is highly regarded.
  • Relevant qualifications in Business, Sales, Marketing or a related discipline are desirable but not essential.

WHAT IS THE WORKING EXPERIENCE LIKE AT SMART WFM?

At Smart WFM, we focus on providing the best possible support to our consultants. As a mature-thinking company, we believe that people are the most important aspect of our business. Our objective is not to create a cookie-cutter culture where everyone acts and thinks the same way, but rather to allow each individual to flourish and express themselves in their own unique way, while experiencing a genuine sense of belonging.

We want every member of our team to achieve success in whatever form that takes, from delivering exceptional client outcomes to improving the way we work every day. Rather than simply reacting to workplace challenges, we focus on creating an environment where people can do their best work from the outset.

At Smart WFM, we have what we call the 'Dr. Seuss Policy', inspired by the famous quote:

"Today you are You, that is truer than true. There is no one alive who is Youer than You."

Smart WFM operates with a mature culture built on trust, communication and cooperation. We value diversity because it brings fresh perspectives, stronger ideas and better outcomes for our clients. We encourage everyone to simply be themselves, creating a workplace that is meaningful, empowering and enjoyable.

INTERESTED?

Tell us about yourself and what motivates you professionally.

Perhaps you're more traditional and would like to send us your CV, that's absolutely fine.

You may prefer to write us a letter explaining your interests and career aspirations.

Or perhaps you'd like to share a portfolio, personal website or other examples of your work.

Be yourself, because that's important to us.

⚠️ ONE LAST THING

Most of our work is evaluation-driven, with some fine-tuning and post-training used to validate research hypotheses. You won’t be expected to build the infrastructure alone: you’ll work with an engineering team that builds the platforms and tools behind the research. You should still be comfortable writing code, analyzing data, and moving your own experiments forward.

Why Vetto?

  • End-to-end ownership. You’ll take research questions from an initial idea to a dataset, benchmark, experiment, and useful conclusion.
  • Direct collaboration with top AI labs. Your work will help frontier teams understand their models and decide what data or training approach to try next.
  • Work that gets used. Your research can become training data, evaluations, technical reports, open benchmarks, and published papers.
  • A wide range of hard problems. Depending on the project, you might work on agents, model evaluations, human or synthetic data, failure analysis, or post-training.
  • Fast, flat team. You’ll ship experiments in days, not quarters.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and run experiments to understand model behavior, test new ideas, and determine whether a dataset or training intervention actually works.
  • Use fine-tuning and post-training experiments when useful to validate research hypotheses and measure improvements in the capabilities we care about.
  • Create datasets, benchmarks, agent environments, rubrics, and evaluation methods for problems that are not well measured today.
  • Work directly with AI labs and enterprise partners to turn open-ended model-development goals into concrete research and data projects.
  • Dig into model outputs and trajectories to understand systematic failure modes and separate model limitations from problems in the data, grader, or evaluation setup.
  • Write analysis code and build lightweight tools or prototypes for your own work, with support from engineers when a workflow needs to become reliable infrastructure.
  • Share what you learn through clear technical reports, internal discussions, benchmarks, and research papers.

What We’re Looking For

Must-haves:

  • Experience doing empirical research or similarly open-ended technical work with machine learning systems.
  • Hands-on experience designing and running agentic systems for complex work, such as coding agents and automated research pipelines.
  • Good experimental judgment: you can form a hypothesis, choose useful baselines and metrics, run a careful experiment, and make sense of noisy results.
  • Strong Python and data analysis skills, plus enough software engineering ability to prototype your own research workflows.
  • The independence to take an ambiguous question about a model and turn it into a dataset, benchmark, experiment, or other concrete contribution.
  • Rigorous analytical thinking — you look at the underlying evidence, notice subtle failure modes, and question results that seem too simple or too good to be true.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with researchers, engineers, customers, and non-specialists.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, changing priorities, and occasional forward-deployed work with partner teams.

Nice to have:

  • Research or industry experience in LLM evaluation, post-training, agents, human or synthetic data, alignment, or AI safety.
  • Experience designing datasets or benchmarks, validating annotation quality, or working with large collections of model outputs and trajectories.
  • Published research, technical writing, open-source contributions, or strong independent projects.
  • Experience building or managing human feedback pipelines.
  • A background in cognitive science, linguistics, philosophy, statistics, or another field that helps you think clearly about evaluation.
  • Experience at an AI lab, AI data company, or in a partner-facing research role.

We care more about evidence of excellent work than any single credential. A graduate degree, publications, lab experience, open-source work, independent research, and production engineering experience are all useful signals, but none is a requirement on its own.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and a stock option plan.
  • Global, remote-first work with flexibility and periodic in-person on-sites every few months.
  • Direct collaboration with cutting-edge AI labs on evaluation, data, and post-training challenges.
  • High ownership and fast career growth in a founding-era team.

Location: Global / Remote, with periodic in-person on-sites every few months

Overview

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

The Vice President, Client Success is accountable for the strategy, operating model, financial performance, technology enablement, organizational capability, and client outcomes of HealthEquity’s mid-market and enterprise Client Success organization.

Leading approximately 250 team members through directors and senior leaders, the Vice President owns the service experience for approximately 5,000 clients representing approximately 80% of the company’s client revenue. The role sets the strategic direction for Client Success, allocates resources across client segments and service functions, and establishes the operating policies, performance standards, department technology (AI) roadmap and management practices required to deliver sustainable business results.

The Vice President is accountable for measurable improvements in client health, retention, renewal readiness, service performance, escalation management, cost to serve, workforce capacity, and organizational effectiveness. The role champions the use of data, automation, and AI to predict client risk, reduce friction, improve productivity, and enable more proactive and personalized client engagement. The role partners across Commercial, Implementation, Product and Technology, Customer Experience, Finance, and Operations to resolve systemic issues and deliver a seamless, digital-first, and measurement-led client experience.

Improved client retention, renewal readiness, and revenue protection

Stronger Client NPS, Client Health Index, and executive relationships

Improved SLA attainment, escalation resolution, and defect prevention

Reduced cost to serve and improved workforce productivity and capacity

A scalable, digital-first, and measurement-led service model

Strong leadership performance, succession depth, and organizational engagement

Effective cross-functional execution and resolution of systemic client issues

Clear executive visibility into performance, risk, investment needs, and results

Strategy and business leadership

Provide executive leadership with clear recommendations regarding client trends, business risks, investment priorities, and strategic opportunities.

Technology, data, and AI leadership

Apply predictive analytics and AI to identify emerging client risks, service issues, renewal concerns, and opportunities for proactive intervention.

Own outcomes across onboarding transitions, steady-state service, executive relationships, renewals, retention, and account-growth enablement.

Use client data, predictive insights, and AI-enabled risk signals to identify concerns earlier and initiate proactive interventions.

Establish differentiated service models based on client complexity, value, risk, and growth opportunity.

Strengthen executive relationships with strategic clients, brokers, consultants, and partners.

Lead resolution of high-risk issues that may materially affect client relationships, revenue, financial exposure, or company reputation.

Align service performance with client value, renewal readiness, retention, and commercial objectives.

Operating model and service performance

Own the Client Success operating budget, forecast, workforce plan, technology investment priorities, and cost-to-serve strategy.

Allocate financial, workforce, and technology resources across client segments and service functions.

Balance client value, service quality, compliance, workforce sustainability, risk, and financial performance when making investment decisions.

Translate operating improvements into measurable productivity gains, cost savings, reduced exposure, improved retention, and protected revenue.

Organizational leadership

Lead and develop directors and senior leaders accountable for distinct client segments, products, and service functions.

Establish leadership expectations and accountability for client, operational, financial, talent, and organizational outcomes.

Ensure the organization has the appropriate structure, leadership capabilities, succession depth, and workforce capacity to execute its strategy.

Build a high-performance culture grounded in client focus, accountability, data-driven decision-making, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Enterprise partnership

Resolve cross-functional tradeoffs and influence enterprise priorities affecting client outcomes.

Use client insights and service-performance data to shape product, technology, process, and policy decisions.

Our global client base needs product-minded professionals who can bridge business and technology, shape data product strategies, and turn complex data requirements into trusted, governed, and reusable data solutions. If you have experience in commercial or specialty insurance, particularly with premium, underwriting, policy, commission, or reinsurance data, and enjoy driving cross-functional collaboration and delivering measurable business value, this role is for you.

At Sedona, we:

  • Obsess about our customers
  • Build robust, scalable technical solutions
  • Create an open, collaborative culture
  • Invest in learning and long‑term careers

The Data Product Manager is a key role within the Global Data Function, accountable for shaping and delivering the Premium data product as part of the Finance Transformation programme. Working closely with the wider product management team, business stakeholders, Technology delivery teams and Architecture, the role will define the product vision, scope and roadmap required to create a trusted, governed and reusable view of premium data. The product will bring together data from multiple business areas and source systems at a consistent level of detail, establish common definitions and quality standards, and enable consistent reporting, analysis and downstream use. The role will lead discovery across the end-to-end data flow—from source systems and interfaces into the Unified Data Ecosystem through to transformation, conformance and consumption—and make clear, evidence-based decisions on priorities, dependencies and phased delivery. It will also matrix-manage the cross-functional delivery team and partner closely with business owners and subject-matter experts to secure adoption, clear ownership and measurable value. Experience in commercial or specialty insurance is required, particularly with premium, underwriting, policy, commission or reinsurance data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and communicate the vision, outcomes and roadmap for the Premium data product, aligned to Finance transformation priorities and wider Group Data strategy.
  • Business Discovery & Scope: Lead discovery with Finance, underwriting and business stakeholders to understand current premium and commission processes, reporting needs, pain points and data flows; translate these into a clear, prioritised and phased product scope.
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Own the product across source data, interfaces into the Unified Data Ecosystem, transformation and conformance requirements, and interfaces out to dashboards, analytics and other consuming products e.g. planning tooling.
  • Common Data Model: Drive alignment of premium, commission and other data across business areas, including common grain, definitions, dimensions and business rules, while making differences and exclusions explicit.
  • Stakeholder & Business Ownership: Establish effective relationships with senior Finance leaders, business product owners, subject-matter experts, Data, Technology and external partners; secure decisions, sign-off and clear accountability for the product.
  • Roadmap, Prioritisation & Dependencies: Maintain an integrated roadmap and backlog covering source readiness, interfaces, platform capability, transformation, reporting and adoption; expose trade-offs and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Team Definition & Mobilisation: Define the cross-functional team structure, capabilities, roles and capacity required to deliver the Premium data product once its scope and roadmap are established; identify resource gaps and work with delivery and functional leaders to mobilise the right team for each phase.
  • Cross-Functional Delivery Leadership: Matrix-manage engineering, architecture, data quality, analysis, reporting and testing specialists through discovery, design, build, validation and release, while maintaining clear separation between product outcomes and delivery execution.
  • Data Governance, Quality & Controls: Define ownership, lineage, metadata, access controls, reconciliation and quality expectations so that premium data is trusted, auditable and suitable for authorised use.
  • Adoption & Value Realisation: Define success measures, monitor product health and usage, and work with consumers to embed the product into reporting and decision-making while reducing manual reconciliation and duplicated data preparation.
  • Lifecycle & Operating Model: Agree the transition from change to run, including stewardship, support, small-change prioritisation and ongoing product improvement.

Requirements

  • Commercial & Insurance Acumen: Strong ability to understand how premium data supports financial management, underwriting performance, planning, reporting and executive decision-making.
  • Data Product Leadership: Proven experience defining and managing data products from discovery and strategy through delivery, adoption and ongoing stewardship.
  • Complex Data Landscape: Experience working across multiple source systems, business units and data models to establish common definitions, aligned grain and reusable data structures.
  • Stakeholder Leadership: Credibility with senior business, Finance, underwriting, Data and Technology stakeholders, with the ability to facilitate decisions, challenge constructively and build alignment where requirements differ.
  • Analytical & Structured Thinking: Ability to break down ambiguous problems, trace business outcomes to source data and transformations, and make pragmatic scope and sequencing decisions.
  • Governance & Data Quality: Practical knowledge of data ownership, controls, lineage, reconciliation, access management and quality standards in a regulated environment.
  • Delivery Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing roadmaps, backlogs, risks and dependencies using Agile and appropriate project disciplines.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to turn complex data and delivery issues into clear choices, recommendations and executive-level updates.

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of Finance and underwriting reporting, including how premium measures and definitions can vary across business areas and reporting bases.
  • Experience delivering enterprise data products on a cloud data platform and enabling Power BI or comparable analytics consumption.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence or similar collaboration and delivery-management tools.

jobs.excerpt: About WaymarkWaymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits.
jobs.description:
About Waymark

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

  • Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.
  • Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.
  • Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.
  • Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About This Role

As the HEDIS Quality Program Principal at Waymark, you will own Waymark’s approach to contractual quality performance, including HEDIS and partner-specific quality measures. You will own the end-to-end operationalization of quality measures and campaigns—from understanding the measure and identifying the opportunity, to designing and deploying high-impact programs, developing workflows, job aids and enablement, coordinating implementation, monitoring execution, and evaluating performance. Reporting to the Vice President of Care Ops, this is an opportunity to build and scale a critical component of Waymark’s care model, improve patient outcomes, and improve contractual performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the portfolio of HEDIS contractual quality measures and roadmap across Waymark’s partnerships.
  • Translate measure specifications and partner requirements into executable programs, including building workflows and scoping and directly managing vendor partners, including for “last-mile” gap closure (eg, home lab visits, at home diagnostic kit distribution) and building the operational infrastructure to scale them.
  • Conduct retrospectives, root cause analyses, and structured improvement cycles to identify execution friction points and accelerate gap closure.
  • Collaborate with Care Operations and Learning and Development teams to develop and maintain the job aids, SOPs, training, and enablement needed for care teams to execute campaigns consistently.
  • Coordinate supplemental data submissions and reconciliation across payer partners.
  • Partner with the Analytics team to define measure logic, dashboards, patient lists, gap reporting, and automated monitoring; independently validate outputs and troubleshoot discrepancies.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for the Clinical Product Development team to ensure the ideation and requirements for new automation and AI innovations reflect best practices, reduce manual work, and make HEDIS programs scalable and efficient.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for the Business Development team on HEDIS metrics and targets during contract negotiations.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and best practices in quality and clinical management and integrate into our operations and product design.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare quality, quality operations, population health, value-based care, managed care, or a related field.
  • 5+ years experience with NCQA HEDIS quality measures and performance programs, including translating requirements into implementable, scalable programs and operational workflows.
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong program and project management skills with a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort and demonstrated success driving program execution independently with a bias for action.
  • Proven track record of managing operational vendors or clinical partners to deliver home-based services, diagnostic programs, or field campaigns.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentation skills, for engaging with executive leadership, training frontline staff, and building strong partnerships with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and manage quality program risks, develop mitigation strategies, and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Experience designing member outreach campaigns, care-team workflows, tasking, job aids, or training in support of quality measures.
  • Ability to manage large volumes of data, analyze data, identify data gaps and develop reporting for performance management
  • Must be able to work in a matrix environment
  • Bachelor’s degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Medicaid managed care
  • Lean Six Sigma or related quality improvement certification
  • Graduate or Advanced Degree (MPH, MHA, MBA)

Hiring Range

The expected hiring range for this role is $127,000 – $157,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.
This is a remote role, however, candidates living in certain high-cost of living cities such as San Francisco, New York City, and Seattle, may be eligible for an additional market premium.

In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company’s growth.
  • Work-from-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office.
  • Incentive Program: Receive additional compensation through performance-based incentives that align with organizational goals and enhance patient outcomes.
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind.
  • Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays.
  • Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non-birthing parents.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule.
  • Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs.
  • Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth.

Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advanced degree/professional license verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process.

Don’t check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

About Nymbus

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The OpportunityThe Fraud Investigator plays a critical role in protecting the financial assets, operational integrity, and reputation of Nymbus clients by leading advanced investigations into complex and high-impact fraud cases across multiple payment channels and products. This role involves the proactive identification of suspicious patterns and anomalies through the review of transactional data, case alerts, and non-alert-based referrals from both internal and external sources.

The Investigator will perform in-depth case analysis, connect cross-channel and cross-client fraud activity, and determine the root cause of fraudulent behavior. They will work directly with clients to present investigative findings, provide recommendations for risk mitigation, and ensure timely resolution of escalated cases. This includes preparing comprehensive reports, tracking key trends, and recommending targeted process enhancements.

Collaboration is essential, as the Fraud Investigator partners closely with internal operations teams, external client contacts, and third-party fraud detection platforms to resolve cases efficiently and in compliance with regulatory standards. The role also involves drafting and maintaining investigative procedures, mentoring Fraud Analysts, and contributing to the development of enterprise-wide fraud prevention strategies.

The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in fraud investigation, strong pattern-recognition skills, deep knowledge of financial regulations, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.

What You Will Own

  • Lead end-to-end investigations into complex and high-impact fraud cases, ensuring timely and thorough resolution.
  • Analyze transactional data across multiple sources to identify patterns, trends, and emerging fraud typologies.
  • Develop and maintain detailed fraud reports for clients, highlighting findings, trends, and recommended actions.
  • Collaborate with internal operational and support teams to ensure accurate documentation, escalation, and resolution of fraud incidents.
  • Work with clients to provide investigative updates, final case reports, and recommended preventive measures.
  • Conduct in-depth reviews of customer claims involving Debit card, Credit card, ACH, P2P, Bill Payments, and other payment channels, with a focus on complex and recurring cases.
  • Identify gaps and recommend procedural enhancements to strengthen fraud prevention measures.
  • Draft, update, and maintain fraud investigation procedures and best practices documentation.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for escalated fraud inquiries from Fraud Analysts and other team members.
  • Track and report investigation metrics for client review.
  • Stay current on industry fraud trends, regulatory changes, and compliance requirements to ensure investigative processes remain effective.
  • Provide training and mentorship to Fraud Analysts on investigative techniques and case handling.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring

  • Associates degree in Business, Criminal Justice, Finance, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in fraud investigation or advanced fraud analysis, preferably in a financial institution or fintech environment.
  • Proven track record managing complex investigations from initiation to resolution.
  • Strong understanding of fraud detection tools and platforms (e.g., Verafin, DataVisor) and the ability to leverage multiple systems for analysis.
  • Fraud certification (CFE, CFCI, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
  • Expertise in identifying patterns, connecting data points, and recognizing emerging fraud trends.
  • Strong understanding of banking operations, payment systems, and relevant regulations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare and deliver investigation reports to diverse audiences.
  • Proven analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently on complex assignments while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google applications, with strong Excel and data analysis skills.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple systems and applications in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

How We Work

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary range: $65,000 to $70,000 annually
  • Annual cash bonus and equity eligibility, if applicable.
  • Remote Work Environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA/FSA/DCA
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible time-off and company holidays
  • Additional paid volunteer day
  • Supplemental Insurance Programs, including voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs [EAP]
  • Wellness programs
  • Growth and development programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, role scope, and location.

Hiring at Nymbus

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the position is based. This role is currently based in the United States. Not all locations are available for consideration, and locations will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.
