Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

jobs.description:
L'équipe Sales s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

En tant que Customer Development Representative (CDR), tu joueras un rôle clé dans le développement de nos relations clients.

Ta mission ? Réengager nos clients et anciens clients, leur donner envie de redécouvrir AssessFirst et organiser des rendez-vous pertinents pour nos Account Managers (AM) et Customer Success Managers (CSM). Tu travailleras au quotidien avec ces équipes pour identifier les bons interlocuteurs, relancer les échanges et créer de nouvelles opportunités.

Tu t'appuieras sur des relations déjà existantes pour susciter l'intérêt, générer des rendez-vous et contribuer à l'adoption de nos solutions et à la croissance de nos comptes. Avec un objectif de 12 rendez-vous honorés par mois, tu pourras mesurer concrètement ton impact tout en développant tes compétences commerciales dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

Tes missions :

  • Réactiver nos clients : reprends contact avec les clients moins actifs, comprends leur intérêt pour nos solutions et organise des échanges avec leurs AM ou CSM.

  • Faire découvrir nos nouveautés : participe aux campagnes de lancement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, présente leurs bénéfices et suscite l'envie d'en savoir plus.

  • Renouer avec nos anciens clients : réengage les entreprises ayant déjà utilisé AssessFirst en valorisant les évolutions de notre plateforme et les nouvelles possibilités qu'elle offre.

  • Assurer un suivi commercial rigoureux : renseigne tes interactions dans HubSpot, suis les rendez-vous honorés et contribue à la visibilité sur les opportunités générées.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes commerciales : coordonne tes actions avec les BDR, AM et CSM pour assurer une expérience client cohérente et éviter les sollicitations en doublon.

Ta future équipe

Au quotidien, tu collaboreras étroitement avec :

  • Les Account Managers (AM) pour identifier les comptes à réengager et favoriser la création d'opportunités d'upsell.

  • Les Customer Success Managers (CSM) pour faciliter la reprise des échanges, renforcer l'adoption et accompagner la relation client.

  • Les Business Development Representatives (BDR) pour coordonner les actions de contact et assurer une répartition claire des comptes.

Expérience souhaitée

📞 Tu es à l'aise au téléphone et tu aimes engager la conversation, créer du lien et donner envie à tes interlocuteurs d'échanger.

💬 Tu communiques avec clarté et enthousiasme, aussi bien à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, et tu sais adapter ton discours à ton interlocuteur.

⚡ Tu es persévérant(e) et orienté(e) résultats : tu aimes relever des défis, atteindre tes objectifs et progresser au quotidien.

🤝 Tu as un vrai sens de la relation client : tu sais écouter, susciter l'intérêt et construire des échanges de qualité.

jobs.description:
Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom. Our portfolio spans more than 10 leading technologies across AI, cloud, data, automation, and business applications.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role. You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds. Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you

accordingly.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.
    • Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.
    • Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.
    • Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.
    • Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.
    • Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.
    • Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.
    • Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.
    • Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.
    • A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.
    • Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.
    • Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.
    • A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.
    • Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.
    • Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.
    • Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.
    • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.
    • A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.
    • Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.
    • Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

• Bilingual English and French.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • You will own client outcomes, not status reports.
    • Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.
    • Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.
    • You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.
    • Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

jobs.excerpt: Lead Data EngineerAbout us:At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
jobs.description:
Lead Data Engineer

About us:

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.

Position Overview:

The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.

At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.

The Right Wrench for the Job

Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.

You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask — this is the center of the role, not a component of it.
  • Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.
  • Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.
  • Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.
  • Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention policy for agent-produced data.
  • Source Ingestion: Onboard new data sources to documented patterns, own schema drift and deletion detection, and partner with engineering on source schema changes.
  • Vendor Direction: Scope and direct the retained architecture consultant’s ongoing work — writing specs, reviewing deliverables against approved standards, and rejecting nonconforming work.
  • Self-Serve Enablement: Provide guidance and office hours for business users and AI builders to self-serve against the data platform. This role explicitly does not build reports on request.
  • Documentation: Treat documentation as a core deliverable, not an afterthought. With no second data employee, documentation is Fullbay’s continuity plan for this function.
  • Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 7+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a production data platform, required.
  • Deep dimensional modeling experience required: able to declare a grain, defend historization choices per attribute, and articulate a restatement policy.
  • Experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse) beyond SQL — warehouse strategy, cost management, RBAC, and environment design — required.
  • Experience building transformations as version-controlled code with automated tests and CI required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience with change data capture and incremental extraction from application databases required.
  • Experience with entity resolution across systems with independent identifiers required.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Comfortable being the only person who knows how something works, and documents accordingly.
  • Willing to say no to a vendor, an app team, or an executive, and ability to explain why.
  • Strong written communication skills; able to arbitrate cross-functional definitional disagreements clearly and diplomatically.
  • Nice to have: Experience serving AI or programmatic consumers of data, familiarity with the Salesforce object model, prior experience as a company’s first data hire, and prior experience directing outside vendors.
    • What Makes This Role Unusual:
      • Two live products — Classic and Next — supported permanently, not a migration to complete.
      • AI agents as first-class consumers of data, alongside human reporting.
      • Greenfield authority to set company-wide data standards, inside an architecture already designed by an outside firm.
      • Direct line to the VP of IT, with the charter to set standards company-wide.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

jobs.description:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

Data Platform Lead

We’re hiring a hands-on Data Platform Lead, to join Convene Hospitality Group’s (CHG) Technology organization.You’ll own our data platform end to end, from architecture to how we model the business, and you’ll manage the analytics engineers who build on it. Data platform modernization and AI-first development are top priorities, and this role sits at the center of both, working hand in hand with the product engineers whose systems create much of our data.

Today, our marts mostly mirror the systems they come from. Salesforce data looks like Salesforce, NetSuite data looks like NetSuite. You’ll reshape our models around how the business runs, organized by domain, and layer governed dashboards and conversational analytics on top. In one year, a finance lead, a venue GM, and an AI agent should all be able to ask a question in plain language and get the same trusted answer.

Today we run Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran. You’ll help us rearchitect for where CHG is headed: building on Snowflake’s native capabilities (semantic views, Cortex, and its agent tooling), rolling out ThoughtSpot, and filling gaps like observability.

This is a hands-on management role, open to first-time managers. If you’ve led as a tech lead, mentored engineers, or directed contractors, you’ll get direct coaching from a VP of Engineering who develops first-time leaders. Experienced managers who still want to build are welcome too.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the data platform end to end. Architecture, reliability, and roadmap from source to decision across Snowflake, dbt, and Fivetran. Move platform configuration from the UI into Terraform, in coordination with Cloud Infrastructure, so warehouses, roles, grants and connectors are versioned, reviewed and reproducible.
  • Rethink how we model the business. Move us from source-shaped marts to domain-oriented models built around how CHG runs. Set the modeling standards, naming conventions and review practices the team builds on.
  • Work backward from the business question. Partner with Finance, Sales, Operations and venue leadership to turn the questions they need answered into models, metrics and definitions they trust.
  • Partner closely with product engineering. Work with product squads on schema design, data contracts, and upstream changes, so the platform and products evolve together.
  • Own data quality and observability. Set the testing standards, contracts, and reconciliation checks that make our numbers trustworthy, and alert an owner before a stakeholder finds a broken dashboard.
  • Own the metrics and BI layer. Roll out our BI tool and build the semantic layer behind governed dashboards in Snowflake semantic views, with certified metrics and shared definitions, so a number means the same thing everywhere it shows up.
  • Bring conversational analytics online, safely. Stand up natural-language querying and agents on Snowflake’s native tools, with the evals and guardrails that keep agent, dashboard, and human answers in sync.
  • Govern the data. Access control, PII handling and accessible documentation across analytics and AI.
  • Lead and grow analytics engineering. Manage and hire our analytics engineers, and direct the contractors we work with today. Coach through code review, pairing, and clear expectations.
  • Keep your hands on the keyboard. Write dbt models, review PRs, debug pipelines and prototype new approaches. Expect to build a lot, especially early on.

What We Look For:

  • You have 7+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering or data architecture, including building a modern data platform that people rely on in production.
  • You use AI agents for real multi-step work: building models, writing tests, debugging pipelines and documenting what exists. You write clear specs, give agents the right context, and verify what they produce against the real system.
  • You're deep on dbt and Snowflake. You've designed project structure, testing strategy and warehouse performance at scale, and you manage the platform as code with Terraform or similar.
  • You’re fluent in data modeling and have moved a team from source-shaped models to business-shaped, domain-oriented marts, then seen the change through to adoption.
  • You've built data quality and observability practices: tests, contracts, freshness monitoring and alerting that people trust.
  • You've built a semantic layer and governed metrics that people trust, and you understand what it takes to make natural-language and agent-driven analytics accurate.
  • You've worked with managed ingestion like Fivetran and know where it fits and where it breaks.
  • You've led beyond your own work: as a tech lead on a multi-person project, mentoring engineers, running interview loops, or directing contractors or vendors.
  • You explain clearly to engineers and non-engineers. You can walk an analyst through a modeling decision and a CFO through a metric definition.
  • You're high agency. You set direction without waiting for a spec, make architecture calls, and write down your reasoning.

Bonus Points

  • You've rolled out ThoughtSpot or another search-driven BI tool.
  • You’ve unleashed an autonomous agent in the wild, and built the fencing, monitoring and improvement loop around it.
  • You've modeled data from Salesforce, NetSuite or HRIS platforms.
  • You've prepared data for AI use cases: retrieval, agents or feature pipelines.
  • You've worked in hospitality, events, real estate or another customer-centric, multi-location business.

Compensation:

At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Health & Wellness: Day-one health coverage for you and your family, 24/7 virtual care, emotional well-being support, and fertility & family planning benefits. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.

As a UX/CX Designer, you'll join our client's U.S.-based Experience Strategy & Design Studio. jobs.excerpt: About Imagine WorldwideAll children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need.
jobs.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

Role Overview

The Data Quality Analyst focuses on data quality across Imagine’s data ecosystem. The role proactively monitors data from devices, programme systems and field sources, builds and improves the checks that catch problems early, and investigates issues raised across the organisation. Where an issue requires deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work, the role provides its findings and works with the relevant team member to resolve it.

Imagine’s data covers learning activity from tablets in more than 1,500 schools, along with programme, operational and field data. Devices sync intermittently and sources don’t always agree, so checking data against what is happening in schools and in the field is central to the work.

The role reports to the Director of Analytics and works closely with the Data Scientist, who provides methodological support. It suits an analyst who enjoys tracing a problem back to its source and wants to keep developing in a small team. As they build context on Imagine’s data, the role takes on more ownership of the team’s data quality reporting and standards.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst’s responsibilities fall into four pillars: data quality monitoring and improvement, data issue investigation, communicating findings, and analytical practice.

Data Quality Monitoring and Improvement

The role takes a proactive approach to data quality, identifying risks and gaps before they affect reporting or decision-making.

  • Monitor the completeness, consistency and plausibility of data across Imagine’s sources, and identify issues independently.
  • Design and implement data quality checks, and recommend where further checks or controls are needed across pipelines and source systems.
  • Develop tooling and automated monitoring that make data quality issues visible, working with the Analytics Engineer on implementation within the platform.
  • Reconcile figures across related sources and investigate discrepancies.
  • Contribute to the team’s data quality reporting, rules and standards.

Data Issue Investigation

The role is the Analytics Team’s first point of investigation when data issues are identified, whether through monitoring or raised by colleagues.

  • Investigate data issues and trace them to their root cause across source systems, pipelines and data models.
  • Work with the Analytics Engineer, MEAL and country teams to resolve issues at source and confirm their resolution.
  • Handle assigned data quality and data export requests from the Analytics Team’s request process.
  • Document findings and hand over issues that require deeper analysis, reporting changes or engineering work to the relevant team member.
  • Support the team’s data quality incident process by providing the evidence needed for decisions.

Communicating Findings

  • Write concise summaries of data issues and investigations, covering the cause, the impact and the recommended action.
  • Report on the state of data quality to the Analytics Team and, where appropriate, to the teams that own the source data.
  • Use clear charts and tables to show the scope and impact of issues.
  • State data limitations plainly, so that figures are not over-interpreted when shared further.

Analytical Practice

Analysis is only useful to a small team if others can check it, reuse it and build on it.

  • Keep checks and analyses reproducible, using version-controlled code and notebooks that someone else could rerun and arrive at the same result.
  • Follow the Analytics Team’s standards for code, documentation and data use, and contribute to improving them as the team grows.
  • Use the team’s shared data models and agreed metric definitions as the starting point for analysis, and flag where they fall short rather than working around them quietly.
  • Ask for review of methods and conclusions from the Data Scientist and Director of Analytics, and give constructive review on colleagues’ work in return.
  • Build a working knowledge of Imagine’s data, programmes and operating contexts, so that analyses reflect how the programme actually runs on the ground.
  • Handle sensitive data responsibly, in line with Imagine’s data governance and privacy policies.

Requirements

The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective with Imagine’s data. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • At least 3 years in a data analyst or closely related quantitative role.
  • Experience monitoring, validating or reconciling data, and tracing issues back to their source.
  • Experience working with imperfect real-world data, such as missing records, inconsistent sources or late-arriving data, and explaining how those issues affect a result.
  • Experience building automated checks or reports that others rely on.
  • Experience communicating findings in writing to non-technical readers.
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

Technical Skills: Core

  • Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations and window functions across large tables.
  • Proficiency in at least one key programming language (such as Python) for automation, data analysis, and reproducible research.
  • Data profiling and validation techniques, including completeness, consistency and plausibility checks.
  • Applied statistics for identifying anomalies, including distributions, outliers and trends.
  • Clear data visualisation.

Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred

  • Querying analytical or columnar databases such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.
  • Data quality testing frameworks such as dbt tests, Great Expectations or Soda.
  • Reproducible workflows using notebooks and Git.

Technical Skills: Advantageous

  • An understanding of data pipelines and how a dbt-modelled data warehouse is structured.
  • Education, programme monitoring or field survey data.
  • Field data collection tools such as CommCare, ODK or KoboToolbox.
  • BI tools such as Apache Superset, Metabase or Power BI.
  • Spreadsheet tools for sharing data with stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Location

The Data Analyst must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK.

This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. The role may involve occasional international travel for in-person team meetings, field support or training, as needed. Candidates should be comfortable working independently in a virtual environment and coordinating with colleagues across global teams.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis

Job Description

The Sales Strategy & Enablement Director, is an individual contributor responsible for driving the AI vision and roadmap for the Sales and SBO (Sales Business Office) organizations at Cox Automotive, both by tracking progress and maturity and by actively driving roadmap items through delivery systems. This individual serves as the designated AI Ambassador for Sales and SBO within the enterprise-wide AI ambassador program, ensuring these functions have an informed, engaged voice in enterprise AI governance, pilot coordination, and emerging technology evaluation. This role leads the strategic effort to determine how Sales and SBO tools should converge as AI capabilities mature, partnering heavily across the Sales Analytics, Business Process Design & Improvement, Technology, Sales, and SBO teams to shape the future seller experience. The Director develops frameworks, evaluation criteria, and phased plans that guide how the current tool stack evolves and how new AI-enabled experiences are curated for sellers and SBO team members. Beyond AI-specific responsibilities, this individual contributes to broader initiatives that improve the overall seller experience at Cox Automotive, serving as a strategic resource that can be deployed against high-priority projects and transformation efforts as business needs evolve.

PRIMARY DUTIES/KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drives the CAI Sales and SBO AI vision and roadmap forward through the delivery system, tracking progress and maturity while ensuring the roadmap evolves as technology, vendor landscape, and business priorities shift.
  • Serves as the designated AI Ambassador for the Sales and SBO organizations, representing their priorities and readiness in the enterprise-wide AI ambassador network through weekly coordination and ad hoc testing sessions.
  • Serves as a trusted AI advisor to CAI Sales and SBO, guiding teams through the development and implementation of AI solutions, helping ensure the right foundation and approach are in place, and providing expertise to assess whether solutions are being designed effectively.
  • Leads organizational readiness and positioning efforts for incoming agentic AI capabilities, developing structured evaluation criteria and sequencing recommendations before new tools enter build or pilot phases.
  • Contributes to the strategic change narrative for sales leadership and the broader field organization, communicating what transformation is coming, why it matters, and how the organization will navigate it.

  • Drives strategic tool rationalization and consolidation decisions, identifying redundancy across the sales and SBO tool stack and building business cases for convergence aligned to the broader AI vision.
  • Creates investment roadmaps and impact analyses aligned with future budget plans, providing clear visibility into new funding requirements and potential variances associated with AI transformation initiatives.
  • Ensures Sales and SBO interests are represented in enterprise-level AI policy, platform, and governance decisions, advocating for alignment between what is being built enterprise-wide and what sellers actually need.
  • Contributes to broader initiatives that enhance the overall seller experience at Cox Automotive, serving as a strategic resource available for high-priority projects and transformation efforts beyond AI-specific work.
  • Partners with the SBO Business Process Design & Improvement Team to ensure smooth handoffs between strategic transformation decisions and operational enablement execution, including tool sunset timing, migration planning, and field communication sequencing.
  • Supports the development of shared governance frameworks, intake and prioritization mechanisms, handoff protocols, and citizen development standards.

The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and 8 years of the above experience; a Ph.D. and 5 years related experience; or 14 years of the above experience without a degree.

Experience with product or program lifecycle management within a structured delivery framework (e.g., Agile or phase-gate), rather than strategic planning alone.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with enterprise AI and agentic technologies, including tools such as Claude and Copilot M365, with the ability to advise teams on how AI can effectively integrate with the broader sales technology ecosystem, including Salesforce, CPQ, sales enablement, and conversation intelligence platforms. Able to evaluate solutions, identify overlap, and recommend opportunities to simplify and optimize the technology stack.

  • Experience leading enterprise-level transformation or change initiatives in a matrixed organization, including stakeholder alignment across multiple functions without direct authority, ideally grounded in a recognized change management framework such as Prosci or ADKAR.
  • Strong ability to evaluate emerging technologies for strategic fit, organizational readiness, and business impact rather than purely technical capability.

Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Sales Executive, Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes (SC ABP)

Position Summary

The Sales Executive, Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes (SC ABP) is responsible for creating, developing, and growing TraceLink's Supply Chain Agentic Business Process business within a defined portfolio of strategic customer and prospect accounts. Serving as the primary commercial owner for the Supply Chain ABP commercialization journey, the Sales Executive partners with executive business and technology leaders to transform end-to-end supply chain business processes into Agentic Business Processes.

Many customers will simultaneously participate in the Track & Trace ABP commercialization journey. In these situations, the Sales Executive works collaboratively with Track & Trace Customer Account Manager (CAM) to deliver a seamless "one account" customer experience while independently owning the Supply Chain ABP commercial relationship.

This role is ideal for an executive-level consultative seller who excels at business transformation, executive relationship development, strategic solution selling, and creating new enterprise software businesses.



Key Responsibilities

Own the Supply Chain ABP Commercial Journey

  • Serve as the primary commercial owner for the Supply Chain ABP commercialization journey across an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts.
  • Develop executive account strategies that establish and grow the Supply Chain ABP business.
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business and IT leaders.
  • Position TraceLink's vision for the Agentic Supply Chain Operating Model, Agentic Supply Chain Operating System, Agentic Business Processes, and OPUS Agents.
  • Lead executive discovery, strategic account planning, and long-term transformation roadmaps.
  • Coordinate executive alignment sessions, business process discovery workshops, and Agentic Business Process strategy engagements.


Create New Supply Chain Transformation Businesses

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new Supply Chain ABP opportunities within existing and prospective customers.
  • Lead customers through the Agentic Business Process commercialization journey, including the Agentic Accelerator Program (AAP), thereby establishing an executive-aligned mutual action plan that is co-executed with the champion
  • Effectively position TraceLink's Supply Chain ABP portfolio, OPUS Platform, OPUS Agents, Agentic Control Tower, and Agentic Business Network as the foundation for enterprise supply chain transformation.
  • Work collaboratively with the Business Process Architects and Value Engineering teams to build compelling executive business cases demonstrating measurable operational and financial outcomes.
  • Develop expansion strategies that establish long-term strategic partnerships across multiple business processes and functions.


Drive Commercial Excellence

  • Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies using TraceLink's WISE agentic operating platform's insights and analysis.
  • Lead opportunities through TraceLink's commercial sales process while applying disciplined MEDDPICC qualification.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline capable of consistently achieving assigned bookings objectives.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts, opportunity strategies, executive engagement plans, and account documentation within WISE and CRM.
  • Ensure disciplined pipeline hygiene, opportunity progression, forecast accuracy, and commercial governance.
  • Utilize TraceLink's business value frameworks, commercial methodologies, and executive messaging to execute consistent customer engagements.


Lead Cross-Functional Solutioning

  • Coordinate ABP Architects, Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, Channels & Alliances, and executive leadership throughout the sales cycle.
  • Lead internal account strategy sessions and opportunity reviews to maximize win probability.
  • Ensure customers experience coordinated commercial engagement across all TraceLink teams.


Partner Across Commercial Businesses

  • Collaborate closely with Track & Trace Customer Account Managers to promote a unified "One Account" customer experience.
  • Leverage insights from the Track & Trace business to identify Supply Chain ABP opportunities.
  • Share customer intelligence that creates reciprocal growth opportunities across both commercialization journeys.
  • Coordinate executive engagement strategies that maximize long-term customer value while maintaining clear commercial ownership across each business.


Success Measures

The Sales Executive is measured on:

  • Supply Chain ABP Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
  • New Customer Acquisition
  • Existing Customer Expansion ARR (MINT, POET, OPUS Agents)
  • Supply Chain ABP Pipeline Coverage
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • MEDDPICC Qualification Quality
  • Pipeline Hygiene and Commercial Process Compliance
  • Successful Completion of Agentic Accelerator Programs
  • Executive Engagement (CxO Meetings, Discovery Workshops, Blueprint Reviews, Proof-of-Value Reviews)
  • Adoption of WISE


Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 6-10 years of enterprise software or technology sales experience.
  • Demonstrated success selling complex enterprise transformation initiatives to executive stakeholders.
  • Proven success creating new enterprise software businesses and consistently achieving bookings objectives.
  • Experience leading multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.
  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and strategic account planning skills.
  • Experience with structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

Preferred Experience

  • Life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or supply chain software experience.
  • Experience selling supply chain planning, execution, ERP, AI, automation, or digital transformation solutions.
  • Knowledge of business process transformation, operational excellence, and enterprise AI.
  • Experience working within matrixed global organizations.


Core Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Development
  • Enterprise Solution Selling
  • Business Transformation
  • Strategic Account Planning
  • Business Value Selling
  • Commercial Negotiation
  • MEDDPICC Opportunity Qualification
  • Pipeline & Forecast Management
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Executive Communication & Presentation


What Success Looks Like

Successful Sales Executives create entirely new Supply Chain Agentic Business Process businesses within strategic accounts by helping customers reimagine how supply chain work is performed. They establish trusted executive relationships, build compelling transformation visions, execute disciplined commercial processes, and consistently deliver predictable bookings growth. By collaborating seamlessly with Track & Trace Customer Account Managers and Business Process Architects, they create long-term strategic partnerships that accelerate customer transformation while reinforcing TraceLink's "One Account" commercial strategy and long-term Agentic Business Process vision.

WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON

WHO WE’D LOVE TO MEET

We’d love to connect with professionals who:

  • Are open to freelance, contract, temporary, or project-based work

HOW THE NEW ENGEN NETWORK WORKS

When you join the New Engen Network, your information will be available to New Engen’s Recruiting team for consideration as relevant project needs arise.

Submitting your information does not guarantee that you will be contacted, interviewed, or offered an engagement. If your skills, experience, rate, and availability align with an opportunity, someone from our team may reach out to discuss the project and next steps.

Opportunities may vary in duration and may require either part-time or full-time weekly availability. “Full-time” in this context describes the expected project schedule; it does not mean the opportunity is a permanent, full-time position.

Some temporary or project-based engagements may eventually lead to consideration for permanent employment. However, conversion is not guaranteed and is not the primary purpose of this Network.

ENGAGEMENT DETAILS

The structure of each engagement will depend on the specific project and may include freelance, independent contractor, fixed-term temporary, or other project-based arrangements.

Project scope, duration, location requirements, schedule, compensation, and any applicable benefits will be discussed before an engagement begins. Compensation will vary based on the work, required experience, engagement structure, and expected time commitment.

LET’S BUILD WHAT’S NEXT TOGETHER

Even if we don’t have an immediate opportunity that matches your background, we’d still love to learn more about you.

Share your experience, areas of expertise, portfolio or work samples, availability, and preferred type of engagement to join the New Engen Network. We’ll be in touch if an opportunity aligns with what you bring.

Compensation for each opportunity is determined based on the applicable labor market, the scope and structure of the role or engagement, and the individual’s qualifications and experience.

New Engen is proud to have offices in Seattle, New York, and Northwest Arkansas, each one anchoring teams that drive creativity, collaboration, and culture. But great work isn’t limited to those zip codes. We also support a distributed team of remote employees across the country, giving people the flexibility to do their best work wherever they are.

We currently hire full-time employees in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin

Important Notice About Job Openings:

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These attempts are often designed to steal your personal information or trick you into paying fees for recruitment or training services.

New Engen does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fees at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process.

All legitimate job openings will be posted directly on our careers page. Communication about these roles will come exclusively from New Engen Recruitment through our ATS, Greenhouse. We will never conduct recruiting outreach through unsolicited text messages or from the @newengen.online domain.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

jobs.excerpt: About Sequel Sequel, headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire, is a company developing the next generation of transformative drug-delivery advancements starting with diabetes.
jobs.description:
About Sequel

Sequel, headquartered in Manchester, New Hampshire, is a company developing the next generation of transformative drug-delivery advancements starting with diabetes. Sequel’s approach is to look at diabetes management holistically to advance systems that make living with diabetes simpler and easier for all. Sequel’s flagship product, the twiist Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) System, launched in July 2025 for people with type 1 diabetes providing them with personalized diabetes management. 

Job Overview:

The Associate Director, Clinical Research and Real-World Evidence is a hands-on scientific contributor who drives and executes clinical research, real-world evidence (RWE), biostatistical planning and interpretation, and other evidence-generation activities across Sequel Med Tech's product portfolio, including the twiist Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) System. Working closely with the Chief Medical Officer and cross-functional partners, this role translates clinical and business questions into rigorous, feasible research plans and helps generate evidence to support product development, regulatory activities, reimbursement, clinical adoption, and scientific dissemination.

The ideal candidate can independently contribute to protocol development, endpoint selection, statistical analysis plans, interpretation of clinical and real-world data, and study execution, while working closely with the CMO and other subject-matter experts on broader evidence strategy. Experience supporting medical device regulatory submissions or working within a regulated environment is preferred. The role will collaborate with internal teams and external investigators, academic research organizations, analytics partners, and other research vendors.

Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties

  • Real-World Evidence & Biostatistics: Design and support RWE studies; contribute to research questions, endpoint definitions, analysis plans, data-quality review, interpretation, and communication of results; partner effectively with internal or external statisticians and data scientists.
  • Study Design & Regulatory Support: Lead the development of study protocols and study concepts for company-sponsored, collaborative, post-market, and pivotal studies, including objectives, populations, comparators, endpoints, sample-size considerations, and analysis approaches; develop clinical evidence for regulatory briefing materials, submissions, and responses.
  • Clinical Research Execution: Drive study start-up and execution, including protocol and case-report-form development, vendor and investigator coordination, data review, issue resolution, analysis, and interpretation across company-sponsored studies, investigator-initiated studies, and special-population research.
  • Evidence Planning: Partner with the CMO to identify evidence gaps and research priorities and drive an integrated evidence-generation plan spanning clinical studies, real-world evidence, publications, and external collaborations.
  • Clinical Evidence Development: Develop clinical evidence materials, including competitive data comparisons, dossiers, evidence summaries, and scientific narratives supporting regulatory, reimbursement, product adoption, medical education, publications, and OUS opportunities.
  • Payer / Market Access: Develop clinical and economic evidence summaries supporting reimbursement, payer engagements, and market-access activities.
  • Publications & Scientific Communications: Support scientific publications, abstracts, posters, congress presentations, and dissemination of clinical and real-world evidence.
  • Medical Affairs Strategy: Contribute to the execution of the Medical Affairs strategy and evidence roadmap, supporting clinical adoption, reimbursement, patient outcomes, and future growth objectives.
  • Medical Education & Scientific Engagement: Serve as a scientific resource across the product portfolio; support advisory boards, congress activities, medical education programs, and engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, and key opinion leaders.
  • Medical Safety: Participate in hazard analysis reviews, adverse-event and complaint evaluations for Sequel owned product, post-market safety activities, and related investigations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Advanced degree in biostatistics, epidemiology, health outcomes research, clinical research, public health, or a relevant scientific or healthcare discipline (e.g., PhD, ScD, DrPH, PharmD, MD, or MS).
  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in clinical research, RWE, biostatistics, epidemiology, medical device or pharmaceutical evidence generation, or a related field; a doctoral degree may substitute for a portion of professional experience.
  • Experience in a regulated medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, academic research, contract research, or health-data environment; direct experience supporting regulatory activities is preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of clinical study design, observational research, registry studies, and real-world evidence methods.
  • Applied understanding of biostatistical principles, including endpoint selection, sample-size and power considerations, longitudinal and repeated-measures data, missing data, confounding, bias mitigation, and interpretation of clinical and real-world analyses.
  • Ability to develop or critically review protocols, statistical analysis plans, tables and figures, and study reports, and to collaborate effectively with statisticians and programmers.
  • Experience supporting clinical research execution, including investigator or vendor collaboration, data review, and interpretation of study findings.
  • Familiarity with FDA expectations, Good Clinical Practice, and clinical evidence requirements for regulated products; medical device experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of clinical research and regulatory requirements outside the U.S., including experience supporting global or international evidence-generation activities, is preferred.
  • Experience preparing abstracts, posters, manuscripts, evidence summaries, or other scientific communications.
  • Knowledge of diabetes management, insulin therapy, continuous glucose monitoring, and Automated Insulin Delivery systems is preferred.
  • Strong scientific writing, communication, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple research activities, and translate evidence into clear scientific, clinical and business insights.
Sequel Med Tech provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
At Sequel, we believe that when you thrive, we thrive. That’s why our benefits package is designed to support you from day one. You’ll be automatically enrolled in our 401k plan, featuring a 6% company match and 100% immediate vesting. We’re committed to your well-being and understand the unique needs of employees and families living with diabetes, so we offer capped out-of-pocket insulin costs and GLP-1 coverage across all plans. You’ll have access to a variety of Meritain health insurance plans to suit your needs and can also take advantage of Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) or Health Savings Account (HSA). Our comprehensive benefits package includes vision and dental coverage, plus voluntary options such as long-term disability, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and even discounts for pet care. In addition, we provide employer-paid short-term disability and life insurance for extra peace of mind.
We know the importance of taking time to rest and recharge. That’s why Sequel offers flexible PTO, generous paid holidays, and Flex Time options to help you balance work and life when you need it most. Our team enjoys a culture built on hard work, fun, and genuine support. At Sequel, you’re not just starting a job, you’re building a rewarding career and a brighter future. Join us, and let’s thrive together!
