jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Lead, Performance Media, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 8 - 10 years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You'll own the strategic direction, quality, and growth of performance media across a portfolio of complex client engagements. This role is ideal for a seasoned media leader who combines deep omnichannel expertise with strong people leadership, commercial acumen, and a forward-looking mindset—including a clear vision for how AI-enabled tools, automation, and intelligent workflows can transform how media is planned, activated, measured, and scaled.

Reporting to the Media Director, this position serves as the senior link between media leadership, clients, and delivery teams—managing up by shaping practice strategy, client growth, and executive-level performance narratives, while managing down by leading, developing, and scaling a team of Senior Performance Media Managers and junior planners and buyers. You’ll drive integrated, omnichannel thinking across programs, ensuring paid media is connected with experience, creative, strategy, data, and commerce efforts.

You’ll be accountable for the overall performance, profitability, and innovation of media programs across paid digital and broader omnichannel touchpoints, setting standards for excellence, championing responsible AI adoption across the team, and ensuring media consistently delivers measurable business outcomes for our clients.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

Media Strategy & Omnichannel Planning

  • Set the strategic direction for performance media across client portfolios, spanning paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, CTV, retail media, and emerging platforms, with an understanding of how traditional and offline channels fit into the mix.
  • Translate client business and growth objectives into integrated, full-funnel, omnichannel media strategies that connect brand, performance, and customer experience goals.
  • Oversee audience-led planning, testing roadmaps, and budget allocation frameworks, incorporating AI-supported planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
  • Review and approve media plans developed by the team, ensuring strategic rigor, quality, and alignment with client objectives.
  • Lead senior-level presentations of media strategy, rationale, and performance to client stakeholders and internal leadership.

Media Buying, Activation & Partner Management

  • Own strategic relationships with key media partners and platforms such as Google, Meta, Amazon, TikTok, DV360, and The Trade Desk, leading negotiations for value, priority access, and betas.
  • Provide oversight of campaign activation, optimization, and budget pacing across accounts, ensuring operational excellence, accuracy, and governance.
  • Champion a structured test-and-learn agenda across new channels, formats, partners, and AI-enabled capabilities, and scale proven approaches across clients.
  • Guide the team in maximizing platform automation and AI-driven bidding, targeting, and creative optimization while maintaining appropriate human oversight and quality controls.
  • Establish and evolve activation standards, QA processes, and workflows that improve speed, consistency, and scalability.

Measurement, Optimization & AI Integration

  • Hold accountability for performance outcomes across the portfolio, ensuring media investment is tied to clear KPIs and business impact.
  • Partner with analytics and data leadership to shape measurement frameworks, including attribution, incrementality testing, and media mix modeling.
  • Lead the identification, piloting, and integration of AI-powered tools and workflows across planning, reporting, insight generation, and optimization—and help define how these are adopted responsibly across the team.
  • Turn complex performance data into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations that inform client decisions.
  • Stay ahead of industry, platform, and privacy changes, assessing their implications and advising clients and internal teams accordingly.

Client Leadership & Growth

  • Serve as the senior performance media lead for key clients, building trusted, strategic relationships with senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to expand scope and grow client relationships, contributing to account planning, new business pitches, and proposals in partnership with the Media Director.
  • Support scoping, resourcing, and budget management to ensure engagements are delivered efficiently and profitably.
  • Collaborate across creative, experience, strategy, technology, and data teams to deliver integrated, experience-led solutions.
  • Represent the performance media practice in cross-functional and leadership forums.

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop a team of Senior Performance Media Managers and junior planners, buyers, and specialists.
  • Set clear goals, provide regular coaching and feedback, and lead performance reviews and development planning in line with Valtech processes.
  • Allocate work and manage team capacity across accounts to balance client needs, quality, and team wellbeing.
  • Build team capabilities in omnichannel planning, analytics, and AI-enabled ways of working through training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on guidance.
  • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and retention, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.
  • Partner with the Media Director to shape practice priorities, best practices, and long-term capability growth.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in digital and performance media planning and buying, ideally within an omnichannel agency or consultancy environment.
  • Deep expertise across paid digital channels (paid search, paid social, programmatic, online video, CTV, retail media), with a working understanding of traditional and offline channels within an integrated mix.
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and growing media teams, including senior-level direct reports.
  • Track record of owning large, multi-channel budgets and delivering measurable business results across multiple clients or brands.
  • Exceptional client leadership, presentation, and storytelling skills, with experience advising senior and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate strategically while staying close enough to execution to guide, unblock, and quality-check the team’s work.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI-powered tools and automation into media workflows, with a clear point of view on how AI can improve efficiency, insight, and performance.
  • Strong command of measurement approaches, including attribution, incrementality, and media mix modeling, as well as tracking and ad ops fundamentals.
  • Commercial acumen, including experience with scoping, resourcing, negotiation, and contributing to new business.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Reporting Structure

  • Reports to: Media Director
  • Direct reports: Senior Performance Media Managers, Performance Media Planners/Buyers, and junior team members
  • Works closely with: Strategy, Creative, Experience, Data & Analytics, and Technology Leads, as well as Client Stakeholders


The benefits

This is a Full-Time position based in Charlotte, NC. The offered salary range is $118,000 to $135,000 annually, depending on experience and location.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryScicom Infrastructure Services is seeking aDatabricks Data Operations Specialistto support the operational stability, reliability, performance, and security of a large-scale Databricks data platform.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Scicom Infrastructure Services is seeking aDatabricks Data Operations Specialistto support the operational stability, reliability, performance, and security of a large-scale Databricks data platform.

This role will work as part of a multidisciplinary Databricks team that includes data engineers, architects, business analysts, governance specialists, and technical managers. The Data Operations Specialist will be responsible for monitoring production data pipelines, responding to incidents, troubleshooting platform and data-processing issues, coordinating deployments, and ensuring that data products meet established availability, quality, and service-level requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience operating Databricks environments and supporting production data workloads using Apache Spark, Delta Lake, SQL, Python, cloud infrastructure, monitoring tools, and automated deployment practices.

Key Responsibilities

Databricks Platform Operations

  • Monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of Databricks workspaces, jobs, pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, and related cloud services.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support for production Databricks environments.
  • Monitor scheduled and event-driven data pipelines for failures, delays, data-quality issues, and performance degradation.
  • Troubleshoot Databricks jobs, Spark workloads, cluster failures, notebook errors, connectivity issues, and data-processing exceptions.
  • Restart, rerun, recover, or coordinate remediation of failed workflows according to documented procedures.
  • Support Databricks Workflows, Lakeflow, Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, and batch-processing workloads.
  • Review driver and executor logs, Spark UI metrics, cluster event logs, audit logs, and application telemetry to identify root causes.
  • Support configuration and maintenance of Databricks clusters, serverless compute, instance pools, cluster policies, and SQL warehouses.
  • Monitor resource utilization and recommend changes to cluster sizing, autoscaling, workload scheduling, and compute policies.
  • Help maintain consistent configurations across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Support platform upgrades, runtime-version changes, library updates, and configuration changes.
  • Coordinate with Databricks support and cloud-service providers when vendor assistance is required.

Production Pipeline Support

  • Monitor ETL, ELT, streaming, API, and file-based data-integration processes.
  • Validate that scheduled data loads complete within required processing windows.
  • Investigate missing, late, duplicated, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
  • Perform controlled data reprocessing, backfills, reconciliation, and recovery activities.
  • Support ingestion and transformation processes involving JSON, CSV, XML, Parquet, APIs, databases, message queues, and cloud storage.
  • Monitor Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers within a medallion architecture.
  • Validate source-to-target record counts, control totals, schema consistency, and business-rule compliance.
  • Coordinate with data engineers to resolve recurring pipeline or transformation defects.
  • Maintain operational runbooks for common failures, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and recurring support tasks.
  • Ensure production interventions are documented and performed in accordance with change-control procedures.

Incident and Problem Management

  • Serve as a first or second level of support for production Databricks and data-pipeline incidents.
  • Triage incidents based on severity, business impact, affected systems, and service-level commitments.
  • Coordinate incident response among engineering, cloud, security, governance, and business teams.
  • Provide timely status updates during active incidents.
  • Escalate issues to technical leads, architects, vendors, or program leadership when appropriate.
  • Conduct or support root-cause analyses for production incidents.
  • Document incident timelines, contributing factors, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
  • Track recurring problems and recommend permanent engineering or process improvements.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and ensure assigned corrective actions are completed.
  • Help develop automated remediation for common operational failures.
  • Maintain incident, problem, and service-request records in the organization’s ticketing system.

Monitoring and Observability

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and operational reports for Databricks and associated data services.
  • Monitor job success rates, pipeline latency, processing duration, cluster utilization, data freshness, data quality, and compute consumption.
  • Configure actionable alerts that minimize unnecessary notifications while identifying material operational issues.
  • Integrate Databricks monitoring data with enterprise observability platforms.
  • Support tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable platforms.
  • Define operational health indicators, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives.
  • Produce daily, weekly, and monthly operational metrics for program leadership.
  • Identify performance trends and operational risks before they result in production failures.
  • Maintain dashboards showing system availability, incident volume, recovery time, pipeline status, and data freshness.

Data Quality and Data Contract Operations

  • Monitor compliance with established data contracts between data producers and consumers.
  • Validate schema, field, data-type, frequency, freshness, completeness, and quality requirements.
  • Detect schema drift, unexpected source-system changes, and contract violations.

The Education Justice Project (EJP) is a unit of the College of Education at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and a comprehensive college-in-prison program. The mission of EJP is to build a model college-in-prison program that demonstrates the positive effects of higher education on incarcerated students, their families, the communities to which they return, the host institution, and society as a whole. To accomplish this mission, EJP developed several programs and initiatives, including a Policy & Research Division.

The mission of EJP’s Policy & Research Division is to educate and equip relevant stakeholders with knowledge, skills, and confidence to produce research and practice civic engagement that promotes equity-focused and evidence-based policymaking related to higher education in prison, reentry, and other relevant issues. Our team is supported by members across the country who are passionate about creating a more just and humane world. We work together to challenge the dominant narrative around incarceration, mitigate the impacts of incarceration, support the creation of more humane and just responses to harm and violence, and allow college-in-prison programs to flourish only as long as prisons exist.

Team members contribute in various ways, depending on their interests and skills. Examples include:

  • Serving as an EJP representative to relevant coalitions and campaigns (e.g., the Illinois Coalition for Higher Education in Prison)
  • Participating in the design and implementation of tools and trainings to support EJP’s policy initiatives
  • Monitoring legislation and policy developments that impact EJP’s work
  • Collecting and analyzing data/research related to ongoing examination of policies and practices of campus units with which formerly incarcerated individuals to identify where supports exist and how to make campuses more inclusive and welcoming

All members participate in trainings and events, attend monthly team meetings, co-present at conferences, and shape our work moving forward.

jobs.excerpt: Sustainability in the NHS Course Developer and Skills CoachPermanent, full-time | Remote within the UK Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience Start date: Available for an immediate start Closing date: Monday 9th November(We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.
jobs.description:
Sustainability in the NHS

Course Developer and Skills Coach

Permanent, full-time | Remote within the UK
Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience

Start date: Available for an immediate start

Closing date: Monday 9th November

(We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We encourage early applications.)

Bring your NHS experience into learning

Have you worked in the NHS and helped turn sustainability commitments into practical action? This is an opportunity to use that experience to shape relevant learning for NHS colleagues and support them as a Skills Coach.

Direct experience of working within the NHS is essential for this appointment. We will prioritise candidates who bring practical NHS sustainability, procurement or related operational experience, as this is the expertise we are looking to add to our team.

Join KnowledgeBrief

KnowledgeBrief is an apprenticeship and training provider helping people and organisations build the skills they need across business management. Our expertise spans leadership and management, digital, and business and professional services. Through apprenticeships, professional qualifications, workshops and coaching, we connect learning to real work, helping people make better decisions, lead change and improve organisational performance.

Our vision is a future where every organisation can turn learning into measurable performance through confident people, modern leadership and practical capability. We bring together specialist expertise, our own learning technology and personalised support to help people apply what they learn and make a meaningful difference in their roles.

We are a values-driven organisation: inspirational, innovative and authentic, with relationships at the heart of how we work. Joining KnowledgeBrief means being part of a team that values the joy of learning and cares about the impact we create for our learners, clients and each other.

About the Role

You will help adapt our established Level 4 Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship for NHS and healthcare learners, then coach apprentices through the programme over the long term. Development is planned from early 2027, with a proposed spring launch.

The course framework and core curriculum are already in place. Working with the Curriculum Development and Sustainability teams, you will review the content through an NHS lens, adapting examples, workplace activities and evidence opportunities while preserving the apprenticeship standard and its knowledge, skills and behaviours.

Your understanding of NHS structures, local priorities and procurement arrangements will help learners apply the programme in their own trust, integrated care board or department. The role sits within Operations and reports to the Curriculum Team Leader.

You may currently work in NHS sustainability, procurement, estates, operations or management and be ready to move into learning and coaching. We will support you to develop your apprenticeship delivery and coaching skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adapt learning cycles, workshops, case studies and workplace activities for different NHS settings, retaining existing content where it remains relevant.
  • Apply NHS sustainability, governance, budgets, commissioning and procurement knowledge to connect learning with employers’ Green Plans, contracts and improvement priorities.
  • Check NHS policy references and resources for accuracy, work to editorial standards and deadlines, and share your subject expertise with colleagues and employer partners.
  • Coach adult apprentices through individual learning plans, monthly one-to-one sessions and relevant workshops, adapting support to their roles and working patterns.
  • Monitor progress, provide developmental feedback and hold reviews with learners and line managers every 6–8 weeks; identify barriers early and agree practical support.
  • Help learners prepare for gateway and end-point assessment, maintain accurate progress and off-the-job learning records, and contribute to programme improvement.
  • Follow safeguarding, Prevent, equality, inclusion, funding and quality requirements, raising concerns promptly.

Interpersonal Fit

You will bring curiosity, clear communication and an approachable manner, building credibility with NHS colleagues at every level. We value people who take ownership, collaborate with stong working relationships, welcome feedback and share our commitment to the joy of learning, sustainable patient care, quality, safeguarding and inclusion.

Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Substantial first-hand experience working within an NHS trust, integrated care board or national NHS body in sustainability, procurement, estates and facilities, operations or management, with hands-on involvement in net zero or social value activity.
  • Experience preparing papers or business cases for senior leaders, boards or committees and managing budgets, resources or contracts within NHS governance requirements.
  • Understanding of NHS structures and governance, Green Plans, the 2040 and 2045 net zero targets, climate duties under the Health and Care Act 2022 and CQC Well-led expectations on environmental sustainability.
  • Knowledge of the Procurement Act 2023, Provider Selection Regime, NHS Net Zero Supplier Roadmap, supplier Carbon Reduction Plans and social value; an understanding of how procurement arrangements differ across NHS organisations and functions.
  • Awareness of sustainability across healthcare estates, energy, clinical waste, medicines, anaesthetic gases, travel, food, digital services and lower-carbon care pathways.
  • Understanding of corporate responsibility and sustainability, including ESG, sustainability frameworks, GHG Protocol scopes, reporting standards, stakeholder theory and risk management.
  • Ability to review and adapt learning materials, check credible evidence and meet deadlines; experience coaching, training or developing adults, facilitating workshops and giving feedback.
  • A relevant degree in health management, environmental management, sustainability, business or procurement, or equivalent professional experience; a teaching or training qualification such as the Level 3 Award in Education and Training, or willingness to achieve one.
  • Clear communication, confidence with online delivery, strong organisation and accurate record keeping; GCSE
  • English and Mathematics at grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent.

Desirable

  • Experience in a Green Plan role, supporting a board-level net zero lead or working with healthcare suppliers on net zero commitments.
  • Familiarity with the Five Case Model, Core20PLUS5, NHS anchor institutions, the NHS 10 Year Health Plan, NHS charities, the NHS Social Value Playbook, Evergreen or SusQI.
  • Experience developing learning resources or delivering apprenticeships; relevant professional membership, assessor, CIPS, NHS leadership or project management qualifications; experience with learning platforms or e-portfolios.

Why Work With Us?

At KnowledgeBrief, we are committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged, and able to grow.

You’ll benefit from:

  • 5.6 weeks’ annual leave
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Dedicated monthly CPD days on successful completion of probation
  • Two weeks’ paid time off over Christmas and New Year on successful completion of probation
  • Company sick pay on successful completion of probation
  • Opportunities to contribute to cross-team projects and organisational growth
  • A remote-first environment with opportunities to connect in person

Our Commitment to Safer Recruitment and Inclusion

KnowledgeBrief is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of learners, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.

Offers of employment are subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, references, and DBS checks where appropriate.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process.

Application Process

Submit your CV, clearly highlighting your NHS employment experience and involvement in sustainability, procurement, net zero or social value activity.

  • Initial screening with the People & Culture Team
  • Interview stage(s) with the hiring team
  • Final decision and feedback

We aim to keep the process timely, transparent, and respectful of your experience.

Ready to Apply?

If you would like to use your NHS experience to help others learn and make a practical difference, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and we will be in touch.

The Hiring Team

KnowledgeBrief

Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience

  • Práticas avançadas de testes unitários no frontend utilizando Jest.

Job Description


Are you a passionate SAP BTP Developer looking to make a significant impact in the publishing industry? Join Penguin Random House as an SAP BTP Senior Developer and be part of a team that is shaping the future of reading.

As a key member of our technology organization, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality SAP BTP solutions across application development, automation, and integrations. We are seeking candidates with strong hands-onSAP BTP development experience, including UI5, Fiori, and Automation (SAP Build).

We are specifically looking for candidates who must-have:

  • Minimum 5+ years of recent and relevant experience in SAP BTP development.
  • Strong understanding of BTP services relevant to application development and automation.
  • Proven experience as a software engineer with a strong focus on coding and technical implementation.
  • Hands-on expertise in SAP UI5, Fiori, Workflows, and SAP Build (Process Automation, Build Apps, Work Zone).
  • Proficiency in cloud development languages such as JavaScript, Node.js, TypeScript, and Python.
  • Experience in developing and customizing Fiori apps using Fiori Elements, Smart Controls, and annotations (local and backend).
  • Development experience in SAP Build projects involving Business Processes, Automation, Decision, and Process Visibility.
  • Application integration experience with REST/OData APIs, SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA.
  • Strong experience in configuring SAP Business Technology Platform and BTP services, with clear understanding of different runtimes (Cloud Foundry is a must).
  • Proficient with tools such as SAP Business Application Studio, Visual Studio Code, and SAP BTP Cockpit.
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in security using XSUAA, Connectivity, and Destination services.
  • Ensure code quality, version control, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub or GitLab, following DevOps best practices.
  • Good understanding of SAP Cloud Connector.
  • Problem-solving and team-oriented mindset with the ability to design, develop, and maintain high-quality technology solutions in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Qualifications


  • Experience in building applications using SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) with Node.js, strong JavaScript/Node.js expertise, and Core Data Services (CDS).
  • Experience in configuring SAP IAS/IPS with corporate identity providers (e.g., Okta).
  • Ability to design and implement integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems using BTP Integration Suite, API Management, and Events.
  • Exposure to diverse business scenarios (A2A and B2B) with hands-on experience in working with major adapters such as SFTP, SOAP, REST, IDoc, OData, JDBC, and SuccessFactors.

We are not seeking candidates who:

  • Are primarily SAP BTP Developer or analysts without a strong focus on hands-on software development.
  • Have limited or no recent experience in SAP BTP development.
  • Possess experience limited to SAP BTP administration activities only.
  • Are seeking a primarily consulting or advisory role rather than a development-focused role. 

Additional Information


If you are ready to take your career to the next level and contribute to a dynamic and innovative company, we encourage you to apply to this US-based remote opportunity. Please note, that while this role is remote-eligible, it will require operating on Eastern Timezone.

You will work closely with Product Management, UX Research, Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, and business stakeholders to understand customer needs and design effective product experiences.


You will help shape the product from its early stages by understanding customer workflows, exploring important use cases, creating and testing design concepts, and translating findings into clear design recommendations.


The successful candidate will be comfortable working on complex and evolving product challenges. You will combine customer-centered thinking with hands-on design execution, use research and product evidence to guide your work, and help cross-functional partners better understand the needs of users.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end UX design for KYC Orchestrator, from customer discovery and concept development through implementation.
  • Translate complex KYC data, risk signals, evidence, and investigation workflows into intuitive, actionable user experiences.
  • Create customer journeys, information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, design patterns, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Design and explore AI-assisted experiences with appropriate transparency, evidence visibility, human review, and user control.
  • Partner with Product Management and customers to conduct interviews, workflow analysis, concept testing, and usability evaluations.
  • Use customer feedback, research, analytics, and product data to validate problems and continuously improve solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and other stakeholders to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical requirements.
  • Lead design reviews and communicate design concepts, research findings, recommendations, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Experience in UX, product, interaction, or related design roles.
  • Experience designing complex digital products, SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, or workflow-driven systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading UX design for products, features, or significant initiatives.
  • Strong skills in interaction design, information architecture, prototyping, user flows, wireframing, and high-fidelity design.
  • Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with modern design tools and practices.
  • Experience translating customer research, feedback, analytics, and product insights into effective design solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating customer-centered problem solving, design execution, iteration, and collaboration.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience with data-rich, configurable, or workflow-intensive products.
  • Experience with compliance, risk, financial services, investigations, or decision-support solutions.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted, generative AI, conversational, or agent-supported experiences.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles, including transparency, source visibility, human review, and user control.
  • Experience taking new products from customer discovery through validation and delivery.
  • Familiarity with Agile/lean product development, design systems, and reusable components.

Portfolio Requirement

Submission of a portfolio is required. Please include case studies that demonstrate your approach to understanding customer problems, designing complex product experiences, iterating through research and testing, collaborating with Product Management and Engineering, and carrying design work through implementation.

jobs.title: Senior Copywriter - Donut Studios
jobs.excerpt: WHY DONUT STUDIOS?  At New Engen, we help brands grow, not just bigger, but smarter.
jobs.description:
WHY DONUT STUDIOS?

At New Engen, we help brands grow, not just bigger, but smarter. We’re a digital marketing agency that drives meaningful impact across the entire customer journey by integrating media, creative, analytics, influencer, and retail strategies into performance-driven campaigns.
Donut Studios is our in-house creative studio, purpose-built to craft high-performing, platform-native, and digital content for the world’s most ambitious brands. As a key part of New Engen’s suite of specialized solutions, alongside offerings like the Acorn Creator Suite - Donut Studios helps unlock breakthrough creative that drives results, fast.

We’re a collaborative group of strategists, content creators, copywriters, editors, designers, account strategists, and more who are all in on helping brands, and each other, thrive. We work hard, stay humble, and build with purpose.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Write Performance-Driven Copy Across Channels
Create compelling, conversion-focused copy across paid social, landing pages, email, video scripts, and other digital marketing channels. Develop messaging that captures attention quickly, keeps audiences engaged, and drives action without feeling overly promotional.

Concept High-Performing Social Creative
Write platform-native short-form content designed for channels like TikTok and Instagram that feels authentic, entertaining, and culturally relevant. Develop concepts, hooks, and scripts that blend storytelling with performance marketing goals.

Adapt Seamlessly Across Brand Voices
Translate complex ideas and dramatically different brand personalities into clear, engaging copy. Move fluidly between tones and industries while maintaining authenticity, consistency, and strong creative standards.

Craft Hooks, Messaging, and Calls-to-Action
Develop scroll-stopping hooks, memorable one-liners, and persuasive CTAs designed to improve engagement and conversion performance. Apply audience psychology and direct-response principles to create copy that resonates and performs.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally to Develop Creative
Partner closely with designers, editors, strategists, and cross-functional teams to bring creative concepts to life. Contribute ideas that strengthen both the creative quality and performance of campaigns.

Stay Ahead of Trends and Emerging Formats
Monitor social trends, platform updates, pop culture moments, and emerging content formats to keep creative fresh and relevant. Continuously bring new ideas and creative angles rooted in what’s resonating with audiences online.

Optimize and Iterate Based on Performance Data
Use campaign performance insights to refine messaging, test new approaches, and improve conversion outcomes over time. Continuously iterate on copy and creative concepts to help drive stronger engagement and lower CPAs.

Maintain a High Editorial Standard
Approach writing with a strong editorial eye, ensuring all copy is polished, grammatically sound, and aligned with brand voice. Self-edit rigorously and provide thoughtful feedback that strengthens the quality and clarity of creative work.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 3-6 years of experience in copywriting, content marketing, or a related creative field, with a strong focus on direct response and performance-driven writing.
  • A strong digital portfolio showcasing direct response copywriting work across channels like paid social, video scripts, landing pages, email, or other digital formats. Candidates without a portfolio will not be considered.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Communications, English, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience writing across multiple brands and adapting to different brand voices, with the ability to shift tone seamlessly while maintaining authenticity and clarity.
  • Deep familiarity with TikTok, social media trends, and internet culture, with a strong understanding of what captures attention and drives engagement across platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, while staying organized and meeting deadlines in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across creative, strategy, and production teams.
  • A self-starter mindset and positive attitude, bringing curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm to both the work and the team.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Remote or hybrid work environment with flexible hours
  • Unlimited PTO + company holidays
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability coverage
  • Life & AD&D insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave & family support
  • Pet care perks & insurance
  • Learning & career development programs
  • Commuter & transit benefits
  • Exclusive employee discounts

Salary Range: $65,000 - $70,000 annually

Compensation for each opportunity is determined based on the applicable labor market, the scope and structure of the role or engagement, and the individual’s qualifications and experience.

New Engen is proud to have offices in Seattle, New York, and Northwest Arkansas, each one anchoring teams that drive creativity, collaboration, and culture. But great work isn’t limited to those zip codes. We also support a distributed team of remote employees across the country, giving people the flexibility to do their best work wherever they are.

We currently hire full-time employees in the following states: Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin

Let’s Build What’s Next Together — If you’re passionate about media and eager to make a meaningful impact with a team that’s all in, we’d love to hear from you.

Important Notice About Job Openings:

Please be aware of fraudulent job postings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These attempts are often designed to steal your personal information or trick you into paying fees for recruitment or training services.

New Engen does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fees at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process.

All legitimate job openings will be posted directly on our careers page. Communication about these roles will come exclusively from New Engen Recruitment through our ATS, Greenhouse. We will never conduct recruiting outreach through unsolicited text messages or from the @newengen.online domain.

If you have any concerns about the authenticity of any message claiming to be from New Engen, please contact us immediately at before taking any further action.

We take your security seriously and are here to support you, ensuring your job search is a safe, positive experience.

jobs.title: Creative Design Team Lead (AI & Performance Marketing)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients.
jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Directeur(trice) de comptes (Télétravail – Montréal)

À propos de nous

Chez GG TEQ, nous aidons les organisations à moderniser leur environnement technologique grâce à des solutions novatrices en matériel, logiciels, services infonuagiques et infrastructure TI.
Nous sommes une entreprise technologique en forte croissance où l'esprit entrepreneurial, l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la performance sont au cœur de notre culture. Si vous souhaitez accompagner les entreprises dans leurs défis technologiques, bâtir des relations durables et contribuer directement à la croissance de GG TEQ, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Notre engagement

Chez GG TEQ, nous respectons votre temps.

Chaque candidature est examinée personnellement par notre spécialiste en acquisition de talents, et tous les candidats qualifiés recevront une réponse dans les 48 heures suivant leur candidature.

Aperçu du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) de comptes dynamique, orienté(e) vers le conseil et les résultats, qui aime développer des relations, créer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires et conclure des ventes.

Vous serez responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu'à la conclusion des ententes, tout en accompagnant vos clients dans leurs projets grâce à un vaste portefeuille de solutions en infrastructure TI, services infonuagiques, logiciels et matériel.

Ce poste offre un potentiel de rémunération exceptionnel, une grande autonomie ainsi que de réelles possibilités d'avancement.

Ce qui définit le succès

  • Développer et maintenir un solide portefeuille d'occasions d'affaires.
  • Mener avec assurance des échanges de qualité avec les clients.
  • Atteindre et dépasser régulièrement les objectifs de vente.
  • Devenir un conseiller de confiance en développant des relations durables avec vos clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu'à la conclusion des ventes.
  • Développer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires grâce à la prospection et au réseautage.
  • Positionner des solutions en matériel informatique, logiciels, services infonuagiques et infrastructure TI.
  • Comprendre les enjeux d'affaires des clients et recommander des solutions adaptées à leurs besoins.
  • Maintenir un portefeuille d'occasions d'affaires à jour et produire des prévisions de ventes fiables.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes avant-vente, les spécialistes techniques et la direction afin d'assurer le succès des projets.
  • Utiliser l'outil de gestion de la relation client (CRM) afin d'assurer le suivi des activités, des occasions d'affaires et des résultats.
  • Atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs de vente établis.

Qualifications

Exigences

  • De 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en vente B2B couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vente.
  • Expérience en vente de solutions technologiques, TI, infonuagiques, SaaS ou de matériel informatique.
  • Historique démontré d'atteinte ou de dépassement des objectifs de vente.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en présentation et en négociation.
  • À l'aise avec la prospection active et le développement de nouvelles occasions d'affaires.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial en forte croissance.
  • Expérience auprès d'un revendeur à valeur ajoutée (VAR) en TI.

Atouts

  • Expérience auprès de décideurs en technologies de l'information.
  • Expérience chez un manufacturier ou un fournisseur de technologies.
  • Connaissance des modèles de revenus récurrents (MRR/ARR).
  • Expérience en vente consultative axée sur la création de valeur.
  • Connaissances en infrastructure TI, cybersécurité, réseautique ou services infonuagiques.

Rémunération et avantages

  • Salaire de base concurrentiel accompagné d'un régime de commissions non plafonné.
  • Vacances payées.
  • Journée personnelles rénumérées.
  • Ordinateur portable et équipement de travail fournis par l'entreprise.
  • Programme complet d'avantages sociaux.
  • Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et de formation continue.
  • Excellentes possibilités d'avancement professionnel.
  • Environnement de travail à 99 % en télétravail.

GG TEQ souscrit au principe de l'égalité en emploi. Nous valorisons la diversité et nous nous engageons à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif où chaque personne est traitée avec respect, équité et professionnalisme.

---

Account Executive (Remote – Montreal)

About Us

At GG TEQ, we're building the next generation of hybrid solutions by offering hardware, software, and IT solutions designed to help organizations modernize infrastructure and move faster with confidence.

We’re a high-growth, entrepreneurial team that values ownership, performance, and integrity. If you want to sell meaningful solutions (not just products) and directly impact company growth, you’ll fit right in.

Our Hiring Commitment

At GG TEQ, we respect your time. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition Manager and you can expect to hear back from us within 48 hours of applying.

Role Overview

We are looking for a driven, consultative, and quota-crushing Account Executive to help us scale. You’ll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing and be instrumental in driving solution sales across our product stack. This role is comprised of unlimited earning potential.

This is a true full-cycle role where you’ll hunt, close, and grow accounts while selling a broad, high-demand portfolio of IT solutions.
In this role you will have the opportunity to have uncapped earning potential, a clear path to growth and leadership and be given high autonomy to provide high impact.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • You have built a healthy, self-generated pipeline.
  • You confidently lead customer conversations.
  • You consistently close deals and drive revenue growth.
  • You become a trusted advisor to your customers. We are in the business of building and growing relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle: outbound prospecting, qualifying leads, product demos, proposals, and closing deals.
  • Develop product knowledge across hardware, software, and cloud services to position solutions effectively.
  • Build strong, consultative relationships with prospects and customers to uncover business needs and deliver tailored solutions.
  • Maintain a sales pipeline and accurately forecast monthly and quarterly revenue.
  • Collaborate with pre-sales engineers and leadership to align deals with customer requirements and implementation timelines.
  • Use CRM tools to track activity, report results, and continuously refine sales approach.
  • Provide feedback to product, marketing, and operations teams to improve go-to-market execution.
  • Achieve set targets.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 2–5 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience (preferably in technology, IT solutions, or cloud/SaaS/hardware).
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a growing team in a startup environment.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting and high activity levels.
  • Experience working for an IT VAR.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience selling into IT decision-makers.
  • Previous manufacturer experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with recurring revenue models (MRR/ARR).
  • Background in value-based selling.
  • Technical acumen or knowledge of infrastructure, cybersecurity, or networking.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission.
  • Paid vacation.
  • Paid personal days.
  • Company-provided laptop and work equipment.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuous training.
  • Excellent career advancement opportunities.
  • 99% remote work environment.

GG TEQ is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Salary: $50,000 - $80,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Fabric — architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter
  • Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.
  • Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice — covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

Job Summary

QC Servion is seeking a Social Media Manager to own the day-to-day social media presence across the QC Ecosystem and organizations supported by our shared marketing function.

This is a hands-on role combining content creation, design, publishing, community engagement, analytics, and strategic thinking. The Social Media Manager will manage content across multiple brands and channels while ensuring each organization maintains its individual voice and contributes to a cohesive ecosystem-wide narrative.

The role requires someone who can quickly learn complex businesses and technical subject matter, translate that information into engaging content, and recognize when social interactions may represent broader client, partnership, media, or business opportunities.

The ideal candidate is highly curious, visually minded, organized, and proactive. We are looking for someone who can take direction and run with it, identify opportunities to improve content and engagement, and increasingly operate independently as they become familiar with our businesses and audiences.

Essential Functions

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Plan and maintain social media content calendars across multiple brands, entities, and channels.

  • Translate technical concepts, company updates, industry developments, thought leadership, and business initiatives into engaging social content.

  • Identify new content opportunities and recommend topics, formats, campaigns, and approaches based on business priorities and audience interests.

Design & Video Production

  • Create social graphics and visual assets that align with established brand guidelines.
  • Produce and edit short-form video and support longer-form content as needed.
  • Apply strong visual judgment to ensure content meets quality and brand standards before publication.
  • Maintain reusable templates, brand kits, and creative assets that improve consistency and production efficiency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative resources and subject-matter experts when specialized content is required.

Multi-Brand Social Media Management

  • Manage day-to-day social activity across a growing portfolio of brands and accounts.
  • Maintain visibility into upcoming campaigns, events, company announcements, and business priorities.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders across the organization to gather information and develop timely content.
  • Manage multiple brands, platforms, priorities, and audiences simultaneously without sacrificing quality or consistency.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of each organization and how each fits within the broader QC Ecosystem.

Community Engagement & Inbound Opportunities

  • Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, mentions, and other inbound social activity.
  • Support social engagement for company and assigned executive accounts.
  • Participate appropriately in relevant industry conversations to strengthen visibility and relationships.
  • Recognize interactions that may represent potential client, business development, partnership, media, or relationship opportunities and route them to the appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Escalate sensitive issues or reputational concerns when appropriate.
  • Maintain a professional, responsive, and consistent brand voice across external interactions.

Analytics & Optimization

  • Monitor audience growth, engagement, content performance, and channel trends.
  • Track and report on established social media KPIs.
  • Use performance data to refine content topics, formats, timing, and channel strategy.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve audience growth and engagement.
  • Stay current on platform changes, algorithms, emerging channels, and social media best practices.
  • Continuously test and recommend new approaches based on performance and organizational priorities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with marketing, business development, events, creative teams, leadership, and stakeholders across the QC Ecosystem.
  • Participate in marketing and business discussions to remain connected to organizational priorities and upcoming initiatives.
  • Build relationships with subject-matter experts to identify stories, insights, and content opportunities.
  • Develop enough familiarity with each business to increasingly take ownership of day-to-day social planning and decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

  • Social channels maintain a consistent, professional, and engaging presence across the organization.
  • Each brand maintains its individual identity while supporting the broader QC Ecosystem story.
  • Content calendars remain organized, current, and aligned with business priorities.
  • Engagement and audience growth improve through thoughtful, data-informed content.
  • Comments, messages, and inbound interactions receive timely and appropriate responses.
  • Potential business, partnership, and relationship opportunities identified through social engagement are recognized and routed appropriately.
  • Internal stakeholders view social media as a valuable extension of marketing and business development efforts.
  • The Social Media Manager increasingly operates independently and proactively identifies opportunities rather than relying solely on assigned requests.

Position Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in social media management, content marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, or a related area; equivalent demonstrated experience may be considered.
  • Experience independently managing content across multiple social media channels and preferably multiple brands, business units, or clients.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills with the ability to quickly understand complex or technical information and translate it for external audiences.
  • Strong visual judgment and working knowledge of Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or comparable design platforms.
  • Experience creating and editing short-form video and other platform-native content.
  • Strong proficiency with LinkedIn and familiarity with X, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience using social media scheduling, content calendar, analytics, and project management tools.
  • Strong community management skills with the judgment to determine when an interaction requires escalation or broader internal follow-up.
  • Excellent organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple brands, channels, deadlines, and stakeholder requests.
  • Highly curious and adaptable, with the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, industries, services, and technical concepts.
  • Proactive working style with the judgment and confidence to recommend ideas, identify opportunities, and move work forward independently.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI and emerging technologies to support research, ideation, content creation, and workflow efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B, engineering, infrastructure, energy, technology, industrial, data center, or other technical environments.
  • Experience managing social media across a multi-brand organization, agency portfolio, or multiple business units.
  • Experience supporting executive social media or thought-leadership accounts.

  • Photography or videography experience for events, client sites, or company activities.
  • Experience collaborating with business development or sales teams and connecting social media activity to broader commercial objectives.

Application Requirements

You will partner directly with the COO to design and execute our specialist network strategy: identifying target markets, recruiting top-tier providers, negotiating agreements, ensuring credentialing readiness, and driving long-term engagement and performance.

About the role

We are looking for an accomplished Chief Information Officer to lead the global information systems and technology organisation of an international, service-oriented university.

Reporting directly to the President and serving as a member of the executive leadership team, the CIO will define and execute the technology strategy supporting the University’s mission, operational excellence and long-term international growth.

The role includes end-to-end responsibility for:

  • Product Management

  • Software Engineering and Enterprise Applications

  • Data and Analytics

  • AI Transformation

  • Enterprise Architecture

  • Infrastructure and Cloud

  • Cybersecurity

  • IT Operations

The successful candidate will be an experienced enterprise technology leader who has previously served as a CIO, or in an equivalent executive role, within a mature and operationally complex global organisation.

Key responsibilities

Technology strategy and executive leadership

  • Define and execute a multi-year global information systems and technology strategy aligned with institutional priorities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the President and executive leadership team on technology, transformation, investment, risk and innovation.

  • Translate the University’s strategic vision into clear technology priorities, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with senior leaders across functions and geographies to ensure organisational alignment and successful execution.

Organisational leadership

  • Lead and develop a distributed global technology organisation of approximately 50 professionals.

  • Build strong leadership capability, succession depth and a high-performance culture.

  • Recruit, retain and develop senior technology talent.

  • Foster accountability, collaboration and inclusion across international teams.

Product management and digital platforms

  • Lead the strategy and lifecycle management of internally developed platforms and systems.

  • Define product roadmaps aligned with the needs of students, faculty and staff.

  • Partner with academic and business leaders to improve digital experiences and operational outcomes.

  • Ensure continuous improvement, scalability and long-term product value.

Engineering and enterprise applications

  • Oversee software engineering, quality assurance, DevOps and enterprise applications.

  • Promote modern engineering practices, scalable architecture and reliable delivery.

  • Drive platform modernisation, cloud adoption and optimisation of the technology ecosystem.

  • Guide build, buy or partner decisions based on strategic value, cost, risk and return on investment.

AI transformation

  • Define and lead the University’s responsible AI strategy.

  • Identify and implement practical AI use cases across academic and administrative functions.

  • Ensure appropriate governance, security, integration and ethical use of AI.

  • Use AI to improve decision-making, efficiency and the experience of students, faculty and staff.

Data and analytics

  • Define and execute the enterprise data strategy.

  • Establish effective governance, quality, ownership and security standards.

  • Build scalable analytics capabilities supporting consistent, data-driven decision-making.

  • Improve access to trusted information across the organisation.

Infrastructure, cybersecurity and IT operations

  • Lead the global technology environment, including cloud infrastructure, networks, end-user services and operational support.

  • Ensure secure, resilient and reliable systems across all locations.

  • Strengthen cybersecurity, privacy, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, security and technology standards.

Vendor and investment management

  • Lead technology vendor strategy, procurement, contracting and performance management.

  • Manage the technology investment portfolio and prioritise initiatives based on strategic impact.

  • Optimise cost, quality, operational resilience and long-term value.

  • Clearly communicate the business case and return on technology investments.

Candidate profile

The ideal candidate will combine strategic vision with the ability to lead complex execution across technology, operations and organisational change.

They should demonstrate:

  • Enterprise-level strategic leadership

  • Strong executive influence and stakeholder management

  • Successful delivery of large-scale transformation

  • Deep understanding of modern technology ecosystems

  • Strong business, financial and value-management orientation

  • Experience building and developing global technology teams

  • A forward-looking approach to AI, data and digital innovation

  • Strong governance, cybersecurity and risk-management awareness

  • The ability to operate effectively in a complex, customer-facing organisation

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

  • At least15yearsof progressive leadership experience in information systems and technology.

  • Previous experience as a CIO or in an equivalent executive technology leadership role.

  • Experience within a mid-sized or large international organisation.

  • End-to-end responsibility for enterprise systems, digital platforms and technology operations.

  • Proven success defining and executing enterprise technology strategies.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex organisational and digital transformation.

  • Experience operating in a customer-facing or B2C environment.

  • Strong track record of aligning senior stakeholders and leading change across distributed organisations.

  • Fluent English.

Strong advantage

Experience within:

  • EdTech

  • Higher education

  • Online learning

  • Digital learning platforms

  • Student-centric technology environments

  • International service-oriented organisations

The opportunity

This is an opportunity to shape the global technology direction of an international university and lead a broad transformation agenda covering product, engineering, data, AI, infrastructure and cybersecurity.

The CIO will have direct access to the President, significant executive influence and real ownership of the systems and capabilities supporting the organisation’s future growth.
