jobs.description:
About Impact Investment Exchange (IIX)

IIX (Impact Investment Exchange) is a Singapore-headquartered pioneer in impact investing, connecting capital markets with sustainable development. For over a decade, IIX has been building the infrastructure for impact by structuring innovative financial instruments, running donor-funded development programs, and developing digital platforms that serve impact investors, enterprises, and communities across Asia and beyond.

Our work spans impact-linked securities, blended finance, gender-lens investing, and climate finance, always with the goal of mobilizing private capital for social and environmental good. We are a lean team committed to our mission. Everyone wears several hats, and the pace is fast. If that appeals to you, you’ll do well at IIX.

About the role

IIX structures impact-linked funds, bonds and credit transactions, runs donor-funded programs and operates across multiple Southeast Asian jurisdictions with a lean team, so it needs a senior lawyer who can own legal risk end to end. This role is IIX’s senior in-house counsel for transaction, commercial, litigation, employment and compliance matters across Singapore HQ, Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, Kenya, the Philippines, Sri Lanka and Vietnam among other jurisdictions and deals also with funders from Australia, Canada, Sweden, the United States and elsewhere. Success means deals close on time on enforceable documentation, compliance gaps are caught before they become problems, reliance on external counsel is targeted and cost-controlled, litigation is managed effectively, and business teams see Legal as an enabler rather than a bottleneck.

Key Responsibilities:

Transactions, Contracts & Credit Documentation

  • Draft, review and negotiate commercial, partnership and collaboration agreements, NDAs, MOUs, service contracts and grant or donor-funding agreements.
  • Lead legal documentation for IIX’s capital-markets and lending activity, including fund, bond and note documentation, loan and credit agreements, security documents and term sheets, working with external counsel where required.
  • Negotiate directly with counterparties, and set and maintain IIX’s standard templates, preferred positions and fallback positions.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk

  • Draft, review and maintain internal and external-facing policies (e.g., AML/KYC, anti-bribery and corruption, data protection, safeguarding) and monitor compliance by IIX and third parties.
  • Track regulatory developments in Singapore, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam and elsewhere relevant to IIX’s activities, and lead legal risk assessments and compliance reviews.
  • Support corporate and entity matters, including entity set-up, relocation or restructuring as IIX expands into new markets.
  • Conduct multi-jurisdictional legal research and turn findings into clear, practical guidance.

Strategic Advisory & External Counsel Management

  • Advise leadership on strategic matters, new products and market entry, giving clear, risk-weighted recommendations rather than lists of issues.
  • Select, instruct and manage external counsel across jurisdictions, including scoping work and controlling legal spend.
  • Manage disputes and pre-litigation matters, and development of litigation strategy and coordination and oversight of litigation counsel.

Legal Operations

  • Own the contract repository, template library and approval workflow, using document management and legal tech tools to improve turnaround and record-keeping.
  • Build playbooks and run short trainings so non-legal teams can handle routine matters.

Experience & Skills

  • Law degree and admission as a lawyer in your jurisdiction, with 8+ years’ post-qualification experience at a leading law firm, in-house at a bank, fund, DFI or impact organization, or a combination.
  • Strong drafting and negotiation skills across commercial contracts, employment law and finance or credit documentation (loans, bonds, security).
  • Working knowledge of the laws of at least one of Indonesia, India, the Philippines, Singapore or Vietnam, or a common law jurisdiction including Australia, Canada, the UK or the US; exposure to other emerging markets and a relevant regional language are a plus.
  • Track record managing external counsel, disputes or cross-border expansion and restructuring, and advising senior management directly, with some litigation exposure.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across cultures and to deal with complex issues without clear answers.
  • Native-level proficiency in English.

The Person

  • Commercial and pragmatic: gives a clear answer and a recommendation, not just a list of risks.
  • Writes and speaks plainly, and can translate legal issues for non-lawyers.
  • Self-directed and highly organized; manages a high-volume, multi-jurisdiction workload with little supervision, with high integrity throughout.
  • A team player, ready to roll up sleeves and get done what needs to be done, whether or not in the JD, as IIX is a dynamic organization with a lean team, so tasks can change daily.
  • Interested in impact investing, gender-lens and climate finance, and motivated by work with measurable social outcomes.

THE PREM FRAMEWORK

Every IIX team member is a PREM professional. We look for these qualities in everyone we hire:

P

Passionate

Mission-driven & purpose-led

R

Resilient

Thrives under pressure & ambiguity

E

Equitable

Champions fairness & inclusion

M

Maverick

Bold, entrepreneurial thinker

Why Join IIX?
  • Work at the intersection of law, finance, and impact.
  • Join a diverse and mission-aligned team reshaping capital markets.
  • Gain experience in global, cross-sector legal and credit documentation practices.
  • Opportunity for professional growth within a pioneering sustainable finance institution

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please send your CV, a brief cover note and a short redacted drafting sample. In your cover note, tell us about a complex agreement or cross-border matter you led: what the key legal risk was, how you negotiated or resolved it, and the outcome. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted, and your personal data will be used strictly for recruitment purposes.

IIX is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team that reflects the communities we serve.

ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology is central to how 321 competes and grows. From our CRM and automation programs to 321 AIM, our proprietary performance marketing platform, the systems we build are a core part of the value we deliver. The Chief Technology Officer is the executive who sets the vision for that technology and turns it into a lasting competitive advantage.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Chief Technology Officer at 321, you will own the agency's technology vision, strategy, and execution at the executive level. This is a C-suite role with company-wide authority — you'll shape how 321 builds, buys, secures, and monetizes technology, lead the technology organization, and help define the agency's direction as a member of the executive leadership team.

The right person for this role thinks in platforms and business models, not just systems. You understand that the right architecture decisions compound over years, that proprietary technology and data can become defensible products, and that AI is reshaping what an agency can deliver and how it should be priced. You're as comfortable advising on a High Level or Salesforce architecture as you are presenting a multi-year technology strategy to ownership, investors, or enterprise clients — and you build the organization that executes it.

You'll provide executive technology leadership in partnership with 321 AIM, guiding platform architecture, scalability, and roadmap decisions so that our proprietary technology and client service delivery grow together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Executive Leadership & Technology Vision

  • Define and own the agency's multi-year technology vision and strategy, aligned with company growth goals, service offerings, and market positioning
  • Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to company strategy, annual planning, and major business decisions
  • Own the technology budget, including platform, licensing, infrastructure, and headcount investments, with clear return-on-investment expectations
  • Lead build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for major platforms and capabilities
  • Report on technology performance, risk, and investment outcomes to ownership and, where applicable, investors or a board

Technology Organization & Talent

  • Build, lead, and scale the technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration
  • Design the organizational structure, leadership roles, and hiring plan needed to support the agency's growth
  • Set the culture, engineering standards, and operating principles for how technology is built, shipped, and supported across the agency
  • Develop leaders within the technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and clear career paths

Proprietary Platforms & Product Strategy

  • Provide executive technology leadership for 321 AIM in partnership with its leadership, guiding platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and roadmap priorities
  • Identify opportunities to turn repeatable agency solutions, data assets, and automations into proprietary products, platforms, or productized services
  • Oversee product development practices, including requirements, release management, quality assurance, and technical documentation
  • Protect and grow the agency's technology intellectual property

AI Strategy & Innovation

  • Set the company-wide AI strategy, positioning 321 as a leader in AI-powered marketing, CRM, and performance services
  • Govern responsible AI use, including data privacy, model selection, accuracy standards, and client disclosure practices
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that create new service lines, improve margins, or strengthen client outcomes
  • Partner with department leaders to embed AI into creative, paid media, CRM, reporting, and agency operations

Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk

  • Own the agency's enterprise architecture across internal systems, client platforms, data infrastructure, and integrations
  • Lead the information security program, including policies, access management, vendor risk, incident response, and business continuity
  • Ensure agency and client technology meets regulatory and contractual requirements in healthcare, insurance, legal, and other regulated industries, including HIPAA, business associate agreements, TCPA, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Guide the agency toward formal security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as client and growth needs require

Data Strategy & Measurement

  • Define the agency's data strategy, including how client, campaign, and performance data is collected, governed, stored, and used
  • Oversee the measurement and attribution infrastructure that connects marketing activity to closed revenue for clients
  • Build the data foundation needed to support performance-based pricing, benchmarking, and predictive insights across the client portfolio

Client, Partner & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the agency's senior technology executive with clients, partners, and prospects — including CMO, CIO, and ownership-level audiences
  • Lead the technology narrative in new business pitches, RFP responses, and strategic client relationships
  • Build and manage strategic technology partnerships with platforms such as High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, and Meta
  • Lead technical due diligence for partnerships, acquisitions, or major client engagements as the agency grows

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 12+ years of experience in technology leadership, with demonstrated depth in MarTech, CRM architecture, data infrastructure, and platform or product development — agency, MarTech, or SaaS experience strongly preferred
  • At least 5 years in an executive or senior technology leadership role (CTO, VP of Technology or Engineering, or Director overseeing multiple teams), including building and scaling technology organizations
  • Proven track record of setting technology strategy and delivering measurable business results, including revenue growth, margin improvement, or new product lines
  • Experience leading the development of proprietary platforms or software products, from architecture and roadmap through launch and scale
  • Deep understanding of CRM and marketing automation ecosystems — High Level strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot also valued
  • Strong command of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure), APIs, integrations, and data platforms
  • Experience leading security and compliance programs in regulated industries, including HIPAA; SOC 2 or similar framework experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated leadership in AI strategy and adoption, including LLM-powered products or workflows, with sound judgment on governance and responsible use
  • Experience owning technology budgets, vendor strategy, and build-versus-buy decisions
  • Executive-level communication skills — able to present technology strategy to ownership, investors, boards, and enterprise clients with clarity and credibility
  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing, remote, multi-client environment with competing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience; advanced degree a plus

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Chief Technology Officer reports directly to the CEO and is a member of the agency's executive leadership team. This role leads the full technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration. The CTO partners with 321 AIM leadership on platform strategy and works closely with the SVP of Strategy, Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director to align technology with client delivery and agency growth.

COMPENSATION

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

That's what makes us a de-risked operator and a category-defining company.

We sit at a rare intersection: software, hardware, real estate, energy systems, and live site operations. The work is concrete and the stakes are real. jobs.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Dans ce rôle, tu seras au cœur de l’expérience employé : c’est toi qui assures un support fiable, humain et efficace pour toute l’équipe de Workleap. Tu touches à une belle variété de demandes, de la gestion des accès et des outils SaaS à l’administration du parc informatique, et ton objectif reste simple : aider vite et bien.

Au quotidien, tu analyses et résous des enjeux techniques, puis tu documentes ce que tu apprends pour que toute l’équipe en profite. Tu as aussi voix au chapitre : si tu vois une façon d’améliorer un processus ou un outil, tu la proposes, et on l’essaie rapidement.

Tu travailles main dans la main avec l’équipe sur les incidents et les projets ponctuels, en gardant tes priorités claires dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et c’est exactement ce qui rend le poste stimulant.

Ton impact :

  • Assurer un support fiable et humain à toute l’équipe de Workleap, pour qu’elle retrouve rapidement sa productivité et que l’expérience employé reste au cœur de nos priorités ;
  • Prendre en charge la gestion des accès et des outils SaaS, afin que chaque nouvelle personne soit opérationnelle dès son premier jour et que nos accès demeurent sécurisés ;
  • Maintenir le parc informatique (rotation, déploiement, inventaire) pour garantir des équipements fiables et à jour à l’ensemble de l’équipe ;
  • Documenter et structurer les connaissances de l’équipe, pour réduire les demandes répétitives et permettre à chacun.e de résoudre plus vite ;
  • Intégrer l’IA dans ton quotidien (Claude, automatisations Slack, skills) pour accélérer la résolution des demandes et libérer du temps pour des projets à plus forte valeur ;
  • Proposer et mener des améliorations de processus et d’outils, afin d’augmenter l’efficacité de l’équipe et l’expérience utilisateur.

Ton équipe

Dans les prochains mois, notre priorité est d’offrir un support rapide, humain et constant à une entreprise en transformation, tout en réduisant le travail répétitif. Concrètement, on travaille sur les profiles, on déploie One Login pour simplifier l’accès de toute l’équipe à ses outils et on automatise la coordination des demandes. Le défi, c’est de garder une excellente expérience pour nos collègues pendant que les volumes et les besoins augmentent. Notre ambition : mieux documenter, automatiser ce qui peut l’être (Slack, Jira Assets) et faire de chaque technicien.ne un point de contact fiable et autonome.

On est une équipe de sept, composée de technicien.ne.s, d’un.e administrateur.trice système, d’un.e administrateur.trice endpoint et d’un.e gestionnaire, qui travaille en français et en anglais selon les besoins. On communique surtout par Slack, de façon directe et sans trop de cérémonie. On partage l’information, on s’entraide et on reste curieux : chacun.e peut proposer des améliorations ou tester de nouveaux outils. On prend des décisions rapidement et on les ajuste en cours de route.

Ce que tu apportes

  • Bilinguisme français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, car tu soutiendras des client.e.s internes qui parlent les deux langues ;
  • Solide expérience en support TI de première et deuxième ligne, avec un excellent sens du service et de la communication ;
  • Aisance avec les environnements Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, la gestion d’accès et les outils SaaS (SSO, MDM, ticketing) ;
  • Connaissance de la gestion de parc informatique (déploiement, inventaire, cycle de vie des équipements) sur Windows et macOS ;
  • Mindset builder : tu documentes, tu structures et tu automatises ce qui est répétitif plutôt que de le refaire à la main ;
  • À l’aise avec l’IA au quotidien (Claude, assistants, automatisations) pour résoudre plus vite et créer de nouveaux outils pour l’équipe ;
  • Atout : expérience avec Jamf, Jira / Jira Assets ou Slack, ou notions de scripting (PowerShell, Python) ou d’automatisation no-code.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 68 000$ - 85 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

Required Skills:

  • Machine Learning

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.

  • Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

Required Qualifications:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

  • Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.

  • Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process:

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure:

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability:

Typically, roles are filled within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The RoleUnlock Health is seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize our modern cloud data platform.
jobs.description:
The Role

Unlock Health is seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to build, maintain, and optimize our modern cloud data platform. This role develops reliable data pipelines, integrates diverse sources, and delivers high-quality datasets for analytics, reporting, and business decisions.

The ideal candidate brings strong SQL skills, experience with Snowflake and/or Google BigQuery, working Python knowledge, and an interest in automation, troubleshooting, and responsible AI-assisted development.

Applicants must reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the United States to be considered for this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using Snowflake, Google BigQuery, SQL, and Python.
  • Ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, cloud storage, marketing platforms, and third-party sources.
  • Build reusable data models and transformation workflows using SQL, dbt, and established engineering practices.
  • Implement data validation, quality checks, monitoring, and troubleshooting for reliable delivery.
  • Automate manual processes and improve pipeline performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Use tools such as Fivetran, Supermetrics, and cloud services for data integration when appropriate.
  • Use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools for development, debugging, testing, and documentation; validate outputs for accuracy and security.
  • Collaborate with data architects, analytics teams, and stakeholders to deliver trusted, analytics-ready datasets.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience developing and supporting production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and/or Google BigQuery, with the ability to learn and support both platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python for data processing, automation, and API integrations.
  • Familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Google Cloud environments.
  • Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, Git, and data quality practices.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fivetran, Supermetrics, or similar integration tools.
  • Tableau or comparable business intelligence platforms.
  • ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI-assisted development tools.
  • CI/CD, orchestration, automated testing, or data governance.
  • Marketing, advertising, CRM, or healthcare data integrations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver reliable, automated, and well-documented data pipelines.
  • Improve data quality, processing efficiency, and platform reliability.
  • Build reusable solutions that reduce manual maintenance.
  • Collaborate effectively with technical and business teams.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive salary; health, dental, and vision benefit packages.
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance; FSA/HSA options.
  • 401(k) with company match; flexible paid time off; paid parental leave.
  • Hybrid and remote schedules; employee assistance and referral programs.

About Us:

Unlock Health is a full-service marketing communication agency, grounded in technology, built for healthcare - and integrated with a managed care consultancy with deep revenue strategy expertise. We brought together leading healthcare firms to solve a core challenge: aligning brand, marketing, technology, and revenue strategy so healthcare organizations can attract and retain patients, grow brand equity, and protect their margins. We help our clients do everything from patient acquisition and brand building, to simplifying complex martech ecosystems, and creating digital experiences. Our work is rooted in clarity, authenticity, and a deep understanding of what moves healthcare forward.

Equality Opportunity Employer Statement
Unlock, and its affiliate companies, is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
